5. ( the fat needs to be hot before you add the mixture ) Pour equal amounts of the mixture into each case  and place in the oven Cook for 20-25 mins Serve with all roast meats ( don't  forget the lashings of gravy ) Please enjoy   from Cathy the Northern Cook.

title: Caribbean Cowpeas And Rice
content:
Recipe Name: Caribbean Cowpeas And Rice
Description: Make and share this Caribbean Cowpeas and Rice recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: black-eyed peas, Onion, Clove, Cumin, Thyme, bay leaf, long-grain rice, vegetable broth, Tomatoe, allspice, Salt
Instructions:
1. Soak peas.
2. COmbine peas with onion, jalapeno, garlic, cumin, thyme, bay leaf and 2 cups water.
3. Boil.
4. Reduce and simmer.
5. Add rice, broth, tomato, allspice and salt.

title: Carnation Lean Fettuccine Alfredo
content:
Recipe Name: Carnation Lean Fettuccine Alfredo
Description: Make and share this Carnation Lean Fettuccine Alfredo recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: fettuccine, Olive Oil, Garlic, Milk, Parmesan Cheese, fresh dill, fresh chives, Nutmeg, Salt, Pepper, asparagus, smoked salmon, Lemon Juice
Instructions:
1. In a large pot of boiling water, cook the fettuccine for 8-10 minutes until  tender but firm.
2. Drain.
3. In a non-stick skillet, heat oil and cook garlic for 30  seconds.
4. Add to drained pasta along with milk and cheese. Cook over medium heat, stirring gently for four to five minutes, until sauce is thickened.
5. Remove from  heat and let stand two to three minutes to thicken more. Stir in dill and chives and season with salt and pepper.
6. Stir in blanched  asparagus, salmon and lemon juice. Garnish each serving with more freshly grated Parmesan, if desired.

title: Caramel Rice Pudding
content:
Recipe Name: Caramel Rice Pudding
Description: Make and share this Caramel Rice Pudding recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: short-grain rice, Brown Sugar, Butter, Milk, Nutmeg
Instructions:
1. Wash the rice well and drain.
2. Mix with remaining ingredients and put in a buttered baking dish and bake in a slow oven 140 C for 2 - 2 1/2 hours, until rice is tender and creamy.
3. Stir every 30 minutes during cooking and add more milk if necessary.
4. When ready, the milk and cream should be a rich, caramel cream and a golden crust should have formed.
5. Serve hot or cold.
6. This can be cooked in individual dishes if wished and just eat from them.
7. You can use brown, raw or demerara sugars.

title: Caramel Apple Milkshakes
content:
Recipe Name: Caramel Apple Milkshakes
Description: Make and share this Caramel Apple Milkshakes recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: frozen yogurt, 1% low-fat milk, applesauce, Cinnamon
Instructions:
1. Place the yogurt, milk, cinnamon, and topping in a blender.
2. Cover and blend  until smooth.
3. Pour into 4 glasses.
4. Serve immediately.

title: Butterscotch Apple Dumpling
content:
Recipe Name: Butterscotch Apple Dumpling
Description: Make and share this Butterscotch Apple Dumpling recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: green apples, self rising flour, Salt, Sugar, Butter, Water, Butter, Brown Sugar, golden syrup, Water
Instructions:
1. Sift flour and salt.  Add sugar.  Rub in butter, then add water and mix to a soft dough.
2. Peel and quarter apples.
3. Divide pastry into 8 equal portions.
4. Roll out each portion of pastry and wrap each around an apple quarter.
5. Place in an oven proof dish.
6. Combine sauce ingredients in saucepan and bring to boil.
7. Pour sauce over pastries in dish.
8. Bake 25-30 minutes in  a moderate oven, about 325 degrees Fahrenheit.  Serve with ice cream.

title: Buttermilk-Oat Bread
content:
Recipe Name: Buttermilk-Oat Bread
Description: Make and share this Buttermilk-Oat Bread recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Buttermilk, Honey, Butter, Margarine, bread flour, rolled oats, Salt, active dry yeast, bread machine yeast
Instructions:
1. For toasted rolled oats, place oats in a shallow baking pan.  Bake at 350 for 15 to 20 minutes or till oats are lightly browned, stirring occasionally.   Cool.
2. Add all of the ingredients to a bread machine according to manufacturer's  directions.   Bake the bread using the regular or white setting.

title: Blueberry Pancake Syrup
content:
Recipe Name: Blueberry Pancake Syrup
Description: I've made this blueberry syrup several times, but I bet it would work well for raspberries. It's worth a try!
Ingredients: Blueberrie, Water, lemons, rind of, Sugar, Lemon Juice
Instructions:
1. Pour the blueberries into a saucepan and crush them with a potato masher or a wooden spoon until most of the skins are broken.
2. Add 1 cup of water  and strips of lemon peel and bring to a simmer.
3. Turn heat down to low and cook the berries for 5 minutes at just under a simmer.
4. Pour the hot berries into a strainer lined with two layers of cheesecloth and let the blueberry juice drip through.
5. Twist the cloth to extract all the juice; there should be about 2 cups.
6. Discard the berry pulp.
7. Combine the remaining  2 cups water with the sugar in a small saucepan.
8. Bring the mixture to a boil, stirring, until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture is clear.
9. Wash down the sides of the pan with a wet pastry brush, then boil the syrup, without stirring, until it reaches 260 degrees on a candy thermometer.
10. Add the blueberry syrup to the sugar syrup and bring the mixture to boil.
11. Boil for 1 minute.  Let the syrup cool, then add lemon juice to taste. Pour the syrup into two pint jars and refrigerate if you plan to use it in a month or two.
12. To can (for indefinite storage) Pour into canning jars with 1/2 inch headspace.  Process in hot water bath for 30 minutes.
13. Cool.

title: Chanfana Ou Lampantana
content:
Recipe Name: Chanfana Ou Lampantana
Description: This dish was typical of the Beira provinces in Mozambique where it was served at large gatherings. This dish is best prepared a day in advance and reheated. It is preferable to use an iron pot, but a good quality oven proof pot will do. Lamb may be used instead of goat.
Ingredients: bacon, Olive Oil, Onion, Paprika, Clove, Nutmeg, bay leaf, Parsley, Garlic, piri-piri, red wine
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.  Place the meat and bacon in a pot and add the oil and lard.  Add the onions, spices, herbs and seasonings.    Cover completely with the wine. Cover the pot and place it in a very hot oven (200 degrees C) for 1 hour.
2. Remove the lit and stir.   Add more wine if necessary.
3. Cover the pot again and reduce the oven temperature of 100 degrees C.
4. Continue cooking, preferably overnight or until the meat is tender.
5. (The time taken will depend on the age of the lamb or goat.)  Serve with potatoes boiled in their Jackets.

title: Cheesecake Cupcakes With Blueberries
content:
Recipe Name: Cheesecake Cupcakes With Blueberries
Description: Make and share this Cheesecake Cupcakes with Blueberries recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cream Cheese, Sugar, Egg, Sour Cream, Vanilla, lemon, rind of, Flour, Blueberrie
Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 325 degrees.Line 12 muffin cups with foil liners.
2. Place a cookie in bottom of each liner; trim cookies to fit if necessary.Beat together cream  cheese and sugar on med.
3. speed in large bowl until smooth.
4. Add eggs, beating  just until blended.
5. Beat in sour cream, vanilla and lemon rind.
6. On low speed,  beat in flour.
7. Stir in blueberries.
8. Spoon batter into cups, dividing  equally.Bake for 35-40 min., until cakes are set. Cool cakes in pan on rack for  20 min.
9. Remove cakes to rack to cool.
10. Refrigerate.                    - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

title: Chicken And Pineapple Salad With Curry Mayonnaise
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken And Pineapple Salad With Curry Mayonnaise
Description: This is nice, I have used ordinary roast chicken. CHICKEN AND PINEAPPLE SALAD WITH CURRY MAYONNAISE
Ingredients: barbecued chicken, Coconut, unsweetened pineapple slices, Onion, curry powder, five-spice powder, Clove, Ginger, Mayonnaise, coconut milk
Instructions:
1. CURRIED MAYONNAISE:
2. Combine all ingredients thoroughly.
3. CHICKEN AND PINEAPPLE SALAD:
4. Toast coconut on oven tray in moderate oven for about 5 minutes.
5. Cut chicken and pineapple into chunks; place in bowl, mix in coconut, shallots and Mayonnaise.
6. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.
7. Serves 4.
8. Cheers,  Doreen Doreen Randal,  Wanganui.
9. New Zealand.

title: Carrie'S Pizza Rolls
content:
Recipe Name: Carrie'S Pizza Rolls
Description: Make and share this Carrie's Pizza Rolls recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: dry yeast, Water, Honey, white flour, Water, Clove, Tomatoe, tomato sauce, Mozzarella Cheese, Parmesan Cheese, romano cheese, Olive Oil, Salt, Pepper, Oregano, Basil
Instructions:
1. Dough: Dissolve yeast with honey and 1/2 cup  water; let stand 10 minutes.
2. Put 4 cups flour in large  mixing bowl; stir in oil, water and yeast mixture. Mix   thoroughly.
3. Knead 8 to 10 minutes.
4. Let dough rise 1 hour until  doubled.
5. Punch  down and roll on floured surface to about 1/2- inch.
6. Cut into rectangles about 4 x 6-inches or desired size of  pizza roll.
7. Sauce: Place all ingredients (except  the  Mozzarella cheese) in a crock-pot and simmer on low for  about 2 hours.
8. Let cool to room temperature. Hot sauce will  make dough soggy.
9. Rolls: Place a small amount of sauce on the  dough rectangles, spreading it to cover the entire   piece of dough.
10. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over half of the  dough.
11. Roll up the  dough burrito-style, sealing edges with  moistened fingers.
12. Place rolls on a  cookie sheet. Allow to rest for  about 10 minutes.
13. Bake in a hot 500 degrees  oven until  dough is golden brown.
14. Serve rolls with a side bowl of hot pizza  sauce  for dipping the pizza rolls inches.
15. These freeze beautifully.
16. Can be   reheated in the microwave. Variations: You may wish to add slices of  mushroom,  olive, shredded beef, pepperoni slices or  whatever in addition to the  Mozzarella cheese inside the pizza roll.

title: Almond Fudge Banana Cake
content:
Recipe Name: Almond Fudge Banana Cake
Description: Make and share this Almond Fudge Banana Cake recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: DOLE® Banana, Sugar, Margarine, Egg, amaretto liqueur, Vanilla Extract, All-Purpose Flour, Baking Soda, Salt
Instructions:
1. Mash bananas and set aside.  Beat sugar and margarine until light and fluffy.
2. Beat in eggs, liqueur and vanilla.
3. Combine dry ingredients.
4. Stir in almonds.
5. Add to sugar mixture alternately with bananas.
6. Beat well.
7. Pour batter into greased 10-inch Bundt pan.
8. Bake in preheated 350°F oven 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out almost clean and cake pulls away from side of pan.
9. Cool 10 minutes.
10. Remove cake from pan to wire rack to cool completely.
11. Drizzle glaze over top and down side of cake.  Make 16-20 servings.

title: Cherry Tomatoes On Provolone Garlic Bread
content:
Recipe Name: Cherry Tomatoes On Provolone Garlic Bread
Description: Make and share this Cherry Tomatoes on Provolone Garlic Bread recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Tomatoe, Scallion, Parsley, rosemary, Garlic, extra virgin olive oil, extra virgin olive oil, Garlic, provolone cheese, Parmesan Cheese
Instructions:
1. For the tomatoes, mix tomatoes, scallions, parsley, rosemary, garlic, olive oil and vinegar in a shallow bowl.
2. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Cover bowl and let tomatoes marinate at room temperature for at least 1 hour, but preferably 3-4 hours.
4. Stir occasionally to distribute seasonings.
5. For the bread, combine olive oil and garlic and let mixture stand for about 10 minutes so flavors can mingle.  Meanwhile, heat the broiler.
6. Brush one side of each bread slice with garlic and olive oil mixture and broil them oiled-side up until lightly browned.
7. Put a slice of provolone and a generous sprinkling of Parmesan on each slice, reserving a little of the parmesan for garnish.
8. Set aside.  Just before serving, heat up broiler again and toast cheese until bubbly.
9. Serve bread in shallow bowls, spooning about 3/4 cup of tomatoes and marinade over each slice, garnishing with remaining parmesan.

title: Cheesy Chicken Noodle Casserole
content:
Recipe Name: Cheesy Chicken Noodle Casserole
Description: Make and share this Cheesy Chicken Noodle Casserole recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chicken breasts, Olive Oil, Velveeta cheese, Pepper, Salt, parsley flakes, Pepper
Instructions:
1. Cook egg noodles in boiling water till chewy.
2. Cook chicken in olive oil, and  Lawry salt till chicken is not pink in middle, then drain oil.
3. Combine cream of chicken soup, egg noodles, and chicken till boiling.
4. Reduce heat, and add  Velveeta cheese, corn, and pepper.
5. Cook until all of Velveeta is melted.
6. Remove from heat and sprinkle with parsley flakes.

title: Caramel Sultana Square
content:
Recipe Name: Caramel Sultana Square
Description: Make and share this Caramel Sultana Square recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Sugar, Egg, Flour, baking powder, sultana, Butter, golden syrup, Sugar
Instructions:
1. Cream butter and sugar, add egg then dry ingredients.
2. Divide shortcake in two.
3. Press one half in tin.
4. Melt together and pour over base.  Sprinkle with sultanas and cover with remaining mixture.  Bake in a moderate oven 20 - 30 minutes.

title: &Quot;21&Quot; Apple Pie
content:
Recipe Name: &Quot;21&Quot; Apple Pie
Description: Make and share this "21" Apple Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: All-Purpose Flour, Salt, Unsalted Butter, apple, Lemon, dark brown sugar, light brown sugar, Cinnamon, Egg
Instructions:
1. Add the cold butter cubes and, with a pastry blender, blend in the flour until mixture becomes mealy ans butter forms peas-size nuggets plainly visible in the flour.
2. The water should be added to the flour slowly to ensure that only the minimum amount of water is used.
3. Do not over-mix the dough.
4. When the dough has been mixed just sufficiently to combine the ingredients, form it into a ball and wrap in a piece of plastic wrap and refrigerate for several  hours.
5. To prepare the filling, melt the butter in a large saute pan until it  begins to brown.
6. Add the sliced apples and cook over medium heat until they begin to soften, about 2 to 3 minutes.
7. In a bowl, combine the lemon juice, sugars, Southern Comfort, and  cinnamon.
8. Add this mixture to the apples and cook 2 to 3 minutes over medium-high heat until the apples are completely caramelized and covered with all the sugar.
9. Remove filling from the heat and  allow to cool.
10. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.
11. When ready to use, remove the dough from the refrigerator, lightly flour a pastry board and a rolling pin, and unwrap the dough.
12. Divide the dough into 2 equal pieces and begin to roll out into a circle by rolling evenly outward from the center and turning   the dough in small 1/8th turns to keep the rolling even.
13. When the  dough is  rolled out to an even thickness and is about 12 inches in  diameter and 1/8-inch thick, it is ready to be transferred to a 10-inch pie pan or plate.
14. Lightly butter the pie plate, partially roll the dough up on the rolling pin, lift the dough and center it in the pie pan and unroll.
15. Roll the second half of the pie dough into a round slightly larger than the pie pan.
16. Fill the bottom crust with the cooked apples using a slotted spoon to drain the apples.
17. Reserve juices if desired, for sauce. Brush an egg wash coating over the lip of the dough.
18. This is where it will be sealed to the top  crust. Cover the apples  with the top half of the pie dough.
19. Trim any excess  from the top  crust before using both hands to crimp the edges of the two crust together to seal.
20. With a sharp knife, make several crosshatch slits in the top  crust. Brush with the egg wash and bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
21. Remove from the oven and cool 20 minutes.
22. Serve with vanilla ice cream.
23. Reserved juices can be reduced with heavy cream for a sauce for the pie.

title: Bugwiches
content:
Recipe Name: Bugwiches
Description: A little bit of fun for the kids this summer. Happy Hunting! Deborah Bugwiches: Whatever filling you choose to put between the top and bottom of your dinner rolls, your little critters are sure to get the shivers when they sit down to eat. You'll want to slice your vegetables a variety of ways in order to make such body parts as legs and antennae, and scales and eyes. What you'll need:
Ingredients: Carrot, lettuce, Cucumber, radish, Raisin, Mayonnaise, Celery, tuna salad, salmon salad
Instructions:
1. How to assemble: Slice roll horizontally, about 1/2 inch from bottom.
2. Pull out  bread from top half, leaving walls about 1/2 inch thick.
3. Place cucumber or  radish slices over bottom halves of rolls, sticking out slightly to make mouths  or tongues.
4. Spoon a mound of filling on top and cover with top halves of rolls.
5. Insert carrot sticks into filling for legs.
6. Make two slits on each side of top  half of bun and insert lettuce leaves as wings.
7. Decorate with vegetable pieces  for eyes, antennae, scales and other body parts.
8. Attach using mayonnaise.

title: All-Purpose Crock Pot Chicken
content:
Recipe Name: All-Purpose Crock Pot Chicken
Description: I discovered this one a few weeks ago. I started out trying to make chicken and rice and ended up with this. It is very tender and very good. An excellent make-ahead dish for summer. All the work is done before the crock pot is even warm. This is excellent for fajitas, pasta salads, chicken salad, soup, added to beans and rice, just laying on bread for chicken sandwiches, or just eating cold.
Ingredients: Chicken, lemon pepper, Salt, bell pepper, Celery, Carrot, Green Onion, Garlic, Water
Instructions:
1. If using thigh portions or a cut up fryer, etc, remove all skin and as much fat  as possible. I boil the skins with garlic for the dog.
2. There is no need to bone  the chicken.
3. Put about 1/4 inch water in the slow cooker.
4. Rinse the chicken  well, getting into the crevices, and sprinkle with the Cajun seasoning on both  sides.
5. Go easy at first; this is NOT low-salt and it tends to be a little spicy.
6. I start immediately placing the chicken in the slow cooker.
7. I rinse one piece,  season both sides, and layer it in the pot. When you are done seasoning all the  chicken (I generally do 2-3 lbs in a batch; less is not worth the time), cover  the pot and let the chicken stand for 30 minutes.
8. At the end of that time, cover the chicken fully with water (don't skimp) and set the cooker on \"Low.\" Cooking time is up to you.
9. A minimum of 8-10 hours is what I recommend.  I  usually set the chicken cooking in an afternoon, and let it cook overnight.  Often it will cook for 12-24 hours.
10. This is an excellent dish for those of us  who never learned to properly debone a chicken ;) At the end of the cooking  time, merely pull out the chicken pieces and separate the bones from the meat.  It will literally fall apart. Save the broth for adding to mashed potatoes,  gravy, rice or soup.
11. You will have a good deal of chicken here. Separate into  smaller portions and freeze.

title: Anise Toast
content:
Recipe Name: Anise Toast
Description: Make and share this Anise Toast recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Egg, Sugar, Flour, Salt, baking powder, Vanilla
Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, beat all eggs, then add sugar, oil, and remaining ingredients.
2. Spread the batter on a cookie sheet. Place in 350° oven for 20 minutes.
3. Remove from oven and cut into squares while it is still hot.
4. Put back into oven for 5 minutes  and remove. Makes a great little add on to ice cream and other flavorful desserts.

title: Amish Friendship Bread And Starter
content:
Recipe Name: Amish Friendship Bread And Starter
Description: Many recipes have been posted for the Amish bread, but none have included the starter, so I thought I'd send this along. Happy baking! Amish Friendship Bread and Starter
Ingredients: Sugar, Milk, Flour, Milk, Egg, Vanilla Extract, Flour, Sugar, baking powder, Cinnamon, Salt, Baking Soda, instant vanilla pudding, Cinnamon, Sugar
Instructions:
1. Place ONE cup each sugar, milk, and flour in large glass or plastic bowl.
2. Cover lightly with plastic wrap and set on your counter at room temperature. Stir with a wooden spoon everyday for 17 days.
3. On day 18 do nothing.
4. On days 19, 20, and 21, stir.
5. On day 22, add 1 cup sugar, 1 cup milk, and 1 cup flour, and stir again.
6. On days 23, 24, 25, and 26 stir.
7. On day 27, add 1 cup milk, 1 cup flour, and 1 cup sugar and stir.
8. It's now ready to use to make the bread.
9. Give away two cups of the starter to two friends, use one to make the bread, and keep one to keep the starter going.  When you give away a cup of the starter, give these directions for keeping it going:  Do not refrigerate; Do not use metal spoon or metal bowl; Do not cover tightly, cover loosely with plastic wrap.
10. AMISH FRIENDSHIP BREAD:  Mix oil, eggs, and vanilla with the starter mix.
11. In a separate bowl, mix flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, baking soda, vanilla pudding mix, and nuts.
12. Add to liquid mixture and stir thoroughly.
13. Pour into two large well-greased 9x5 inch loaf pans, or one Bundt pan, that have been sprinkled with a mixture of cinnamon, sugar, and flour.
14. Sprinkle more cinnamon and sugar on the tops of the unbaked loaves (or cake).  Bake at 325F for one hour or until done.

title: Amish Cornbread
content:
Recipe Name: Amish Cornbread
Description: Make and share this Amish Cornbread recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Amish Friendship Starter, Egg, Milk, Sugar, Flour, cornmeal, Baking Soda, Salt, baking powder
Instructions:
1. Combine all above in large bowl and beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
2. Add:  oil, baking soda, salt, and baking powder Mix well and pour in well greased 9\" pan.
3. Bake at 425*F 25-30 minutes.

title: Light Cucumber Soup
content:
Recipe Name: Light Cucumber Soup
Description: Make and share this Light Cucumber Soup recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cucumber, nonfat sour cream, low sodium chicken broth, Onion, fresh parsley, fresh dill, dill weed, Lemon Juice, white pepper
Instructions:
1. Cut cucumbers into large chunks; place in a blender with remaining ingredients.
2. Puree; pour into bowl.
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.

title: Cold Celery
content:
Recipe Name: Cold Celery
Description: Make and share this Cold Celery recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Celery, Salt, Soy Sauce, Brown Sugar
Instructions:
1. Wash the celery and cut into 1 inch lengths.
2. Put into a large pan, cover with cold water and bring to the boil, drain and immediately cover with water.
3. Chill completely under cold running water.
4. Drain.
5. Add the salt, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
6. Mix well and serve chilled.

title: Coconut-Lemon Macaroons
content:
Recipe Name: Coconut-Lemon Macaroons
Description: Make and share this Coconut-Lemon Macaroons recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Coconut, Sugar, Lemon Juice, lemons, rind of, Flour
Instructions:
1. In a medium pan combine coconut, sugar, 1 egg white, lemon rind and strained lemon juice.  Stir over a low heat until lukewarm, cool.
2. Beat remaining egg whites until soft peaks form.
3. Gradually fold egg whites into cooled mixture.  Add sifted flour, combine gently.
4. Place mixture in heaped teaspoonfuls on greased oven trays which have been lightly dusted with cornflour.
5. Bake in slow oven 30 minutes.
6. Cool on trays.

title: Chicken Flambe
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Flambe
Description: Make and share this Chicken Flambe recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, Onion, portabella mushroom caps, dry white wine, Butter, Margarine, Flour
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to  350  F.
2. Lightly season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
3. In a large skillet over medium heat, brown chicken breasts on both sides.
4. Add onions and mushrooms and stir cook until the onions soften.
5. Transfer mixture to a shallow casserole dish and bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes.
6. In a small sauce pan warm the orange liqueur over low heat (should be lukewarm, not hot). Take the casserole out of the oven.
7. Pour the liqueur over the chicken and vegetables and ignite it. When the flames die out, add the wine and return the casserole to the oven for another 15 minutes or until chicken breasts are no longer pink inside. Remove the casserole from the oven.
8. Arrange the chicken and vegetables on a warm platter and keep hot. Mix butter and flour to make a paste. Stir this into the pan juices, add cream and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes until thickened.
9. Pour sauce over chicken.
10. Serve with wild rice and vegetables.

title: Chicken Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Curry
Description: Accompany curry with pappadams and chutney. This particular combination of spices, which includes cardamom and cinnamon, gives a mild heat and rich fragrance to the dish. You can adjust the spices to suit your taste.
Ingredients: /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), red pepper flakes, turmeric, Ginger, Clove, Salt, Black Pepper, Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, Butter, Ginger, Garlic, Onion, Cinnamon, bay leaf, cardamom pods, Tomatoe, Sour Cream, golden raisin, fresh cilantro, basmati rice, Pecan, mango chutney
Instructions:
1. In a dry skillet over medium heat, toast coriander and cumin  seeds until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
2. Transfer to spice grinder, add  crushed red-pepper flakes, and grind to a powder.
3. Place in a small  bowl, and add turmeric, ginger, cloves, salt, and black pepper.
4. Add  chicken, and toss to coat. Heat peanut oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.  Add  chicken, cooking until browned, 3 to 5 minutes.
5. Remove chicken.
6. Set  aside. Reduce heat, and add ginger, garlic, and onions.
7. Cook until  softened and deep-brown in color, 8 to 10 minutes.
8. Add cinnamon  sticks, bay leaf, and cardamom pods; cook for 10 minutes.
9. Add  tomatoes, chicken stock, and cooked chicken.
10. Raise heat to medium  high, and cook until liquid is reduced, about 15 minutes.
11. Meanwhile,  toast pappadams.
12. Reduce heat to low, and stir in yogurt and  raisins.
13. Cook until warmed throughout; add cilantro.
14. Serve with  basmati rice, and garnish with cashews.

title: Chicken Goulash On A Sour Cream Crust
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Goulash On A Sour Cream Crust
Description: Make and share this Chicken Goulash on a Sour Cream Crust recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Olive Oil, Onion, Chicken, Paprika, seasoned flour, tomato paste, red wine, Sour Cream, Butter, Sour Cream, Egg, self raising flour, Parsley
Instructions:
1. Lightly saute the onions in 1 Tbsp of the oil until golden.
2. Meanwhile place the seasoned flour and paprika in a mixing bowl, add the chicken to coat.  Remove the onions from the pan, Add the rest of the oil and saute the chicken for 2 - 3 minutes.
3. Return onions to the pan, add the tomato paste, wine and stock.
4. Bring to the boil and simmer for 6 - 7 minutes.
5. Remove pan from the heat and stir in the yoghurt.  (This can be made in advance and stored in the refrigerator.) CRUST Place the butter, sour cream and egg into a bowl, mix to combine. Stir in the flour and parsley to form a soft dough.
6. Press the dough into a lightly greased casserole or flan dish, working it well up the sides to a thickness of 12 mm.
7. Spoon the filling, cover and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.
8. Uncover and bake for a further 10 minutes or until golden and crusty.

title: Chicken In Pizza Dough
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken In Pizza Dough
Description: Make and share this Chicken in Pizza Dough recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chicken breast, Egg, active dry yeast, Sugar, Salt, Water, All-Purpose Flour
Instructions:
1. Prepare pizza dough (see recipe following).  While dough rises, prepare baked  chicken and vegetables.
2. After dough has risen and chicken has finished baking,  turn  dough onto a lightly floured board.
3. Cut off a small piece of  dough the  size of a tennis ball to use for a top decoration.
4. Form remaining dough into a  ball and roll out to a 12 x 17-inch  rectangle. Place chicken, breast side down, in the middle  of the dough.
5. Arrange vegetables around chicken.
6. Wrap sides  and  ends of dough over chicken.
7. Turn right side up and place  on a baking sheet.  Brush surface with beaten egg.
8. Roll out  reserved piece of dough.
9. Using a cookie cutter, cut out a  design and place on top of dough wrapped chicken.
10. Brush with  egg.
11. Bake in pre-  heated 425 degrees oven for 30 minutes, until  golden brown.
12. To serve, let everyone tear off the bread, then cut up  the chicken.
13. PIZZA DOUGH: Dissolve yeast, sugar and salt in warm water.
14. In  large bowl,  combine 2 cups of flour and yeast  mixture; beat with an electric mixer several  minutes.
15. Stir in enough  additional flour to make a stiff dough.
16. Turn out on a   floured board and knead 5 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place  dough in a  lightly oiled bowl; turn to coat surface of dough  with oil.
17. Cover with a damp  cloth and let rise in a warm  place until double in bulk (about 2 hours).

title: Chicken Lasagna
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Lasagna
Description: Make and share this Chicken Lasagna recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Onion, Green Pepper, Skim Milk, fresh mushrooms, pimiento, dried basil, nonfat cottage cheese, Mozzarella Cheese, Parmesan Cheese, Chicken, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions:
1. Mix filling ingredients in large bowl.
2. Spread 1 cup filling on bottom of each of 2 8x8 pans.
3. Cook noodles for 3 min (or not at all). Break noodles to fit pans and layer over filling.
4. Repeat. Evenly divide remaining filling for the final layer.
5. Sprinkle with paprika.
6. Freeze. To serve, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top and bake from frozen to done for 1-2 hours at 400 deg.

title: Chicken Liver Pate
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Liver Pate
Description: Make and share this Chicken Liver Pate recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Cream Cheese, chicken liver, Onion, Chicken Broth, brandy, Paprika, Salt, cayenne pepper
Instructions:
1. Bring liver, onions, chicken broth, brandy to boil.
2. Cook 5 min.
3. Put in  blender.
4. Add paprika, salt and cayenne pepper.
5. Blend on high.
6. Add butter and cream cheese. Pour in a mold or container.
7. Let stand covered in refrigerator until  firm about 3 hours.
8. Serve with crackers or party rye.                    - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

title: Chicken Liver Pate Ii
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Liver Pate Ii
Description: Make and share this Chicken Liver Pate II recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chicken liver, Heavy Cream, Butter, Onion, Garlic, allspice, bay leaf, Pepper, dried funghi porcini, white mushrooms, madeira wine, cognac, shallot
Instructions:
1. Marinate livers in the cognac overnight. Drain Soak dried mushroom in hot water  for 1 hour.
2. Drain it squeezing out all the liquid Melt 1 tbs butter in a pan Add the livers, onion, mushroom and garlic. Cook until almost all the red has  disappeared.
3. Add the cream, the funghi,  and the spices and cook to reduce by  half over high heat. Turn off heat, process everything and mix in the butter  while still hot..
4. Pour into a mold and refrigerate If you like you may top it  with gelatin

title: Coconut Shrimp With Orange Mustard Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Coconut Shrimp With Orange Mustard Sauce
Description: Make and share this Coconut Shrimp With Orange Mustard Sauce recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: shrimp, All-Purpose Flour, Salt, Pepper, Paprika, beer, Coconut, orange marmalade, orange marmalade, Dijon mustard
Instructions:
1. Peel and devein the shrimp leaving the tails intact. Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika in a medium bowl, stirring well.
2. Make a well in center of the flour mixture. Gradually add beer stirring until batter is smooth.
3. Dip shrimp in batter then dredge in the coconut. Fry shrimp in hot oil until lightly browned.
4. Drain in paper towels.
5. Orange Mustard Sauce:  Combine marmalade, juice and mustard in a small bowl, stirring well.  Makes 1 cup.
6. Jan.

title: Chicken Liver Pate Iii
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Liver Pate Iii
Description: Make and share this Chicken Liver Pate III recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chicken liver, Unsalted Butter, Onion, Salt, white pepper, brandy, Heavy Cream, bacon
Instructions:
1. Using a large skillet, sweat the livers in 4 oz of the butter.
2. After 3 minutes,  add the onion, salt, and pepper.
3. Cook until the livers are just off-pink.
4. Set  aside and hold warm.
5. Line a 2 l/2quart mold with a single layer of the bacon  slices.
6. Chill the mold.
7. Puree the liver and onion mixture in a food processor.
8. Gently warm the remaining butter.
9. Add to the livers with the brandy and cream.
10. Mix again to assure uniformity Pour into the well-chilled mold.
11. Place the mold  in a water bath that reaches to I in.
12. (2.5 cm) from the top of the mold.
13. Bake  45-60 minutes at 3250F (1630C) until the pate sets.
14. Shake the pan gently to  observe the texture. A metal cake tester should come out clean.
15. The time will  vary depending on the thickness of the mold.
16. Record the time for future  reference. Remove from the oven and water bath.
17. Cover and chill for a minimum of 12 hours.
18. Unmold, plate, and garnish for presentation.

title: Appetizers-Easy Stuffed Mushrooms
content:
Recipe Name: Appetizers-Easy Stuffed Mushrooms
Description: Hi, Here is a great recipe for Stuffed Mushrooms that is easy to make and is usually goes over well. You can make these a day ahead and bake before serving.
Ingredients: fresh mushrooms, Butter, Celery, Onion, Worcestershire Sauce, parsley flakes, Salt, Oregano
Instructions:
1. Wash and dry the mushrooms.
2. Remove and chop the stems.
3. Melt butter in a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat.  Add the mushroom stems, celery and  onion.
4. Saute until the onion is translucent, stirring occasionally.
5. Stir in the bread crumbs, Worcestershire Sauce and seasonings.
6. Mound the stuffing onto the mushroom caps.
7. Arrange caps on a greased baking sheet.  Bake for 5-7  minutes, or until thoroughly heated.
8. If you like mushrooms, you will like this!

title: Anzac Biscuits
content:
Recipe Name: Anzac Biscuits
Description: These biscuits (cookies in America) are called Anzacs because they were baked by Australian women and sent to their ANZAC soldier sons/husbands serving in Europe and Middle east during WW I. It was more like 2 months before they were received back then, so they certainly do travel well! :-) ** Please note that 1 Australian Tablespoon = 20 mls whereas in most others countries it = 15 mls. Anzac Biscuits
Ingredients: rolled oats, plain flour, Sugar, golden syrup, Butter, bicarbonate of soda, Water
Instructions:
1. Mix oats, flour, sugar and coconut together.
2. Melt syrup and butter together.
3. Mix the bicarb with boiling water and add to butter and syrup mixture.  Add this to dry ingredients.
4. Place tablespoonsful of the mixture on a greased oven slide (cookie sheet).  Bake at 150 - 160 C (300-325F) for 20 minutes.
5. Good luck.

title: Ancho Chile Rub
content:
Recipe Name: Ancho Chile Rub
Description: Make and share this Ancho Chile Rub recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: dried ancho chiles, mild chili powder, hot chili powder, chimayo chili powder, cayenne pepper, Black Pepper, Salt, chipotle paste
Instructions:
1. Combine ancho chiles, mild chili powder, hot chili powder, chimayo chili powder, cayenne pepper, black pepper, salt, and chipotle paste in a large bowl.
2. Makes about 2 cups.

title: Amish Six Layer Dinner
content:
Recipe Name: Amish Six Layer Dinner
Description: Make and share this Amish Six Layer Dinner recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: ground beef, raw potatoes, Celery, Onion, Salt, Pepper, Green Pepper, Tomatoe, Onion
Instructions:
1. Grease a casserole dish.
2. Sprinkle each layer with salt and pepper before adding the next layer.  Place potatoes in the bottom of the casserole.  Add the layer of  celery.  Add the layer of hamburger.  Add the layer of onions.  Add the green  pepper.
3. Pour the tomatoes over the mixture.
4. Bake for 2 hours at 350°F (I  cover with foil after about an hour).

title: Chicken On Sunday  (Or Whenever)
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken On Sunday  (Or Whenever)
Description: Make and share this Chicken on Sunday (Or Whenever) recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Minute Rice, Milk, chicken parts, Salt, Pepper, Curry
Instructions:
1. Grease large 9x13-inch pan.
2. Heat soups and milk together in a large saucepan.
3. Stir in Minute Rice (you want the mixture to be rather juicy). Pour into 9x13-inch pan.
4. Place chicken part on top and then sprinkle with seasoning salt, pepper and curry lightly.
5. Cover all with foil.
6. Bake at 325°F for 2 hours and 15 minutes.
7. I have baked this on a higher temp with less baking time but, you have to watch that you don't make the rice get hard and crusty by doing so.

title: Chicken Pot Pie Lasagna
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Pot Pie Lasagna
Description: Make and share this Chicken Pot Pie Lasagna recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Chicken, fresh mushrooms, Carrot, Onion, frozen green pea, Thyme, Salt, All-Purpose Flour, Skim Milk, dry sherry, low-fat ricotta cheese, part-skim mozzarella cheese, lowfat swiss cheese
Instructions:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions.
2. Spray a Dutch oven or large   skillet with cooking spray; place over medium-high heat until hot. Add  chicken  and saute 4 minutes or until cooked through.
3. Drain well and set  aside.   Recoat Dutch oven with cooking spray and place over medium-high heat until   hot. Add  mushrooms, carrots and onions; saute 6 minutes.
4. Set aside.  Place flour in a  medium saucepan.
5. Gradually add milk, stirring with a wire   whisk until blended; stir in sherry.
6. Bring to a boil over medium heat and  cook for 5 minutes or  until thickened, stirring constantly.
7. Stir in salt  and  red pepper.
8. Reserve one cup of sauce and set aside.  In a bowl, combine ricotta cheese, 1 cup mozzarella cheese and Swiss  cheese.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
9. Spread 1 cup of the  sauce over the bottom of  a  13 x9 x 2-inch pan.
10. Arrange 4 pieces of the lasagne (3 lengthwise, 1  widthwise)over the sauce. Top with half of ricotta cheese  mixture, half of   chicken mixture and half of remaining sauce mixture.   Repeat layers, ending with 4 pieces of lasagne. Spread reserved 1 cup of  sauce over  the last complete layer of lasagne, being sure to cover the  lasagne completely.
11. Cover lasagne with foil and bake 1 hour.
12. Uncover  lasagne,  sprinkle remaining  1/2 cup mozzarella cheese on top and bake an additional  5  minutes uncovered.
13. Re-cover and let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Roll-Ups
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Roll-Ups
Description: Make and share this Chicken Roll-Ups recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Chicken, Cream Cheese, Butter, Margarine, Onion, chives, pimiento, Milk, Salt, Pepper, croutons, Butter, Margarine
Instructions:
1. Boil chicken until done and no pink remains.
2. Cool and chop into  small cubes.
3. In a large bowl, mix together the cream cheese, butter, onion,  pimento, milk,  salt, and pepper.
4. Stir in chicken and set aside.  Open crescent rolls and place each piece of dough flat on a  lightly greased baking sheet.  Place several  tablespoons of chicken mixture on the center of  each piece of dough.
5. Roll up  dough around the chicken mixture making sure are  edges are sealed.
6. Dip each  chicken roll in melted butter and roll in the crushed  croutons or corn flakes  (optional). Place on baking sheet.  Bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes or  until golden brown.
7. Serve with chicken gravy if desired.
8. To make chicken  gravy add 1 can cream of chicken soup to a  small saucepan.
9. Add 1 tablespoon  fresh lemon juice and stir well.
10. Add milk or sour cream to thin to desired  consistency.
11. Cook over  low heat until hot. Serve over chicken roll-ups.

title: Chicken Supreme With Mushrooms
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Supreme With Mushrooms
Description: Make and share this Chicken Supreme with Mushrooms recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Onion, Mushroom, dry white wine, tomato puree, Chicken
Instructions:
1. Melt 15g of the butter in a pan.
2. Add the onions and saute until soft. Add the  mushrooms and salt and pepper to taste and cook until soft. Add the wine, tomato puree and stock and continue cooking, stirring, until the liquid is well  concentrated; chill.
3. Beat out the chicken breasts to an even thickness and place each one on a sheet of foil.
4. Divide the mushrooms mixture between them and dot  with the remaining butter.
5. Fold the foil over the top and seal the edges.
6. TO FREEZE Place parcels on a baking sheet and freeze, then pack in a plastic  bag.
7. Seal, label and return to the freezer.
8. TO SERVE Place the foil parcels on a baking sheet. Cook from frozen in a  preheated hot oven, 220 C , for about 1 hour.
9. Remove the foil and sprinkle with  parsley.

title: Cola Roast
content:
Recipe Name: Cola Roast
Description: Make and share this Cola Roast recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Salt, Pepper, garlic powder, chili sauce, Worcestershire Sauce
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325F.
2. In a small bowl, combine the salt, pepper, and garlic powder; rub over surface of roast.  In a Dutch oven, heat the oil to hot and brown roast on all sides.
3. Transfer roast to roasting pan.
4. Combine all the remaining ingredients; pour over roast.  Cover and roast for 2 1/2-3 hours until tender.

title: Cola Cake
content:
Recipe Name: Cola Cake
Description: Make and share this Cola Cake recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Flour, white sugar, Baking Soda, Buttermilk, Butter, Margarine, Vanilla, Egg, miniature marshmallows
Instructions:
1. Beat all but eggs and marshmallows for two minutes.
2. Add eggs and beat two minutes more.  Stir in marshmallows.
3. Bake in 9 X 13 pan for 35 minutes.
4. FROSTING: 1/2 cup butter or margarine  3 tablespoon cocoa 1 pound powdered sugar 1/3 cup Coke or Pepsi 1 cup chopped nuts Mix butter, cocoa, sugar and Coke well together and add chopped nuts.
5. Pour over hot cake.

title: Chicken Sate With Peanut Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Sate With Peanut Sauce
Description: We prefer the chicken breasts whole, with the sauce accompanying, but you can cut it into chunks and skewer it if you prefer. The sauce is SO good that I eat the leftovers with a spoon! (Also very good on toasted English muffins...)
Ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, Soy Sauce, Lime Juice, Butter, Onion, Olive Oil, cayenne, Soy Sauce, Sugar, Garlic, Ginger, Salt, Lime Juice
Instructions:
1. Combine butter, 1/4 cup soy sauce, coriander, and 2 Tbsp lime juice. Marinate chicken in this while you make peanut sauce:  Saute onion and garlic in oil  until tender.
2. Cool.
3. Place in blender, add everything else, and blend carefully.
4. Slowly and carefully add enough boiling water to form a thick paste.  Now, broil chicken until done, basting with marinade.  Serve with peanut sauce.

title: Coconut Crunch Beans
content:
Recipe Name: Coconut Crunch Beans
Description: Garden-fresh beans receive an exotic twist with a lightly spiced crunchy coconut and sesame seed topping.
Ingredients: sesame seeds, Butter, unsweetened coconut, chili powder, turmeric, Salt, green beans
Instructions:
1. In nonstick skillet, cook sesame seeds, stirring, over medium heat for 2 minutes or until slightly golden.
2. Stir in half of the butter until melted.
3. Stir in coconut, chili powder, turmeric and salt; cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until coconut turns deep golden.
4. (Coconut mixture can be stored in airtight container at room temperature for up to 24 hours.) In large pot of boiling salted water, cook beans for 3 minutes; drain well.
5. (Beans can be prepared to this point, chilled under cold water, drained and refrigerated in towel-lined airtight container for up to 24 hours.) In nonstick skillet, melt remaining butter over medium heat; cook beans for about 3 minutes or until tender-crisp.
6. Toss with coconut topping.

title: Coconut Chicken Bites
content:
Recipe Name: Coconut Chicken Bites
Description: Make and share this Coconut Chicken Bites recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chicken breast, Coconut, Flour, Salt, Black Pepper, garlic powder, Egg, Butter
Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 400°F.
2. Mix flour, coconut, salt, pepper and garlic powder together.
3. Dip chicken bites in the egg, then in the flour mixture. Place the chicken bites onto a greased cookie sheet or baking pan.
4. Drizzle with melted butter.
5. Bake approximately 25 minutes or until the chicken is browned and cooked through.
6. Turn once during cooking.
7. This is good served with an apricot or plum dipping sauce.  Jan.

title: Chocolate Pound Cake
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Pound Cake
Description: I am resending this recipe. This is the corrected version! I really made a goof up on the original. Sorry about the mistake I've made.
Ingredients: boiling water, Vanilla, Egg, cake flour, Sugar, Sugar, baking powder, Salt, Unsalted Butter
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Use a 8 x 4 x 2 1/2\" loaf pan, (4 cups) or any 6 cup loaf  pan or fluted tube pan, greased and floured.
3. In a medium mixing bowl whisk  together the cocoa and water until smooth.
4. Allow to cool to room temperature  and lightly whisk in the vanilla and eggs.
5. In a large mixing bowl combine the  remaining dry ingredients and mix on low speed for 30 seconds to blend.
6. Add 1/2  the chocolate mixture and the butter.
7. Mix on low speed until the dry  ingredients are moistened.
8. Increase to medium speed and beat for 1 minute to  develop the cake's structure.  Scrape down the sides.
9. Gradually add the  remaining chocolate mixture in 2 batches, beating 20 seconds after each addition to incorporate the ingredients and strengthen the structure.  Scrape down the  sides.
10. Scrape the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the surface with a  spatula.
11. The batter will be almost 1/2 inch from the top of a 4-cup pan.
12. (if your  pan is slightly smaller, use any excess batter for cupcakes.)  Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, (40 to 50 minutes in a fluted tube pan) or until a wooden toothpick  inserted in the center comes out clean.
13. Place loosely with buttered foil over  the cake after 20 minutes to prevent over browning.
14. The cake should start to  shrink away from the sides of the pan only after removal from the oven.
15. Let the cake cool in the pan on a rack for 10 minutes.
16. Loosen the sides with a metal  spatula and invert onto a greased wire rack.
17. If baked in a loaf pan, to keep  the bottom from splitting, reinvert so that the top is up and cool completely  before wrapping airtight.
18. TOPPING:  This is for extra moistness and gives a subtle coffee accent.
19. In a  small pan, stir together 1/4 cup water and 2 Tbsp sugar.
20. Bring to a full rolling boil.
21. Cover and remove from heat.  When cool, add 1 tbsp Kahlua.
22. When cake is baked, brush half the syrup onto the top.
23. Cool the cake 10 minutes and invert it onto a lightly greased rack.
24. Brush the bottom and sides with remaining syrup.
25. Reinvert onto rack, top side up, to finish cooling.

title: Chicken With Portabella Mushrooms-
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken With Portabella Mushrooms-
Description: For extra richness, finish with a Tablespoon of butter, My suggestion is to serve with a nice pasta side, salad and fresh baked bread.
Ingredients: chicken breasts, Flour, Olive Oil, Butter, portabella mushroom, Onion, Green Onion, fresh garlic, fresh basil, Oregano, Lemon Juice
Instructions:
1. Dredge the chicken breast pieces in flour and saute in olive oil.
2. In a non stick pan you can get by with very little.
3. Add the onions and mushrooms and saute till soft.
4. Add the lemon juice and fresh herbs, saute for 1 minute  till the flavors  combine.

title: Low-Fat Apple &Amp; Apricot
content:
Recipe Name: Low-Fat Apple &Amp; Apricot
Description: Make and share this Low-Fat Apple & Apricot recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Raisin, dried currant, lemon, rind of, Cinnamon, Clove
Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a 3-quart pot.
2. Simmer uncovered for the better part of an hour, stirring often.
3. Add more juice if necessary and discard spice packet at end of cooking time.
4. Serve warm or chilled.
5. Keeps for days in the refrigerator.

title: Chicken, Mozzarella & Pepper Tarts
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken, Mozzarella & Pepper Tarts
Description: Make and share this Chicken, Mozzarella & Pepper Tarts recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Chicken, Onion, sun-dried tomato, dried basil, Mozzarella Cheese
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 F.
2. In a non-stick skillet, stir cook the chicken just until it turns white. Add the onion, pepper, tomatoes and basil.
3. Continue to stir cook until the onions are tender.
4. Remove from the heat and let cool.
5. Stir the Mozzarella into the cooled chicken mixture then fill the tart shells.
6. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.

title: Cola Fruit And Date Loaf
content:
Recipe Name: Cola Fruit And Date Loaf
Description: --Adopted Recipe-- The original submitter says that this fruity loaf showed up in Coke and Seven-Up cookbooks. The recipe was adapted from "Cooking With Coke" - a publication of the Coca Cola Company. Be sure to make a day ahead of time, because it is best the next day.
Ingredients: dates, Brown Sugar, Flour, Baking Soda, baking powder, Cinnamon, lemon rind, Egg, Vanilla Extract, Pecan
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 Fahrenheit.
2. Generously grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
3. Chop dates.
4. Heat cola to boiling.  Remove from heat and stir in dates, mixing very well.
5. Stir in sugar and oil.  Cool while preparing other ingredients.
6. Stir dry ingredients together and add to cola mixture.  Stir in egg, extract and nuts.
7. Spoon batter into pan.  Bake about 1 hour until cake tests done.  Cool on a rack for 20 minutes then remove from pan and wrap.
8. Store overnight before slicing.

title: Coca-Cola Cake
content:
Recipe Name: Coca-Cola Cake
Description: Make and share this Coca-Cola Cake recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Flour, Sugar, Salt, Baking Soda, Margarine, Buttermilk, miniature marshmallows, Egg, Margarine, Confectioners' Sugar, Vanilla
Instructions:
1. Combine flour, sugar, salt, cocoa and baking soda.
2. In small saucepan, bring butter and Coca-cola to a boil.
3. Add dry ingredients to mixture and then add buttermilk, eggs, and marshmallows.
4. (batter will be thin). Bake in 9x12 inch baking pan at 350 degrees for about 45 to 60 minutes or until tooth pick comes out clean.
5. Topping for coca-cola cake: Combine butter cocoa and coke in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.
6. Pour over sugar and mix well.
7. Add nuts an vanilla.
8. Pour over cake while still hot.

title: Chicken-Fried Steak With Cracked Pepper Gravy
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken-Fried Steak With Cracked Pepper Gravy
Description: Make and share this Chicken-Fried Steak With Cracked Pepper Gravy recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Flour, Salt, Pepper, cayenne, Egg, bock beer, Unsalted Butter, Flour, Milk, Salt, cracked pepper
Instructions:
1. Prepare the flour spice by blending the flour, salt, pepper, and cayenne. Set aside on a plate or wax paper.
2. Prepare the batter by mixing the eggs with a whisk, in a large bowl.
3. Add the cream, and beer. Whisk to blend.
4. Set aside. In a deep, heavy skillet, heat the oil to 350 degrees. While the oil is heating, prepare the round steaks by dredging them in the flour spice, taking care to evenly coat the meat. Shake off any  excess.
5. Dip the meat into the batter, and then again in the flour  spice, evenly coating the batter so it is dry on the outside. When  the oil temperature reaches 350 degrees (when a drop of batter sizzles when dropped in it), gently slide one steak into the hot oil. Cook the steak about 5 minutes.
6. Turn in, taking care not to break  the coating, and cook the meat 5 more minutes, or until the batter is nicely browned. Drain the cooked steak on paper towels. Repeat with the other steaks.
7. Hold the cooked steaks in a 225 degree oven until all four are done. Pour Cracker-Pepper Gravy over the steaks and serve. Yield: 4 servings.
8. CREAM GRAVY Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan.
9. When the foam goes down, whisk in the flour. Continually whisk until the flour cooks, becoming a fragrant light brown.
10. Slowly add the milk, continuing to whisk to  keep lumps from forming.
11. Season with salt and pepper.
12. Simmer gravy for 10 minutes to cook and reduce. Serve hot.

title: Claudi Sanders' Refrigerator Rolls
content:
Recipe Name: Claudi Sanders' Refrigerator Rolls
Description: Make and share this Claudi Sanders' Refrigerator Rolls recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: shortening, Sugar, potato, Milk, cake yeast, Flour, Baking Soda, Salt, baking powder
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400.
2. Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.
3. Add potatoes and cream again.
4. In separate pot,m heat milk to lukewarm, and dissolve yeast.  Pour milk mixture into shortening, sugar and potatoes.
5. Ad enough flour (about 4 cups) to make a like a cake dough consistency.
6. Stir in salt.  Cover.
7. Let rise 2 hours, stir in balance of flour (about 6 to 7 cups), baking soda and powder to make like biscuit dough-knead.
8. Cover and refrigerate 1/2 hour, make into tolls.
9. Let rise until double in size.  Bake about 15-20 minutes.
10. Refrigerate and use over 5 or 6 days.
11. Makes 24 rolls.

title: $20,000 Prize-Winning Chili Con Carne
content:
Recipe Name: $20,000 Prize-Winning Chili Con Carne
Description: Make and share this $20,000 Prize-Winning Chili Con Carne recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Onion, Clove, Budweiser beer, Hunts tomato sauce, Water, chili powder, Cumin, bouillon, oregano leaves, Paprika, Sugar, Flour, cornmeal, Water
Instructions:
1. In large saucepan or Dutch oven, brown half the meat; pour off fat. Remove meat.
2. Brown remaining meat; pour off all fat except 2 Tbsps.
3. Add onion, garlic; cook and stir until tender.
4. Add meat and remaining ingredients except flour, cornmeal and warm water.   Mix well.
5. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer covered 2 hours.
6. Stir together flour and cornmeal; add warm water.   Mix well.
7. Stir into chili mixture.  Cook covered 20 minutes longer.
8. Serve hot.

title: Chilies Corn Muffins
content:
Recipe Name: Chilies Corn Muffins
Description: Make and share this Chilies Corn Muffins recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: All-Purpose Flour, cornmeal, Sugar, Brown Sugar, baking powder, Salt, Skim Milk, soymilk, Egg, green chilies
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400.
2. Spray a standard muffin pan with cooking spray.
3. In medium bowl, whisk flour, cornmeal, both sugars, baking powder and salt.  In medium  bowl, mix remaining ingredients.
4. Make well in dry ingredients.
5. Add milk  mixture and stir until just blended.
6. Divide batter among prepared muffin cups.
7. Bake 15 to 20 minutes, or until top springs back when lightly pressed.
8. Let cool in pan 5 minutes, them loosen edges and turn out on rack and cool completely.

title: Classic Cream Scones
content:
Recipe Name: Classic Cream Scones
Description: You're best off describing scones to a German by saying that they are like a cross between a Kuchen (cake), a Plaetzchen (cookie), and a Broetchen (roll), but are very unique and not really like anything else found in Germany. My German husband *loves* this recipe: Classic Cream Scones (from Simply Scones, by Leslie Weiner and Barbara Albright)
Ingredients: All-Purpose Flour, Granulated Sugar, baking powder, Salt, Unsalted Butter, Heavy Cream, Egg, Vanilla Extract, currants, Raisin, Egg
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425F.
2. Lightly butter a baking sheet. In a large bowl, stir together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.   Cut the butter into 1/2-inch cubes and distribute them over the flour   mixture. With a pastry blender or two knives used scissors fashion, cut in   the butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
3. In a small bowl, stir   together the cream, egg, and vanilla.
4. Add the cream mixture to the flour   mixture and stir until combines.
5. Stir in the currents/raisins (optional). With lightly floured hands, pat the dough into a 1/2-inch thickness on a   lightly floured cutting board.
6. Using a floured 2 1/2-inch-diameter round   biscuit cutter or a glass, cut out rounds from the dough and place them on   the prepared baking sheet. Gather the scraps together and repeat until all   the dough is used.
7. Lightly brush the tops of the scones with the egg mixture,   if desired.
8. Bake for 13-15 minutes, or until lightly browned.
9. Remove the baking sheet to a wire rack and cool for 5 minutes.
10. Using a   spatula, transfer the scones to the wire rack to cool.
11. Serve warm or cool   completely and store in an airtight container.
12. Makes about 14 scones.
13. Variation: Add about 1 1/2 teaspoons of grated lemon peel to the dry ingredients.
14. My variation: Classic Scones 280 grams all-purpose flour 65 g granulated sugar 2 teaspoons baking powder 1/8 teaspoon salt 110 g unsalted butter, chilled 6 tablespoons milk 1 large egg 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar 125 g raisins Preheat oven to 220C.
15. Directions as above.

title: Chinese Chicken
content:
Recipe Name: Chinese Chicken
Description: Make and share this Chinese Chicken recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Chicken, tomato sauce, Soy Sauce, dry sherry, white vinegar, chili powder, Garlic, Ginger
Instructions:
1. Wash and dry chicken.
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients together and mix well.
3. Add the chicken, coat well with the marinade.  Allow to stand several hours or overnight in refrigerator.
4. Place chicken in a baking dish and pour over marinade.  Cover dish with foil.
5. Bake in a moderate oven 1 1/2 hours, remove foil, bake a further 30 minutes, brushing frequently with marinade.

title: Classic Chicken And Coconut Soup
content:
Recipe Name: Classic Chicken And Coconut Soup
Description: Make and share this Classic Chicken and Coconut Soup recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Chicken Broth, unsweetened coconut milk, fresh lemongrass, chicken breast, Lime Juice, jalapeno chile, fresh cilantro
Instructions:
1. Bring first 3 ingredients to boil in heavy medium saucepan.
2. Reduce
3. heat, add chicken and simmer until almost cooked through, turning occasionally, about 12 minutes.
4. Transfer chicken to plate; cool.
5. Remove chicken skin and bones.
6. Cut meat into 1/2-inch pieces.
7. Strain soup through sieve into small saucepan.
8. Add 1 Tbsp lime juice and jalapeno to soup and simmer until reduced to 2 cups, about 20 minutes.
9. Add chicken and simmer just to heat through.
10. Taste, adding more lime juice if desired.
11. Ladle soup into bowls.
12. Sprinkle with fresh cilantro.

title: Chinese Hot And Sour Chicken Noodle Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Chinese Hot And Sour Chicken Noodle Salad
Description: Make and share this Chinese Hot and Sour Chicken Noodle Salad recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chicken breast, dry linguine, Pepper, rice vinegar, Cider Vinegar, Soy Sauce, fresh cilantro, Cucumber
Instructions:
1. In a 5-6 quart pan, bring about 3 quarts of water to a boil.
2. Add chicken, cover  and bring to a boil.
3. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, until meat is  white in thickest part, about 20-25 min.
4. Lift out chicken, let cool and reserve  water.
5. Remove and discard skin and bones*; tear chicken into bite-size shreds.
6. If made ahead, cover and chill chicken and water until next day.
7. Bring water to a boil and add linguine. Boil, uncovered, until just tender to  bite, 6-8 min.
8. Drain; immerse in cold water until cool, then drain well again.
9. Remove any debris from peppercorns.
10. In a 6-8\" frying pan, toast peppercorns over med-low heat until fragrant, 2-3 min.; shake pan often.
11. Pour peppercorns into a  blender and whirl until finely ground.
12. Add chiles and oil to pan; cook over low heat until chiles just begin to brown,  about 3 min.
13. Let cool and add ground pepper, vinegar, soy sauce and cilantro.
14. On a shallow dish, arrange a bed of noodles; cover with cucumber and chicken.
15. Pour dressing evenly over salad and mix to blend.
16. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -  NOTES : * I just use boneless, skinless chicken breasts to start with.

title: Clam - Lobster Bake
content:
Recipe Name: Clam - Lobster Bake
Description: Even if you don't live at the beach, you can enjoy an impressive backyard clambake. Simply substitute a combination of greens and damp cheesecloth for seaweed, firewood for driftwood and heavy duty aluminum foil for the traditional sand covering. About 12 lbs. of mixed greens (collard greens, kale, etc.) and 15 yards of cheesecloth will hold in moisture as food cooks. Three rolls of heavy duty 37 1/2 ft. aluminum foil will both line and seal pit
Ingredients: baking potatoes, sweet potatoes, Pepper, Onion, chicken halves, live lobsters, clams
Instructions:
1. Prepare your favorite clam chowder as an appetizer.
2. Serve clambake with plenty of melted butter, lemons, and watermelon.
3. \"  Detailed directions below.
4. Dig a bow-shaped pit 3 ft. in diameter and 1.5 feet deep in the center.
5. Using crisscross pattern, line with double thickness of heavy duty aluminum foil, then a layer of dry rocks about the size of grapefruit. NOTE: Wet rocks can explode. Build a bonfire on top of rocks in the pit. Use firewood and kindling.
6. Let the fire burn 1.5 to 2 hours or until burned down and rocks are hot. NOTE: Do not use charcoal.
7. Soak corn-on-the-cob (with silk removed) and mixed greens in cold water while fire is burning.
8. Wash clams and set aside. Refrigerate lobster on ice. Peel onions; remove ends.  Oil potatoes.
9. Once fire has burned down, work quickly to prevent rocks from losing heat. Tamp down embers.
10. On top of rocks, layer pit in the following order: Half of the greens, strips of wet cheesecloth, potatoes, corn, onions, chicken halves, live lobsters and clams.
11. Cover food with remaining wet cheesecloth, then greens.
12. Cover pit with heavy duty aluminum foil.
13. Crimp all sides to the edges of aluminum foil used to line the pit. Let food steam cook 40 to 60 minutes.
14. Remove foods immediately when done. Cooking times will vary depending on temperature of rocks.
15. Peek at clams after 40 minutes.  If they are open and lobsters are bright red, dinner is ready.
16. Serve with melted butter and lemon.

title: Civil War Cake
content:
Recipe Name: Civil War Cake
Description: Someone was looking for a cake that didn't have any milk in it. Well I found this one of my mothers. It is got to be over 67 years old. It is really good it tastes like a spice cake. Civil War Cake (or-Eggless, Butterless, Milkless Cake)
Ingredients: Raisin, Water, Sugar, shortening, cake flour, Salt, Cinnamon, Baking Soda, Nutmeg, Clove
Instructions:
1. Combine raisins, sugar, 1 cup of water, shortening, salt & spices in a saucepan.
2. Bring to a boil, simmer 3 minutes, stirring occasionally, then cool till  lukewarm, then add the other cp of water.
3. Dissolve soda in 2 teas.
4. of water, set aside.  Stir sifted & measured flour into raisin mixture & beat until smooth.
5. Add dissolved soda last. Pur into greased floured 13x9 [am & bale 50-55 min.
6. at  350 degrees.
7. It may also be cooked in a tube pan.
8. Serve with whipped cream or caramel frosting.
9. Combine 3/4 cup of brown sugar 1/2 cup of water 1/2 tsp salt in a saucepan.
10. Cook 6 min.
11. stirring often.
12. Cool to lukewarm and stir in 3 Tbsp.
13. of butter.
14. Then gradually stir in 21/4 cups of sifted confectionery sugar, beating until smooth.
15. Stir in 1 teas.
16. vanilla and spread on cake. You will be surprised how good it taste with such little ingredients.

title: Chinese Hot And Sour Pork Soup
content:
Recipe Name: Chinese Hot And Sour Pork Soup
Description: Make and share this Chinese Hot and Sour Pork Soup recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Soy Sauce, white pepper, egg substitute, Cornstarch, bamboo shoot, water chestnut, Carrot, shiitake mushroom, cake tofu, white vinegar, Scallion
Instructions:
1. Bring stock to a simmer.
2. Add soy sauce, pork, mushrooms and chile paste. Simmer  for 10 minute.
3. Add pepper, vinegar, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, fungus and  tofu.
4. Simmer 5 minute.
5. Mix cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water and add.
6. Bring back to simmer and pour  the eggs in a very thin stream over the surface. Let stand for 10 sec. before  stirring in the sesame oil.
7. Serve with a garnish of chopped scallions.
8. NOTE: The pepper, chile paste and vinegar can be varied for taste. I also omit the pork and use less egg.

title: Citrus Glazed Barbecued Pork Loin
content:
Recipe Name: Citrus Glazed Barbecued Pork Loin
Description: Make and share this Citrus Glazed Barbecued Pork Loin recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: canola oil, Onion, Garlic, chipotle pepper, arbol chile, cracked black pepper, Worcestershire Sauce, barbecue sauce, Lemon, Salt, Olive Oil, Salt, cracked black pepper
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. In a small saucepot add canola oil and saute onions and garlic until translucent.
3. Add chipotle and arbol chilies and continue to cook until chiles start to toast.
4. Add cracked black pepper and deglaze with Worcestershire sauce and orange juice; reduce until starts to thicken.
5. Then add in your favorite barbecue sauce, reduce to low heat, and simmer for about 15 minutes.
6. Season with hot sauce, lemon juice and to taste with salt.  Strain barbecue sauce and set aside.
7. On a large sheet pan rub the pork loin with olive oil and season with salt and cracked pepper.
8. Roast in a 350 degree oven (basting with the citrus glaze about every 15 minutes) until the internal temperature is about 140 degrees.
9. Remove from oven and let meat set for about 5 minutes, slice, and enjoy!

title: Citrus Chicken
content:
Recipe Name: Citrus Chicken
Description: Make and share this Citrus Chicken recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chicken breast halves, Lemon Juice, Lime Juice, Sugar, dried oregano
Instructions:
1. Rinse chicken; pat dry.
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
3. Place chicken in plastic bag set in shallow dish.
4. For marinade, combine lemon, lime, and orange juices, oil,  sugar and oregano in small bowl.
5. Pour over chicken; seal bag.
6. Marinate in  refrigerator 4 to 24 hours, turning occasionally.
7. Drain chicken, reserving marinade.
8. Grill chicken on rack of uncovered grill directly over medium coals  12 to 15 minutes or until tender and no longer pink inside, turning once and brushing  occasionally with marinade during first half of cooking.
9. Or, broil on unheated rack of broiler pan 4 to 5 inches from heat 12 to 15 minutes, turning once and  brushing occasionally with marinade during first half of cooking.
10. Discard any remaining marinade.

title: Citrus Baked Halibut
content:
Recipe Name: Citrus Baked Halibut
Description: Make and share this Citrus Baked Halibut recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: halibut steaks, Butter, Onion, Clove, fresh parsley, Salt, Black Pepper, Lemon Juice
Instructions:
1. OVEN COOKING:
2. Rinse halibut in cold water and dry using paper toweling.
3. Arrange  halibut in a 9\" x 13\" oven-proof baking dish.
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
5. In a frying pan, add butter, onion and garlic. Saute until translucent.
6. Remove from heat; stir in parsley, orange rind, salt and pepper.
7. Spread mixture over  halibut steaks.
8. In a small bowl, mix together orange juice and lemon juice.
9. Sprinkle juice over steaks, but be careful not to wash away the onion/garlic  mixture.
10. Bake fish in preheated 400 degree Fahrenheit oven for 20 to 22 minutes, turning over  at about 10 minutes of cooking time.
11. Continue cooking until time expires or until fish flakes easily with a fork.
12. DO NOT OVERCOOK FISH.
13. Spoon hot juices  over fish.
14. Serve at once.
15. MICROWAVE COOKING:
16. Prepare and arrange fish and onion/garlic as above.
17. Reduce orange juice by 2 tablespoons.
18. Cover fish with a clear plastic wrap vented.
19. Cook on HIGH (full power) for 4 minutes.
20. Turn fish over and cook for an additional 3 to 4 minutes on HIGH (full power) or until fish flakes easily with  a fork.
21. Spoon juices over fish and serve at once.
22. If desired, serve with Tartar Sauce.

title: Chinese Plum Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Chinese Plum Sauce
Description: Make and share this Chinese Plum Sauce recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: plums, Onion, Water, Ginger, Garlic, Granulated Sugar, rice vinegar, Cider Vinegar, Salt, Cinnamon, cayenne pepper, Clove
Instructions:
1. In large heavy saucepan, bring plums, onions, water, ginger and garlic to boil over medium heat; cover, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until plums and onions are very tender, about 30 minutes.
2. Press through food mill or sieve and return to clean pan; stir in sugar, vinegar, coriander, salt, cinnamon, pepper and cloves.
3. Bring to boil, stirring; reduce heat to low and simmer until mixture reaches consistency of applesauce, about 45 minutes.
4. Fill and seal jars; process in boiling water bath for 30 minutes.
5. Makes about 4 cups

title: Chinese Meatballs
content:
Recipe Name: Chinese Meatballs
Description: Make and share this Chinese Meatballs recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: shrimp, water chestnut, Green Onion, Soy Sauce, white wine, Salt, Sugar, Cornstarch, Egg, Chicken Broth, napa cabbage
Instructions:
1. Combine pork, shrimp, water chestnuts, ginger, green onion, 1 Tbsp soy sauce, wine, salt, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1 Tbsp cornstarch, and egg.
2. Make twelve meatballs.
3. Heat oil in wok.
4. Add meatballs; cook 6-8 minutes, until browned, stirring occasionally.
5. Transfer meatballs to 5-qt saucepan; discard drippings.
6. Add chicken broth, 2 Tbsp soy sauce and 1/2 tsp sugar.
7. Bring to a boil.
8. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 30 minutes.
9. Meanwhile, core cabbage.  Cut base of leaves into 2\" squares.
10. Cut leafy tops in half.
11. Place over meatballs; cover and simmer 10 minutes more.  Transfer meatballs and cabbage to serving platter.
12. Blend 2 Tbsp cornstarch and 3 Tbsp water, and stir into pan juices cooking until slightly thickened.
13. Add sesame oil and serve over meatballs.

title: Cinnamon Curry Rice
content:
Recipe Name: Cinnamon Curry Rice
Description: Make and share this Cinnamon Curry Rice recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Onion, Potatoe, Carrot, apple, curry powder, Flour, Garlic, Water, Butter, rice, Cinnamon
Instructions:
1. Bring cinnamon to boil in 2 cups water, simmer covered until reduced to 1 cup;  strain, discard pulp, reserve broth.
2. Cook enough rice for 5 persons.
3. Heat butter in a wok, add flour and stir well to mix and thicken; then add curry powder and  stir well to mix; then add a little stock or water and mix well; return to boil, add carrot, potatoes, and apple, cover, simmer on low heat.
4. In a separate wok or pan, stir-fry sliced pork quickly in a little oil along with garlic.
5. Remove and  reserve. When carrots and potatoes are almost done, add cinnamon broth, pork and onions to the pot, return to boil, simmer for a few minutes, then serve over  rice.

title: Chocolate Almond Scones
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Almond Scones
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Almond Scones recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: All-Purpose Flour, baking powder, Sugar, Salt, Butter, Egg, chocolate chips
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Combine flour, baking  powder, sugar and salt.
3. Cut in  butter until it resembles course meal.
4. Add 2  eggs (1 egg is reserved for later use), almond extract and cream.
5. Stir until  soft dough forms; mix in chocolate  chips and toasted almonds.
6. Pat out dough until 3/4  inch thick.
7. Cut into diamond shape; brush  with reserved egg.
8. Place on baking  pan coated with cooking spray.
9. Bake for 10  minutes until lightly browned.
10. Serve warm.

title: Cinnamon Apple Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Cinnamon Apple Salad
Description: Make and share this Cinnamon Apple Salad recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: boiling water, lemon gelatin, applesauce, Cream Cheese, Mayonnaise, Pecan, Celery
Instructions:
1. In a bowl, dissolve candies in water (keep warm until melted).  Add gelatin and stir to dissolve.  Stir in the applesauce and pour half into an 9\" square pan that has been lightly coated with nonstick cooking spray.
2. Refrigerate until firm.
3. Cover and set remaining gelatin mixture aside at room temperature.  Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients and spread over chilled gelatin mixture.  Carefully pour remaining gelatin mixture over cream cheese layer.
4. Chill overnight. Yield: 9 servings This recipe was sent to Reminisce magazine by Lisa Andis.

title: Chunky Tomato Cheese Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Chunky Tomato Cheese Pie
Description: Make and share this Chunky Tomato Cheese Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Tomatoe, cheddar cheese cubes, All-Purpose Flour, Sugar, Salt, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Cut 4 of tomatoes into cubes; slice remaining tomato.
3. On a lightly floured surface roll out pastry; fit into a 9-inch pie pan; flute edges.
4. In a large bowl combine tomato cubes, cheese cubes, bread crumbs, flour, sugar and salt. Toss until well blended.
5. Spoon into pie shell.
6. Bake 30 minutes until cheese cubes melt and tomato cubes are soft.
7. Remove from oven and garnish with tomato slices.
8. Add cheese strips.
9. Return to oven.
10. Bake 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted and tomatoes are soft.  Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Chocolate Bread And Butter Pudding
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Bread And Butter Pudding
Description: I copied this out of a magazine yesterday while at the hairdresser, being made more beautiful (Grin)
Ingredients: Butter, chocolate chips, Egg, Milk, Sugar, sherry wine, Vanilla
Instructions:
1. Cut crusts from bread.
2. Butter and bread, cut into triangles and layer with chocolate in a ovenproof dish.
3. Beat eggs, milk, sugar, sherry and vanilla together and pour over the bread.
4. Leave to stand for 15 minutes to fully absorb liquid.
5. Heat oven to 160 C.
6. Bake for 30 minutes until golden and set.  Dust with icing sugar to serve. Hope it tastes good.

title: Christmas Cranberry Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Christmas Cranberry Salad
Description: Make and share this Christmas Cranberry Salad recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: cranberries, miniature marshmallows, Sugar, apple, seedless grapes, Walnut, Salt
Instructions:
1. Cover marshmallows and cranberries with sugar; chill overnight.
2. Add apples, grapes, walnuts, salt and whipping cream.
3. Chill until ready to serve.

title: Chocolate Caramels
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Caramels
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Caramels recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, Brown Sugar, Salt, corn syrup, Heavy Cream, Vanilla, Butter
Instructions:
1. In a sauce pan over medim heat, add chopped chocolate, sugar, salt, syrup and cream.
2. Cover and boil 5 minutes.
3. Uncover.
4. Boil slowly, stirring constantly,  to firm ball stage (248 degrees Fahrenheit).
5. Remove from heat.
6. Add flavoring and stir until  well blended.
7. Pour quickly over nuts which have been placed in well-buttered  pan.
8. Allow to cool; cut into squares.

title: Chocolatey Raisin Chip Cookies
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolatey Raisin Chip Cookies
Description: Make and share this Chocolatey Raisin Chip Cookies recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Brown Sugar, Sugar, canola oil, Vanilla, Water, Flour, Baking Soda, Raisin, Walnut
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375F.
2. Combine sugars and oil; mix thoroughly.
3. Add vanilla and egg whites; beat well.
4. Stir in water.
5. In separate bowl, combine flour, milk, baking soda, and cocoa powder; add to wet ingredients.
6. Stir in chocolate chips, raisins, and nuts.
7. Drop by heaping teaspoon onto lightly oiled cookie sheets.
8. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
9. Remove from sheets immediately; cool on racks.
10. Makes about 60 cookies.

title: Chocolate-Chocolate Cupcakes
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate-Chocolate Cupcakes
Description: Make and share this Chocolate-Chocolate Cupcakes recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Water, Egg, Skim Milk, powdered sugar, Vanilla Extract, powdered sugar
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350  degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Spray muffin cups with cooking spray.
3. In large bowl, combine cake mix, water, and eggs; beat with an electric mixer for 2-1/2  minutes.
4. Divide batter evenly into muffin cups about two-thirds full.
5. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in centre comes out clean.
6. Let cool in  pan for 10 minutes.
7. Remove from pan; cool another 10 minutes.
8. Gently cut  each cupcake in half horizontally - a serated knife usually works best.
9. Using a  double boiler; mix together chocolate morsels, milk, and cocoa in top; and bring water to a boil.
10. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and cook until morsels are  melted; stirring occasionally.
11. Remove boiler from heat and stir in 2 cups  powdered sugar and vanilla.
12. Gently spread bottom half of cupcakes with 2-3  teaspoons chocolate mixture; cover with top half of cupcake.
13. Sprinkle lightly with remaining powdered sugar.

title: Crock Pot Chocolate Zucchini Nut Bread
content:
Recipe Name: Crock Pot Chocolate Zucchini Nut Bread
Description: This is an adopted recipe. Directions refer to a "bread insert." If you don't have the manufacturer's baking insert with a lid, you can use an 2 pound metal coffee can. Use a double thickness of paper towels as a can cover.
Ingredients: shortening, Sugar, Egg, Vanilla, Baking Soda, Zucchini, Milk, Flour, Walnut
Instructions:
1. Cream sugar and shortening in mixer, beat in eggs one at a time, add vanilla.  Add everything else and mix thoroughly.
2. Pour into a greased crock pot bread insert.  Cook 3 hours on high, or until the bread tests done with a wooden pick.
3. Let stand until it's medium cool to the touch before unmolding.  Serve with butter.  You can also dust the bread with powdered sugar.
4. Possible modifications:  no cocoa; substitute 2 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp nutmeg for cocoa; substitute 1 cup brown sugar for the white sugar.

title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake Dip
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake Dip
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Chip Cheesecake Dip recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Raisin, brandy, Cream Cheese, Vanilla Extract, dark brown sugar, Cinnamon
Instructions:
1. Mix the raisins and brandy until raisins are coated and soak for 15 minutes.
2. In another bowl, beat the cream cheese and whipping cream until well  blended and smooth.
3. Add the vanilla, mixing well.
4. Blend in the brown sugar and cinnamon.
5. Mix in the drunken raisins and chocolate chips, blending well.
6. Garnish with a light dusting of cinnamon.
7. Serve at room temperature.
8. About 3 -3/4 cups dip.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Zucchini Cake recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Egg, Sugar, Vanilla Extract, Butter, All-Purpose Flour, baking powder, Baking Soda, Salt, Buttermilk, Zucchini, Walnut, Butter, Confectioners' Sugar, Vanilla Extract, Milk
Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, beat eggs until fluffy.
2. Add sugar gradually, beating until mixture is thick and lemon-colored.
3. Beat in vanilla and butter.
