4. Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder, soda and salt; add alternately with buttermilk.
5. Beat until smooth.
6. Fold in zucchini and walnuts.
7. Divide batter into four greased and floured 8 or 9-in. round pans.
8. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 to 30 minutes or until top springs back when gently pressed.
9. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove to wire wracks and cool completely.
10. For frosting, beat all ingredients in a large bowl until creamy.
11. Frost between layers and on sides and top of cake.

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Zucchini Bread recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Egg, Sugar, Vanilla Extract, Zucchini, All-Purpose Flour, Salt, Baking Soda, Cinnamon, baking powder
Instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl, beat eggs, oil, sugar and vanilla.
2. Stir in zucchini.
3. Combine dry ingredients; add to zucchini mixture and mix well.
4. Pour into two greased 8x4x3-inch loaf pans.
5. Bake at 350°F for 1 hour or until bread tests done.  Makes 2 loaves.

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Chip Muffins
Description: When I find my bananas getting too ripe I freeze them for later use. Just thaw them in the microwave when you want to use. Here is a recipe for chocolate chip muffins that uses one banana. They even taste healthy :-)
Ingredients: All-Purpose Flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder, banana, Brown Sugar, Egg, Milk, Butter, chocolate chips
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Butter 12 large muffin pans well or line with  paper muffin cups.
3. Sift together all-purpose flour, whole wheat flour, and baking powder. Reserve.
4. Combine mashed banana with brown sugar until smooth.
5. Beat in eggs, milk and melted butter.
6. Stir in dry ingredients only until blended.
7. Quickly stir in chocolate chips. Do not overbeat.
8. Spoon mixture into prepared muffin cups. An ice cream scoop  works  well for this.
9. Bake 25 minutes or until browned slightly.
10. Cool on  racks.
11. Preparation time 15 minutes, Cooking Time 25 minutes, Yield 12 large muffins.
12. RJ's Note: Tested recipe August 31, 1999.
13. I substituted 1/3 cup canola oil instead of butter.
14. The banana and chocolate chips give the muffin a nice flavour and it is not overly sweet.  Tastes almost healthy :-).

title: Chocolate Triumph Of Gluttony Cake
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Triumph Of Gluttony Cake
Description: Recipe Courtesy of Nick Malgeri, Director Baking Program, Peter Kumps Cooking School PAN DI SPAGNA
Ingredients: Egg, Vanilla Extract, Sugar, unbleached all-purpose flour, Cornstarch, Salt, Unsalted Butter, maraschino cherries, Salt, Sugar, Water, maraschino cherry juice
Instructions:
1. In a medium mixing bowl, whisk the yolks with the vanilla extract.  Whisk in half the sugar and continue to beat until very light and  frothy, about 5 minutes.
2. Combine the flour and cornstarch and sift  once to aerate. In a clean, dry bowl, beat the egg whites with the  salt until they hold a very soft peak.
3. Beating faster, add the  remaining sugar in a very slow stream, beating until the egg whites  hold a firm peak.
4. Fold the yolks into the whites.
5. Sift the flour and  cornstarch over the eggs in 3 additions, folding them in gradually.
6. Do not over-mix the batter.
7. Pour the batter into a buttered and  paper-lined 9- or 10-inch round pan, 2-inches deep and smooth the  top.
8. Bake the Pan di Spagna at 350 degrees, 30 to 40 minutes,  until it is well risen and feels firm when pressed gently with the  palm of the hand.
9. Immediately loosen the layer from the side of the  pan with a small knife or spatula.
10. Invert the layer and leave the  paper stuck to it. Turn the layer right side up and cool it on a rack.
11. Double-wrap the layer in plastic and keep it in the refrigerator up to  5 days or freeze it. Variations: Flavor the batter with a grated  orange or lemon zest or a tablespoon of Anisette.
12. For the chocolate filling, bring the cream to a boil and remove the  heat.
13. Add finely cut chocolate, stir once and let stand for 3  minutes.
14. Whisk smooth, pour into a bowl and cool until set, several  hours at a cool room temperature.
15. Set aside.
16. For the syrup, bring  sugar and water to a boil in a small pan.
17. Cool and stir in  Maraschino.
18. For the pistachios, place in a pan and cover with  water.
19. Bring to a boil, drain and rub in a towel to loosen skins.
20. Go over pistachios to separate from skins.
21. Place pistachios on a jelly  roll pan and dry out at 325 degrees about 5 minutes.
22. Cool and  chop coarsely.
23. To prepare the layers, cut the Pan di Spagna into 5  thin horizontal slices.
24. Reserve 2 of the slices, then cut the other  slices into smaller disks, each 1-inch smaller in diameter then the  reserved 2, to make a 9, 8-, and 7-inch disk.
25. Reserve scraps.
26. To  finish the filling, beat the butter by machine until soft and light, then  beat in the cooled chocolate mixture all at once. Beat again until  light, then beat in the Maraschino.
27. Stir in half of the chopped  pistachios.
28. To assemble, place one of the 10-inch layers on a  platter or cardboard and moisten with the syrup.
29. Spread the filling.
30. Continue with the remaining layers.
31. After spreading the 7-inch layer  with the filling, form a 6-inch layer with the scraps on top of it.
32. Moisten the 6-inch layer and spread the entire outside of the cake  with the filling.
33. Cut a slash from the center to the edge of the  reserved 10-inch layer and cover the entire outside of the cake with  it.
34. Moisten with the remaining syrup and spread with the remaining  filling.
35. Press the reserved pistachios all over the outside of the  cake.
36. Dust lightly with the confectioners' sugar.

title: Chocolate Chip Squares
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Chip Squares
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Chip Squares recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Brown Sugar, Flour, baking powder, Vanilla, Milk, chocolate chips, Brown Sugar
Instructions:
1. Mix the butter, brown sugar, flour, baking powder, vanilla, milk, and egg yolks together until it forms a stiff dough.
2. Press dough into the bottom of a 9 X 9 inch pan.
3. Sprinkle chocolate chips over dough.
4. Make a meringue by whipping together the egg whites and brown sugar.
5. Pour meringue over dough and chocolate chips.
6. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for about 30 minutes.
7. NOTES : I usually cut down on the brown sugar in the meringue by about 1/4 of a cup. The squares are rich enough that they don't miss it. I also use margarine instead of butter.

title: Chocolate Tapioca Pudding
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Tapioca Pudding
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Tapioca Pudding recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, tapioca, Salt, Milk, Egg, instant coffee, Vanilla
Instructions:
1. Combine sugar, tapioca, and salt in a saucepan; stir in milk and egg.
2. Let stand 5  minutes.
3. Add chopped chocolate squares and instant coffee.
4. Cook, stirring over medium heat, until mixture comes to a full boil and chocolate is blended, about 15 minutes.
5. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.
6. Cool for 20 minutes; stir and chill.
7. Serve  with whipped topping if desired.

title: Chocolate Chip Shortbread
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Chip Shortbread
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Chip Shortbread recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Unsalted Butter, powdered sugar, Vanilla, All-Purpose Flour
Instructions:
1. Cream butter, sugar, and vanilla until blended.
2. On low speed, beat in flour.
3. Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips.
4. Cover and chill until firm, but not too firm.
5. Shape heaping tablespoonfuls into 3\" long x 1/2\" thick logs.
6. Place cookies on lightly greased cookie sheets.
7. Bake in 350 degree Fahreneheit oven for 8 minutes or until golden brown.
8. Cool.
9. Melt remaining 1/2 cup chocolate chips and oil.
10. Dip 3/4\" of one end of  each cookie into the melted chocolate.
11. Place cookies on a wire rack to set.

title: Chocolate Chunk And Walnut Brownies
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Chunk And Walnut Brownies
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Chunk and Walnut Brownies recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: All-Purpose Flour, Baking Soda, Salt, Granulated Sugar, Unsalted Butter, light corn syrup, Water, Egg, Vanilla Extract, Walnut
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Line a 13 by 9-1/2 inch baking pan with two layers of aluminum foil, allowing an overhang on each end. Grease the foil with butter.
3. Stir together the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
4. Place the chopped semi-sweet chocolate in a larger bowl.
5. In a saucepan, heat the granulated sugar, unsalted butter, corn syrup and water until the butter melts and the sugar is dissolved.
6. Remove the pan from the heat once it reaches a boil.
7. Pour the hot syrup over the semi-sweet chocolate, allowing it to stand momentarily. Stir until smooth.
8. Whisk the eggs in one at  a time.
9. Whisk in the vanilla and the flour mixture until smooth.
10. Fold in the walnuts and the chopped Swiss chocolate.
11. Scrape the batter into the prepared pan.
12. Bake for 50 minutes to 1 hour, or until a cake tester comes out clean.
13. Cool the brownies in the pan on a wire rack for at least 6 hours.
14. Carefully invert the brownies onto a large cutting board or platter and peel off the foil.
15. Invert the brownies again and cut into 24 squares.

title: Chocolate Pudding
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Pudding
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Pudding recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: instant nonfat dry milk powder, Sugar, Cornstarch, Salt, chocolate pudding mix, Milk, Vanilla, Butter
Instructions:
1. Mix the dry milk powder, sugar, cornstarch, salt, and cocoa together until well blended.
2. It can be stored in a big airtight container or glass jar until you need it.
3. To use, stir mix before using to redistribute ingredients.
4. Measure out 2/3 cup of the pudding mix into a medium saucepan.
5. Add milk, vanilla and butter and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil.
6. Continue cooking and stirring for another minute.
7. Remove from heat and let cool.

title: Chocolate Pudding Ii
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Pudding Ii
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Pudding II recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, Cornstarch, Salt, Milk, baking chocolate, Butter, Vanilla
Instructions:
1. Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt in medium saucepan; gradually stir in milk  and egg yolks.
2. Add baking chocolate, broken into pieces; cook and stir over  medium heat until mixture boils.
3. Boil and stir for 1 minute; remove from heat.  Add butter and vanilla; pour into individual serving dishes.
4. Chill.
5. Serve with whipped cream.

title: Fudgy Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
content:
Recipe Name: Fudgy Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
Description: Make and share this Fudgy Chocolate Crinkle Cookies recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, Egg, Vanilla, Salt, Flour, baking powder, powdered sugar
Instructions:
1. Mix oil, chocolate, sugar; blend in eggs.
2. Add vanilla, salt, baking powder and flour.
3. Cover and chill several hours or overnight.
4. Preheat oven to 350F and grease your cookie sheets.
5. Roll 1 tbsp dough into a ball and roll around in powdered sugar to coat.
6. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake for 10 to 12  minutes.
7. Remove from baking sheet and cool.

title: Chocolate Cream Puffs
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Cream Puffs
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Cream Puffs recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Water, Unsalted Butter, Sugar, Salt, Flour, Egg, ice cream
Instructions:
1. Combine water, butter, sugar and salt in a medium size saucepan.
2. Place over  medium low heat to melt butter.
3. Add flour and cocoa powder all at once; stir  vigorously until mixture pulls away from side of pan.
4. Remove from heat. Heat  oven to 400.
5. Lightly coat baking sheet with cooking spray.
6. With the saucepan  off heat, add eggs one at a time, to batter in saucepan, beating well after each addition.
7. With a 1/4 cup drop mixture onto baking sheet, spacing 2\" apart. Bake for 40 minutes until puffed and firm.
8. Cool slightly.
9. Cut off top third of each puff; scoop out soft center from bases.
10. Cool bases and top on wire rack.
11. Fill  puffs with ice cream of your choice; cover with tops.
12. Freeze on baking sheets  until firm.
13. Transfer to an airtight container.
14. Freeze for up to 1 week.
15. Place puff on plates.
16. Let stand 15 minutes.
17. Top with sauce of your choice.

title: Chocolate Cream Meringue Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Cream Meringue Pie
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Cream Meringue Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, All-Purpose Flour, Salt, Milk, Butter, Margarine, Vanilla, cream of tartar, Sugar
Instructions:
1. FILLING:
2. Combine sugar, flour, cocoa, and salt in medium saucepan; stir in milk.
3. Cook  over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture boils; remove from heat.
4. Stir half of the mixture into beaten egg yolks; return egg mixture to saucepan.
5. Continue cooking and stirring over medium heat until mixture boils; boil and  stir for 1 minute.
6. Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla.
7. Cool for  10 minutes.
8. Pour into pre-baked pie shell.
9. MERINGUE TOPPING:
10. Heat oven to 350°F.
11. In small mixing bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy.
12. Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.
13. Spread this on warm pie  filling, carefully sealing to the edges of crust.
14. Bake 5 to 8 minutes or just  until meringue is lightly browned.
15. Cool to room temperature; chill for several  hours.

title: Chocolate Cream Easter Eggs
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Cream Easter Eggs
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Cream Easter Eggs recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Flour, Water
Instructions:
1. Combine frosting mix with soft butter, water and if desired chopped fruits or  nuts.
2. Knead 20-30 times on board lightly dusted with confectioners sugar.
3. Divide and shape into 8 eggs; chill.
4. Coat eggs with Chocolate Fudge Frosting  mix by dipping egg into frosting, ending with a swirl on top.
5. Keep frosting mix over hot water while dipping the eggs.
6. Decorated with white frosting mix tinted with pastel colors.

title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Cream Cheese Pie
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Cream Cheese Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: German chocolate square, Milk, Cream Cheese, Sugar, Cool Whip, graham cracker pie crust
Instructions:
1. Melt chocolate bar in milk over low heat.
2. Cream together cream cheese and sugar. Add chocolate, then fold in cool whip.
3. Put into pie crust.
4. Freeze.

title: Chocolate Cream Brulee
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Cream Brulee
Description: Make and share this Chocolate Cream Brulee recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chestnut puree, Heavy Cream, Cinnamon, chocolate, Sugar
Instructions:
1. Beat the chestnut puree to lighten it.
2. Whip the cream (not stiffly); fold in  cinnamon, chestnut puree and chocolate.
3. Divide among 4 heat-proof ramekins and smooth level.
4. Chill 1 hour.
5. Preheat broiler.
6. Sprinkle sugar on the Brulee evenly; broil until bubbly.
7. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Curry Ii
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Curry Ii
Description: This is a very mild chicken curry, very suitable for children. My daughter loved it from the age of 9 months and 18 years later it is still a family favourite. You need to start it the day before but don't let that put you off. It couldn't be more simple to make. We serve the curry and rice as a complete meal, having a big plateful each (about 1-1/2 cup rice each and one cup of the curry).
Ingredients: Chicken, Unsalted Butter, Onion, Salt, Flour, curry powder, Ginger, Black Pepper
Instructions:
1. The day before, place whole chicken in a large saucepan.
2. Cover chicken with water; bring to a boil; lower heat and simmer for about one hour or until chicken is  starting to fall off the bones.
3. Remove chicken and put aside to cool.
4. Pour stock into a large bowl; place in the refrigerator.
5. The next day the fat will have set. Remove the fat and throw it away.
6. Meanwhile, remove chicken from bones and cut into bite size pieces.
7. Put in refrigerator until needed.
8. (Ingredients do not need to be precise.) Place butter and onions in saucepan over a medium to high  heat and fry until soft.
9. Add one teaspoon of salt.
10. Add extra butter to saucepan if needed as you are about to add flour, curry powder, ginger, and a good few  shakes of pepper (about 1/2 teaspoon).
11. You need the melted butter to combine it all to a thick paste.
12. Stir out any lumps.
13. Add chicken stock one cupful at a time; stir well to smooth paste.
14. Bring to boil after each cupful is added.
15. Continue with this process until sauce is the thickness you like. (I like it fairly thick).
16. Add chopped chicken.
17. Reheat until chicken is hot.
18. Serve with rice. (Tastes better if cooked the day before).
19. Leftover curry can be frozen. Don't freeze the rice.

title: Chicken Giblets Or Livers
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Giblets Or Livers
Description: Giblets : The edible inner parts of poultry, including the gizzard, heart, liver and kidneys ....... This recipes was devised to use up all the giblets left over from home slaughtered chickens! You can use either giblets or just livers in this recipe. However, the cooking time for giblets is longer than that for livers. Giblets need 15 - 20 minutes, but the livers should be added only 5 - 8 minutes before serving. Have lots of fresh bread and rolls on hand to dip into the sauce!
Ingredients: chicken giblets, Olive Oil, Cumin, Clove, Paprika, bay leaf, piri-piri, Onion, Garlic, white wine
Instructions:
1. Fry the giblets and/or livers in the olive oil until brown.
2. Add the spices and seasonings and stir well.
3. Add the chopped onion and garlic.  Fry for 5 minutes.
4. Add wine and simmer gently until cooked.
5. If you are cooking giblets only, a little water may be added if necessary.

title: Chicken Fried Brown Rice
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Fried Brown Rice
Description: Make and share this Chicken Fried Brown Rice recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, Green Onion, cooked brown rice, light soy sauce
Instructions:
1. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon oil.
2. Add chicken, red  pepper, and green onion.
3. Cook 5 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
4. Remove  to plate.
5. Heat remaining tablespoon of oil in skillet.
6. Add cooked rice; cook 1 minute.
7. Stir in soy sauce, vinegar, and peas; cook 1 minute.
8. Stir in chicken and vegetable mixture.
9. *NOTE: Simmer, covered, 1 cup brown rice in 2-1/2 cups water for 45 minutes.

title: &Quot;Any&Quot; Muffins
content:
Recipe Name: &Quot;Any&Quot; Muffins
Description: Make and share this "any" Muffins recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: white flour, Milk, Egg, Sugar, baking powder, Salt, Milk
Instructions:
1. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in a 400 oven.
2. FOR THE MUFFINS: GRAIN:  Use 2 to 2 1/2 cup of white flour.
3. OR --
4. substitute oatmeal,  cornmeal, whole wheat flour, rye flour, or flake cereal for 1 cup of the white  flour.
5. OR --
6. substitute 1 cup leftover cooked oatmeal, rice or cornmeal for  1/2 cup of the white flour and decrease liquid to 1/2 cup.
7. MILK:  Use 1 cup.
8. OR --
9. substitute buttermilk or sour milk.
10. Or substitute fruit juice for part  or all of the milk.
11. FAT:  Use 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 4 Tbsp melted butter or  margarine.  OR  substitute regular or crunch peanut butter for part or all of  the fat.  The fat can be reduced or omitted with fair results if using a \"wet  addition.\"  EGG:  Use 1 egg.
12. OR --
13. substitute 1 heaping Tbsp of soy flour and 1 Tbsp of water.
14. If using a cooked grain, separate the egg, add the yolk to the batter, beat white until stiff, and fold into the batter.
15. SWEETENER:  Use  between 2 Tbsp and 1/2 cup sugar.
16. OR --
17. substitute up to 3/4 cup brown sugar.
18. OR -- substitute up to 1/2 cup honey or molasses and decrease milk to 3/4 cup.
19. BAKING POWDER:  Use 2 teaspoons.
20. If using whole or cooked grains or more than 1 cup  additions, increase to 3 teaspoons.
21. If using buttermilk or sour milk, decrease to 1  tsp and add 1/2 tsp baking soda.
22. SALT:  Use 1/2 tsp, or omit if you have a  salt-restricted diet.  OPTIONAL INGREDIENTS: The following ingredients are optional.
23. Additions can be  used in any combination, up to 1 1/2 cups total.
24. If using more than 1 cup of  wet additions, decrease the milk to 1/2 cup.
25. DRY ADDITIONS:  Nuts, sunflower seeds, raisins, coconut, and so on.
26. MOIST ADDITONS:  Blueberries, chopped apple, shredded zucchini, shredded carrot, and so on.
27. WET ADDITIONS:  Pumpkin puree, applesauce, mashed potato, mashed bananas, mashed carrot, and so on.
28. If using 1/2 cup drained canned fruit or thawed shredded  zucchini, substitute the syrup or zucchini liquid for all or part of the milk.
29. SPICES:  Use spices that complement the additions, such as 1 tsp cinnamon with 1/4 tsp nutmeg or cloves.
30. Try 2 tsp grated orange or lemon peel.
31. JELLIES AND JAM:  Fill cups half full with a plain batter.
32. Add 1 tsp jam or  jelly and top with 2 more Tbsp batter.
33. NONSWEET COMBINATIONS:  Use only 2 Tbsp sugar and no fruit.  Add combinations of the following:  1/2 cup shredded cheese, 2 strips fried and crumbled bacon, 2  Tbsp grated onion, 1/2 cup shredded zucchini, 2 Tbsp Parmesan cheese.  Spices  could include parsley, marjoram, rosemary --
34. ALENA KIBBLER'S ADDITIONS: Hawaiian Muffins:  Use 1/2 cup mashed banana, 1/2 cup drained crushed pineapple, and 1/2 cup flake coconut, and 1 Tbsp vanilla or rum flavoring.
35. Use the  pineapple juice instead of milk.
36. Cherry Vanilla Chip Muffins:  3/4 cup pitted chopped cherries, 3/4 cup vanilla  chips, 1 tsp vanilla.
37. Elvis Muffins:  Use about 3/4 to 1 cup mashed banana, 1/2 cup chopped peanuts or walnuts (any nut).  And substitute 1/4 peanut butter for the oil.

title: Amber And Zach'S Kisses
content:
Recipe Name: Amber And Zach'S Kisses
Description: Make and share this Amber and Zach's Kisses recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Granulated Sugar, baking powder, Salt
Instructions:
1. Beat egg whites until they are very stiff.
2. Add the sugar slowly while beating the stiff egg whites.
3. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper lined cookie sheet.
4. Bake at 275 degrees Fahrenheit for 50 minutes.
5. Adds a wonderful decoration to anything edible or eat them by themselves.
6. For a colorful variation, separate into small bowls and add small drops of food coloring to a more colorful decoration.
7. Experiment with  them.
8. Use your imagination to make all kinds of food art; flowers, smiley faces, animals, etc.

title: Swiss Crab Melt
content:
Recipe Name: Swiss Crab Melt
Description: Make and share this Swiss Crab Melt recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: English muffins, Tomatoe, Celery, Lemon Juice, Mayonnaise, swiss cheese
Instructions:
1. Split English muffins and broil until lightly browned.
2. Top each half  with a fourth of the crab meat.
3. Place a slice of tomato on each.
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
5. Top with Swiss cheese.
6. Put back under the broiler briefly until cheese melts.
7. Serve while hot.

title: Lee'S Hot Crab Dip
content:
Recipe Name: Lee'S Hot Crab Dip
Description: Make and share this Lee's Hot Crab Dip recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cream Cheese, Sour Cream, Mayonnaise, Lemon Juice, Worcestershire Sauce, dry mustard, Milk, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions:
1. Remove cartilage from crab meat.
2. In a large bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, and garlic salt until smooth.
3. Add enough milk to make mixture creamy.
4. Stir in 2 tablespoons of the grated cheese.
5. Fold crab meat into cream cheese mixture.
6. Pour into greased 1-quart casserole.
7. Top with remaining cheese and paprika.
8. Bake at 325 degrees Fahrenheit until mixture is bubbly and browned on top, about 30 minutes.

title: Grilled Avocado Toast
content:
Recipe Name: Grilled Avocado Toast
Description: Make and share this Grilled Avocado Toast recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Olive Oil, Clove, plum tomato, Onion, avocado, Pepper, Cheddar Cheese
Instructions:
1. Combine olive oil and garlic.
2. Cut bread diagonally into 1/2 inch slices.
3. Brush  each slice with oil.
4. Place on a cookie sheet; broil or grill until golden, approximately 5 minutes.
5. Top each slice with tomato, onion, avocado and cheese.
6. Return  to broiler for 5 to 10 minutes until avocados begin to blister and brown.

title: Mustard Dill Sauce I
content:
Recipe Name: Mustard Dill Sauce I
Description: Make and share this Mustard Dill Sauce I recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: spicy brown mustard, Sugar, distilled white vinegar, dry mustard, fresh dill
Instructions:
1. Whisk first 4 ingredients in bowl.
2. Gradually whisk in oil.
3. Stir in dill.
4. Cover and chill.

title: Cucumber Pita Wedges
content:
Recipe Name: Cucumber Pita Wedges
Description: Make and share this Cucumber Pita Wedges recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cream Cheese, Cucumber, lemon-pepper seasoning
Instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and salad dressing mix until combined.
2. Split pita breads in half, forming two circles.
3. Spread cream cheese mixture over pita circles; cut each into six wedges.
4. Top with cucumbers.
5. Sprinkle with lemon-pepper.

title: Thai Chicken Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Chicken Curry
Description: Make and share this Thai Chicken Curry recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: coconut milk, Potatoe, nam pla, curry powder, Clove, Chicken
Instructions:
1. Combine cocnut milk, potatoes, nam pla, curry powder, and cloves.
2. Simmer 15 minutes.
3. Add chicken; cover, increase heat and cook until chicken and potatoes are tender, about 8 minutes.
4. Stir  occasionally.
5. Serve with rice.

title: Thai Chicken Noodles
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Chicken Noodles
Description: Make and share this Thai Chicken Noodles recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, white wine, Clove, shallots, shrimp, tomato paste, Sugar, nam pla, bean sprouts, Basil, peanuts
Instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in wine 30 minutes.
2. In a small skillet, saute garlic and shallots in 3 Tablespoons oil until crisp; drain, reserving oil.
3. Boil rice vermicelli noodles 2 minutes; drain; toss with garlic oil.
4. Grind red chilies.
5. In a wok, heat 1 tablespoon oil and fry chilies 1 minute, until aroma mellows.
6. Add chicken and wine, and sliced Chinese mushrooms; stir-fry 3 minutes.
7. Add shrimp; heat through; add tomato paste, 2 tablespoons sugar, and nam pla.
8. Add bean sprouts and basil; stir 2 minutes.
9. Add noodles; toss.
10. Garnish with garlic, shallots, and peanuts.

title: Sorrel Tarragon Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Sorrel Tarragon Sauce
Description: Make and share this Sorrel Tarragon Sauce recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Mayonnaise, Sour Cream, fresh sorrel, arugula, fresh tarragon, dried tarragon, fresh chives, Onion, fresh parsley, Lemon Juice, Garlic
Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients in medium bowl.
2. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Cover and chill at least 4 hours.
4. (Can be prepared 1 day ahead. Keep refrigerated.)

title: Thai Cucumber Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Cucumber Salad
Description: Make and share this Thai Cucumber Salad recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cucumber, Onion, Sugar, nam pla, lime, peanuts
Instructions:
1. Seed and finely chop cucumbers; pat dry.
2. Mix together with onion and shrimp;  sprinkle with sugar.
3. Season with nam pla and lime juice.
4. Sprinkle with peanuts and optional chilies.

title: Lime Pistachio Bars
content:
Recipe Name: Lime Pistachio Bars
Description: Make and share this Lime Pistachio Bars recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: All-Purpose Flour, powdered sugar, Unsalted Butter, Egg, Granulated Sugar, All-Purpose Flour, baking powder, lime zest, Lime Juice, Salt
Instructions:
1. To prepare crust: Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Coat bottom of 8-inch square baking pan with cooking spray.
3. Place flour and powdered sugar in bowl of food processor.
4. Add butter.
5. Pulse machine on and off until mixture resembles coarse meal.
6. (By hand, place flour and sugar in mixing bowl; add butter.
7. Cut butter into dry ingredients using pastry blender or 2 table knives.) Remove mixture from processor; knead gently until dough holds together and forms solid mass.
8. Press dough evenly into prepared pan.
9. Bake on center rack until crust is lightly colored, 15-18 minutes.
10. Remove from oven; retain oven temperature. To prepare filling: Beat eggs in mixer on medium speed 1 to 2 minutes.
11. Add sugar, flour and baking powder; beat 1 minute at high speed.
12. Stir in lime zest and juice. Pour mixture over baked crust and spread evenly with spatula.
13. Return pan to oven and bake until top is light brown and center is set, 20-25 minutes.
14. Sprinkle pistachios over top, pressing them down so they adhere well.
15. Let cool completely in pan.
16. Using long, heavy, sharp knife, cut into 16 squares.
17. If not using immediately, arrange squares on plate and cover with plastic wrap.
18. (Bars can be prepared 1 day ahead).
19. Serve bars cold or at room temperature.

title: London Bars
content:
Recipe Name: London Bars
Description: Welcome to one of my adopted recipes. I have yet to make this, but I hear it is good, yet needs a tweak or two, based on a very helpful reviewer. When I do make it, I may try adding the pecans to the crust and sprinkling a few on top of the meringue for a garnish.***ADOPTED AGAIN***
Ingredients: Butter, Margarine, Sugar, Egg, All-Purpose Flour, Vanilla Extract, Pecan
Instructions:
1. Cream butter in a large mixing bowl; gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
2. Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating well  after each addition.
3. Stir in flour, blending well.
4. Press mixture into a lightly greased 15 x 10 x 1\" jelly-roll pan.
5. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
6. Remove from oven; cool in pan.
7. Spread raspberry  preserves over baked crust.
8. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) in a  medium mixing bowl until foamy.
9. Gradually add remaining sugar, 1  tablespoon  at a time, beating until stiff peaks form.
10. Fold in vanilla.
11. Spread meringue over preserves.
12. Sprinkle with pecans.
13. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 15 minutes or until  lightly browned.
14. Cool slightly; cut into 2 x 1-inch bars with a warm knife.
15. Remove to wire racks to cool completely.
16. Store in airtight containers.

title: Stewed Jimmy Crabs
content:
Recipe Name: Stewed Jimmy Crabs
Description: This is a traditional watermen's meal, relished for its flavor and the respite it affords wives for picking crab meat. The eater, you see, does his own crab meat picking. There is no etiquette, by the way, to the eating. Just dig in.
Ingredients: tap water, bacon, Flour, Salt, Pepper, Onion, Potatoe
Instructions:
1. Remove all traces of mud from crabs.
2. Pull off back shell and innards.
3. Set a 10 quart pot on the burner.
4. Lay 4 strips of bacon on the bottom of the pan and fry.
5. Set aside bacon.
6. To the bacon grease add 2 tablespoons of flour.
7. Brown the flour in the grease, then add 1 quart of water to the pot. Add the diced onion, the cleaned crabs, and the salt and pepper.
8. Cook over medium heat for 25 minutes, then add potatoes.
9. When potatoes are cooked through, remove the stew from the heat and serve hot. For hearty crab eaters, allow 4 crabs per serving.

title: Ann'S Blooming Lovely Chocolate Cheesecake
content:
Recipe Name: Ann'S Blooming Lovely Chocolate Cheesecake
Description: Make and share this Ann's Blooming Lovely Chocolate Cheesecake recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Margarine, firm tofu, oranges, banana, cocoa powder, Sugar, soya milk
Instructions:
1. To make the base:
2. Melt the margarine gently in a saucepan.
3. Crush  the digestive biscuits until they resemble fine breadcrumbs.
4. Take  the margarine off the heat and mix in the biscuit crumbs.
5. Press this mixture into an 11\" flan tin.
6. To make the topping:
7. Mix the tofu, orange juice, orange rind or  banana, cocoa powder, oil and sugar well, preferably in a food  processor.
8. Ensure a smooth consistency.
9. If it doesn't mix well, add  a few tablespoons of soya milk.
10. Place over the base and smooth the top.
11. Cook for 30-40 minutes at 175 degrees Celsius.
12. Remove from oven.
13. Cool. Chill in the refrigerator overnight.
14. Add a topping of your choice such as slices of fresh orange or grated chocolate.

title: Chinese Style Sauteed Firm Tofu
content:
Recipe Name: Chinese Style Sauteed Firm Tofu
Description: This is an adopted recipe that I have not yet had the chance to try. Please review and add comments should you try this before I do (or after, of course!) Thanks!
Ingredients: firm tofu, Salt, Onion, Mushroom, Carrot, green bell peppers, sake, white wine, Soy Sauce, Ginger, Sugar, Water, Cornstarch
Instructions:
1. Cut tofu crosswise into pieces the shape of French-fried potatoes.
2. Heat a wok, coat with oil and sprinkle on the salt.
3. Add onion then mushrooms, stir-frying each over high heat for about 30 seconds.
4. Reduce heat to medium-low.
5. Add carrot, green pepper and tofu in that order, sauteing each for about 1 minute.
6. Reduce heat to low and add sake, soy sauce, ginger, sugar and water.
7. Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes.
8. Stir in dissolved cornstarch and simmer 30 seconds more.

title: Chesapeake Bay Crab Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Chesapeake Bay Crab Salad
Description: Make and share this Chesapeake Bay Crab Salad recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Mayonnaise, pimiento, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire Sauce, Salt, Lemon, Celery, lettuce, lemon slice, Paprika
Instructions:
1. Remove cartilage from crab meat.
2. In a bowl, mix mayonnaise, pimiento, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, salt, hot pepper sauce, lemon juice, and celery.
3. Blend well.
4. Pour over crab meat and toss lightly but evenly.
5. Refrigerate.
6. Serve in bowl lined with lettuce leaves.
7. Garnish with lemon  slices and sprinkle with paprika.

title: Crab Bisque Chincoteague
content:
Recipe Name: Crab Bisque Chincoteague
Description: Make and share this Crab Bisque Chincoteague recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Flour, Milk, sharp cheddar cheese, lemon pepper, cooking sherry, Parsley, Salt
Instructions:
1. Melt butter in a heavy 4-quart saucepan over medium heat. Stir in flour to make a roux.
2. Slowly add milk until it is well blended.
3. Stirring constantly, add cheese and cook until mixture thickens.
4. Reduce heat and add seasonings, sherry, cream, and parsley.
5. When mixture is thoroughly heated, add crab meat, stirring gently to keep lumps intact. Serve immediately in warm bowls and garnish with parsley.

title: Maryland Pavilion Crab Cakes
content:
Recipe Name: Maryland Pavilion Crab Cakes
Description: Make and share this Maryland Pavilion Crab Cakes recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Egg, Mayonnaise, Parsley, Salt, Pepper
Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine crab meat, eggs, mayonnaise, horseradish mustard,  chopped parsley, salt, pepper, and hot-pepper sauce. Mix lightly.
2. Separate  and form into 12 to 16 small cakes; do not pack firmly.
3. Roll crackers into  fine crumbs.
4. Pat the cracker crumbs lightly onto the crab cakes.
5. Heat oil  to a depth of about 1/4 inch in a large skillet, or heat the oil in a deep  fryer.
6. Fry crab cakes until golden brown, turning once. Drain on paper  toweling.
7. Serves 6.
8. \"This recipe came from the Maryland Pavilion at the 1964-65 New York  World's Fair.\"

title: Crabapple Jelly
content:
Recipe Name: Crabapple Jelly
Description: Make and share this Crabapple Jelly recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cinnamon, lemon basil, Sugar
Instructions:
1. Wash apples; remove stem and blossom ends.
2. Cover with a water in a  large stainless steel or ceramic pot.
3. Add washed sprigs of cinnamon or lemon basil.
4. Simmer until apples are soft.
5. Drain juice over pan; through jelly bag or clean dish towel.
6. Bring 4 cups of drained juice (add water to make 4 cups if necessary), to a boil in a very large stainless steel or ceramic pot.
7. Add sugar and boil to sheeting stage. (When the drips sheet together on the side of a stainless steel spoon). Skim.
8. Pour into sterilized jelly jars.
9. Skim again and seal with two thin layers of paraffin, making certain the 2nd one seals the jar to glass edges.
10. Yield - about 5 cups of bright red jelly.

title: Trifle
content:
Recipe Name: Trifle
Description: After steamed puddings, trifle is the most traditional of English Christmas desserts. The cake base uses only egg white substitutes, while the custard eliminates eggs completely.
Ingredients: egg white substitute, Granulated Sugar, soymilk, Lemon Juice, whole wheat pastry flour, baking powder, Salt, Cornstarch, Granulated Sugar, soymilk, Vanilla Extract, Lemon Juice, sweet sherry, port wine, pear
Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
2. Beat the egg white substitutes until stiff  with an electric mixer.
3. Fold in the sugar, milk, and lemon juice and beat again.
4. Combine the flour, baking powder, and salt in a small mixing bowl.
5. Sprinkle into  the egg white mixture, a bit at a time, beating in each time with the mixer  until velvety smooth.
6. Pour into a lightly oiled, 9- by 13-inch baking pan.
7. Bake  for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden and a knife inserted into the center  tests clean.
8. This cake may be made well ahead of time; let it cool completely,  then store in an airtight container or proceed with the remaining steps.
9. For  the custard, combine the cornstarch and sugar in a heavy saucepan.
10. Pour in  enough soy milk to dissolve them.
11. Whisk in the remaining milk.
12. Place over  moderate heat and bring to a simmer, whisking almost continuously, so that the  cornstarch does not lump on the bottom.
13. Let the mixture simmer gently, whisking  frequently, until thick.
14. Remove from the heat. Stir in the vanilla and lemon  juice. Let the custard cool to room temperature.  Before assembling the trifle, cut the cake base into 4 to 6 sections, then  carefully split the sections in half through the center so that they are half  the thickness.
15. Spread the bottom halves with the raspberry preserves , then  cover with the tops.
16. Cut the sandwiched cake into approximately 1- by 2-inch  fingers.
17. Assemble the trifle in a trifle dish or a IO-inch round, preferably  clear-glass casserole dish at least 3 to 4 inches deep: half the cake fingers,  sprinkled with half of the sherry or port, half of the custard, the pear s  lices, the remaining cake fingers, the remaining sherry or port, the remaining  custard.
18. Sprinkle the top with the sliced almonds and decorate with small dots  of raspberry jam, either in an irregular or regular pattern.
19. Chill thoroughly  before serving.

title: Suffolk Trifle (English)
content:
Recipe Name: Suffolk Trifle (English)
Description: Okay, this isn't my recipe, although I do intend on making it soon. It's one of the ones I acquired when the elves were clearing out the Recipezaar account. Please tell me what it's like if you make it.
Ingredients: white wine, brandy, Egg, cornflour, caster sugar
Instructions:
1. Put the macaroons in a glass bowl and pour over the wine and brandy.
2. Leave macaroons to soak, adding extra wine or brandy if they appear   dry.
3. Pour the single cream into a pan and warm gently until just on   the point of boiling.
4. Beat together the egg, egg yolk and cornflour   in a bowl, pour on the cream and whisk Iightly.
5. Return to a clean   saucepan and cook gently, without boiling, until custard has   thickened, stirring continuously.
6. Stir in the sugar and allow the   custard to cool a little. Pour over the soaked macaroons and set in   a cool place. Carefully smooth the jam over the custard,  then    sprinkle  with  almonds  and candied peel.
7. Whip the double cream   until it stands in soft peaks and pipe or pile on top of trifle.   Serve decorated with extra blanched almonds and candied peel, if   desired.

title: Twice-Baked Potatoes (Microwave)
content:
Recipe Name: Twice-Baked Potatoes (Microwave)
Description: Make and share this Twice-Baked Potatoes (Microwave) recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: baking potatoes, bacon, Butter, Margarine, Green Onion, Milk, Salt, Pepper, Paprika
Instructions:
1. Pierce well-scrubbed potatoes twice.
2. Place 1 inch apart on paper towel in microwave oven.
3. Microwave at HIGH 10-1/2 to 12-1/2 minutes, or until  just softened, rearranging and turning over after half the cooking  time.
4. Let stand, covered with a bowl, for 5 minutes.
5. Place bacon on paper towel lined plate. Cover with paper towel.
6. Microwave at HIGH 5 to 6 minutes, or until crisp.
7. Drain bacon on paper towel; crumble.
8. Place butter and green onion in 2 quart casserole; cover.
9. Microwave at HIGH 1-1/2 to 2 minutes, or until butter is melted and onion is tender.
10. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise.
11. Scoop out center; place in casserole with onion-butter and bacon.
12. Add milk, salt and pepper; mash until fluffy.
13. Spoon into potato shells.
14. Arrange on paper towel-lined microwaveable baking sheet.
15. Sprinkle with paprika.
16. Microwave at HIGH 3 to 7 minutes, or until heated, rotating 1/2 turn.
17. Garnish with additional chopped green onion, if desired.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
content:
Recipe Name: Twice Baked Potatoes
Description: Make and share this Twice Baked Potatoes recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: baking potatoes, Milk, Butter, Egg, Parmesan Cheese, Nutmeg, chives, Onion, Paprika
Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Scrub potatoes; prick several times with a fork.
3. Place in oven; bake 50 to 60 minutes until potatoes feel soft when squeezed.
4. Remove and cool 15 minutes; half potatoes length wise (carefully).
5. Using a small spoon scoop out pulp into a large bowl, leaving a 1/4 inch thick shell.
6. Save the best 8 shells.
7. Freeze the remaining shells for French fries or stuffed potato skins.
8. Simmer milk and butter until butter melts.
9. Pour over potato pulp and mash or beat until almost smooth.
10. Add egg, half of cheese,salt, pepper and nutmeg.
11. Mash until almost smooth.
12. Fill shells using about 1/3 cup mixture per shell.
13. Sprinkle with chives or green onion, remaining cheese and a little paprika.
14. Reduce oven heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
15. Place shells on cookie sheet.
16. Bake for 30 minutes until puffed and brown.

title: Spiced Pear Butter
content:
Recipe Name: Spiced Pear Butter
Description: Make and share this Spiced Pear Butter recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: pear, Cinnamon, allspice, Clove, Sugar
Instructions:
1. Combine pears and apple juice in a large Dutch oven.
2. Tie broken cinnamon  spices, gingerroot, allspice and cloves in a piece of cheese cloth; add  to pear mixture. Bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 45  minutes to 1 hour or until pears are tender.
3. Drain pears, and discard  spice bag.
4. Mash pears or process in food processor until smooth.
5. Return  pear puree to Dutch oven, and add sugar.
6. Cook, uncovered, over medium  heat for 30 to 40 minutes or until mixture thickens, stirring frequently.
7. Remove from heat, and quickly pour hot pear mixture into hot sterilized  jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace; wipe jar rims.
8. Cover at once with  metal lids, and screw on bands.
9. Process in boiling water bath for 5  minutes.

title: Lemon Curried Lamb Chops
content:
Recipe Name: Lemon Curried Lamb Chops
Description: Make and share this Lemon Curried Lamb Chops recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: lamb chop, Lemon Juice, Salt, curry powder, Sugar, Butter
Instructions:
1. Combine lemon juice, curry powder, salt and sugar.
2. Brush mixture over the chops and let stand for 2 hours to absorb the flavors.
3. Heat the  butter in a frying pan, cook until golden brown on both sides.

title: Lemon Mint Lamb Chops
content:
Recipe Name: Lemon Mint Lamb Chops
Description: Make and share this Lemon Mint Lamb Chops recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: lamb chop, Butter, Onion, Lemon, Lemon Juice, Sugar, Cilantro
Instructions:
1. Grill chops until tender.
2. While chops are under the grill, prepare the sauce:
3. Melt butter in pan; add finely chopped onion, saute until tender.
4. Add lemon rind, lemon juice, sugar and mint, heat gently.
5. Spoon over hot chops.
6. Cheers, Doreen Doreen Randal, Wanganui, New Zealand.

title: Winter Pear Butter
content:
Recipe Name: Winter Pear Butter
Description: Smooth, delicate pear butter is delicious on toast, popovers, biscuits and other light breads. Try it on waffles and pancakes, too.
Ingredients: pear, Sugar, brandy, Water
Instructions:
1. Peel, quarter and core the pears; chop in 1/2-inch pieces.
2. Put all the ingredients in a large heavy pot; bring to a boil.
3. Reduce the heat and cook, stirring often, for 15 minutes, or until the  pears are soft.
4. Puree the mixture in a food processor or blender.
5. Return the  puree to the pot.
6. Cook uncovered over very low heat, stirring often, for 1 to 1-1/2 hours, or until the pear butter is very thick.
7. Be careful not  to let it scorch.
8. Remove from the heat.
9. Stir the hot pear butter for a minute or two to release more heat.
10. Spoon into clean hot jars, leaving 1/4 inch of space at the top of  each jar.
11. Wipe the rim of each jar.
12. Cover and allow to come to room  temperature. (You'll notice that the pear butter is a rather gray-green  color; this is the correct color.)
13. Label the jars and refrigerate for up to three weeks.
14. (Remember: The label should include the name of the recipe and the  date by which it should be eaten. Be sure the recipient stores the pear butter in the refrigerator.).

title: Meatballs In Cheese Pastry
content:
Recipe Name: Meatballs In Cheese Pastry
Description: Make and share this Meatballs in Cheese Pastry recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Flour, cayenne pepper, Butter, cheese, Egg, sesame seeds, beef, lime rind, Lime Juice
Instructions:
1. Process flour, pepper and butter until combined.
2. Add cheese, process until mixture forms a ball.
3. Knead dough on a lightly floured surface until smooth; cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.
4. Roll pastry between sheets of greaseproof paper until 2mm thick.
5. Cut into 4cm rounds, top each with a meatball.
6. Fold pastry to enclose meatballs completely, roll into balls.
7. Brush top with egg, sprinkle with seeds, place about 3cm apart on greased oven trays.
8. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.
9. Bake in a moderately hot oven about 15 minutes or until lightly browned; cool before serving.
10. MEATBALLS:- Combine all ingredients in a bowl; mix well.
11. Roll level teaspoons of mixture into balls.
12. You can make three hours ahead of time and cooked balls freeze well.

title: Basic Habanero Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Basic Habanero Sauce
Description: WARNING, WHEN HANDLING HABENEROS, WEAR RUBBER GLOVES AND GLASSES or GOGGLES. WHEN COOKING ALWAYS COVER, OR USE THE STOVE'S VENT FAN. Basic Habenero Sauce
Ingredients: habanero peppers, Carrot, Onion, distilled vinegar, Clove, Lime Juice
Instructions:
1. Saute onion and garlic until soft.
2. Add carrots with a small amount of water.
3. Bring  to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until carrots are soft.
4. Place in a blender with the peppers; puree until smooth.
5. Mix puree with vinegar and lime juice and simmer for 5 minutes.
6. Seal in sterilized bottles/jars.  Makes 2 cups.
7. You can also try: My recipe.
8. I'm allergic to onions, so I make mine somewhat differently
9. 24-30 Habenero peppers, stemmed and chopped, 2 Tbsp Olive oil, 1 pound shredded carrots, 2 heaping Tbsp of chopped garlic (I get this at the market in a jar. I prefer  to use the water pack, but the garlic packed in oil works just as well), 1 cup apple cider vinegar, 1/2 to 3/4 cup key lime juice.
10. Saute Garlic in oil until soft.
11. Add carrots and stir-fry for a minute or two to  distribute the garlic well.
12. Add enough water to come just short of covering the  carrots.
13. Bring to a boil, and simmer until carrots are soft, and liquid is  reduced to about 1/2 of what you started with.
14. Put carrot mixture and peppers into food processor and process until relatively smooth, adding vinegar and lime juice.
15. Return to the stove and simmer 5 to 7 minutes.
16. For smooth Tabasco style sauce, strain through cheesecloth (pressing out  all the liquid) and bottle in sterilized bottles.
17. For a thicker basting type sauce, bottle as is.
18. Makes 8 or 9 ( 4 oz) canning jars.

title: Greek Phyllo Seafood Rolls
content:
Recipe Name: Greek Phyllo Seafood Rolls
Description: From spanakopita to baklava, the Greeks know how to use phyllo! Here the flaky dough encloses a mixture of spinach, cheese and shrimp, lightly seasoned with lemon. The rolls are easy to make and delicious to eat, particularly with a Greek salad of tomatoes, feta, olives and bell peppers alongside.
Ingredients: frozen spinach, part-skim ricotta cheese, feta cheese, Lemon, dried dill weed, fresh dill weed, Pepper, Olive Oil, Onion, Clove, Clove, large shrimp, phyllo dough, Butter
Instructions:
1. Squeeze the spinach with your hands to remove excess liquid.
2. Put the spinach in  a large bowl with ricotta, feta, lemon zest, dill weed and pepper.
3. Stir to mix  well.
4. Heat the olive oil in a medium frying pan over medium heat.
5. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is tender, 3 to 4 minutes.
6. Add  the garlic and stir 20 to 30 seconds.
7. Add the onion-garlic mixture to the bowl with the spinach; stir until well mixed.
8. Stir in the shrimp and set aside.
9. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
10. Separate 1 sheet of the phyllo dough; lay it on the work surface with the long side toward you.
11. (Keep the stack of remaining dough covered with plastic wrap to prevent it from drying.).
12. Lightly brush the sheet with a little of the melted butter; lay another sheet evenly on top.
13. Lightly brush half of the top sheet with more butter; fold the other half over to make a rectangle 8 x 11 inches.
14. Lightly brush with a little more melted  butter.
15. Spoon a generous 1/4 cup of the filling along the bottom edge, leaving 1 inch of phyllo clear on all sides.
16. Lift the bottom end of the sheet and fold it over the filling.
17. Fold the sides over and press lightly; gently roll up.
18. Set the roll seam-side down on a lightly greased baking sheet (you will need 2  baking sheets).
19. Repeat to use the remaining filling and phyllo.
20. Brush the tops  of the rolls with melted butter.
21. Bake until golden, 25 to 30 minutes.
22. Serve  hot or warm.

title: Ouzo-Marinated Greek Cheese
content:
Recipe Name: Ouzo-Marinated Greek Cheese
Description: Make and share this Ouzo-Marinated Greek Cheese recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: kasseri cheese, Olive Oil, fresh parsley, fresh thyme, Pepper
Instructions:
1. Cut cheese lengthwise into four 1/2-inch thick pieces.
2. Arrange in single layer in shallow dish.
3. Mix ouzo, olive oil, parsley, thyme and pepper in small bowl.
4. Pour over cheese.
5. Marinate at least 4 hours and up to 8 hours, turning once.
6. Preheat broiler.
7. Remove cheese from marinade; transfer to 4 small broiler proof gratin dishes.
8. Drizzle 2 teaspoons marinade over each piece of cheese.
9. Broil until cheese is soft and just begins to melt, about 4 minutes.
10. Serve with bread.
11. Notes: This starter is an easy version of the fried cheese dish, saganaki, which is traditionally paired with a glass of ouzo.
12. Serve with freshly grilled pita bread.

title: Greek Spinach Triangles
content:
Recipe Name: Greek Spinach Triangles
Description: Make and share this Greek Spinach Triangles recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: frozen spinach, Egg, Onion, Cream Cheese, Pepper, feta cheese, Butter, Margarine, phyllo pastry
Instructions:
1. * To cut calories, you can use butter-flavored cooking spray in place of the  butter.
2. Cook spinach according to directions; drain well.
3. Mix spinach, eggs, onion, cream cheese, pepper and feta cheese together.
4. Refrigerate mixture at least 1 hour.
5. Open package of phyllo pastry; cut a strip 2\" wide, cutting through all layers.
6. Cover remaining dough with a damp cloth to prevent cracking.
7. Separate dough so that you have 2 sheets for each triangle.
8. Brush the dough with melted butter.
9. Put 1 rounded teaspoon of spinach mixture at the top of the strip.
10. Fold pastry over like folding a flag.
11. Place on well-buttered baking sheet; brush top with butter.
12. Bake at 375 degrees Fahrenheit  for 20 minutes.
13. Serve warm.
14. To freeze the triangles before cooking, butter both sides of triangle and wrap well.
15. Bake when needed.

title: Grand Marnier Cake
content:
Recipe Name: Grand Marnier Cake
Description: Make and share this Grand Marnier Cake recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Sugar, Grand Marnier, Flour, Baking Soda, baking powder, Sour Cream, Walnut, Sugar, Grand Marnier
Instructions:
1. Cream sugar and butter.
2. Add egg yolks and 1 teaspoon  Grand Marnier.
3. Continue to beat. Sift flour, baking soda and  baking powder.
4. Add flour to mixture with sour cream, beginning  and ending with dry ingredients.
5. Add orange rind, walnuts and  stiff beaten egg whites.
6. Butter and flour an angle food cake  pan.
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 55 minutes.
8. Spoon topping over baked  cake while still in hot pan.
9. Cool and invert onto serving  plate.

title: Spanish Potato Omelet (Tortilla A La Espanola)
content:
Recipe Name: Spanish Potato Omelet (Tortilla A La Espanola)
Description: Make and share this Spanish Potato Omelet (Tortilla a la Espanola) recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Olive Oil, Potatoe, Onion, Salt, Egg
Instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a 8-9 inch skillet. Add the slices of potato one at a time to avoid sticking together.
2. Alternate layers of potatoes with layers of onions.
3. Cook slowly over medium heat, turning the potatoes until tender, not brown.
4. Drain potatoes in a colander, save oil.
5. Make sure skillet is very clean for later use.  In a bowl, beat eggs with a fork until slightly foamy.
6. Salt to taste.  Add the potatoes, press down to cover potatoes completely with egg.  Return to skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of saved oil until smoking point.  Add the mixture, spread it out. Rapidly, lower the temperature to medium-high.
7. Shake the pan often to avoid sticking.
8. When the bottom is brown, cover the skillet with a plate, turn skillet up-side down, remove tortilla, slide off plate with uncooked side down into skillet and cook the other side, Turn several times until cooked

title: French Pecan Pie
content:
Recipe Name: French Pecan Pie
Description: Make and share this French Pecan Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, Vanilla, Pecan, German chocolate
Instructions:
1. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry.
2. Gradually add sugar.
3. Add vanilla, broken crackers and pecans.
4. Bake in a 10-inch buttered pie pan for 30 minutes at 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
5. Cool.
6. Top with sweetened whipped cream (spread over cooled pie).
7. Garnish with shaved chocolate.

title: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup
Description: Make and share this Thai Coconut Chicken Soup recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, coconut milk, Green Onion, serrano chilies, nam pla, lemongrass, lime
Instructions:
1. Bring 1 cup coconut milk to boil.
2. Add chicken, lemon grass, and Laos.
3. Cover  and simmer til chicken is tender.
4. Add remaining 1 cup coconut milk, green  onions and chilis.
5. DO NOT BOIL.
6. Stir in lime juice and fish sauce just before  serving.

title: Salt Cod Chowder
content:
Recipe Name: Salt Cod Chowder
Description: Salt cod is used for cooking in Scandinavian and Spanish cooking, but isn't very well known in the United States. Here's a tasty chowder to introduce it to the uninitiated.
Ingredients: Salt, Salt, Onion, raw potatoes, raw carrot, boiling water, Salt, Pepper, canned corn niblet, Milk
Instructions:
1. Freshen salt cod by soaking it overnight in cold water to cover.
2. Drain, place in a stewing pot, and cover with fresh water.
3. Bring to simmer with low heat.
4. Check to see if the fish is still too salty - if so, drain, add fresh cold water, and bring to simmer again, and drain.
5. Fry salt pork in stewing pot until crisp; remove fried pork scraps and reserve for garnish.
6. Cook onion in pork fat until tender.
7. Add potatoes, carrots, water, salt, and pepper and cook covered for about ten minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
8. Add corn or hominy, heated milk, and freshened salt cod.
9. Bring chowder to a simmering temperature, but do not boil.
10. Garnish with the pork scraps.
11. Serve hot, with freshly baked home made bread or rolls and butter.

title: Thai Fried Bananas
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Fried Bananas
Description: Make and share this Thai Fried Bananas recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: banana, Butter, palm sugar, lime
Instructions:
1. Peel bananas; slice lengthwise then in half.
2. Fry in butter until soft and golden.
3. Add sugar and stir until syrup thickens.
4. Sprinkle with lime juice and serve.

title: Thai Beef Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Beef Salad
Description: Make and share this Thai Beef Salad recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: romaine lettuce, red leaf lettuce, Belgian endive, fresh lime juice, Soy Sauce, beef, Brown Sugar, Clove, Cilantro, Tomatoe, Green Onion
Instructions:
1. Tear romaine lettuce, red leaf lettuce, and Belgian endive into bite-size pieces.
2. In small bowl, combine 2 tablespoons oil,  2 tablespoons lime juice, and 2 tablespoons soy sauce.
3. Add beef strips; stir; marinate at least 1 hour at room  temperature.
4. In food processor, combine 1/2 cup oil, 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1 tablespoon soy  sauce, ginger, brown sugar, garlic and jalapenos; puree.
5. Reserve marinade.
6. Stir-fry beef in 2 tablespoons oil until just browned.
7. Mix reserved marinade with  dressing.
8. Top greens with beef.
9. Pour dressing into a wok; stir to heat; mix in beef juices.
10. Pour hot dressing over salad.
11. Add cilantro, tomatoes, and  green onions; toss.

title: Feijoada (Brazilian Bean Soup)
content:
Recipe Name: Feijoada (Brazilian Bean Soup)
Description: Make and share this Feijoada (Brazilian Bean Soup) recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: dried black beans, Onion, turkey Polish kielbasa, turkey Polish kielbasa, Garlic, Cumin, Water, Salt, Pepper, bay leaf, red wine vinegar
Instructions:
1. Sort and wash beans; place in a large Dutch oven.
2. Cover with water to 2 inches above beans, and bring to a boil; cook 2 minutes.
3. Remove from heat; cover and let stand 1 hour.
4. Drain beans; set aside. Wipe pan with a paper towel.
5. Heat oil in pan over medium heat. Add onion, kielbasa, and garlic; saute 10 minutes or until onion is tender.
6. Add cumin, and saute 1 minute. Return beans to pan.
7. Add water and next 3 ingredients; bring to a boil.
8. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 1 hour and 10 minutes or until beans are tender; remove bay leaf.
9. Stir in vinegar and hot sauce.

title: Thai Coconut Custard
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Coconut Custard
Description: Make and share this Thai Coconut Custard recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: coconut milk, Egg, palm sugar, Salt
Instructions:
1. Beat coconut milk, eggs, palm sugar and salt together.
2. Cook in a double boiler, stirring constantly, until it resembles  soft scrambled eggs.
3. Pour into a small casserole dish.
4. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 30  minutes.
5. Brown under a broiler.

title: Feijoada (Brazilian Bean Soup) Ii
content:
Recipe Name: Feijoada (Brazilian Bean Soup) Ii
Description: Make and share this Feijoada (Brazilian Bean Soup) II recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: black beans, Water, ham, hot Italian sausage, Tomatoe, Onion, red pepper flakes, Clove, orange zest
Instructions:
1. Soak black beans overnight; drain.
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
3. Combine black beans, water, ham, pork loin, Italian sausage, cherry tomatoes, onion, red pepper flakes, garlic, and orange zest in a Dutch oven.
4. Bring to boil, uncovered, on stove top.
5. Cover and transfer to oven.
6. Bake 90 minutes.
7. Remove cover and bake another 30 minutes.
8. Cool overnight in refrigerator.
9. Remove fat and reheat.

title: Bean Curd With Broccoli
content:
Recipe Name: Bean Curd With Broccoli
Description: Make and share this Bean Curd With Broccoli recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cornstarch, dry sherry, Soy Sauce, Scallion, Ginger, Clove, broccoli, Salt, medium firm tofu
Instructions:
1. Put cornstarch into a cup and slowly add 1/4 cup of the vegetable stock (make  sure it is room temperature or cooler) and mix well.
2. Add wine, soy sauce and  sesame oil.
3. Mix well.
4. Cut scallion into 1 1/2-inch lengths.
5. Heat vegetable oil  in a wok over medium heat. When hot, put in ginger and garlic. Stir fry for 10  seconds.
6. Put in scallion and broccoli.
7. Fry for 1 minute. Add 1/2 cup vegetable  stock and the salt. Bring to a simmer.
8. Cover and cook over a medium heat for a  minute, until broccoli is tender-crisp.
9. Remove broccoli with a slotted spoon.
10. Turn heat to low and add tofu.
11. Let it heat through.
12. Add cornstarch mixture.Stir  very gently.
13. Put broccoli back in wok.
14. Serve as soon as the sauce is thick and  everything is heated through.

title: Cauliflower And Potatoes
content:
Recipe Name: Cauliflower And Potatoes
Description: Make and share this Cauliflower and Potatoes recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Ginger, cauliflower, Potatoe, garam masala, Salt
Instructions:
1. Put oil, cumin seed and ginger in a large frying pan and cook over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes.
2. Add cauliflower and potatoes.
3. Add some garam masala and red peppers and mix.
4. Cook over medium heat 7 to 10 minutes.
5. Cover and reduce heat to low. The steam should cook the vegetables. If it seems too dry, add a little water.

title: Curried Vegetables
content:
Recipe Name: Curried Vegetables
Description: Make and share this Curried Vegetables recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: cauliflower, Carrot, Celery, Onion, Mayonnaise, Salt, curry powder, Ginger, Cheddar Cheese, Butter
Instructions:
1. Cook the cauliflower, carrots, celery, and onion in a small amount of water until crisp- tender-drain; set aside.
2. Combine the soup, mayonnaise, salt, curry powder, coriander, and ginger in a mixing bowl; mix well.
3. Stir in the vegetables.
4. Spoon into an oven-proof casserole dish.
5. Combine cheddar cheese, bread crumbs and melted butter.
6. Sprinkle over the vegetables.
7. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 to 35 minutes.

title: Scrambled Tofu On Toast
content:
Recipe Name: Scrambled Tofu On Toast
Description: Tofu is a wonderfully versatile food! I make tofu "egg salad" fairly often, and it's delicious. So scrambled tofu on toast makes perfect sense to me. :)
Ingredients: plain firm tofu, Butter, turmeric, herbs
Instructions:
1. Crumble the tofu and fry it in the vegetable oil and butter until evenly cooked.
2. Add the turmeric, herbs, and salt and pepper to taste. Saute a further few minutes.
3. Serve on crispy wholemeal toast spread with butter.
4. This is the basic recipe... you can also add grated cheese, fried mushrooms, sweet or hot peppers, onions, garlic, or anything you like to this mixture to make it to your taste!  Experiment and enjoy!

title: Crisp Sauteed Cucumbers With Lemon
content:
Recipe Name: Crisp Sauteed Cucumbers With Lemon
Description: Make and share this Crisp Sauteed Cucumbers With Lemon recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cucumber, Salt, Lemon, Olive Oil, Flour, Salt, Pepper, fresh parsley leaves
Instructions:
1. Peel the cucumbers if waxed.
2. Cut cucumbers in half lengthwise; scoop out the seeds with a spoon.
3. Cut them into inch chunks.
4. If the cucumbers are not super-firm, place the chunks in a colander and sprinkle them with 1 tablespoon  of salt. Shake to distribute the salt. Let cucumber drain for about 20 minutes. Rinse and dry.
5. If the cucumbers are already firm, proceed with the recipe.
6. Remove a few strips of zest from the lemon with a zester or vegetable peeler; mince enough to measure 1 teaspoon.
7. Cut the lemon in half through its equator and section it as you would an orange. Set the zest and lemon sections aside.
8. Place  the butter or oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
9. Place about 2 cups flour in a bag, and, when the butter melts or the oil is hot, put a few chunks of cucumber at a time in the bag.
10. Shake well; add cucumbers to the skillet.
11. Repeat until all the cucumbers are used up.
12. Cook over medium high heat, stirring and turning occasionally, for about 10 minutes, until the exteriors of the cucumbers are crisp and the interiors are tender enough to be easily pierced  with a thin-bladed knife.
13. Add the lemon zest and lemon sections, along with salt and  pepper, and cook for 1 minute more.
14. Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Tutti Frutti Trifle
content:
Recipe Name: Tutti Frutti Trifle
Description: This is one of the Zaar recipes that I adopted. I hope to make this soon as it looks like a dish my family would enjoy. I’ll edit the recipe accordingly if needed.
Ingredients: grapefruit, orange, fresh pineapple, marshmallows, maraschino cherries, moist coconut, maraschino juice, Confectioners' Sugar
Instructions:
1. Remove segments from membrane of grapefruit and orange; slice pineapple.
2. Cut marshmallows and cherries into eighths.
3. Soak marshmallows and coconut in maraschino juice.
4. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in sugar.
5. Combine  with fruits and coconut marshmallow mixture. Freeze until firm.
6. For an extra taste treat add 1 Tbsp of brandy or some people  like to add 1/2 cup of seedless raisins.

title: Creamed Cucumbers
content:
Recipe Name: Creamed Cucumbers
Description: Make and share this Creamed Cucumbers recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Salt, Butter, Onion, Pepper, Sour Cream, Sour Cream, fresh dill, Cucumber
Instructions:
1. Peel the cucumbers if waxed.
2. Cut them in half lengthwise and scoop  out the seeds with a spoon.
3. Cut them into 3/4 inch chunks.
4. If the  cucumbers are not super-firm, place the chunks in a colander and sprinkle  them with 1 tablespoon of salt. Shake to distribute the salt and let  them drain for about 20 minutes.
5. Rinse and dry.
6. If the cucumbers are  already firm, proceed with the recipe.  Place butter in a medium to large skillet over medium heat. When it  melts, add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion  softens, about 5 minutes.
7. Do not let the onion brown.
8. Add the cucumbers  and cook, stirring for about 5 minutes, until the cucumbers are just  tender.
9. Add pepper and, if you did not salt them earlier, salt.  Turn heat to low, then stir in the cream or yogurt and a good handful  of dill.
10. Stir until well blended, then serve, garnished with more dill.

title: Virginia Fried Soft Shell Crabs
content:
Recipe Name: Virginia Fried Soft Shell Crabs
Description: Make and share this Virginia Fried Soft Shell Crabs recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: soft shelled crabs, Milk, Flour, Egg, Salt
Instructions:
1. Dress fresh crabs or thaw frozen crabs.  Rinse in cold water; drain.
2. Combine eggs, milk, and salt.
3. Combine flour and crumbs.
4. Dip crabs in egg mixture and roll in flour/crumb mixture. For heavier breading, let crabs sit several minutes and repeat dipping/rolling procedure. Additional spices, such as cayenne pepper and garlic, may also be added.
5. Place crabs in a heavy frying pan which contains 1/8 to 1/4 inch of fat, hot but not smoking.
6. Fry at moderate heat. When crabs are brown on one side, turn carefully and brown the other side. Cooking time is approximately 8 to 10 minutes.
7. Drain on absorbent paper.

title: Blue Jimmy Pillows
content:
Recipe Name: Blue Jimmy Pillows
Description: Make and share this Blue Jimmy Pillows recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Chicken Broth, Worcestershire Sauce, Parsley, Salt, celery seed, tarragon, All-Purpose Flour, Egg
Instructions:
1. In saucepan, combine chicken broth, vegetable oil, Worcestershire sauce,  parsley, season salt, celery seed, red pepper, and tarragon.
2. Bring to a  boil, incorporate flour until blended.
3. Once flour and ingredients are  combined set aside to cool.
4. While that is cooling beat eggs to a fluffy  consistency.
5. The reason for letting the flour mixture cool is so that it  doesn't cook  the eggs.
6. Combine beaten eggs and flour mixture thoroughly.
7. Incorporate  crab meat. After everything is combined, drop 1 large tablespoon per  serving onto ungreased cookie sheet, and bake at 425 degrees for 12 to 15  minutes or until golden brown.

title: Apricot Salsa
content:
Recipe Name: Apricot Salsa
Description: Make and share this Apricot Salsa recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: red bell pepper, Olive Oil, Onion, Tomatoe, apricots, dark rum, apple cider
Instructions:
1. Cut a red bell pepper in half; remove seeds; and roast half of it. (Brush with olive oil; put under broiler very close to heat until blackened, about 5 minutes). Chop.
2. Saute onion in about a tablespoon  of olive oil until translucent.
3. Add tomato and jalapeno; saute about another 5 minutes, until tomato is cooked.
4. Add apple cider to cover apricots and boil down until cider is almost all boiled off.
5. Add chopped roasted bell pepper; stir.
6. Add dark rum and flambe. (Light and swirl until flame goes out).
7. Serve hot over grilled shark, swordfish, shrimp, or marlin.

title: English Trifle - Guy Attwood
content:
Recipe Name: English Trifle - Guy Attwood
Description: Make and share this English Trifle - Guy Attwood recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, Cornstarch, Vanilla, Nutmeg, cream sherry, frozen raspberries
Instructions:
1. This recipe was given to me by my Grandmother who came over to America in 1895 from England. I have altered it slightly. As far as I know it is  relatively original, or as original as any type of recipe such as this can be. It is not only addictive and decadent but pretty to look at as  well. This is a special occasion dessert.
2. Whisk yolks in a medium saucepan.
3. Gradually add sugar, whisking until  mixture is thick and lemon colored, about 1 or 2 minutes.
4. Blend in whole milk,  whipping cream and cornstarch; mix.
5. Place over medium low heat and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens, about 3 to 5 minutes. DO NOT BOIL  OR MIXTURE WILL SEPARATE.
6. Remove from heat and stir until slightly cooled.
7. Blend in vanilla and nutmeg.
8. Transfer to a bowl; repeat process for the  two required for the trifle.
9. ASSEMBLY:
10. Whip the cream as your MaMa or Daddy taught you to do.
11. In your  prettiest large crystal bowl (salad bowl size) place a little less than  half the whipped cream around the bottom and half way up the sides.
12. Break 1/2 of the cakes into bite sized pieces and drop randomly all over the  cream.
13. Drizzle sherry over all.
14. Drop dollops of jam and slightly less  than half of the drained raspberries over the cake.
15. Drizzle 1/2 of the  thick but liquid custard over all.
16. Repeat for the next layer, reserving  some raspberries for the top.
17. (Try to plan to end with a layer of jam and  raspberries as the top of the Trifle.)
18. Finally, completely cover the top  with the remaining whipped cream.
19. Drizzle a little chocolate on top in any  pattern you think looks good.
20. Add a few raspberries and stand back to receive raves.
21. To serve, merely scoop down and place on a pretty  plate.
22. NOTE: Make about 4 hours before serving. Cover with plastic wrap and  refrigerate.

title: Rote GrÜTze
content:
Recipe Name: Rote GrÜTze
Description: Make and share this Rote Grütze recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: raspberries, strawberries, dark sweet red cherries, dark sweet cherries, cranberry juice, Sugar, lemon zest, Lemon Juice, Cornstarch, dry red wine, Heavy Cream
Instructions:
1. FOR DESSERT:
2. Combine raspberry juice, pureed strawberries and cherry juice in  1 quart measure.
3. Add enough grape juice to total 1 quart.
4. Pour mixture into  heavy saucepan (NOT ALUMINUM).
5. Add 2 more cups grape juice.
6. Stir in sugar, lemon zest, lemon juice.
7. Bring to a boil, uncovered, over medium heat stirring often.
8. Combine cornstarch with wine in separate bowl to make a thin, smooth  paste.
9. As soon as mixture boils, add corn starch paste, whisking vigorously.
10. Immediately reduce heat to low; cook and stir for 3 minutes until mixture boils again, thickens, and starch taste is gone.
11. Stir in raspberries and cherries gently.
12. Heat and stir 1 minute more.
13. Remove from heat and stir 1 minute more.
14. Cool mixture to room temperature.
15. Chill for 24 hours.
16. FOR TOPPING:
17. Shortly before serving, beat heavy cream with vanilla sugar until slightly thickened, but still thin enough to pour.
18. Spoon Rote Grutze into stemmed goblets and top each with a generous ladle of whipped cream and serve.

title: Twice Baked Ham And Cheese Potatoes
content:
Recipe Name: Twice Baked Ham And Cheese Potatoes
Description: Make and share this Twice Baked Ham and Cheese Potatoes recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Potatoe, Cheddar Cheese, Milk, ham, Sour Cream, Pepper, Butter, Paprika, parsley flakes
Instructions:
1. Bake potatoes at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 1 hour until soft.
2. Slice potatoes in half lengthwise.
3. Scoop out insides, leaving a firm shell.
4. Place potato pulp, cheddar cheese, milk, ham, sour cream, onion salt, pepper, and butter in a mixing bowl.
5. Beat at high speed until smooth.
6. Fill potato shells with mixture.
7. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 to 30   minutes.
8. Garnish with paprika or parsley.

title: Twice-Baked Sweet Potatoes
content:
Recipe Name: Twice-Baked Sweet Potatoes
Description: Make and share this Twice-Baked Sweet Potatoes recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: head of garlic, sweet potatoes, Sour Cream, Salt, Pepper
Instructions:
1. Remove outer covering from garlic but don't separate the cloves.
2. Wrap garlic in aluminum foil coated with cooking spray.
3. Place garlic and sweet potatoes on a baking sheet.
4. Bake at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 1-1/4 hours.
5. Separate garlic cloves; squeeze to extract 2 teaspoons pulp.
6. Slice skin away from top of each potato and scoop out the pulp leaving   the shells intact.
7. Mash potato pulp with garlic, sour cream, salt and pepper.
8. Spoon into potato shells.
9. Bake 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 15 minutes or until heated.

title: Curry Curlies
content:
Recipe Name: Curry Curlies
Description: Make and share this Curry Curlies recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: puff pastry sheets, Butter, curry powder
Instructions:
1. Cut pastry into 1 cm strips.
2. Brush both sides of the strips with combined melted butter and curry powder.
3. Lightly press finely crushed potato chips on both sides; twist to curl.
4. Place on lightly greased oven trays.
5. Bake in moderately hot oven 8 minutes or until golden.
6. Cool on wire rack.

title: Florentiner
content:
Recipe Name: Florentiner
Description: Make and share this Florentiner recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Sugar, Flour, Water
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. In saucepan, combine whipping cream, butter and  sugar.
3. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Add candied fruit, candied orange, almond slivers, ground almonds, and flour, one after the other to cream, mixing well.
6. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet, leaving several inches space in between.
7. With fork, dipped in water, press dough to approx 5 cm  (2 inches diameter) rounds.
8. Bake 5 to 6 minutes.
9. Carefully remove and cool on  rack.
10. In the meantime, for the glaze, melt the grated chocolate with water in double boiler or in microwave.
11. After cookies have cooled, brush glaze onto smooth bottom side of  cookies.
12. Before glaze hardens, make a pattern by moving a fork across glaze.
13. Die Florentiner im 180 oC heissen Ofen 5 bis 6 Minuten backen.
14. Mit einem  Spatel vom Blech loesen und auf einem Kuchengitter abkuehlen lassen.
15. Inzwischen die feingeriebene Zartbitterschokolade mit dem Wasser  vermischen und im heissen Wasserbad schmelzen.

title: Florentines
content:
Recipe Name: Florentines
Description: Make and share this Florentines recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: All-Purpose Flour, Baking Soda, Salt, Butter, Margarine, Brown Sugar, light corn syrup, Egg, Coconut, Vanilla Extract, Butter, Margarine
Instructions:
1. Mix flour, baking soda and salt.
2. Cream 1/4 cup butter or margarine.
3. Gradually add brown sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
4. Add corn syrup  and egg.
5. Blend well.
6. Stir in flour mixture, coconut and vanilla.
7. Drop by half teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheets, leaving 2 inches between.
8. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit (180 degrees Celsius) about 10 minutes.
9. Cool on baking sheets for 1 minute.
10. Remove quickly and finish cooling on racks. (If wafer hardens, return briefly to oven).
11. Melt chocolate and 1 tablespoon  butter in pan over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth.
12. Drizzle chocolate over cookies.

title: Thai Citrus Chicken Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Citrus Chicken Salad
Description: This is a healthy and delicious summer salad. Great for lunch while sitting out in the garden with a a nice cold glass of white wine. :)
Ingredients: Clove, light soy sauce, oranges, lime, Brown Sugar, Chinese cabbage, bean sprouts, Onion, orange, fresh cilantro, fresh cilantro
Instructions:
1. DRESSING:
2. Combine the ginger, garlic, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, orange juice, lime juice, and brown sugar together.
3. Add salt and freshly ground pepper and taste for seasoning.
4. Refrigerate 1 hour to allow flavors to infuse.
5. SALAD:
6. Combine the Chinese Cabbage, bean sprouts, sliced red onion and orange segments. (I like to drop everything in a large zip-lock bag).
7. Toss with half of the dressing. (Again, if you use a zip-lock bag you can easily pour in half of the dressing, seal and fumble to mix dressing in with salad; place in the refrigerator until ready to use.).
8. Add the sliced chicken to a frying pan and brown lightly with a small amount of olive oil.
9. Add the remainder of the citrus dressing; bring to a boil; reduce for 30 seconds to allow mixture to thicken slightly.
10. Place Chinese cabbage mixture on two dinner plates.
11. Arrange sliced chicken on top and pour over the remaining sauce.
12. Top with freshly chopped cilantro.

title: Chutney Ham Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Chutney Ham Salad
Description: This is one of the Zaar recipes that I adopted. I hope to make this soon as it looks like a dish my family would enjoy. I’ll edit the recipe accordingly if needed.
Ingredients: pineapple chunks, ham, Cheddar Cheese, Sour Cream, chutney
Instructions:
1. Drain pineapple, reserving 2 tablespoons juice.
2. Arrange pineapple, ham and cheese onto each of four salad plates lined with crisp salad greens.
3. For dressing, combine sour cream, reserved pineapple juice and chutney.
4. Spoon dressing over each salad to serve.

title: Dolmades With Yogurt-Mint Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Dolmades With Yogurt-Mint Sauce
