Description: Make and share this Dolmades with Yogurt-Mint Sauce recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Olive Oil, Olive Oil, Onion, Garlic, long grain white rice, Cumin, canned chicken broth, currants, pine nuts, fresh parsley, of fresh mint, grape leaves, Sour Cream, of fresh mint, Garlic, lemon wedge
Instructions:
1. FOR GRAPE LEAVES:
2. Heat 1/4 cup oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium low heat. Add  onion and garlic. Saute until very tender, about 10 minutes.
3. Add  rice and cumin and stir 1 minute. Add 2 cups broth and currants.
4. Cover and simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, about  20 minutes.
5. Transfer to bowl.
6. Mix in nuts, parsley and mint. Season  with salt and pepper.
7. Cool completely.
8. (Can be made I day ahead. Cover; chill.)
9. Place grape leaves in bowl.
10. Cover with cold water and let stand 30  minutes.
11. Drain.
12. (Cut off stems.
13. Arrange 1 leaf veined side up on  work surface. Place 1 rounded Tbsp of rice filling on stem end,  leaving 1/2-inch border.
14. Fold 2 short sides over rice, then roll up  starting at stem end.
15. Repeat with remaining leaves and filling.
16. Place seam in side down in 2 heavy 12-inch skillets.
17. Divide  remaining 3 Tbsp oil and 2 cups broth between skillets.
18. Cover;  simmer over medium-low heat until liquid is absorbed, about 30  minutes.
19. Uncover and let rolls cool.
20. Transfer to platter.
21. Cover and  chill.
22. (Can be made 1 day ahead.)   FOR SAUCE:  Combine yogurt, mint, and garlic in small bowl.
23. Season to taste with  salt and pepper.
24. Place grape leaf rolls on platter and garnish with lemon.
25. Serve with  sauce.  These rice-filled grape leaves are a classic Greek appetizer.

title: Grand Marnier Cake Ii
content:
Recipe Name: Grand Marnier Cake Ii
Description: Make and share this Grand Marnier Cake II recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Sugar, Egg, Flour, baking powder, Baking Soda, Sour Cream, orange, zest of, Grand Marnier, Sugar
Instructions:
1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Beat in egg yolks.
3. Add flour, baking powder and baking soda alternately with sour cream, beating until smooth.
4. Stir in orange rind and chopped almonds.
5. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
6. Pour into buttered 9-inch tube pan.
7. Bake in moderate 350 degree Fahrenheit oven about 50 minutes.
8. Mix orange juice, Grand Marnier, and sugar together; spoon over hot cake in pan.
9. Decorate top with almonds.
10. Cool before removing from pan.

title: French Pecan Pie Ii
content:
Recipe Name: French Pecan Pie Ii
Description: Make and share this French Pecan Pie II recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Vanilla, graham cracker crumbs, Sugar, Pecan, baking powder
Instructions:
1. Mix egg whites and vanilla.
2. Add graham cracker crumbs, sugar, pecans, and baking powder.
3. Gentleness not obligatory; just stir it all up and pour into a well buttered pie pan.
4. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for  25 to 30 minutes.
5. Do not overcook.
6. Allow to cool.
7. Top with whipped cream and  refrigerate until ready to serve.
8. Pie (without cream) freezes well.

title: Fish Chowder
content:
Recipe Name: Fish Chowder
Description: This is one of the recipes I adopted -- it's gotten 5 stars all around, so I won't change it, but I wouldn't use margarine or cooking oil -- I would use either light olive oil or unsalted butter. I also might substitute half and half for the milk, to be a little decadent once in a while...
Ingredients: cod fish fillet, Margarine, Onion, Celery, raw potatoes, Carrot, boiling water, Salt, Pepper, Milk
Instructions:
1. Cut cod fillets into bite sized pieces.
2. Melt margarine in large saucepan Cook  onion and celery until onion is tender and translucent. Add potatoes, carrots,  water, salt and pepper.
3. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes until vegetables are  tender.
4. Add fish and cook 10 minutes longer.
5. Add milk.
6. Reheat, but do not boil.
7. Serves 4.
8. Serve hot, with freshly baked home made bread or rolls and butter.

title: Drunken Chicken
content:
Recipe Name: Drunken Chicken
Description: Make and share this Drunken Chicken recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: whole chicken, low sodium chicken broth, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Scallion
Instructions:
1. Put chicken in a medium-size pot, large enough to hold it and have  it submerged in the cooking liquids.
2. Add chicken broth, ginger, soy  sauce, scallions and whiskey and bring it to a simmer.
3. Simmer, covered  for 45 minutes.
4. Then turn off the heat and leave the lid on the pot--do  not remove cover.
5. Allow chicken to sit for another 30 minutes or so.
6. Then remove chicken, rub lightly with sesame oil and serve.

title: Drunken Chicken Ii
content:
Recipe Name: Drunken Chicken Ii
Description: Make and share this Drunken Chicken II recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Water, chicken breast, Ginger, Scallion, Salt, sherry wine, Cilantro
Instructions:
1. Bring water to boil, then add chicken breast, ginger, scallion and salt.  Boil 15 minutes.
2. Remove to bowl.
3. Debone chicken while warm.
4. Remove ginger and scallion and discard.
5. Place chicken and its stock in container.
6. Add sherry.
7. Cover and refrigerate 1-5 days.
8. When ready to serve, cut chicken into 1-inch pieces.
9. Arrange on platter.
10. Pour jellied liquid over chicken and decorate with cilantro.
11. Serve cold.

title: Curry Chicken
content:
Recipe Name: Curry Chicken
Description: Make and share this Curry Chicken recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: chicken wings, curry powder, Salt, Black Pepper, Onion, Green Pepper
Instructions:
1. Season wings to taste, using curry powder generously.
2. Cut potatoes into bite size cubes.
3. Saute chicken wings, onion, green pepper and potatoes in oil until brown.
4. Add 1/2 to 3/4 cup water.
5. Simmer until juices thicken and chicken is tender.

title: Curried Chicken
content:
Recipe Name: Curried Chicken
Description: Make and share this Curried Chicken recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Chicken, Salt, curry powder, Onion, rosemary, Garlic, Thyme, Water
Instructions:
1. Season chicken with salt, curry powder, onions, rosemary, garlic, pepper and thyme.
2. Marinate for 2 hours, or in refrigerator overnight.
3. In a heavy skillet,  brown the chicken pieces lightly in oil for approximately 20 minutes.
4. Check constantly to make sure nothing sticks.
5. Add water and simmer for another 20  minutes until tender.
6. Serve over white rice. (Serves 4).

title: Cheesy Stuffed Acorn Squash
content:
Recipe Name: Cheesy Stuffed Acorn Squash
Description: Great vegetarian version of stuffed acorn squash, full of stuff most people would have in the fridge.
Ingredients: acorn squash, Butter, Onion, broccoli floret, Mushroom, Celery, Walnut, Brown Sugar, Soy Sauce, fresh basil, muenster cheese
Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 400°F.
2. Cut squash in half and remove the seeds.
3. Rub the cut flesh  with salt and place flesh side down in a baking dish and bake for about 35  minutes.
4. While the squash is baking, sauté onion in butter until clear and add  chopped broccoli florets, mushrooms and celery.
5. Sauté about 4 minutes.
6. Stir in  walnuts and fresh basil, then sprinkle with brown sugar and soy sauce, adjust  seasoning to taste. Toss to mix well.
7. Check baking squash with a fork to see if  it glides through the flesh.
8. Stuff with vegetable mixture, top with equal  amounts of grated cheese and return to oven for about 5 minutes.
9. NOTES : Baked acorn squash halves stuffed with sautéed broccoli, cheese and  walnuts.

title: Acorn, Butternut Squash And Parsnips Gratin
content:
Recipe Name: Acorn, Butternut Squash And Parsnips Gratin
Description: Make and share this Acorn, Butternut Squash and Parsnips Gratin recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: fresh parsley, Salt, dried oregano, dried thyme, Pepper, acorn squash, parsnips, Olive Oil, olive oil-flavored vegetable cooking spray, reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese, oregano sprig
Instructions:
1. Combine breadcrumbs, parsley, salt, oregano, thyme and pepper  in a large bowl; stir well.
2. Add acorn squash, butternut squash, parsnips, and olive oil, tossing to coat.
3. Spoon squash mixture into a 2 quart casserole coated with cooking spray.
4. Cover and bake at 325 degrees Fahrenheit for 1-1/2  hours.
5. Sprinkle with cheese.
6. Bake, uncovered, an additional 15 minutes.
7. Garnish with oregano, if desired.
8. NOTES : Use any combination of winter squash to equal 6 cups, if desired.

title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Caesar Wraps
Description: Make and share this Chicken Caesar Wraps recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Olive Oil, lemon pepper, Garlic, skinless chicken breast half, Sour Cream, Milk, Parmesan Cheese, Pepper, Garlic, flour tortilla, romaine lettuce
Instructions:
1. In a large self-closing plastic bag combine olive oil, lemon pepper, garlic, and Italian seasoning.
2. Add chicken to bag and seal tightly.
3. Turn bag gently to distribute marinade. Refrigerate 15  minutes.
4. Preheat grill to medium heat.
5. Remove the chicken from the marinade and arrange on the grill rack.
6. Grill 10 to 14 minutes, turning occasionally.
7. Remove chicken and cut into strips.
8. In a small bowl combine sour cream, milk, parmesan cheese, Italian seasoning, pepper and garlic for the dressing.
9. Place Romaine lettuce and sliced chicken in a warmed tortilla.
10. Top with dressing.
11. Fold tortilla.
12. NOTES : I slice chicken and then place in marinade. I also cook on the stovetop.

title: Spicy Acorn Squash Soup
content:
Recipe Name: Spicy Acorn Squash Soup
Description: Make and share this Spicy Acorn Squash Soup recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: low sodium chicken broth, Onion, acorn squash, Salt, Water, long-grain rice, chunky peanut butter, fresh parsley
Instructions:
1. Place 1/4 cup chicken broth in a large saucepan; bring to a boil.
2. Add onion and  crushed red pepper; cook 5 minutes or until tender.
3. Add remaining 2-3/4 cups  broth, squash, salt, and water; bring to a boil.
4. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer  for 20 minutes.
5. Add rice; cover and simmer 20 minutes or until squash and rice  are tender.
6. Place peanut butter and half of soup in a blender; cover and process until  smooth.
7. Pour puree into a bowl.
8. Repeat with remaining soup, and add to bowl,  stirring well.

title: Ken'S White Chili
content:
Recipe Name: Ken'S White Chili
Description: Make and share this Ken's White Chili recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: great northern bean, fat-free chicken broth, Onion, Clove, Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, Cumin, Oregano, cayenne pepper, Lemon Juice, green chilies, monterey jack cheese
Instructions:
1. Soak beans overnight.
2. Combine beans, chicken broth, onions and garlic in large pot.
3. Cook (boil, then simmer) for 1 to 2 hours until beans are done. (Do not stir  too much or the beans will fall apart).
4. When beans are done, add chicken, cumin, oregano, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper, lemon juice, and chilies.
5. Simmer for approximately 1 hour.
6. Add grated cheese last. Simmer until cheese is melted; stir or cheese will sink to the bottom  and scorch.
7. NOTES.
8. Cooking times are approximate. Basically cook until the beans are  done and spices have \"soaked in\" then cook until cheese melts.
9. Sometimes not all of the chicken broth is necessary.
10. You don't want it too soupy, so I  usually add about 4 cans of chicken broth and add the last can as needed.
11. This will make a large pot.
12. Serve with a salad and garlic bread and enjoy!

title: White Chili
content:
Recipe Name: White Chili
Description: Make and share this White Chili recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast halves, great northern bean, fat-free chicken broth, Cumin, salsa, monterey jack cheese
Instructions:
1. Brown chicken breast pieces in a little oil or Pam.
2. Add beans, salsa, cumin  and a little chicken broth and simmer for 30 minutes.
3. Add cheese and simmer  until completely melted.
4. Add chicken broth as needed to thicken to desired  consistency.

title: Light Easy Crisp
content:
Recipe Name: Light Easy Crisp
Description: Make and share this Light Easy Crisp recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cinnamon, Blueberrie, Blueberrie, All-Purpose Flour, rolled oats, Brown Sugar, Butter
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350F.
2. Peel and core apples, if using.
3. Cut peaches or apples into  1/2-inch wedges and place in a bowl.
4. Sprinkle with cinnamon and toss until  evenly coated.
5. If using peaches, mix in berries.
6. (Blueberries will turn the  apples gray.) Press down firmly in a 9-inch pie plate.  In a medium-sized bowl, stir flour with rolled oats and brown sugar.Slowly add  butter, working in with a fork.
7. Carefully mound on top of fruit and gently press  into surface. Bake in centre of preheated oven for 60-70 minutes or until fruit  is tender when pierced with a skewer.
8. This crisp is wonderful served warm with  ice cream or yoghurt cheese

title: Giant Baked Hero
content:
Recipe Name: Giant Baked Hero
Description: Make and share this Giant Baked Hero recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Olive Oil, Clove, Clove, dry basil leaves, dry oregano leaves, dry thyme leaves, ham, fontina, monterey jack cheese, Onion, Olive Oil
Instructions:
1. Pat loaves together.
2. On a lightly floured board, roll dough into a 12\" x18\"  rectangle.
3. Garlic Oil: Combine 3 tablespoons olive oil with 2 cloves garlic, minced or  pressed and 1/2 teaspoon each dry basil leaves, dry oregano leaves and dry thyme  leaves. Brush surface with 2 tablespoons garlic oil.
4. Cover half dough lengthwise with overlapping layers of salami, ham, coppa, cheese, onions and  peppers.
5. Lift plain half of dough over filling (if dough sticks, loosen with a  spatula). Press edges firmly together to seal.
6. Using 2 wide spatulas, transfer  packet to an oiled 12\" x17\" baking sheet; tuck ends of dough under.
7. Brush with remaining oil.
8. Let rise in a warm place until puffy, about 20 minutes.
9. Bake at 400 degrees Fahrenheit until richly browned, 15 to 20 minutes.
10. Cut sandwich lengthwise in half then  crosswise into 3\" slices.
11. Grilled Onion: In an 8-10\" frying pan over medium high heat, combine 1 tablespoon olive oil, 2 tablespoons balsamic or red wine vinegar and 1 large onion, sliced. Stir often, until onion begins to brown, 8 to 10 minutes; set aside.

title: Brown Sugar Shortbread
content:
Recipe Name: Brown Sugar Shortbread
Description: Make and share this Brown Sugar Shortbread recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Brown Sugar, Flour
Instructions:
1. In a mixing bowl, cream butter and brown sugar.
2. Gradually stir in the flour.
3. Turn onto  a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth, about 3 minutes.
4. Pat into a 1/3\"  thick rectangle measuring 11\" x8\".
5. Cut into 2\" x1\" strips.
6. Place 1\" apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
7. Prick with a fork.
8. Bake at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 minutes or until bottom begins to brown.
9. Cool for 5 minutes.
10. Remove to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Pork Sate With Peanut Dipping Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Pork Sate With Peanut Dipping Sauce
Description: Make and share this Pork Sate With Peanut Dipping Sauce recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: fresh lemongrass, fresh lime juice, dark brown sugar, Soy Sauce, Clove, fresh lemongrass, Chicken Broth, creamy peanut butter, Onion, jalapeno chile, Onion
Instructions:
1. Mix 1 Tbsp lemon grass, 1 Tbsp lime juice, 1 Tbsp dark brown sugar, soy sauce, and garlic in large bowl.
2. Add pork; toss to coat with marinade.
3. NOTE: Pork tenderloins should be trimmed, cut into 3-inch long, 1/2-inch wide, 1/4-inch-thick slices.
4. Let stand 30 minutes to 1 hour.
5. Meanwhile, mix remaining 1/3 cup lemon grass, remaining 2 Tbsp lime juice, remaining 1 Tbsp sugar, 1 cup chicken broth, peanut butter, onion, coriander and jalapeno in heavy medium saucepan.
6. Bring to boil, whisking frequently.
7. Transfer mixture to blender and puree.
8. Strain into heavy small saucepan, pressing on solids with back of spoon; discard solids.
9. Simmer until reduced to thick sauce consistency, stirring frequently, about 6 minutes. (Can be prepared 1 day ahead. Cover and refrigerate. Reheat before using, thinning with more chicken broth if necessary.)
10. Preheat broiler.
11. Thread 3 pork strips on each skewer.
12. Broil until cooked through, about 3 minutes per side.
13. Pour sauce into bowl; set in center of platter.
14. Sprinkle with green onion.
15. Surround with pork skewers and serve.
16. Serves 6 as an appetizer.

title: Eight Layer Shortbread Slices
content:
Recipe Name: Eight Layer Shortbread Slices
Description: Make and share this Eight Layer Shortbread Slices recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Flour, Cornstarch, Butter, Margarine, Confectioners' Sugar, Vanilla
Instructions:
1. Sift together flour and cornstarch onto a sheet of waxed paper. Set aside.
2. Beat butter and confectioners' sugar in a medium bowl until blended.
3. Stir in vanilla.
4. Gradually beat in flour mixture to make soft dough.
5. Divide dough in half.
6. Knead cocoa  powder into 1/2 of dough in bowl.
7. Flatten both doughs; wrap separately in plastic wrap or waxed paper.
8. Chill 1 hour or until easy to handle.
9. Roll each  batch of dough between 2 sheets of wax paper into 10\" square.
10. Push sides in to  make absolutely even, using ruler or long-bladed knife.
11. If dough becomes too  soft or sticky, refrigerate on cookie sheet.
12. Remove top sheet of wax paper from nonchocolate dough; brush top with egg white.
13. Remove paper from top of chocolate dough; invert onto nonchocolate dough, matching sides up exactly.
14. Peel off  remaining sheet of wax paper.
15. Cut into 4 equal strips, each 10 x 2 1/3\".
16. Brush  lightly with egg white.
17. Stack dough strips neatly to make 8 alternating layers.
18. Wrap stack in plastic wrap.
19. Chill several hours or overnight.
20. Dough can be  refrigerated for up to 1 week.
21. Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
22. Cut dough crosswise into slices slightly less than 1/4\"  thick.
23. Place slices on cookie sheets 1\" apart.
24. Bake 10 minutes.
25. Transfer cookies to wire rack to cool completely.
26. Store cookies in  tightly covered containers in cool, dry place.

title: Oktoberfest Spinach Strudel
content:
Recipe Name: Oktoberfest Spinach Strudel
Description: Make and share this Oktoberfest Spinach Strudel recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Onion, Parsley, frozen spinach, fat free parmesan, Nutmeg, Black Pepper, phyllo dough, Skim Milk
Instructions:
1. Simmer onion and parsley in stock until tender; set aside.
2. Cook spinach  according to package directions. Drain, squeezing out excess liquid.
3. Add onion  mixture, bread crumbs, egg white, Parmesan, nutmeg and pepper; mix well.
4. Place  two phyllo sheets on a damp towel on work surface.
5. Work quickly so that phyllo does not dry out.
6. Spread half of spinach mixture along (about 1-inch inside) narrow edge of phyllo and roll up jelly-roll-style.
7. Brush top and sides with skim milk.
8. With sharp knife, cut several slits on top to vent steam.
9. Place on baking sheet prepared with nonstick spray.
10. Cover with another damp towel while repeating process with last two phyllo sheets and remaining spinach mixture.
11. Bake at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown.
12. Cut each roll into six pieces.

title: Thai Fish Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Fish Curry
Description: Make and share this Thai Fish Curry recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Onion, fresh cilantro stems, fresh lemongrass, turmeric, Ginger, Cumin, Clove, sea bass fillet, canned unsweetened coconut milk, bottled clam juice, fresh cilantro, rice
Instructions:
1. Blend onion, cilantro, lemongrass, turmeric, ginger, cumin, garlic, and dried red peppers in a food processor to dry paste, stopping frequently to scrape down sides of work bowl. (Paste can be prepared  3 days ahead. Cover and chill.)
2. Heat vegetable oil in a medium non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add 2  rounded tablespoons spice paste; stir 1 minute.
4. Add fish and cook 2  minutes, turning occasionally with tongs.
5. Add coconut milk and clam  juice; simmer until fish is cooked through, turning occasionally, about 6 minutes.
6. Transfer fish to plate.
7. Boil liquid until reduced to thick sauce, about 8 minutes.
8. Season with salt.
9. Return fish to sauce and heat through.
10. Sprinkle with cilantro.
11. Serve over rice.
12. The mild spice paste is also great used as a base for chicken and  shrimp curries.

title: Spinach Phyllo Casserole
content:
Recipe Name: Spinach Phyllo Casserole
Description: The layers of this low-fat phyllo pastry are coated with a mixture of egg whites and olive oil instead of melted butter.
Ingredients: Onion, Chicken Broth, All-Purpose Flour, Skim Milk, low-fat cheddar cheese, fresh spinach, frozen spinach, phyllo pastry, Olive Oil
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 F (190 C). Saute onions in chicken broth until broth has  evaporated.
2. Stir flour into milk until dissolved.
3. Add to onions and stir  constantly over medium heat until thickened.
4. Blend in cheese until melted.
5. Remove from heat and stir in spinach.
6. Beat 6 egg whites until frothy and blend  into cheese mixture. Pour into a deep casserole dish brushed with olive oil.
7. Whisk together remaining egg white and the olive oil.
8. Blend well.
9. Cut sheets of  phyllo pastry in half.
10. Top the casserole with one piece of phyllo pastry.
11. Brush  with egg white mixture. Continue layering phyllo sheets, brushing each with the  mixture. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Mango Salsa
content:
Recipe Name: Mango Salsa
Description: Make and share this Mango Salsa recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: serrano chili, mango, tamarind pulp, Garlic, fresh cilantro, raw red bell pepper
Instructions:
1. mix together all ingredients in a bowl, makes about 2 cups
2. From: Salsa by Reed Hearon

title: Grilled Pineapple Salsa
content:
Recipe Name: Grilled Pineapple Salsa
Description: Make and share this Grilled Pineapple Salsa recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: fresh pineapple, anaheim chilies, jalapeno chile, Olive Oil
Instructions:
1. In a bowl, toss pineapple, anaheim and jalapeno chilies, and onion slices together in the olive oil.
2. Grill until soft and browned, about 10 minutes.
3. Pull tops off chiles.
4. Puree all ingredients in a food processor or  blender.

title: Country Fried Yellow Squash
content:
Recipe Name: Country Fried Yellow Squash
Description: Adopted Recipe...I worked through all my adopted recipes and made changes to suit my tastes and cooking habits. I do not cook with bacon grease, so I changed the recipe from bacon grease to butter. (Note added 2/5/06).
Ingredients: Butter, Onion, Salt, Water, Sugar
Instructions:
1. Wash tender yellow squash; remove stem and blossom ends.
2. Cut into 1/2-inch rounds.
3. Place squash, butter, onions and salt into heavy skillet.
4. Add water.
5. Cover and cook on medium low heat until water is absorbed and squash is tender.
6. Lightly mash with a fork.
7. Add sugar and cream.
8. Let it cook slowly until mixture is fairly dry and flavors develop, being careful not to let it scorch.

title: Tangy Marinated Yellow Squash (No Cooking)
content:
Recipe Name: Tangy Marinated Yellow Squash (No Cooking)
Description: Make and share this Tangy Marinated Yellow Squash (No Cooking) recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Green Onion, Green Pepper, Celery, wine vinegar, Sugar, Salt, Pepper, Cider Vinegar, Clove
Instructions:
1. Toss yellow squash, green onion, green pepper, and celery together.
2. Mix the marinade ingredients together.
3. Pour marinade over squash mixture.
4. Refrigerate for at least 12 hours.

title: Secret Salsa
content:
Recipe Name: Secret Salsa
Description: I rescued this salsa recipe by adopting it from the recipezaar account, and plan to nurse it back to health when i get the chance :) I think with a bit of tweaking, this recipe could be really good!
Ingredients: Tomatoe, tomato sauce, cumin powder, whole cumin seed, chili powder, msg, Onion
Instructions:
1. Get out the blender.
2. assemble the ingredients: At this point you should  barely have enough room to put  the lid on the blender.
3. Now the trick is to turn the blender on and off  quickly on \"chop\" speed if you have one with variable speeds.
4. That is  real slow.
5. Best if you got one with a pulse button.
6. This is one ya really  don't want all over the kitchen.
7. You can do this with a blender that has  only on/off by not leaving it on till you got spicy tomato soup.
8. However,  a good stiff shove to the bottom with a wooden spoon of the tomatoes  that are floatin to the top tryin to get away from the Jalapenos will help  things along quite nicely.
9. All you wanna do is get them broken into large  pieces and mixed thoroughly.
10. No more than fifteen seconds on total.
11. This should be about a Quart and a half.
12. I would recommend you put this  Gem in Glass jars and Lid/ring them and refrigerate for a while but it is  ready right now just gets better after sittin a spell.
13. It'll keep a week or so  in the icebox, most likely won't last that long anyhow.
14. Only problem,  which I have a solution to, Is that after a period of time there is so much  acid in this it starts attacking the metal lid/ring.
15. Solution: I have recently  come across some rather sturdy white plastic screw on lids by \"BALL\"  (r) that work very well.

title: Mashed Sweet Potato Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Mashed Sweet Potato Pie
Description: Make and share this Mashed Sweet Potato Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: sweet potatoes, Egg, Sugar, Salt, Ginger, Nutmeg, Vanilla, evaporated milk, Butter
Instructions:
1. Bake sweet potatoes until tender; peel and mash. Make sure all lumps are  removed, straining if necessary.
2. Mix mashed sweet potatoes, eggs, sugar, salt, ginger, nutmeg, vanilla, cream or evaporated milk and melted butter together.
3. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
4. Bake at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 50 minutes or until knife inserted one inch from edges of pie comes out clean.

title: Potatoes Tapas In Garlic Mayonnaise (Potatoes Aioli)
content:
Recipe Name: Potatoes Tapas In Garlic Mayonnaise (Potatoes Aioli)
Description: "Tapas, The Little Dishes of Spain" By Penelope Cases Alfred A. Knopf 1986 This book contains more than 200 recipes for tapas. The word "tapa" in Spanish means top or cover( there are other meanings) Spain has many bars one for every 120 persons. They are usually small and run by families. Coffee, water, soft drinks and liquor. They serve food also. They have the time and ingredients for these small dishes. In the early days tapas were served on small dishes placed as a cover over drinks. The tapas were small and sometimes they were free or sold for a small price. Today the dishes are larger and expensive. (4) recipes of the most commonly found tapas all over Spain
Ingredients: salad potatoes, Mayonnaise, Clove, Parsley, Salt
Instructions:
1. Boil potatoes in salt water until tender; peel and cut into 3/4 inch  chunks.
2. In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, garlic, and parsley.  (Mayonnaise should be a little thin, dilute with lemon juice or soft vinegar if necessary.).
3. Fold the potatoes into the sauce gently, season with salt to taste, serve  at room temperature.

title: Roasted Tomato And Mint Salsa
content:
Recipe Name: Roasted Tomato And Mint Salsa
Description: Make and share this Roasted Tomato and Mint Salsa recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Tomatoe, Clove, Lime Juice, extra virgin olive oil, Cilantro, spearmint, lime zest, orange zest, Salt
Instructions:
1. With a comal or black iron skillet over medium-high heat, cook the tomatoes until blackened all over.
2. While still warm, pulse tomatoes with the garlic in a food processor until roughly chopped.
3. Cool to room temperature.
4. Add lime juice, olive oil, peppers, cilantro, spearmint, lime zest, orange zest, and salt.
5. Mix together and let stand at least 30 minutes before using.
6. Mark Miller writes: \"Ripe red tomatoes roasted on a hot steel comal until the skins blacken are a basic element of many Mexican salsas. The smoky flavor adds a complexity to the taste of ripe tomatoes.\".

title: Raspberry Tapioca With Vanilla Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Raspberry Tapioca With Vanilla Sauce
Description: Make and share this Raspberry Tapioca With Vanilla Sauce recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: frozen raspberries, Granulated Sugar, lemon, rind of, Water, port wine, quick-cooking tapioca, Cornstarch, Water, vanilla flavoring, Salt, Milk, Water
Instructions:
1. In a medium-size saucepan combine raspberries, sugar, lemon peel and  water.
2. Bring to a boil while stirring.
3. Simmer for about 10 minutes.
4. Stir  in tapioca, bring back to boiling, reduce heat, cook stirring constantly  until mixture becomes thick and translucent. Pour into a glass mold or  individual dessert dishes.
5. Refrigerate until chilled (about 2 hours).  Serve with vanilla sauce or whipped cream.
6. Vanilla Sauce: Mix the cornstarch with the water, add sugar, vanilla flavor and salt.
7. In medium sized saucepan boil the milk, take saucepan off the heat.
8. Add  cornstarch mixture, stirring constantly.
9. Return to heat, stir in the egg yolk/water, and cook on low heat, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.
10. Serve cold.

title: Spaetzle - Basic Recipe - Art Culinaire Issue
content:
Recipe Name: Spaetzle - Basic Recipe - Art Culinaire Issue
Description: Make and share this Spaetzle - Basic Recipe - Art Culinaire Issue recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Egg, Flour, Milk, Salt, baking powder
Instructions:
1. Bring a saucepan of salted water it a boil, reduce the heat, and  maintain a simmer.
2. In a bowl, stir all the ingredients together.
3. Place a  colander over the pan, pour about 1/4 of the batter into the colander,  and press through the holes with a plastic spatula into the  hot water.
4. When the spaetzle starts to float to the surface, cover the  pan and keep covered until the spaetzle appears to swell and is fluffy.
5. Remove the dumplings and repeat the procedure with the remaining batter.

title: Home-Style Meatballs (Albondigas Caseras)
content:
Recipe Name: Home-Style Meatballs (Albondigas Caseras)
Description: The word "tapa" in Spanish means top or cover (there are other meanings) Spain has many bars - one for every 120 persons. They are usually small and run by families. Coffee, water, soft drinks and liquor. They serve food also. They have the time and ingredients for these small dishes. In the early days tapas were served on small dishes placed as a cover over drinks. The tapas were small and sometimes they were free or sold for a small price. Today the dishes are larger and expensive. (4) recipes of the most commonly found tapas all over Spain.
Ingredients: beef, pork, Clove, Egg, Nutmeg, Salt, Pepper, Flour, Olive Oil, Onion, Green Pepper, Tomatoe, dry white wine, Chicken Broth, Salt, Pepper
Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine the beef, veal, and pork with bread crumbs, 4 cloves of  garlic, the eggs, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
2. Form into cocktail-size  meatballs. Dust with flour.
3. Saute the meatballs in a casserole with olive oil until well browned on all sides.
4. Add onion, remaining clove of  garlic, and green pepper.
5. Cook until onion is wilted.
6. Add the tomato, wine, broth, salt and pepper.
7. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes.

title: Banana Orange Ice Cream
content:
Recipe Name: Banana Orange Ice Cream
Description: Make and share this Banana Orange Ice Cream recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: banana, Lemon Juice, Salt, Sugar, Confectioners' Sugar, Heavy Cream
Instructions:
1. Peel and mash bananas.
2. Combine with lemon juice, salt, sugar and fresh orange juice.
3. Fold confectioners' sugar into lightly whipped heavy cream.
4. Add to banana  mixture.
5. Churn-freeze.

title: Kahlua
content:
Recipe Name: Kahlua
Description: Make and share this Kahlua recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Water, Sugar, instant coffee, vodka, pure vanilla extract
Instructions:
1. Bring water and sugar to a rolling boil.
2. Remove from heat.
3. Add instant coffee. Stir well to dissolve completely.
4. Let cool until lukewarm.
5. Add vodka and vanilla.
6. Stir well; bottle in brown bottles.
7. Let stand for 2 weeks.

title: Apple Crisp
content:
Recipe Name: Apple Crisp
Description: Make and share this Apple Crisp recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: apple, Flour, Salt, Sugar, Egg, baking powder, Butter
Instructions:
1. Fill a 6\" x 10\" (I use a 9\" x 13\") baking pan with sliced apples.
2. Mix the flour, salt, sugar, egg, baking powder together with two knives or pastry blender until crumbly; spread over the apples.
3. Pour 1/2 cup melted butter (real butter please) over top and sprinkle with cinnamon.
4. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes or until apples are done and topping is crisp.

title: Apple Crisp Ii
content:
Recipe Name: Apple Crisp Ii
Description: Make and share this Apple Crisp II recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Flour, Brown Sugar, oatmeal, baking powder, Salt, Butter, Walnut, cooking apples, Sugar, Cinnamon, Lemon Juice
Instructions:
1. With pastry cutter or steel blade in food processor add flour, brown sugar, oatmeal, baking powder, salt and butter.
2. Process until mixture no longer looks \"floury\".
3. Add walnuts and process just a second. Set aside.
4. Half and core apples, peeling is up to you.
5. Slice apples.
6. Arrange apple slices in a buttered 9x13 baking dish.
7. Combine sugar (adjust to tartness) and cinnamon.
8. Spread over apples.
9. Sprinkle with lemon juice.
10. Distribute topping over apples.
11. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 45 minutes.
12. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

title: Fruit-Filled Acorn Squash
content:
Recipe Name: Fruit-Filled Acorn Squash
Description: Make and share this Fruit-Filled Acorn Squash recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: acorn squash, Raisin, Water, Salt
Instructions:
1. Cut squash in half lengthwise; discard seeds and membrane.
2. Place squash, cut side down, in a vegetable steamer; arrange apricots around squash.
3. Place steamer over boiling water in a Dutch oven.
4. Cover and steam 15 minutes or  until squash is crisp-tender.
5. Coarsely chop apricots.
6. Combine chopped apricots, raisins, apricot preserves, water, and salt.
7. Spoon evenly into each squash half.
8. Cover and steam 5 minutes or until squash is  tender.
9. Sprinkle with toasted almonds.

title: Killer Kahlua
content:
Recipe Name: Killer Kahlua
Description: Make and share this Killer Kahlua recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Water, Sugar, instant coffee, pure vanilla extract, Monarch 151 rum
Instructions:
1. Bring to boil water and sugar.
2. Remove from heat and add instant
3. coffee. Bring to boil again.
4. Remove from heat and add vanilla extract   (very important you use pure extract NOT imitation). Cool before   adding rum.
5. Put in bottles and cork.
6. Makes about 3 fifths.
7. NOTE:   Since this is made with 151 rum, it has a lot more alcohol (75.5%).

title: Baked Zucchini Frittatas
content:
Recipe Name: Baked Zucchini Frittatas
Description: Make and share this Baked Zucchini Frittatas recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Zucchini, Onion, red bell pepper, Clove, reduced-calorie margarine, 1% low-fat milk, Salt, monterey jack cheese, fat-free parmesan cheese
Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 400°F.
2. Grease two 10-oz.  custard cups or individual baking dishes.
3. In 8-inch skillet over medium low heat, sauté zucchini, onion, red pepper and garlic in margarine until tender; let cool slightly.
4. In medium bowl, beat eggs, half-and-half and seasonings until combined.
5. Stir in zucchini mixture. Pour into prepared custard cups or baking dishes.
6. Sprinkle with cheeses.
7. Bake, uncovered, at 400°F for 14 to 17 minutes or until top is puffy and light golden brown.
8. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Fat-Free Fettuccine Alfredo
content:
Recipe Name: Fat-Free Fettuccine Alfredo
Description: Make and share this Fat-Free Fettuccine Alfredo recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cornstarch, fat free cream cheese, Mushroom, Scallion, fettuccine
Instructions:
1. Mix 1 teaspoon cornstarch and 1 teaspoon skim milk in a saucepan.
2. Add the rest  of the skim milk and bring to a boil.
3. Lower heat to medium and slowly add the  cream cheese, stirring constantly.
4. Simmer mixture until thick.
5. Add salt and pepper.
6. Saute mushrooms and scallions in a nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray.
7. Cook fettucini according to package directions.
8. Toss cooked noodles with sauce.   - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -.

title: Lemon Chicken
content:
Recipe Name: Lemon Chicken
Description: Make and share this Lemon Chicken recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: skinless chicken breast halves, Lemon, unbleached flour, Salt, fresh pepper, Paprika, lemon, rind of, Brown Sugar, Lemon Juice, Water, Lemon
Instructions:
1. Place chicken in bowl or casserole. Cover with lemon juice and marinate in  refrigerator for several hours or overnight, turning chicken periodically.
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
3. Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika in plastic bag.
4. Remove chicken from marinade and coat each with flour by shaking it in bag.
5. Place chicken in baking pan in a single layer.
6. Either peel the zest from a lemon and chop it fine in your food processor, or  grate the zest with a hand grater.
7. Mix grated peel with brown sugar.
8. Sprinkle the lemon zest mixture evenly over the chicken breasts.
9. Combine lemon  juice and water and sprinkle evenly over chicken.
10. Put 1 lemon slice on each chicken breast and bake for 35-40 min.  or until cooked through.
11. To make sure chicken is cooked, cut one of them in the middle and make sure that it is not red or pink, then, if it is, cook it a little bit more.

title: Hawaiian Ham Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Hawaiian Ham Salad
Description: Make and share this Hawaiian Ham Salad recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: smoked ham, pineapple chunks, celery ribs, black olives, Mayonnaise, Lemon Juice, peanuts
Instructions:
1. Combine ham, pineapple, celery, and olives.
2. Mix
3. mayonnaise and lemon juice; stir into ham mix.
4. Chill  at least an hour.
5. Stir in peanuts before serving.
6. -----

title: Zucchini Frittatas Ii
content:
Recipe Name: Zucchini Frittatas Ii
Description: Make and share this Zucchini Frittatas II recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Olive Oil, Onion, Garlic, Zucchini, Salt, Pepper, fresh basil, flat-leaf Italian parsley, fat-free parmesan cheese
Instructions:
1. Heat 1/2 Tbsp. oil in a 10-inch, heavy-bottomed, oven-proof skillet. Add onion  and saute until tender and translucent. Stir in garlic and zucchini and continue sauteing until squash is just tender.
2. Season with salt and pepper and remove  from heat. In a mixing bowl, whisk together eggs, basil and parsley.
3. Stir in  sauteed vegetables.
4. Add remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil to same skillet over medium heat, tilting pan to coat bottom and sides.
5. Add egg-vegetable mixture, spreading evenly.
6. Reduce heat to low and cover pan.
7. Cook 10 to 15 minutes, until set.  Preheat broiler.
8. Sprinkle grated cheese on top of frittata if desired and broil  briefly until lightly browned.
9. Cut into 3 wedges.
10. Serve immediately from the pan or transfer to a large round plate or platter.

title: Mom'S First Place Turkey Fruit Salad
content:
Recipe Name: Mom'S First Place Turkey Fruit Salad
Description: Make and share this Mom's First Place Turkey Fruit Salad recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: low-fat mayonnaise, Honey, Ginger, canned mandarin oranges, turkey, apple, grapes, pecan halves
Instructions:
1. Combine mayonnaise, honey, and ginger; mix well.
2. Add mandarin oranges, turkey, apple, grapes, and pineapple chunks.
3. Season with salt and pepper (if desired).
4. Chill.
5. Stir in toasted pecans just before serving.

title: Jarrett House Vinegar Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Jarrett House Vinegar Pie
Description: From an old southern cookbook. Vinegar pies were the alternative to lemon pies when lemons weren't in season.
Ingredients: Sugar, Butter, Egg, Flour, Cider Vinegar, Vanilla
Instructions:
1. Beat sugar, melted butter, eggs, flour, and vinegar together on high for 1 minute until smooth. Stir in vanilla. Pour mixture into pie shell.
2. Bake at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 50 minutes or until top forms a pale golden crust (inside will be slightly liquid).
3. Cool and serve at room temperature.

title: Vinegar Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Vinegar Pie
Description: Make and share this Vinegar Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, Flour, lemon zest, Cider Vinegar, Water, Egg, Butter
Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Combine sugar, flour, and lemon zest in a saucepan; stir together until thoroughly blended.
3. Add cider vinegar while stirring or whisking  constantly; add the water.
4. Place over medium heat; bring the mixture to a boil and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
5. Remove from heat and stir a little of the hot mixture into the eggs; stir the warmed egg mixture into the remaining hot mixture.
6. Stir in the butter.
7. Pour the mixture into the prepared pie shell.
8. Bake for 10 minutes at 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
9. Reduce heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
10. Continue baking for 30 minutes more.
11. Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool completely before serving.
12. (The  filling will seem quite liquid, but will firm as the pie cools.)
13. This pie has pretty much the same ingredients as the one above, but the  method is different and therefore you end up with a slightly different pie.

title: Ham And Cheese Pockets
content:
Recipe Name: Ham And Cheese Pockets
Description: Make and share this Ham and Cheese Pockets recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Mayonnaise, ham slices, swiss cheese, dill pickle slices, Mayonnaise, mustard, Milk
Instructions:
1. Cut pita breads in half.
2. Open.
3. Spread with sauce. Fill with boiled ham slices,  Swiss cheese and pickle slices.
4. Bake at 350 degrees for about 10 min.
5. Sauce: Combine mayonnaise, mustard and milk.
6. Stir slowly over low heat until  warm.
7. Spoon into sandwiches.

title: Super Sandwich
content:
Recipe Name: Super Sandwich
Description: Make and share this Super Sandwich recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Cucumber, Tomatoe, Onion, black olives, green olives, ham, pork, muenster cheese
Instructions:
1. In a bowl combine cucumber, tomato, onion, olives and salad dressing; set aside.
2. Cut 1\" off top of bread; set aside.
3. Carefully hollow out top and bottom of  bread, leaving a 1/2\" shell. (Discard bread or save for something else).
4. Layer 1/4 of the ham, salami, pork and cheeses inside the shell.
5. Top with 1/3 of the vegetable mixture.
6. Repeat layers, ending with meat and cheeses, gently  pressing down to flatten as needed.
7. Replace bread top; wrap tightly in plastic  wrap.
8. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Tiramisu
content:
Recipe Name: Tiramisu
Description: Make and share this Tiramisu recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Sugar, Cream Cheese, mascarpone, marsala wine, heavy whipping cream, marsala, Sugar, Water, french-style ladyfinger cookies
Instructions:
1. Prepare Cream Mixture:
2. In an electric mixer, prepare cream mixture by whipping sugar and egg yolks on high speed until pale yellow and thick.
3. With mixer on medium speed, add cream cheese and whip until smooth.
4. Add mascarpone and  Marsala.
5. Mix until incorporated.
6. Fold in whipped cream.
7. Refrigerate.
8. Prepare Espresso Mixture:
9. To prepare espresso mixture, combine espresso, additional Marsala, sugar, and warm water.
10. To assemble, dip ladyfingers in espresso mixture.
11. Place one layer of dipped ladyfingers on bottom of serving platter.
12. Top with one layer of cream mixture.
13. Add another layer of dipped ladyfingers, topped with a second layer of cream mixture.
14. Sift cocoa over top.

title: Hazelnut Shortbread Cookies
content:
Recipe Name: Hazelnut Shortbread Cookies
Description: Make and share this Hazelnut Shortbread Cookies recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Flour, hazelnuts, Butter, light brown sugar
Instructions:
1. Combine flour and hazelnuts.
2. In a large bowl, cream the butter and brown sugar.
3. Gradually blend in the dry ingredients.
4. Cover and chill for 8 hours or  overnight.
5. Preheat oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
6. Lightly grease cookie sheets.
7. On a  floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4\".
8. Using cookie  cutters, cut out the shapes and place on prepared cookie sheets 1-1/2\" apart.
9. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly colored.
10. Transfer to wire racks to cool.

title: Pecan Shortbread
content:
Recipe Name: Pecan Shortbread
Description: Make and share this Pecan Shortbread recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Flour, Pecan, Butter, light brown sugar, Vanilla Extract
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Combine flour and pecans.
3. In a large bowl, cream  the butter and brown sugar.
4. Beat in the vanilla extract.
5. Gradually stir in the dry ingredients. The dough will be stiff.
6. Pinch off walnut size pieces of dough and roll into small balls.
7. Place the balls 1-1/2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
8. Flatten the cookies with the back of a spoon dipped in flour.
9. Back for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly colored.
10. Transfer onto wire racks to  cool.

title: Tiramisu - Balducci'S In New York City
content:
Recipe Name: Tiramisu - Balducci'S In New York City
Description: This is an adopted recipe. I shall be trying it out and then post any additional information if needs be. If you are going to give any or no stars, please at least give the reason why so that you can help me improve the recipe. Thank you.
Ingredients: ladyfingers, espresso coffee, Egg, Sugar, mascarpone, marsala wine, triple sec, brandy, bittersweet chocolate
Instructions:
1. Arrange the ladyfingers on a plate and lightly soak them with the cooled espresso.
2. Put half of the soaked ladyfingers in one layer in a rectangular  serving dish.
3. While the ladyfingers are soaking, beat the egg yolks with the  sugar until the yolks turn pale in color.
4. Add the mascarpone, the liquors, and  the extract, and stir gently.
5. In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites with a  wire whisk until they are stiff.
6. Gently fold the whites into the mascarpone  mixture. Use half of this mixture to make a layer on top of the ladyfingers in  the serving dish.
7. Sprinkle with half of the chopped chocolate. Repeat the  procedure with another layer of soaked ladyfingers, the mascarpone mixture, and  chocolate. Cover with tin foil and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before  serving.

title: Sweet Potato Pecan Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Sweet Potato Pecan Pie
Description: Make and share this Sweet Potato Pecan Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: sweet potato, Butter, Margarine, Cinnamon, Vanilla Extract, Nutmeg, Salt, Egg, graham cracker pie crust, Egg, dark corn syrup, Brown Sugar, Butter, Pecan
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.
2. With mixer, beat hot yams and butter until smooth.
3. Add condensed milk, cinnamon, orange rind, vanilla extract, nutmeg, salt, and egg; mix well.
4. Pour mixture into crust.
5. Bake 20 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, make Pecan Topping: Beat together egg, corn syrup, brown sugar, melted butter and maple flavoring. Stir in chopped pecans.
7. Remove pie from oven; reduce oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit.
8. Spoon Pecan Topping on pie.
9. Bake 25 minutes longer or until set.
10. Cool.
11. Serve warm or at room temperature.
12. Garnish with orange zest twist, if  desired.
13. Refrigerate any leftovers.

title: Yellow Squash Frittata
content:
Recipe Name: Yellow Squash Frittata
Description: Make and share this Yellow Squash Frittata recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Butter, Egg, Cheddar Cheese, Salt, Pepper
Instructions:
1. Slice squash into equal sized rounds. You can cut a bigger squash in half instead of using the small ones, if you want to.
2. Saute squash in butter until tender-crisp.
3. Beat eggs with the grated cheese, Italian seasoning,  salt and pepper.
4. Pour egg mixture over squash.
5. Cook until eggs are cooked and puffy.

title: Yellow Squash Puffs
content:
Recipe Name: Yellow Squash Puffs
Description: I have made this recipe a thousand times and we just love it. It came up for adoption and I jumped on it. Goes great with just about any main dish.
Ingredients: Egg, All-Purpose Flour, cornmeal, baking powder, Salt, Onion
Instructions:
1. Combine the cooked squash and egg, stirring well.
2. Combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder and salt, stir well.
3. Add squash mixture and onion; stir until blended.
4. Drop squash  mixture by level tablespoonful into hot oil.
5. Cook until golden  brown, turning once. Drain well on paper towels.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto
content:
Recipe Name: Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto
Description: Make and share this Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: sun-dried tomato, boiling water, plum tomato, basil leaves, pine nuts, Olive Oil, Pepper, Clove
Instructions:
1. Combine sun-dried tomatoes and boiling water in a bowl and let stand 4  minutes.
2. Drain and chop.
3. Combine tomatoes, plum tomato, and remaining ingredients in a blender or  food processor and process 20 seconds or until a paste forms.

title: Sweet Potato-Pecan Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Sweet Potato-Pecan Pie
Description: Make and share this Sweet Potato-Pecan Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Egg, fresh sweet potatoes, Sugar, Unsalted Butter, Margarine, Vanilla Extract, Salt, Cinnamon, allspice, Nutmeg, Egg, Sugar, dark corn syrup, Unsalted Butter, Margarine, Vanilla Extract, Cinnamon, pecan halves, Heavy Cream
Instructions:
1. Prepare pie shell,set aside.
2. Make sweet potato filling: In medium bowl, with electric mixer, beat 1 egg until frothy.
3. Add mashed cooked sweet potatoes, sugar, butter, vanilla extract, salt, cinnamon, allspice, and nutmeg; beat at medium speed until the mixture is smooth, about 2 minutes.
4. Make  pecan topping: In medium bowl, with mixer, beat eggs until frothy.
5. Add sugar, corn syrup, melted butter, vanilla and cinnamon.
6. Beat at low speed just until mixture is well blended, about 1 minute.
7. Stir in pecans.
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
9. To assemble:  Turn sweet potato filling into unbaked pie shell, spreading evenly.
10. Pour pecan  topping over top.
11. Bake 60 to 70 minutes until set, and knife inserted in center comes  out clean.
12. Remove pie to rack to cool.
13. Just before serving decorate with whipped cream.

title: Corn Salsa
content:
Recipe Name: Corn Salsa
Description: This delightful corn salsa is a perfect salsa for dipping and can be used to boost flavor or garnish a southwestern meal. Chilling time not included in preparation time.
Ingredients: whole kernel corn, Green Pepper, red bell pepper, Onion, Tomatoe, ripe olives, cider, red wine vinegar, Pepper
Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a  large bowl.
2. Cover and chill for several hours.

title: Sweet Potato Custard Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Sweet Potato Custard Pie
Description: Make and share this Sweet Potato Custard Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Egg, Sugar, Salt, Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Milk, raw sweet potato, Butter
Instructions:
1. Combine eggs, sugar, salt, nutmeg, cinnamon, orange rind and milk.
2. Add sweet potatoes, grated just before adding to milk mixture.
3. Stir in melted butter.
4. Pour filling into pie shell.
5. Bake at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 45 to 50 minutes, or until knife  inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean.
6. Serve slightly warm or cold.

title: Zesty Sweet Potato Pie
content:
Recipe Name: Zesty Sweet Potato Pie
Description: Make and share this Zesty Sweet Potato Pie recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: Homemade Pie Crust, sweet potatoes, Sugar, molasses, Egg, Nutmeg, Ginger, Cinnamon, orange zest, Butter, Milk, evaporated milk
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Line a pie pan with rolled out dough; prick all over with fork; press a piece of heavy-duty foil directly into the pie shell.
3. Bake for 6 minutes; remove foil; bake for 4 more minutes until just beginning to brown.
4. Combine the sweet potatoes and sugar in a large bowl; beat in molasses and eggs.
5. Add the spices and orange zest and stir well.
6. Stir in melted butter and milk.
7. Pour filling into pie shell.
8. Bake for 15 minutes.
9. Reduce heat to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
10. Continue baking for 30 to 40 minutes or until filling is firm around edges, but center remains slightly soft and quivers when you move the pie.

title: Avocado Salsa
content:
Recipe Name: Avocado Salsa
Description: Make and share this Avocado Salsa recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: frozen corn, ripe olives, red bell pepper, Onion, Garlic, green olives, Lemon Juice, white vinegar, Cider Vinegar, dried oregano, Salt, Pepper, avocados
Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine the corn (or cucumber), olives, red pepper, and onion.
2. In a small bowl, combine garlic, oil, lemon juice, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper; mix well.
3. Pour over corn (or cucumber) mixture; toss to coat.
4. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
5. Just before serving, chop avocados and stir into salsa.
6. Serve with tortilla chips.  Note:  make sure that you get good, ripe avocados!  Also, you can add some minced jalapeno if you'd like a bit of spiciness.

title: Masala Karela Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Masala Karela Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Masala Karela Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Karela (Bitter Gourd/ Pavakkai) - deseeded, Salt - To Taste, Onion, tablespoon Gram flour (besan), teaspoons Turmeric powder (Haldi), tablespoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Tablespoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), tablespoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Sunflower Oil - As Required
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Masala Karela Recipe,de-seed the karela and slice.
2. Do not remove the skin as the skin has all the nutrients.
3. Add the karela to the pressure cooker with 3 tablespoon of water, salt and turmeric powder and pressure cook for three whistles.
4. Release the pressure immediately and open the lids.
5. Keep aside.Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan or a kadhai.
6. Add cumin seeds and let it sizzle.Once the cumin seeds have sizzled, add onions and saute them till it turns golden brown in color.Add the karela, red chilli powder, amchur powder, coriander powder and besan.
7. Stir to combine the masalas into the karela.Drizzle a little extra oil on the top and mix again.
8. Cover the pan and simmer Masala Karela stirring occasionally until everything comes together well.
9. Turn off the heat.Transfer Masala Karela into a serving bowl and serve.Serve Masala Karela along with Panchmel Dal and Phulka for a weekday meal with your family.

title: Ragi Semiya Upma Recipe - Ragi Millet Vermicelli Breakfast
content:
Recipe Name: Ragi Semiya Upma Recipe - Ragi Millet Vermicelli Breakfast
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Ragi Semiya Upma Recipe - Ragi Millet Vermicelli Breakfast (South Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: /2 cups Rice Vermicelli Noodles (Thin), Onion, /2 cup Carrots (Gajjar) - chopped, /3 cup Green peas (Matar), Green Chillie, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Mustard Seed, teaspoon White Urad Dal (Split), Tablespoon Ghee, sprig Curry leaves, Salt - To Taste, Lemon Juice
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Ragi Vermicelli Recipe, first steam the ragi vermicelli in a rice cooker or a steamer for about 5-6 minutes or till it is cooked but firm.Keep aside this aside till later use.
2. You can add a few drops of oil and mix it so that they don't stick to each other.Place a kadai on the heat, add the ghee or oil to it and when warm add hing and allow it to sizzle for 30 seconds.
3. Then follow it up with mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves, and allow them to crackle.Saute for 1 minute or so till the urad dal is slightly browned.Then, add onions and fry till translucent and soft.Next, add the green chillies along with par boiled carrots and peas.
4. Sprinkle some salt and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the vegetables are semi cooked.Then, add the steamed ragi vermicelli toss it together so the vegetables are all well combined.Switch off the heat, take the vermicelli out into a serving dish and to with lemon juice.
5. Mix well and serve along with Coconut Chutney and a hot cup of coffee or tea for a wholesome breakfast.

title: Gongura Chicken Curry Recipe - Andhra Style Gongura Chicken
content:
Recipe Name: Gongura Chicken Curry Recipe - Andhra Style Gongura Chicken
Description: A flavorful and authentic Andhra recipe for Gongura Chicken Curry Recipe - Andhra Style Gongura Chicken (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Chicken, Onion, Tomato - chopped, Green Chillies - Slit, Ginger, Clove, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Garam masala powder, tablespoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil, Salt - To Taste, /4 Teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Dry Red Chillie, Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf), teaspoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil, Cloves Garlic, cups Sorrel Leaves (Gongura) - picked and chopped, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making Gongura Chicken Curry Recipe first prep all the ingredients and keep them aside.In a small pan, dry roast the methi seeds, coriander seeds, fennel seeds and red chillies for about 3 to 4 minutes on medium heat, until you notice the seeds crackling.
2. Once done, turn off the heat and allow it to cool a bit and blend it into a smooth powder.Heat oil in a pressure cooker over medium heat; add the chopped onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies and saute until the onions are lightly browned and tender.Add the tomatoes, and saute until the tomatoes become soft and mushy.
3. Once done add the chicken, the garam masala and turmeric powder.
4. Add 1/4 cup of water and pressure cook the chicken for 3 to 4 whistles and turn off the heat.Once done, allow the pressure to release naturally.Make sure there are no stems when you pick the gongura leaves.
5. Wash and chop the gongura leaves and keep aside.In another pan,add some oil along garlic and saute the chopped gongura leaves along with a little salt and the ground masala.
6. The gongura leaves will wilt almost instantly.
7. Saute the gongura in the masala for about 3 to 4 minutes until it becomes like a mushy paste.Once done, add the cooked chicken curry into the Gongura masala and saute on high heat for another 2 minutes and turn off the heat.Check the salt and spices and adjust according to taste.
8. Transfer the Gongura Chicken Curry to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve Gongura Chicken with Ghee Rice Recipe | Neychoru , Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita Recipe and a Semiya Payasam for a delicious weekend lunch.

title: Udupi Style Ash Gourd Coconut Curry Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Udupi Style Ash Gourd Coconut Curry Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Udupi recipe for Udupi Style Ash Gourd Coconut Curry Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Vellai Poosanikai (Ash gourd/White Pumpkin), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - For Cooking, Dry Red Chillie, /2 Cup Fresh Coconut - Grated, grams Tamarind Water, /2 teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoons Sesame seeds (Til seeds), tablespoons Jaggery, cup Tamarind Water, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, sprig Curry leaves - roughly torn, Dry Red Chillie
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Udupi Style Ash Gourd Coconut Curry Recipe  cook the ash gourd in the pressure cooker with little water, turmeric powder and salt for just 1 whistle.
2. Release the pressure naturally.Soak the tamarind ball in hot water for about 15 minutes, and squeeze and keep the water.Then dry roast the spices and other ingredients for the ground paste in a pan except the coconut.
3. Then grind it along with coconut to a smooth paste.In same pressure cooker which has the ash gourd add the paste and little water and give it stir.
4. Keep the Udupi Ash Gourd Coconut Curry on the medium heat, Adjust the seasoning and texture if required.
5. Once done transfer it in a bowl.For the seasoning, heat oil in a small skillet and add mustard seeds and let it crackle.
6. After the mustard seeds have crackled add the curry leaves and red chillies.
7. Tun off the heat after the red chillies have darkened and add it on top of the Udupi Style Ash Gourd Coconut Curry and serve.
8. Serve the Udupi Style Ash Gourd Coconut Curry Recipe along with steamed rice, Elai Vadam  and Pisarna Manga for lunch.

title: Mexican Style Black Bean Burrito Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Mexican Style Black Bean Burrito Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Mexican recipe for Mexican Style Black Bean Burrito Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Tortillas, /4 cup Black beans - soaked overnight and  cooked, to 8 Spinach Leaves (Palak), Onion, Tomato - chopped, Clove, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), cup Rice - or brown rice, Lemon Juice, Onion, tablespoons Cheddar cheese, tablespoon Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Black Bean Burrito recipe, pick the coriander leaves and set aside, then finely slice the stalks.Keep it aside.Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a heavy bottomed pan over a medium heat, add the chopped garlic and coriander stalks and fry till they become brown.Add the cooked beans, mix it well and cook for a minute.
2. Add the rice and cook for further 5 minutes.
3. Remove from the heat and add coriander leaves that were kept aside.
4. For Salsa, toss together tomatoes, onions, spring onions, lime juice, coriander leaves, mix well using a fork and season to taste.Heat the tortillas on a griddle pan till it softens.
5. Lay it on a plate.Layer spinach leaves over the  tortilla.
6. Spoon one-quarter of the fried rice and beans, top with a generous spoonful of salsa.Grate over some cheese and add a spoon of yoghurt.
7. Wrap up the burrito, then tuck it in.Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make the rest of the burritos.
8. Serve Black Bean Burrito with a side of chips and a healthy Green Apple, Radish & Pepper Salad  and a glass of Carrot Pineapple Orange Juice Recipe to make a delicious lunch or dinner.

title: Spicy Crunchy Masala Idli Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Spicy Crunchy Masala Idli Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Spicy Crunchy Masala Idli Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Idli - cut into strips, cup Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - thinly sliced, cup Tomato - finely chopped, Onion, Green Chillies - finely chopped, /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), tablespoons Tomato Ketchup, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Mint Leaves (Pudina) - to taste, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To prepare Spicy Crunchy Masala Idli Recipe, Heat a tablespoon of oil in a heavy bottomed pan and stir fry them until they are lightly crisp.
2. Transfer to a bowl and keep aside.In 2 teaspoons of oil the same pan; add in the onions, capsicum, green chillies and saute them on medium heat until tender.
3. This takes about 5 to 7 minutes.
4. Add in the chopped tomatoes, salt, pepper, turmeric powder, chilli powder and stir well.
5. Saute until the tomatoes turn soft.
6. Finally stir in the tomato ketchup, the fried idli's the chopped coriander and mint leaves.
7. Stir fry on high heat until well combined just for about a minute.Turn off the heat and transfer the Spicy Crunchy Masala Idli Recipe to a serving bowl and serve hot topped with more date chutney or tomato ketchup.

title: Homemade Baked Beans Recipe (Wholesome & Healthy)
content:
Recipe Name: Homemade Baked Beans Recipe (Wholesome & Healthy)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Fusion recipe for Homemade Baked Beans Recipe (Wholesome & Healthy) (High Protein Vegetarian).
Ingredients: grams Dry beans - (such as cannellini or soya beans), teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Onion, Clove, Tomatoe, tablespoon Honey - or more to taste, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), teaspoon Dried oregano, /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder - or cayenne pepper, Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making the homemade baked beans recipe, we first have to soak the beans overnight for about 8 hours in water.We also have to make the cooked tomato puree.
2. Click here to see the recipe of how to make tomato puree at home.Once the beans are soaked well, our next step is to cook them.
3. I like using the pressure cooker method to cook the beans.
4. Place the beans in the pressure, place the weight on, cover the pan and cook it along with 2-1/2 cups of water.
5. After you heat 4 to 5 whistles, turn the heat to low and cook for another 15 minutes.Turn off the heat and allow the pressure cooker to release its pressure naturally.
6. This would take another 10 minutes.
7. The beans continue to cook under the pressure even when it is turned off.Once the pressure is released, open the cooker and drain out the excess liquids.
8. You store this liquid and use it in the vegetable stock or risotto.Once the beans are cooked, our next step is to spice it up to make the baked beans.Heat oil in a sauce pan on medium heat; add in the onions and garlic and give it a light sauté until the onions are tender.
9. Add the tomatoes, honey and the spices and give it a stir.Add in the cooked drained beans into the tomato gravy.
10. Stir fry the beans until the beans get well coated with the tomatoes.
11. Cover the pan, turn the heat to low and simmer the beans for about 30 minutes until you noticed the beans are well coated with the spices and tomatoes.
12. Check the salt and seasoning levels and adjust to suit your taste.You can optionally garnish the Homemade Baked Beans with coriander leaves and serve it along with toast, or Potato Cakes Recipe.

title: Veg Chili Cheese Burgers Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Veg Chili Cheese Burgers Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Veg Chili Cheese Burgers Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Burger buns, Pickled Jalapenos - sliced, Cheese Slices, Potatoes (Aloo) - pressure cooked, Onion, tablespoon Red Chilli powder, Salt - To Taste, Whole Egg, /2 cup Whole Wheat Bread crumbs, Clove, Onion, Tomatoe, cup Homemade tomato puree, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - chopped, /2 cup Soy granules, tablespoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Red Chilli Flake, tablespoon Cumin powder (Jeera), tablespoon Dried oregano, tablespoon Tabasco Original - Hot Sauce, teaspoon Honey, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Veg Chili Cheese Burgers Recipe, we will first pressure cook the potatoes and keep it ready.
2. Cook them for 5 whistles in a pressure cooker.
3. Once done allow the pressure to release naturally and peel off the skin.
4. Add them into a bowl and mash it using a potato masher.Add onions, salt and red chilli powder and bind it together.
5. Shape them into medium sized cutlets and leave it in the fridge to rest until you move on to make the sauce.To make the sauce, heat a flat skillet with oil on medium heat, add garlic and allow it soften for few seconds.Add chopped onions and saute until they turn golden brown.
6. Add chopped capsicum and saute for a few minutes.
7. Add in chopped tomatoes and sprinkle with a bit of salt and saute till they turn mushy.
8. Also add in the tomato puree and all the seasonings like, red chilli powder, cumin powder, red chilli flakes, dried oregano, tobacco sauce and honey.Keep sautéing until the tomatoes are cooked, you will notice the tomatoes will change color and the raw smell goes away.At the end add the soya granules and salt to taste.
9. Add about 1/4 cup of water and allow it to boil for 4-6 minutes minutes.
10. Let the sauce be little gravish.Switch off the heat, heat a flat skillet for the patties to shallow fry them.
11. Take the patties out of the fridge.
12. Beat an egg into a bowl and also keep the bread crumbs ready over a plate.Carefully dip the patties into the egg and place them over the bread crumbs and coat them well on either side Dust off the excess bread crumbs.Place the crumb dipped patties on to the hot skillet and drizzle some oil on top.
13. Cook on either side for atleast 10 minutes.
14. Till you can see brown color crispy layer on top.Do the same for the rest of the patties and set aside.Once done, add a tablespoon of butter on the same skillet and cut the burger bun in to half horizontally and toast them on the tawa.
15. Toast till the burger buns are golden brown and crisp.Take a cooked patty, spoon two tablespoon of the sauce on top, place a cheese slice over it and microwave the patty for just 10 seconds until you see the cheese melt.Take the patty out, spread some of the sauce on the base of the burger bun and place the patty with cheese on top and add few slices of jalapeno and close it with the burger top and serve.
16. Do the same for the rest of the burger.Serve the Veg Chili Cheese Burgers Recipe along with baby potato stir fry and Mango Iced Tea Recipe to make it a complete meal.

title: Andhra Style Ingavu Chaaru Recipe - Asafoetida Flavored Tamarind Rasam
content:
Recipe Name: Andhra Style Ingavu Chaaru Recipe - Asafoetida Flavored Tamarind Rasam
Description: A flavorful and authentic Andhra recipe for Andhra Style Ingavu Chaaru Recipe - Asafoetida Flavored Tamarind Rasam (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Tamarind Water, /2 cup Arhar dal (Split Toor Dal), teaspoon Asafoetida (hing), Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), sprig Curry leaves, Pinch Asafoetida (Hing), Sunflower Oil - For Cooking
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Andhra Style Ingavu Chaaru Recipe pressure cook the tamarind water with toor dal, hing and salt for about 4 whistles.
2. Turn off the flame and allow the pressure to release naturally.
3. Open the lif of the cooker and thoroughly mash the dal and bring the whole mixture together by mixing it well.
4. To temper, heat a kadai with oil, add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds and allow it to crackle.Add curry leaves, pinch of hing and leave it for 2 seconds and pour it over the rasam.
5. Serve the Andhra Style Ingavu Chaaru Recipe along with steamed rice and Gorikayi Palya Recipe  as a comforting meal during your week day.

title: Aar Macher Jhol Recipe - Bengali Style Fish In Tomato Gravy
content:
Recipe Name: Aar Macher Jhol Recipe - Bengali Style Fish In Tomato Gravy
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Aar Macher Jhol Recipe - Bengali Style Fish In Tomato Gravy (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Aar Maach (fish) - rohu/ katla fish (cut into thick steaks), Tomato - finely chopped, Bay leaves (tej patta), Ginger, Green Chillies - coarsely crushed, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Salt - To Taste, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Green Chillies - slit lengthwise, Mustard oil - as required, /4 cups Water - add 2 cups if you like a loose gravy, Sugar - a pinch (optional), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Aar Macher Jhol Recipe, firstly marinate the fish with salt and turmeric powder.Heat oil in a wok and shallow fry the fish on both sides till they turn crispy and golden.
2. Remove and keep aside.Into the same wok, add bay leaves and cumin seeds.
3. Fry these for 1 minute and add the chopped tomatoes.Sauté well.
4. Into this Bengali Style Fish Gravy, add turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder and enough salt and sauté till tomatoes soften.
5. Add the ginger paste and coarsely crushed green chilies.
6. Sauté till raw smell goes away and oil floats.Now add the water and allow the Fish gravy to come to a boil.
7. Once the gravy starts boiling, add the fried fish and cook covered till fish has cooked through. [This should take about 6 to 8 minutes approximately]Once the fish has cooked through, add the slit green chilies, adjust salt if necessary and add sugar to taste.
8. Allow it to cook for 5 minutes.Garnish this Bengali Fish Curry with coriander leaves and serve hot.
9. Serve piping hot Aar Macher Jhol – Fish In Spicy Tomato Gravy along with Steamed Rice and Begun Bhaja for a weekday lunch or dinner.
10. Enjoy!

title: Saunf Aloo (Fennel Potato Curry) Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Saunf Aloo (Fennel Potato Curry) Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Punjabi recipe for Saunf Aloo (Fennel Potato Curry) Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Potatoes (Aloo) - halved with skin, teaspoon Fennel seeds (Saunf) - crushed, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /4 cup Fresh cream - or 1/2 cup milk, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin with Saunf Aloo, heat oil in a pressure cooker.
2. Add turmeric powder, salt, red chilli powder and crushed fennel seeds till the fennel seeds turns golden in colour.Now add the potatoes and mix it properly with the masala.
3. Sauce it for 2-3 minutes and then add enough water to cover the potatoes in the cooker.Switch the heat after two whistles and once the pressure is released, open the lid of the pressure cooker.The next step is to add the cream or milk and mash a few potatoes to get a thicker consistency.
4. Let it cook for 5 more minutes or until the cooker releases 2 more whistles.Garnish the Saunf Aloo with some roasted saunf and chopped coriander.
5. Serve Sauf Aloo along with Amritsari Dal and Whole Wheat lachha Paratha for a weekday meal.

title: Hariyali Egg Curry Recipe In Coriander And Mint Gravy
content:
Recipe Name: Hariyali Egg Curry Recipe In Coriander And Mint Gravy
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Hariyali Egg Curry Recipe In Coriander And Mint Gravy (Main Course).
Ingredients: Egg, Cinnamon, Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), Cloves (Laung), Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Garam masala powder, tablespoons Fresh cream, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), cup Mint Leaves (Pudina) - chopped, Green Chillies - chopped, Onion, Ginger, Cloves Garlic
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Hariyali Egg Curry recipe, we will first make the Hariyali Masala.Into the Mixer Grinder (medium jar), add the Coriander leaves mint leaves, Green Chillies and 1/2 cup water.
2. Blend all of them together to make a smooth paste and keep aside.Into the small jar of the mixer grinder, add the onions, ginger and garlic and grind to make a paste.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a kadai over medium heat, add the Bay leaf (tej patta), Cloves, Cinnamon Stick and roast for a few seconds.
4. Add the Onion ginger garlic paste.Saute for 4 to 5 minutes until raw onion smell goes away.Once the onions are roasted, add garam masala powder, coriander powder and saute for a few seconds.Add the Hariyali Coriander Mint Mixture, the fresh cream and the 4 Boiled eggs.Add water if required to adjust the consistency of the Hariyali Egg Curry.
5. Cover & simmer the Hariyali Egg Curry for 5 minutes.Check the salt and spices and adjust to according to your taste and transfer the Hariyali Egg Curry into a serving bowl.
6. Serve the Hariyali Egg Curry along with Malabar Parotta or  Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha and Burani Raita for a weeknight dinner.

title: Homemade Tater Tots Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Homemade Tater Tots Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Homemade Tater Tots Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Potatoes (Aloo), teaspoon Garlic powder, Onion, teaspoon Dried oregano, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Red Chilli Flake, tablespoon All Purpose Flour (Maida), tablespoon Rice flour, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - for deep frying the tater tots
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Homemade Tater Tots Recipe, scrub potatoes thoroughly and wash them until clean.
2. Peel the skin of the potatoes and we will not parboil the potatoes in hot water.
3. In a large saucepan, add the potatoes and boil it brisk for about 5 to 7 minutes.
4. After 5 to 7 minutes the potatoes would have boiled through slightly, but firm.Once boiled, water the potatoes until cold water and pat dry.
5. This process will cool the potatoes a little.
6. Once slightly cooled, grate the potatoes into a large mixing bowl.
7. Add the garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, red chili flakes, fresh coriander leaves, salt to taste, all purpose flour, rice flour and mix well to form a dough like consistency.The next step is to shape the potatoes and deep fry the tater tots.
8. Grease your fingers and palm with oil and shape the potatoes into bite size ovals (cylinders).Heat oil in a pan for deep frying over medium heat.
9. Carefully drop each one of the shaped Tater Tots in oil and fry them on medium heat until golden brown on all sides.Once done, remove the Tater Tots from the oil and place it on kitchen paper towels to absorb the excess oil.Serve the Tater Tots with tomato ketchup or a Sichuan Style Bird Eye Chili Sauce as a tea time snack or as an appetizer for parties.

title: Maharashtrian Kakdi Thalipeeth Recipe - Spiced Cucumber Flat Bread
content:
Recipe Name: Maharashtrian Kakdi Thalipeeth Recipe - Spiced Cucumber Flat Bread
Description: A flavorful and authentic Maharashtrian Recipes recipe for Maharashtrian Kakdi Thalipeeth Recipe - Spiced Cucumber Flat Bread (Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: /2 cup Gram flour (besan), /2 cup Whole Wheat Flour, /4 cup Rice flour, Cucumber - peeled and grated, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Green Chillies - finely chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Clove, Salt - To Taste, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Maharashtrian Kakdi Thalipeeth Recipe, in a large mixing bowl add all the 3 flours together and mix them.
2. Add all the remaining ingredients like the grated cucumber, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, green chillies, coriander leaves, garlic and salt to taste.Mix everything well and add a little water at a time to make a smooth and firm dough of the Kakdi Thalipeeth.
3. The cucumber will release water when it gets combined with salt, so take care to add little water at a time.
4. The dough will be slightly sticky to handle.
5. Allow the dough to rest for 5 minutes.
6. Divide the dough into 4 portions.
7. Preheat the skillet on medium heat.
8. Keep water in a separate bowl to wet fingers and to wet a muslin cloth.Spread a wet muslin cloth on a smooth counter top.
9. Take a portion of the Kakdi Thalipeeth mixture and pat it on the wet cloth to about 4 inches in diameter.
10. Try not to make it too thin as it can break while flipping it on the skillet.Carefully lift the cloth along with the patted mixture and flip the Thalipeeth over on the skillet.
11. Drizzle a teaspoon of oil or ghee around the Thalipeeth and cook on medium heat.After about 3 minutes, you will be able to flip the Kakdi Thalipeeth over to the other side.
12. Allow each side to cook on medium heat for about 3-4 minutes, until the Thalipeeth are slightly crisp and browned.
13. Remove from heat and place on a serving platter.Continue the same procedure with the other portions of the Kakdi Thalipeeth dough.Serve the Maharashtrian Kakdi Thalipeeth along with Homemade Yogurt or lahsun chutney for breakfast.

title: Homemade Healthy Subway Sandwich Recipe With Beet & Sprout
content:
Recipe Name: Homemade Healthy Subway Sandwich Recipe With Beet & Sprout
Description: A flavorful and authentic Fusion recipe for Homemade Healthy Subway Sandwich Recipe With Beet & Sprout (Main Course).
