Ingredients: Submarine Bread (Subway Bread) - (flat breads or foot longs), /2 cup Green Moong Sprouts, Beetroot - grated, Clove, /2 cup Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Tomatoe, Onion, Tabasco Original - Hot Sauce - to taste, Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making Subway Sandwich Recipe With Roasted Beetroot, we will first cook the beets.Heat a teaspoon of oil in a wok; add the grated beets and garlic, sprinkle some salt and stir fry on low to medium heat until the beets are softened and cooked.Once you notice the beetroot is cooked through, turn off the heat and allow it to cool completely.Once the beetroot has cooled completely, add it to a large mixing bowl.
2. To this add in the greek yogurt/ hung curd, coriander leaves, spring onions along with salt and pepper to taste.
3. Give the mixture a good stir.
4. Keep this aside.In the next step toast the subway bread or the foot long along with butter in a skillet until lightly warmed and crisp.
5. You can use butter or olive oil for toasting.
6. Make sure you cut them into half and then toast.Once once, the next step is to layer the Subway Sandwich With Roasted Beetroot.Place the cut and toasted subway bread on a flat surface.Spread the beetroot mixture on one half of the sandwich, scatter the sliced tomatoes, the green moong sprouts and drizzle some tabasco sauce for a punch.
7. Now cover the Subway Sandwich With Roasted Beetroot by pressing it down with the other half and serve.Serve the Subway Sandwich Recipe With Roasted Beetroot for a wholesome weeknight dinner or even as an after school snack for your kids along with a Apple Almond Date Smoothie.
8. You can also pack this sandwich into an office lunchbox.

title: South Indian Style Murungakkai Poriyal Recipe - Drumstick Stir Fry
content:
Recipe Name: South Indian Style Murungakkai Poriyal Recipe - Drumstick Stir Fry
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for South Indian Style Murungakkai Poriyal Recipe - Drumstick Stir Fry (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Drumstick - cut into 3 inch pieces, /2 Cup Fresh Coconut - Grated, Green Chillies - Slit, sprig Curry leaves, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, teaspoons Coconut Oil, Dry Red Chillie, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, Water - as needed
Instructions:
1. To begin making Murungakkai Poriyal Recipe, wash the drumsticks well & peel them by removing the tough green part.
2. Cut them in 2 inches length.Take about glass of water in a kadhi, bring it to a boil, add these drumsticks with salt, turmeric powder (optional) & lightly steam them for 5-8 minutes.
3. Be careful not to overcook the drumsticks.
4. It should be tender but not mushy as in sambar or avial.Drain the water, keep the steamed drumsticks aside to cool slightly.Grate the coconut, add the green chillies & grind them well in a mixer.In the kadai, add coconut oil, once hot, add the mustard seeds, let it crackle.Then add the dry red chillies, curry leaves & add the steamed drumsticks.Mix everything well & let it cook for a minute.
5. Add the grated coconut & give it one last stir.Serve Murungakkai Poriyal Recipe along with Kerala Avial Recipe, Steamed Rice Recipe and Malabar Style Dates Pickle Recipe for a complete meal.

title: Kesar Mango Lassi Recipe - Saffron Mango Lassi Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Kesar Mango Lassi Recipe - Saffron Mango Lassi Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Kesar Mango Lassi Recipe - Saffron Mango Lassi Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: /4 cup Mango Pulp (Puree), cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt) - (low fat), tablespoon Sugar - or honey, pinch Saffron strands, tablespoons Badam (Almond) - roughly chopped, tablespoons Milk - luke warm+more cold milk as needed, Ice cubes - a few
Instructions:
1. To begin making Kesar Mango Lassi Recipe, soak one pinch kesar in 2 tablespoons warm milk and keep it aside for few minutes.Get prep with other ingredients as well.
2. Take out the pulp from the mangoes and keep aside.In a blender, add mango pulp, curd/yogurt, cold milk and blend till combined.Once it is done, add chopped almonds (2 tablespoons), honey or sugar, some ice cubes and blend to make the Kesar Mango Lassi Recipe.Kesar Mango Lassi Recipe is ready to serve, garnish it with the rest of chopped almonds and saffron and serve with Bhel Puri Recipe or Asian Watermelon Salad Recipe during evening.

title: Mini Dal Samosa Curry/Sabzi Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Mini Dal Samosa Curry/Sabzi Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Mini Dal Samosa Curry/Sabzi Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Pepper, Cinnamon, Clove, Mace (Javitri), Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), Black cardamom (Badi Elaichi), /2 teaspoon Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves), /2 teaspoon Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder, Samosas - mini, Cashew nuts, Green Chilli, Onion, Tomato - roughly chopped, Ginger, /2 Teaspoon Sugar, tablespoon Fresh cream, tablespoons Sunflower Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Mini Dal Samosa Gravy Recipe, we need to first prepare the gravy.
2. In a heavy bottomed pan, add 1 tablespoon of cooking oil and heat it on a medium flame.
3. Once the oil is hot, add Cardamom, Black Pepper, Cloves, Cinnamon, Javitri and saute for few seconds.
4. Next add cashew nuts, green chilli, ginger, chopped onion and tomatoes.
5. Mix well and add 1/2 cup water and Salt (as per your taste)Cover the pan and boil this mixture until the onions and tomato become soft.
6. Turn off the flame and let this mixture cool.
7. Once the mixture is cool, add it to a mixer and blend until smooth.
8. Strain the paste to remove any big chunk of ingredients (optional to give fineness to gravy). Keep aside.
9. In the same heavy bottomed pan, heat one tablespoons of oil and add bay leaf, black cardamom.
10. Once the spices release the aromas add in the ground tomato and onion mixture, add Kashmiri Red Chilli powder, Turmeric powder, Coriander powder, Garam Masala and the crushed Kasuri Methi.Mix well and cook for 10 mins at low flame.
11. Add fresh cream and sugar and stir it well into the gravy.
12. Simmer for a few more minutes and add the mini Samosas in the gravy.
13. Turn off the flame.Make sure to add the mini dal samosas to the gravy only one hour before serving, else the samosa will get completely soggy.
14. To make mini dal samosas at home follow Moong Dal Mini Samosas.Serve Mini Dal Samosa Curry Recipe along with hot Phulka, Tawa Paratha or Jeera Rice and Kachumber Salad Recipe With Cucumber, Onion & Tomatoes for a sumptuous Sunday meal

title: Spinach Garlic Bruschetta Recipe With Red Bell Pepper Sauce
content:
Recipe Name: Spinach Garlic Bruschetta Recipe With Red Bell Pepper Sauce
Description: A flavorful and authentic Italian Recipes recipe for Spinach Garlic Bruschetta Recipe With Red Bell Pepper Sauce (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Baguette - sliced, /2 tablespoon Butter, /2 tablespoon Garlic - minced, cup Spinach Leaves (Palak), Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) - (optional, Tomato - finely chopped, Onion, tablespoon Black pepper powder - adjust, tablespoon Italian seasoning, teaspoon Fresh cream, cup Cheddar cheese - grated, Salt - To Taste, tablespoon Roasted tomato pasta sauce
Instructions:
1. To prepare Spinach Garlic Bruschetta Recipe With Red Bell Pepper Sauce, prepare garlic flavoured butter first.
2. Mix the garlic extract through cutting and folding method into butter at room temperature until well mixed.Slice the bread to about an inch thick, apply garlic butter, and grill them for 6-10 minutes in a preheated oven at 180 degrees C.
3. You can even roast it on the stove if you don't have an oven.
4. Blanch spinach leaves in the microwave for 4-5 minutes and chop roughly.Meanwhile, Red bell pepper sauce can be prepared.In pan, mix chopped bell peppers, onions, salt, pepper roasted tomato sauce and Italian seasoning with butter and cook till mushy.Add fresh cream at the till and saute till thick and creamy.
5. Set the red bell pepper sauce aside to cool.spread the blanched spinach on the grilled baguette bread, spoon the chopped tomatoes on it, add cheese and bake again for 5 minutes in the pre-heated oven at 180 degrees C.Once the sauce is cooled, serve Spinach Garlic Bruschetta Recipe With freshly prepared Red Bell Pepper Sauce recipe.
6. Couple it with Roasted Cherry Tomato Soup Recipe or your choice of soup and salad like Potato And Cucumber Salad Recipe for light dinner.

title: Mini Dal Pakwan Chaat Recipe - A Perfect Party Snack
content:
Recipe Name: Mini Dal Pakwan Chaat Recipe - A Perfect Party Snack
Description: A flavorful and authentic Sindhi recipe for Mini Dal Pakwan Chaat Recipe - A Perfect Party Snack (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, Cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Tablespoons Ghee, Salt, Sunflower Oil - for deep frying, cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder, /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), /2 Teaspoon Sugar, Salt, Tablespoon Ghee, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Green Chillies - Slit, sprig Curry leaves, /4 cup Sweet Chutney (Date & Tamarind), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Onion, /2 cup Fresh Pomegranate Fruit Kernels, /4 cup Sev
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Dal Pakwan Chaat, we will first make the Pakwan and keep it ready.Sift both the flours together.
2. Add ajwain, cumin, salt and ghee and mix all together into the flour.
3. Knead the flour into a smooth dough adding water little at a time.
4. Preheat the oil for deep frying.Divide the Pakwan dough into equal lemon size portions.Dust the surface with flour and roll the pakwan dough into a small disc.Use a fork and mark impressions on the rolled pakwan.
5. Pierce from both sides, this will prevent the pakwan from puffing up.Place the pakwans into the preheated oil and deep fry on low to medium heat until golden brown and crisp on both sides.
6. Transfer the fried pakwan on a kitchen paper towels to drain the excess oil and store in airtight containers.Next step is to make the Dal for the Pakwan Chaat.
7. Wash and soak chana dal in water overnight or for at least 4 hours.Once soaked, drain the water and cook the chana dal in 2 cups of water in the pressure cooker for a couple of whistles along with salt, sugar, turmeric powder, garam masala and amchur powder.After a 4 to 5 whistles, turn the heat to low and simmer for another 5 minutes and turn off the heat.
8. Allow the pressure to release naturally.
9. The grains of the chana dal should be soft and yet separate.Open the lid once the pressure releases completely.In a small tadka pan, heat ghee over medium heat.
10. Add the cumin and green chilies.Saute for a few seconds, add the curry leaves and asafoetida and turn off the heat.Pour the seasoning over the Sindhi Chana Dal and give it a stir.To make the Mini Dal Pakwan ChaatWhen you are ready to serve, place the Pakwan (the crisp puri) on serving platters.
11. Spoon a small portion of the dal over each of the pakwan (crisp puri).Drizzle some date chutney and green chutney and finally top with with some chopped onions and pomegranates, sev and serve.These Mini Dal Pakwan Chaat make great appetizers at parties, you can even serve it this was for a delicious weekend breakfast as well.Serve these Mini Dal Pakwan Chaat as an evening snack or as an appetizer for parties along with Pav Bhaji, Dahi Vada, Pani Puri and finally end it with a Paneer Kheer as a dessert.

title: Asian Style Sweet & Spicy Green Beans Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Asian Style Sweet & Spicy Green Beans Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Thai recipe for Asian Style Sweet & Spicy Green Beans Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: grams Green beans (French Beans) - cut into half, Clove, tablespoon Soy sauce, tablespoons Thai Sweet Chilli Sauce, Lemon - juice, tablespoons Rice Wine Vinegar, /4 cup Roasted Peanuts (Moongphali), Salt - To Taste, tablespoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Asian Style Sweet & Spicy Green Beans Recipe, firstly add the green beans into a pressure cooker with salt to taste and 2 tablespoons of water.Pressure cook the beans for one whistle and release the pressure immediately and keep aside.
2. We release the pressure immediately, so the greens remain green and fresh,Our next step is to stir fry the green beans in Asian sauces.Preheat heat oil in a pan over medium heat; once the oil is hot add the cloves and saute for a few seconds until the aromas come through.
3. At this stage, add the soy sauce, thai sweet chilli sauce, rice wine vinegar, and lemon juice and stir to combine.
4. Add the cooked beans and roasted peanuts to the above sauce mixture.Stir fry on high heat for 3 to 4 minutes till the beans and the peanuts are well coated with the sweet and spicy sauce.Once done, check the salt and spices and adjust to taste accordingly.
5. Once done, turn off the heat and transfer the Asian Style Sweet & Spicy Green Beans to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve Asian Style Sweet & Spicy Green Beans Recipe with steaming hot Thai Jasmine Sticky Rice and Thai Pineapple Vegetarian Curry for a delicious meal.

title: Chinese Darsaan Recipe With Ice Cream
content:
Recipe Name: Chinese Darsaan Recipe With Ice Cream
Description: A flavorful and authentic Chinese recipe for Chinese Darsaan Recipe With Ice Cream (Desserts).
Ingredients: Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, All Purpose Flour (Maida), /4 teaspoon Baking powder, Water - to make the dough, Sunflower Oil - to deep fry, tablespoons Honey, tablespoon Sugar, tablespoon Sesame seeds (Til seeds) - white, tablespoons Water, /2 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chinese Darsaan Recipe With Ice Cream, we will first make the dough for the honey tossed flat noodles.
2. To make the Flat Noodles In a mixing bowl, combine the all purpose flour, with the baking powder, and oil, using just enough water, make a smooth soft dough.
3. Once the dough is ready, divide into equal portions of lemon sized balls.
4. Dust each of those dough balls with flour and roll out like a roti using a rolling pin.
5. Using a paring knife, cut long strips of the dough measuring 1 centimeter size, resembling flat noodles.
6. Heat a saucepan with water on medium flame, along with a teaspoon of oil and bring to a boil.Once the water has come to a rolling boil, reduce the flame and gently put the noodle strips in.
7. Boil for about 2-3 minutes.
8. Once the noodles, tend to fluff up, remove from the water, using a slotted spoon and put it into a strainer that's resting on a bowl, to hold the excess water.
9. Do this for all the strips of dough and set aside.
10. Heat a kadai with oil on medium-high heat, gradually add in the boiled noodles, reduce the flame to medium-low and fry ensuring the noodles are cooked and it doesn't get the brown colour.
11. We need our noodles to be crispy, yet be pale in colour and not deep brown.
12. Remove the noodles from the kadai and place it on an absorbent paper to drain out the excess oil.
13. Allow it to cool.
14. To make the Honey Syrup In a small saucepan, combine the sugar, water and honey and bring to a single boil on medium-high flame.
15. Turn off the flame, add the roasted sesame seeds and give it a good mix.
16. Allow this honey syrup to cool down only until it is warm, toss it in the freshly fried noodles until well coated.This is the Darsaan ! Serve the Darsaan with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.Serve Chinese Darsaan Recipe with Ice Cream as dessert after a meal of Dragon Chicken Sizzler Recipe or Sweet and Sour Vegetable Recipe with Tofu & Brown Rice.

title: Cabbage, Spinach, Pomegranate Slaw With Lemon Dressing Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Cabbage, Spinach, Pomegranate Slaw With Lemon Dressing Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Cabbage, Spinach, Pomegranate Slaw With Lemon Dressing Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: cup Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) - shredded, cup Spinach - shredded, cup Fresh Pomegranate Fruit Kernels, Lemon Juice, tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Cabbage, Spinach, Pomegranate Slaw with Lemon Dressing Recipe, we will first whisk in the dressing in a bowl.
2. Combine lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper well and keep aside.Using a fork emulsify the lemon and oil together and add in your fresh vegetables and fruits.Mix well, check for seasonings, if your require anything more you can add and mix again.Serve the Cabbage, Spinach, Pomegranate Slaw with Lemon Dressing Recipe along with Baked Chicken or a Grilled Vegetable Sandwich Recipe With Herb Goat Cheese with a glass of freshly made Carrot Pineapple Orange Juice Recipe.

title: Matar Samosa Recipe -Green Pea Samosa
content:
Recipe Name: Matar Samosa Recipe -Green Pea Samosa
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Matar Samosa Recipe -Green Pea Samosa (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), Tablespoons Ghee, Salt, Sunflower Oil - for deep frying, Tablespoons Ghee, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), teaspoon Green Chilli Sauce, Cinnamon, /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder, /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), /2 cups Green peas (Matar) - steamed and mashed, Salt - To Taste, teaspoon All Purpose Flour (Maida), /4 cup Water
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Matar Samosa Recipe first, mix together half a teaspoon of salt into the flour.
2. Rub ghee or vegetable shortening into the flour mixture, with your fingers until it resembles loose bread crumbs.Gradually add water, slowly, and knead to make a soft but firm dough.
3. Roll the dough into a ball, cover with a moist muslin cloth and keep aside.The next step is to make the filling.
4. In a kadai or heavy bottomed pan, warm the ghee, add the jeera and allow it to crackle and tip in the chilli paste.
5. Saute these together for a minute.Add peas followed by all the other spices and cook till the pea mixture becomes dry and all the water has dried up.
6. Season with salt and cook again for 2-3 minutes.
7. Set the peas mixture aside to cool down so it is easier to handle when shaping the samosas.Make a flour paste, by combining the flour and water.To begin making the samosa cases, divide the dough into small balls and roll them into thin circles.
8. Cut each rolled-out circle into two halves by running your knife down the center, so you have 2 semi-circles for each disc.
9. Roll the semi-circles into cones and using a teaspoon fill them with the peas mixture.Dab the flour paste along the edges of the open side of the cone, press the two edges together and seal.
10. Arrange the matar samosas in a platter and cover them with a moist muslin cloth.Heat oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
11. Deep fry the matar samosas in hot oil till they are golden brown.
12. Try not to fry too many together as it will crowd the kadai and alter the cooking time.Remove the Matar Samosa from the kadai using a slotted spoon and drain them on kitchen paper.
13. Matar Samosa  can be served with a dollop of Dhaniya Pudina Chutney and khajoor imli chutney or tomato ketchup, along with masala chai in the evening.

title: Eggless Chocolate Cupcakes With Raspberry & Cheese Frosting
content:
Recipe Name: Eggless Chocolate Cupcakes With Raspberry & Cheese Frosting
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Eggless Chocolate Cupcakes With Raspberry & Cheese Frosting (Desserts).
Ingredients: Cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), /2 cup Sugar, cup Dark chocolate, /2 cup Cocoa Powder, Salt, /4 cup Milk, /2 tablespoon Baking powder, /2 teaspoon Baking soda, /2 tablespoon Vanilla Extract, cup Britannia Cream Cheese, /4 cup Caster Sugar, teaspoon Vanilla Extract, Fresh raspberries
Instructions:
1. To begin with the Eggless Chocolate Cupcakes With Raspberry And Cream Cheese Frosting Recipe first, sieve flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda and keep aside.Take a bowl and whisk butter for 5 minutes, make sure that it is light and fluffy.
2. Then add vegetable oil and sugar and whisk for another 3 minutes.Further, add vanilla extract and milk (half) and whisk.In double boiling method melt the dark chocolate and Now, add in rounds the dry ingredients and fold them nicely.
3. Keep adding rest milk as required.Preheat the oven at 200 degree Celsius for 10 min.Pour the batter into the cup cake mould.
4. I used silicon mould) and bake for 15 minutes at 150 degree Celsius.Let it cool properly before frosting else the frosting will melt.For the frosting:Whisk the soft cream cheese till you get pointed peaks.Whisk in low pace to get peaks.As you whisk add sugar and vanilla extract and mix well.Grind few raspberries and add in the cream cheese mixture.Fill the icing in the piping bag with your favourite nozzle and do the icing on top of the cupcake.After icing it with cream cheese place a raspberry on it and serve it.
5. Serve the Eggless Chocolate Cupcakes With Raspberry And Cream Cheese Frosting Recipe for an Evening Snack or as a Dessert in a party.

title: Kerala Palada Pradhaman Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Kerala Palada Pradhaman Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Kerala Recipes recipe for Kerala Palada Pradhaman Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: cup Ada, liter Milk - full cream, /4 cup Sugar, Tablespoon Ghee, /2 teaspoon Cardamom Powder (Elaichi)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Kerala Palada Pradhaman recipe, first slow boil milk and 1/2 cup sugar on low flame until it reduces lesser than half the quantity.I used pressure cooker with weight on for about 60 minutes and slow cooked/boiled the milk.
2. The milk turned slightly pink in colour by doing this.Cook ada as per packet instructions.
3. Once cooked, drain the ada and rinse it in cold water to stop cooking.Heat ghee in a pan.
4. Add 1/4 cup sugar and saute.
5. Wait till sugar melts and starts to turn slightly brown.
6. Add cooked ada and saute for about 2 minutes.Add about 1 to 1-1/2 cup boiled milk.
7. Mix well.
8. If it need more milk add it.Sprinkle cardamom powder, mix well.
9. Serve hot or cold.
10. Either ways it tastes delicious.Serve Kerala Palada Pradhaman after your meal of Keerai Sambar, Beetroot Thoran and Steamed Rice.

title: Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Chettinad recipe for Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Chicken legs, /4 cup Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Onion, Cloves Garlic, Ginger, tablespoon Fresh coconut - grated, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /4 Teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Onion, Pepper, Dry Red Chillie, Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf), Cinnamon, Cloves (Laung), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Tablespoon Ghee, teaspoon Tamarind Paste, teaspoon Jaggery, Tablespoon Ghee, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, sprig Curry leaves, Cloves Garlic
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe, thoroughly wash and clean the chicken leg.
2. Keep it aside.
3. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan, on medium flame.
4. Add onions, coconut, ginger and garlic and cook till the onions become soft and the coconut turn light brown in colour.Turn off the flame and grind to a coarse paste with a little water in a mixer grinder.The next step is to marinate the chicken.
5. In a mixing bowl, add the onion coconut paste, yogurt, turmeric powder and chicken legs.Mix everything well and ensure that the chicken is properly quoted with the masala.
6. Keep it aside for 30 Minutes.For the Chettinad Spice MixHeat a heavy bottomed pan.
7. Add chettinad spice mix ingredients -  includes cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds, kalonji, black peppercorn, dry red chillies, fennel seeds, cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom and mustard seeds.Dry roast them for about 2 minutes.
8. Once done, let it cool down a bit.
9. Now, add thes spices into a mixer grinder and grind it into a powder.Heat ghee in the same pan and add this Chettinad spice mix into the ghee.
10. After 30 seconds, add the chicken along with all the marinade.Mix everything well, add the tamarind pulp, jaggery and 1/4 cup of water.
11. Cover the pan and cook for about 8 to 10 minutes or till the chicken is 3/4th done.Turn off flame.
12. Take out the chicken pieces seperatly and keep the masala aside.Heat a grill pan on high heat, until smoking hot and place only the chicken leg on it.Let this get a nice crispy skin by cooking it for about 5-7 minutes on each side.
13. Once done, turn off the heat and keep the chicken piece on a plate.The final step is to temper the chicken.
14. To make the tempering, heat ghee in a tadka pan on medium flame.Add mustard seeds, curry leaves and allow it to crackle.
15. Add the chopped garlic and fry till golden brown.
16. Turn off the flame.To assemble the Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe, in a serving plate, place the chicken leg, top it with the thick masala and garnish with the tadka.
17. It is ready to be served.Serve this Chettinad Style Chicken Roast Recipe on its own as a party starter or with Kerala Style Appam Recipe (Without Yeast) or Mangalorean Neer Dosa Recipe (Savory Rice & Coconut Crepe) for a complete meal.

title: Palakottai Kuzhambu Recipe-Kongunad Style Jackfruit Seeds Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Palakottai Kuzhambu Recipe-Kongunad Style Jackfruit Seeds Curry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Tamil Nadu recipe for Palakottai Kuzhambu Recipe-Kongunad Style Jackfruit Seeds Curry (Side Dish).
Ingredients: cup Jackfruit Seeds (Kathal), cup Tamarind Water, Cloves Garlic, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Curry leaves, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, teaspoons Sambar Powder, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Salt - To Taste, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, /2 cup Fresh coconut, Pepper, Dry Red Chillie, Onion, Tomato - chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Sunflower Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making Palakottai Kuzhambu Recipe  wash the jackfruits seeds thoroughly, make a slit on the outer layer and remove the outer white layer.
2. In a pressure cooker, add the Jackfruit seeds, add enough water to submerge the seeds,add a pinch of salt, and pressure cook it on a high heat for 3-4 whistles or till they are cooked al-dente.
3. Allow the pressure to release naturally.
4. Drain and reserve the jackfruit seed stock for later use.Heat a kadai on medium flame, add oil once the oil is hot, add onions  and saute until almost translucent, for about 2-3 minutes.
5. Now add chopped tomatoes , cover and cook until the tomatoes are mushy.
6. Transfer the sauteed onion-tomatoes  and allow them to cool.Transfer the onion-tomato mixture into a mixer-jar, add coriander seeds and grind well along with some of the jackfruit stock.
7. We need a smooth paste.
8. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.
9. Yet again, in a mixer grinder, combine fresh grated coconut, red chillies and black pepper along with a little jackfruit seeds stock, and grind to a smooth paste.
10. Keep aside.
11. Heat a pan with oil, on medium heat, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds and curry leaves.
12. Once they splutter and sizzle, add in asafoetida and the crushed garlic cloves and saute till the garlic turn golden.Once garlic turns to golden, add the ground onion tomato paste and saute well until it starts boiling.Add the tamarind water to it and stir.
13. Boil for 2-3 minutes and cooked palakottai/jackfruit seeds.
14. Mix well.Add required salt, turmeric powder, chilli powder, sambar powder.
15. Mix well and cook for 5 minutes in medium heat, such that the flavours seep into the jackfruit seeds.Now add the ground coconut mixture  and stir well.
16. Cook on a low heat until it thickens.
17. Taste and adjust seasoning and consistency of the Palakottai Kuzhambu to your liking.
18. Turn off the flame.
19. Garnish with coriander leaves.
20. Serve Palakottai Kuzhambu Recipe along with Raw Jackfruit Poriyal Recipe, Steamed Rice Recipe and Thayir Semiya Recipe for a hearty weekday lunch.

title: Kesar Chai Recipe - A Delicious Saffron Flavored Indian Tea
content:
Recipe Name: Kesar Chai Recipe - A Delicious Saffron Flavored Indian Tea
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Kesar Chai Recipe - A Delicious Saffron Flavored Indian Tea (North Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: Cups Water, teaspoon Tea leaves, /4 cup Milk, Saffron strands - or more
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Kesar Chai, add water into a saucepan, along with the saffron strands and allow it to come to a brisk boil.Once it begins to boil; add the tea leaves.
2. Allow the tea leaves to simmer in the water for about a minute and turn off the heat.Once you add the tea leaves, allow it to brew just a little to ensure the tea stays light and does not turn bitter.Stir in the milk into the chai and allow it to rest for a few seconds.
3. Strain the Kesar chai into the cups and serve.
4. Add a few more saffron strands to the top while serving, this will give a great look and also add to the taste and flavor of the chai.Serve the Kesar chai Recipe along with Samosa or Vegetable Bajji or Pakora for an evening snack.

title: Kodava Mudi Chekke Barthad Recipe - Raw Jackfruit & Black Chickpea Stir Fry
content:
Recipe Name: Kodava Mudi Chekke Barthad Recipe - Raw Jackfruit & Black Chickpea Stir Fry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Coorg recipe for Kodava Mudi Chekke Barthad Recipe - Raw Jackfruit & Black Chickpea Stir Fry (Main Course).
Ingredients: Jackfruit Seeds (Kathal), cup Kala Chana (Brown Chickpeas) - soaked overnight, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), sprig Curry leaves, Tomato - chopped, /2 cup Tamarind Water, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Dry Red Chillie, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Cloves (Laung), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), /2 cup Fresh coconut, Inch Ginger, Cloves Garlic
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Kodava Mudi Chekke Barthad Recipe, soak the chickpeas overnight and pressure cook them in 2 cups of water, salt to taste and cook for 6 to 8 whistles for about 20 to 25 minutes.Once done allow the pressure to release naturally.
2. Drain the water out from the chickpeas.
3. Into the same cooker add the jackfruit seeds and 1 cup of water and pressure cook for at least 3 whistles.Release the pressure, drain any excess water and leave the seeds to dry, once it has cool down, peel off the skin and chop them into small pieces.Grind, dry red chillies, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, cloves, cinnamon, coconut, ginger and garlic to a coarse paste, you can add little water if needed.
4. Keep it aside.Heat a kadai with oil, add mustard seeds, cumin seeds and splutter for few seconds.
5. Add curry leaves and allow it to crackle for few seconds.Add in chopped tomatoes and saute till the tomatoes become slightly mushy.
6. Add in the ground coconut masala.
7. Sprinkle turmeric powder and salt and give it a mix.Cook for 5 minutes and add in the boiled chickpeas and chopped jackfruit.
8. Pour in the tamarind water and sprinkle salt for seasonings and mix well.Cook the Mudi Chekke Barthad for another 2 minutes until all the masala has been absorbed.
9. Check the salt and spices and adjust to taste accordingly.
10. Once done turn off the heat and transfer the Mudi Chekke Barthad to a serving bowl.Serve the Kodava Mudi Chekke Barthad Recipe along with Palak Tovve or Palak Dal  and Jolada Roti and Raita to have it for your every Lunch Meals.

title: Whole Wheat Crepe Recipe With Herbed Vegetables
content:
Recipe Name: Whole Wheat Crepe Recipe With Herbed Vegetables
Description: A flavorful and authentic Coorg recipe for Whole Wheat Crepe Recipe With Herbed Vegetables (Main Course).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, Salt, teaspoon Italian seasoning, /4 cup Cheese spread - flavoured, Broccoli - cut into florets, Onion, Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) - diced, Salt - To Taste, sprig Parsley leaves - roughly chopped
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Whole Wheat Crepe Recipe With Herbed Vegetables, first get all the ingredients ready.In a small mixing bowl, blend all the ingredients for the crepe along with just enough water to make the crepe batter light and fluffy.
2. The batter should coat the back of the spoon, but at the same time it should be runny and thin.Then strain the crepe mixture through a fine mesh sieve.
3. Pouring the mix into a tall jug makes it easier to portion out the batter when making crepes on a hot pan.Allow the crepe batter to rest at room temperature for about 15 to 20 minutes.
4. This makes the crepes soft and fluffy.The next step is to toss the vegetables in a wok.Heat a teaspoon of olive oil in a wok; add the broccoli, onion, bell pepper, sprinkle some salt and toss the vegetables on high heat for just 2 to 3 minutes.
5. Its nice when the vegetables are not over cooked, but are just stir fried to get a crunch in the crepe.Once done, turn off the heat, check the salt and adjust to suit your taste.
6. Stir in the parsley and keep aside.To begin making the crepes, warm a crepe pan with a rim on a medium heat.
7. Butter or oil it evenly.
8. When the pan gets hot, pour just enough batter to cover the base, and start tilting and swirling the pan to spread the batter and make a crepe.
9. These crepes gets cooked really quick and you need to cook it just until the bottom begins to get a little golden, then gently lift the edges and flip the crepe to cook on the other side for a few seconds.Transfer the prepared whole wheat crepes to a platter and cover with a dome lid to keep warm and soft.
10. Proceed the same way with the remaining batter and stack the crepes one on top of the other.Once the crepes are made, spread the cheese spread on the inside of the crepes, place the stir fried vegetables inside and fold into half and serve.Serve Whole Wheat Crepe Recipe With Herbed Vegetables along with Cold Coffee Smoothie and Spinach and Feta Muffins for breakfast.

title: Makki And Methi Roti Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Makki And Methi Roti Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Punjabi recipe for Makki And Methi Roti Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Makki Ka Atta (Yellow Corn Meal Flour), /2 cups Methi Leaves (Fenugreek Leaves) - chopped, Green Chillies - chopped, tablespoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), tablespoon Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making Makki and Methi Roti Recipe, heat some water in a pan till lukewarm.In a steel mixing bowl, add Maize flour, chopped fenugreek leaves, green chillies, carom seeds and salt.
2. Mix everything well.
3. Now add lukewarm water to the maize flour little by little and knead into a soft dough.
4. Add some oil on top of the entire ball of dough and keep aside.
5. Place a tawa on low heat and let it heat up.
6. Next divide the dough into small balls.
7. Roll out each ball between two sheets of plastic (cling film) into a circle or you can use your hands with the help of wet fingers to make a small round roti.
8. Place roti on the the tawa and cook it on low flame from both sides until brown spots appear.
9. Prepare the rest of the the rotis in a similar way and serve hot.
10. Serve Makki and Methi Roti with Sarson Ka Saag and Burani Raita for a delicious weekday meal.

title: Cabbage And Carrot Sambharo Recipe - Gujarati Vegetable Stir Fry
content:
Recipe Name: Cabbage And Carrot Sambharo Recipe - Gujarati Vegetable Stir Fry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Gujarati Recipes﻿ recipe for Cabbage And Carrot Sambharo Recipe - Gujarati Vegetable Stir Fry (Main Course).
Ingredients: Carrots (Gajjar) - grated, cups Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) - shredded, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - thinly sliced, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Sugar, Lemon Juice, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), sprig Curry leaves, Green Chillies - slit lengthwise
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Cabbage and Carrot Sambharo Recipe, heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan on medium heat.
2. Add the mustard seeds and allow it to crackle.
3. Once it crackles, add the asafoetida, green chilies, curry leaves and saute for a few seconds.
4. At this stage add the turmeric powder and the chopped vegetables, salt and stir to combine all the ingredients well.
5. Turn the heat to low, cover the pan and allow the vegetables to cook in its own steam for about 3 to 4 minutes, until just about cooked.
6. You want the vegetables to remain little firm and crunchy and not too soft.Once done, turn off the heat and the Cabbage and Carrot Sambharo is ready to be served.Serve Cabbage And Carrot Sambharo along with Palak Ragi & Oats Wheat Thepla Recipe or Beetroot & Sesame Thepla Recipe for a simple mean.

title: Whole Wheat Pita Bread Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Whole Wheat Pita Bread Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Whole Wheat Pita Bread Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: /2 cups All Purpose Flour (Maida), /2 cups Whole Wheat Flour, teaspoons Active dry yeast, Salt, /2 teaspoons Sugar, /4 cups Lukewarm Water, tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Pita bread we will first have to get your ingredients ready especially the yeast.
2. If you are using active dry yeast (look like small round balls) - follow the instructions given in the packet.If you are using fast action yeast (looks more like fine semolina) then in a large bowl combine the flours, salt and sugar and gradually add in the yeast and knead the dough until smooth and elastic, adding little flour if it tends to get sticky.
3. Once all of the ingredients form a ball; add the olive oil and place the ball on a work surface and knead the dough for approximately 10 minutes.
4. Repeated kneading combines all the ingredients well and will help the bread rise well in the oven.Once you have finished kneading and gained enough arm muscle; place the dough in a large bowl coated with olive oil and cover it with cling wrap/plastic wrap and allow it to rise for about 2 hours.After two hours you will notice that the dough has doubled.
5. At this point punch the dough down and knead gently.
6. Divide the dough into 10 portions and roll each portion into a ball.
7. Place the balls on a baking sheet and cover them with a damp cloth and let them sit for another 30 minutes.While the dough is resting, preheat the oven to 250 C.
8. The oven should be preheated for at least half an hour before you can bake the pitas in them.
9. Now it should be time to work your dough into flat bread.
10. Take one ball, dust it with a little flour and dust the work surface as well.
11. Using a rolling pin, roll the pita into an oval or a circle.
12. Make sure the pitas are thin; about 1/8th inch or 1/4 inch thick.
13. Continue the same with the remaining dough balls.Place the rolled portion of pita bread on dusted baking sheets and place it inside the oven.
14. Bake the pita dough until they puff - you will see them rising forming bubbles, to slowly puffing and fully puffing up.The whole process takes a maximum or 3-5 minutes and not more than 5 minutes.
15. If the pita bread does not rise in 5 minutes, then take them out.
16. The Pita Bread will still be cooked, but just wont have pockets and will still taste just as good.You can serve Whole Wheat Pita Bread Recipe along with soups or make it into sandwiches like Egg Bhurji Stuffed Pita Pockets Recipe, Aloo Tikki Stuffed Pita Sandwich Recipe, Pita Sandwich With Cauliflower Falafel And Roasted Vegetables Recipe and more.

title: Andhra Style Tamati Pachadi Recipe (Tomato Chutney)
content:
Recipe Name: Andhra Style Tamati Pachadi Recipe (Tomato Chutney)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Andhra recipe for Andhra Style Tamati Pachadi Recipe (Tomato Chutney) (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Tomatoe, Dry Red Chillies - adjustable, teaspoon Tamarind Paste, teaspoons Red Chilli powder - optional, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), tablespoon Mustard seeds, teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Cloves Garlic, Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Andhra Style Tamati Pachadi recipe, take the chopped tomatoes in a deep bottomed pan.
2. Add salt, turmeric & tamarind to them.
3. Keep the pan on medium heat & boil till they loose all the water & turn into a mushy paste alike.
4. Keep stirring in between.
5. Meanwhile when the tomatoes are boiling, take another pan, heat 2-3 teaspoons of oil.
6. Add the mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds.
7. Once they crackle, add dry red chillies.
8. Fry them till they become fragrant.
9. Once done, cool them & grind them into a smooth powder.Add the ground masala that we made in step two to the tomatoes & mix well.
10. If you think that the chillies aren't spicy enough, then add red chilli powder according to your preference at this step.Once again heat 5 tbsp oil, add the garlic pods & mustard seeds to it.
11. Once the garlic turns brownish & the seeds crackle, switch off the stove & let them cool.Add the tempered mixture to the chutney.
12. You can even add some urad dal or chana dal to this tempering.
13. But make sure to add this tempered oil mix only when it is completely cooled off.
14. This is important as it makes sure the chutney stays fresh for a long time.Serve Andhra Style Tamati Pachadi along with Ghee Masala Dosa and Homemade Soft Idlis for your breakfast or as your tea time snack.

title: Aamras Recipe - Ripe Mango Ras
content:
Recipe Name: Aamras Recipe - Ripe Mango Ras
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Aamras Recipe - Ripe Mango Ras (Side Dish).
Ingredients: cups Mango (Ripe) - cut into pieces, /4 cup Water, Sugar - optional
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Aamras Recipe, roll the whole mangoes with your palms to soften them.Peel the mango, transfer all the pulp into a mixer-jar, discarding the seed.
2. Along with the mango pulp in the jar, add water and adjust the sugar to your liking and depending on the sweetness of the mango.
3. Pulse it until smooth.
4. Keep in fridge for some time and serve cold along with your meal.Serve this delicious Aamras recipe along with Puri Recipe, Batata Nu Shaak and Mumbai Style Masala Khichia Churi or just enjoy it on its own for your breakfast or evening snack, and you will simply love it.

title: Rajasthani Khooba Roti Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Rajasthani Khooba Roti Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Rajasthani recipe for Rajasthani Khooba Roti Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, Salt - To Taste, Water - As Required, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin with, Rajasthani Khooba Roti first, in a large mixing bowl, add flour, salt, and water, Mix together with your hands to form crumbs.Add water to combine it well and make a smooth and yet stiff dough.Leave the dough aside for 15 minutes so it rests.Pinch a large lemon sized ball from the dough and roll it to make a ball.
2. Dust the counter well and roll out the dough ball to make a thick round roti.
3. Spread a little ghee on one side of the roti and place that side on the tawa.
4. After 20 seconds, flip the roti and start pinching on the top of the roti.Keep pinching till the full roti is covered.
5. Flip the roti and again roast from the patterned side.Once both sides are lightly browned hold the roti with a tong, remove it from tawa and place it directly on flames.Flip and roast from both the sides till its evenly cooked from both the sides.Once done, switch off the stove and pour ghee on the roti and serve.Your Rajasthani Khooba Roti is ready to be served with Makai Wali Bhindi or Pyaz ki sabzi..

title: Peerkangai Thogayal Recipe (Ridge Gourd Peel Chutney)
content:
Recipe Name: Peerkangai Thogayal Recipe (Ridge Gourd Peel Chutney)
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Peerkangai Thogayal Recipe (Ridge Gourd Peel Chutney) (Side Dish).
Ingredients: cups Ridge Gourd Skin (Turai/ Peerkangai), teaspoons White Urad Dal (Split), Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Dry Red Chillie, Curry leaves, grams Tamarind, /4 teaspoon Mustard seeds, Dry Red Chillie, Curry leaves, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Peerkangai Thogayal Recipe, heat a teaspoon oil in a heavy bottomed pan; add the cut peels of the Ridge Gourd, along with a little salt and saute until soft and tender.
2. Turn off heat and allow it to cool.
3. The peels will not get completely soft, so its ok as long as they have cooked through.In another small pan; roast the fenugreek seeds, dry red chillies and urad dal until it releases a roasted aroma and slightly browned.Now grind the roasted ingredients, the cooked ridge gourd peels, the tamarind and curry leaves together until it forms a smooth paste.
4. Check the salt in the Peerkangai Thogayal Recipe and adjust to suit your taste.Heat a little oil in a pan; add mustard seeds, dry red chillies and curry leaves.
5. Allow it to crackle and the red chillies to roast.
6. Add it to the Peerkangai Thogayal.Serve the Peerkangai Thogayal along with a hot bowl of Steamed Rice and Ghee.

title: Paneer Tikka Kathi Roll Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Paneer Tikka Kathi Roll Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Paneer Tikka Kathi Roll Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: cups Whole Wheat Flour, Salt - To Taste, Tablespoon Ghee, Tablespoon Ghee, grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - thinly sliced, /4 cup Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt), tablespoon Gram flour (besan), Ginger, Clove, tablespoon Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder, teaspoon Garam masala powder, /4 cup Mint Leaves (Pudina) - finely chopped, Salt - To Taste, Coal - for giving a smoked flavour, /4 cup Mint Leaves (Pudina) - chopped, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - thinly sliced, Onion, /2 Lemon - juice extracted, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Paneer Tikka Kathi Roll Recipe, get all the ingredients prepped and ready.
2. If you are making paneer at home you can use our homemade paneer recipe.To make the paneer tikka, add all the ingredients for Paneer Tikka in a bowl except the paneer and stir them well until combined.Add the cut paneer pieces into it and allow it to rest for 5 minutes.Heat a teaspoon of oil or ghee in a wok or a skillet, add the paneer mixture and sauté over high heat for four to five minutes, stirring occasionally and cook the paneer until all the marination thickens and forms a coat over the paneer.Once done, check the salt and spice and adjust to suit your taste.
3. Keep this aside.Next step is the give the paneer tikka a smoked flavour.
4. Place a large piece of coal on the gas flame and allow it to turn red hot.Place a katori in the center of the paneer tikka pan, place the red hot coal in the katori/ cup and spoon a little bit of ghee over the coal.
5. It will begin to emit smoke.
6. Cover the pan and allow the paneer tikka to get the smoky flavours.After about 30 seconds, remove the coal cup and the smoked paneer tikka is ready.The next step is to make the roti for the rolls.
7. In a large mixing bowl add the flour and salt, give it mix with your fingers.
8. Add a little water at a time and make a smooth dough.Once you have the dough ready, add a teaspoon of oil over the dough and knead for a couple of minutes, this will give the dough a flaky texture.To make the wrap for the kathi rolls, divide the dough into 5 large portions.
9. Roll the dough into a large circle by dusting it in flour.
10. Preheat a skillet on medium heat, place the rolled dough on the skillet and cook it on both sides by smearing ghee over it until it is cooked through and browned and slightly crisp.The addition of ghee helps in creating a crisp texture to the rolls.In a small mixing bowl, combine the raw onions, capsicum, lemon, mint leaves and salt.
11. Toss them together.Place the cooked rotis on a flat surface and place a portion of the filling towards the center, sprinkle some onion capsicum mixture and if you like a little more chaat masala and roll it up tightly.The Paneer Tikka Kathi rolls are now ready to be served.
12. Proceed the same way with the remaining dough portions and serve.Serve the Paneer Tikka Kathi Rolls as a snack for tea on weekends, as an appetizer for parties along Mumbai Style Tawa Pulao Recipe With Moong Sprouts and Nawabi Kofta Curry Recipe or make it less spicy and pack it into your kid's lunch box.

title: Pan Fried Rice Balls Filled With Cheese Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Pan Fried Rice Balls Filled With Cheese Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Pan Fried Rice Balls Filled With Cheese Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt, Onion, cups Jasmine Rice, Salt, cup Sweet corn, /4 cup Parsley leaves - finely chopped, cup Parmesan cheese - grated, cup Mozzarella cheese - cut into small cubes, Cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), Egg, cup Whole Wheat Bread crumbs, Sunflower Oil - for deep frying
Instructions:
1. To begin with the Pan Fried Rice Balls Filled With Cheese Recipe, first in a heavy bottomed pot, heat oil over medium heat and add some butter.
2. As the butter melts, add diced onion and saute until soft for about 4-5 minutesAdd rice and give a stir to coat with oil.Now add 5 cups of water to the rice and 1 teaspoon of salt.
3. Cover and cook until water has been completely absorbed by the rice.Stir in the corn and cook covered for another 5 minutes and check if the rice has cooked and absorbed all the water.
4. Allow it to cool.
5. Once cooled, combine parsley and parmesan cheese to the mixture.Make rice balls using hand and stuff each ball with a small cube of mozzarella cheese in the centre.
6. The cheese cube should be totally covered with the rice mixture.Arrange flour in a bowl, 3 beaten eggs in another and breadcrumbs in the third ballCoat the rice balls with all purpose flour.
7. Shake off the excess flour.
8. Dip the balls in the beaten egg.
9. Finally, roll balls in breadcrumbs until it is evenly coated with it.
10. Repeat for the remaining balls.
11. Heat some oil in skillet over medium flame.
12. Once hot add the coated rice balls in batches and cook until they turn golden brown.Your Pan Fried Rice Balls Filled With Cheese Recipe is ready to be served.Serve the Pan Fried Rice Balls Filled With Cheese Recipe with classic Marinara sauce or ranch for evening snack.

title: Spicy Seafood Stew Casserole With Tomatoes And Lime Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Spicy Seafood Stew Casserole With Tomatoes And Lime Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Spicy Seafood Stew Casserole With Tomatoes And Lime Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Fish fillet - basa, grams Prawns, Clamps, Baby Potatoes, Carrots (Gajjar), Onion, Tomatoe, Fresh Red chillies, Cloves Garlic, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), teaspoon Paprika powder, Salt - To Taste, Tablespoon Lemon Juice, teaspoon Black pepper powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, cup Chicken stock, /4 cup Coconut milk
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Spicy Seafood Stew Casserole With Tomatoes And Lime recipe, clean basa fish and cut into small pieces.
2. Clean, wash and devein the prawns.
3. Wash well.I could not get clamps so I did not use it in the recipe but I highly recommend you to use it.Now marinate seafood in lime juice, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper powder for about 30 minutes.
4. Let it marinate in the fridge.While the seafood is marinating in fridge, we will prepare the stew.In a wide pan, heat olive oil.
5. Add minced garlic and sauté till garlic turns golden brown.
6. Add finely chopped onions and finely chopped red chilies.
7. Cook till onions turn soft.Add finely chopped tomatoes and cook until tomatoes turn mushy.Add cumin powder, paprika power and remaining salt to taste.
8. Add peeled potatoes and chopped carrots and give it a mix.Add chicken stock and bring it to boil.
9. Cook till potatoes and carrots are fully cooked.
10. Check for seasoning.
11. Boil the stew for 5 to 8 minutes more.
12. Add more stock if needed.Now add the marinated seafood and cook in low flame for about 8 to 10 minutes.Once the seafood is cooked, add coconut milk and continue to cook for a minute or two.Turn off the stove, add fresh chopped coriander leaves and serve hot with toasted bread.Serve Spicy Seafood Stew Casserole With Tomatoes And Lime along with steamed rice for a weekend lunch or dinner.

title: Spicy Chilli Garlic Noodles Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Spicy Chilli Garlic Noodles Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Asian recipe for Spicy Chilli Garlic Noodles Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Hakka Noodles, Water - As Required, Salt, Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Sunflower Oil - As Required, Onion, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - thinly sliced, Clove, teaspoon Soy sauce, Tablespoon Red Chilli Sauce, /2 teaspoon White vinegar, tablespoon Tomato Ketchup, Dry Red Chillies - crushed (chilli flakes), Salt, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Spicy Chilli Garlic Noodles recipe, first cook the noodles as per the instructions on the packet, with enough water, salt and oil.Put a pot of water with oil and salt, on the heat and bring it to a rolling boil.When it boils, turn the heat down, add the noodles to it and cook for 5-6 minutes or as specified on the packet, till it is cooked al dente.Take care not to over cook the noodles or they may turn mushy.
2. When the noodles are done, drain the noodles in a colander and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process.Sprinkle a few drops of oil over the noodles and toss well till they are well coated.
3. This will keep the noodles from getting mushy and stuck to each other.
4. Now you can keep them aside for later use.To begin making the spicy seasoning, place a heavy bottomed pan on the heat.
5. Add some oil and warm it up.
6. Then add the finely chopped garlic and thin slices of onions and toss on a high heat for a minute.Add the capsicum and cook it for about a minute or two.Add soya sauce, red chilli sauce, vinegar, tomato ketchup, crushed dry red chilli and mix well.
7. Cook with constant stirring for about 30 seconds till the sauces begin to bubble.Add salt to taste, pepper powder and mix well.
8. Bear in mind that the sauce and noodles will already contain saltiness so season accordingly.Next, add the cooked noodles to the prepared sauce and toss well to cot the noodles.Serve Spicy Chilli Garlic Noodles on its own or with Mushroom Chilli for a weekend meal.

title: Chanar Dalna Recipe -Bengali Style Paneer & Potato Gravy
content:
Recipe Name: Chanar Dalna Recipe -Bengali Style Paneer & Potato Gravy
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Chanar Dalna Recipe -Bengali Style Paneer & Potato Gravy (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - cut into cubes, Potato (Aloo) - peeled and cut into cubes, Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), Dry Red Chilli, tablespoon Panch Phoran Masala - roasted and powdered, Tomato - big sized, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Ginger, Salt - To Taste, /2 Teaspoon Sugar, Sunflower Oil - As Required
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chanar Dalna recipe, grind roasted cumin and grated ginger in a mortar pestle.Mix red chilly powder and turmeric in a tablespoon of water and set it aside.In a heavy bottomed pan heat oil, add cubed potatoes and fry till the edges turn brown.
2. Set it aside.Add Paneer cubes to the same oil and fry till they turn gold.
3. Set it aside.Add bay leaf and dry red chilly to the same pan.
4. Add cumin and ginger paste and saute till it turns brown.Add red chilly and turmeric paste and mix it well, till the raw smell is gone.Add chopped tomato and cook till it is cooked well and oil separates.
5. Add Paneer and Potato cubes to this.
6. Cook for a minute.Add 2 cups of water and cook till the potatoes are soft.
7. Add powdered paanch phoran and give it a good mix.Boil till the gravy till it reaches the desired consistency and turn off the heat.Serve Chanar Dalna with steamed rice and Bengali Luchi and Watermelon Smoothie Recipe for a weekend brunch.

title: Cheesy Garlic Broccoli Nuggets Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Cheesy Garlic Broccoli Nuggets Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Cheesy Garlic Broccoli Nuggets Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: /2 cups Broccoli - florets, /2 cup Mozzarella cheese, tablespoon Nutralite Cheesy Garlic Mayo, tablespoons Corn flour, /4 cup Whole Wheat Bread crumbs, Salt - To Taste, Nutralite Garlic & Oregano Spread - for pan roasting
Instructions:
1. To begin making Cheesy Garlic Broccoli Nuggets Recipe, firstly wash and then finely chop the broccoli florets.
2. Melt Nutralite Garlic & Oregano Spread in a pan, add the broccoli and saute it for about a minute until it softens just a bit.Once it softens, allow it to cool completely.
3. Once the broccoli florets have cooled down, add in the cheese, Cheesy Garlic Mayo, corn flour and salt and mix well.
4. Have a taste to check for salt and seasoning and adjust accordingly.Take a small quantity of the Cheesy Garlic Broccoli Nuggets mixture and shape it into small oval kebab size portions.
5. Toss these Cheesy Garlic Broccoli Nuggets on breadcrumbs to give it a crust.Heat a skillet and melt a little Nutralite Garlic & Oregano spread over medium heat.Place the Cheesy Garlic Broccoli Nuggets and pan fry them on both sides until they are browned and crisp.Serve Cheesy Garlic Broccoli Nuggets Recipe along with a Cocoa Banana Almond Date Smoothie as an after school snack for your kids or even as a party appetizer along with Nutralite Achari Mayo as a dip by the side.

title: Bengali Mooli Aloo Ki Sabzi  Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Bengali Mooli Aloo Ki Sabzi  Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Bengali Mooli Aloo Ki Sabzi Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Mooli/ Mullangi (Radish) - cut into small piece, Potato (Aloo) - cut into small piece, Onion, Green Chilli - chopped, tablespoons Kasundi mustard sauce, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Onion, tablespoon Mustard oil - adjustable, /2 Teaspoon Sugar, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Bengali Mooli Aloo Ki Sabzi recipe, heat mustard oil in a heavy bottomed pan.Add the mustard seeds, cumin seeds, nigella seeds and saute them for about 10 seconds.After 10 seconds, add green chilli and onion.
2. Cook till the onion becomes soft and translucent.
3. Once the onions become translucent, add the potatoes in the pan.
4. Stir them for a while on a medium heat.
5. Then put the radish into the pan.
6. Fry them for 4-5 minutes on a medium flame.Next add in all the spice powders, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, sugar and salt to taste.
7. Mix well to combine.Add little water to the vegetables and cover them with a lid.
8. Allow them cook for few minutes on a low flame and keep stirring in between.When the veggies are cooked, add the the mustard paste and mix it with the vegetables properly.
9. You can make the curry semi liquid or dry.
10. Cook for 2 more minutes and turn off the heat.Transfer Bengali Mooli Aloo Ki Sabzi into a serving bowl.Serve Bengali Mooli Aloo Ki Sabzi along with Bengali Style Lau Die Tetor Dal and Steamed Rice for a weekday lunch.

title: Kaddu Palak Roti Recipe (Pumpkin Spinach Flat Bread)
content:
Recipe Name: Kaddu Palak Roti Recipe (Pumpkin Spinach Flat Bread)
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Kaddu Palak Roti Recipe (Pumpkin Spinach Flat Bread) (Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, cup Spinach - chopped, cup Kaddu (Parangikai/ Pumpkin) - grated (red one preferably), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Salt, Water - as required for dough, Sunflower Oil - as required for rotis
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Kaddu Palak Roti recipe, wash the spinach leaves in cold water and chop them finely.Remove the skin from pumpkin and grate them.
2. In a large bowl, add flour, pumpkin, spinach, spice powders, and salt.
3. Combine them well.Add water little by little and mix them well to form a tight dough.
4. Add water cautiously and in small amount since you would not want the dough too be any runny or not pliable.Dust the working surface with flour and roll the dough into small lemon-sized balls.
5. Dust the discs with flour while rolling them, and roll using rolling pin into thin circular discs.Heat the Tawa over medium flame.
6. Season the tawa with oil and cook the roti on both sides until they are golden on both sides.Repeat the same for the remaining dough.
7. Serve it warmly with raita or curry or simple with a bowl of curd.Prepare this Kaddu Palak Roti and serve it for your dinner/breakfast along with Corn And Onion Raita and Dhaniya Pudina Chutney.

title: Iranian Baida Curry Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Iranian Baida Curry Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Middle Eastern recipe for Iranian Baida Curry Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Whole Egg, Onion, tablespoon Jaggery, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /4 cup Fresh coconut - grated, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Dry Red Chilli, tablespoon Sesame seeds (Til seeds), tablespoon Poppy seeds, Ginger, Clove, Badam (Almond)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Iranian Baida Curry Recipe, boil the whole egg in water, make sure the eggs are fully immersed.Boil them for at least 15 minutes until the eggs are completely cooked and keep them aside to de shell them once it cools down.Dry roast the ingredients mentioned in the list to grind on to a pan, once done cool it down and grind it into a smooth paste by adding little water.Heat a kadai with oil, add onions and saute them until it turns golden brown.
2. Add the ground masala paste.
3. Saute for 10 minutes.Add 1 cup of water along with jaggery and bring it to a boil.
4. Check for salt and adjust according to your palate.Finally, de-shell the eggs, cut them into half and drop them into the boiling curry.
5. Boil the curry for 2 more minutes and switch it off.
6. Serve by garnishing it with some coriander leaves.Serve the Iranian Baida Curry Recipe along with Garlic naan, Chapathi and some steamed rice along with Moong Sprouts Salad with Grated Carrots and Coriander.

title: Vegan Chickpea Omelette Recipe (Spiced Chickpea Flour Pancakes)
content:
Recipe Name: Vegan Chickpea Omelette Recipe (Spiced Chickpea Flour Pancakes)
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Vegan Chickpea Omelette Recipe (Spiced Chickpea Flour Pancakes) (North Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: cup Gram flour (besan), /2 cup Coconut milk, /4 cup Water, Inch Ginger - Grated, Clove, /2 teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /4 teaspoon Baking soda, Green Chillies - finely chopped, Onion, Tomato - finely chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - For Cooking
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Vegan Chickpea Omelette Recipe, first place a non-stick griddle/tava on the heat.
2. Turn the heat to low so it can slowly pre-heat while you prepare the batter.To make the batter, sieve the chickpea flour/besan into a mixing bowl to remove all lumps.To it, add the ginger-garlic paste, ajwain, asafoetida, turmeric powder, baking soda, onion, tomato, green chillies, Coriander leaves and salt.
3. Mix well to combine.Next, stir in the coconut milk (or Soy or Almond milk), if using, and mix to make a smooth batter.Alternatively, add enough water to make a batter which is smooth and spreadable, but not too watery/runny.When the griddle is hot enough, pour a ladle full of the batter on it and spread evenly into a round pancake.Drizzle oil along the edges of the omelette and cook for 2-3 minutes, on medium heat till the bottom is golden brown.
4. Lift it gently with a spatula to check if it releases and if that bottom has cooked.When it looks golden, flip the omelette over and cook on the other side for 1-2 minutes.Serve hot along with Peanut Carrot Chutney.

title: Ulundu Kozhukattai Recipe - Uppu Kozhukattai/ Urad Dal Modak
content:
Recipe Name: Ulundu Kozhukattai Recipe - Uppu Kozhukattai/ Urad Dal Modak
Description: A flavorful and authentic Maharashtrian Recipes recipe for Ulundu Kozhukattai Recipe - Uppu Kozhukattai/ Urad Dal Modak (Appetizers).
Ingredients: cup Rice flour, cup Water, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Salt, cups White Urad Dal (Whole) - soaked for 4 hours, Green Chillies - chopped, Ginger, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Salt - To Taste, teaspoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, sprig Curry leaves - finely chopped
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Ulundu Kozhukattai Recipe - Uppu Kozhukattai/ Urad Dal Modak, first soak the urad dal in 2 cups of water for about 3 to 4 hours.
2. Drain the water completely.
3. Combine the dal, green chillies, ginger, salt and asafoetida powder and blend into a coarse batter.Place the batter in steamer plates or idli plates and steam on high heat for about 10 minutes until cooked.
4. To check if it is cooked insert a knife in the center and it should come out clean.Remove from the steamer and allow it to cool.
5. Once partially cool, cut into pieces crumble the steamed lentils until there are no lumps.Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan; add the mustard seeds and allow it to crackle.
6. Stir in the crumbled steamed lentils into the seasoning and saute for a few minutes until well combined.Allow the urad dal/ ulundu to cool.
7. Once cool divide the lentils into 10-15 oval shaped portions and keep aside.
8. This will be the savory filling for the rice wrapperTo make the wrapper for the modak/ Ulundu KozhukattaiBring the water to a boil in a pan along with the salt and oil.Gradually add little rice flour at time and keep stirring till the Ulundu Kozhukattai mixture comes together.Turn off the heat and transfer the rice flour mixture to another bowl and cover with a muslin cloth.
9. Keep it aside for 5 minutes.
10. It will help the Ulundu Kozhukattai dough to come together.With a little oil in a cup, smear the oil in your hands and knead the dough well to remove any lumps.
11. At all times make sure keep the dough covered with a wet muslin cloth to prevent the dough from drying out.Take a lemon size portion of the Ulundu Kozhukattai dough, make into a ball and press the dough in the palm of your hands to make a flat dough, cup your palms a bit so it forms a depression in the center.Place the urad dal filling in the center and bring the edges of the dough together to the center to make an oval shape Ulundu KozhukattaiContinue the similar process with the remaining portions of the dough and dal fillingNote: Keep dipping and smearing your fingers and palms with sesame oil when you handle a new portion of the dough.
12. This will prevent the Ulundu Kozhukattai from sticking to your handsPrepare the steamer filled with water.
13. Place the Ulundu Kozhukattai in the steamer plate and into the steamer.Steam for about 10 minutes until the Ulundu Kozhukattai look shiny and smooth.
14. You will also notice that if it is not cooked, the rice wrapper will be sticky.Once they are steamed, the Ulundu Kozhukattai (Ukadiche Modaks) are ready for an offering to god for the festival of Ganesh Chaturthi.
15. You can also have this steamed dumpling as your Tea Time Snack.

title: Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Asian recipe for Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Chicken, Onion, Green Chillies - chopped, teaspoon Garlic - minced, tablespoons Soy sauce, Tablespoon Lemon Juice, teaspoon Black pepper powder, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera), Tablespoon Red Chilli Sauce, tablespoon Sweet and Spicy Red Chilli Sauce (Tomato Chilli Sauce), Salt - To Taste, Tablespoon Red Chilli Sauce, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, cups Rice - soaked for 10 minutes, tablespoons Garlic - crushed, Ginger, Green Chillies - slit and roasted, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - sliced, Onion, Onion, Carrots (Gajjar) - cubed, Salt - To Taste, teaspoon Chinese 5 Spice Powder, teaspoon White pepper powder, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, grams Egg noodles - boiled and tossed in a teaspoon oil, /2 cup Classic Mayonnaise (With Egg), tablespoons Tomato Ketchup, tablespoons Red Chilli sauce, tablespoon Vinegar
Instructions:
1. To begin making Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice Recipe, keep all the ingredients prepped and ready.Marinate the chicken cubes by combining chicken with spring onions, garlic, green chilies, soya sauce, lemon juice, black pepper, red chili powder, cumin, chilli sauce, sweet and spicy sauce, and salt to taste in a mixing bowl.
2. Allow chicken to marinate for about 30 minutes.You can meanwhile boil the noodles as per instruction on packet and drain it and keep it aside.
3. Toss the noodles with teaspoon of oil to prevent them from sticking together.To make Mayonnaise SaucePrepare the mayo sauce by mixing mayonnaise, tomato ketchup, red chilli garlic sauce and vinegar.
4. Keep aside in a bottle or a closed container.
5. You can make this ahead of time and keep ready before a few days as well.To make Fried Rice Recipe:Cook the rice in a pressure cooker for two whistle and let the pressure releases naturally.
6. Once done open the pressure cooker and fluff up rice and keep aside.To make fried rice recipe,heat oil in a wok.
7. Once the oil is hot add ginger & garlic, and slit green chillies.
8. Saute till the raw smell disappears, on a low flame such that the ginger garlic does not char.Now add carrots, saute for a minute, add all the vegetables, and saute on medium heat.Once they are a bit tender, and then add salt, 5 spice powder, white pepper powder and mix well.Add rice to the wok and toss till the spiced veggies mix well and turn off heat.
9. Keep aside.To make Chicken:In another wok, heat a tablespoon oil and add the marinated chicken and cook covered.
10. Saute occasionally till tender and cooked well.
11. You can sprinkle a bit of water if you want, but the moisture in it is enough for chicken to cook.Assembling Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice RecipePlace a cup of cooked rice on the serving plate.Top it up with boiled noodles.Pour the prepared mayonnaise sauce.Put sauteed marinated chicken as the topmost layer of the layered fried rice.Serve Singapore Style Chicken Layered Fried Rice Recipe as a one pot meal for lunch, along with a dessert like Coconut Tapioca Pudding Recipe with Spicy Strawberry Sauce or Cinnamon Rice Pudding With Cherry Compote Recipe.

title: Masala Sandwich Recipe With Rocket Leaves
content:
Recipe Name: Masala Sandwich Recipe With Rocket Leaves
Description: A flavorful and authentic Fusion recipe for Masala Sandwich Recipe With Rocket Leaves (Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese), Potatoes (Aloo) - boiled and mashed, Onion, Inch Ginger - Grated, Clove, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - julienned, Tomatoe, Pav bhaji masala - to taste, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), French bread - or rye bread to make sandwiches, Rocket leaves - or salad leaves for the sandwich
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Masala Sandwich with Rocket Leaves, we will first make the masala for the sandwich.Heat a teaspoon of oil in a wok/kadai, add the onions, ginger, garlic, capsicum and saute them on low to medium heat until soft and tender.
2. Add the tomatoes, and stir fry until softened.
3. This will take 4 to 5 minutes.
4. Once the tomatoes have softened, add the mashed potatoes, paneer and the pav bhaji masala.
5. Stir well to combine.
6. Check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste.Cover the pan, turn the heat to low and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.
7. Once done, turn off the heat and stir in the coriander leaves.Slice the french rolls into half lengthwise and spread butter on each half.
8. Toast them on a skillet until lightly browned.Once the bread is toasted spread the Bombay Masala mixture on one half , place the rocket leaves and close the sandwich with the other half on top and press gently so that the sandwich holds together.Serve the Masala Sandwich with Rocket Leaves by cutting them into half.Serve them hot and fresh with Strawberry Yogurt Lassi Recipe or Coffee Banana Oats Smoothie Recipe for breakfast.

title: Tomato Relish Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Tomato Relish Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Tomato Relish Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Tomatoe, Onion, /2 cup Red Wine Vinaigrette, /2 Dried oregano, Clove, /2 Black pepper powder, /2 Dijon Mustard, tablespoon Cane sugar, to 3 tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Tomato Relish Recipe, heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan.
2. Add onions, garlic and saute it until translucent.Add the tomatoes, red wine vinegar and cook on low to medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes until its all softened and mushy.Cook further to see all the liquid is evaporating.
3. Next, add mustard, black pepper powder, oregano, sugar and salt and cook until the sauce comes together.Turn off the heat, let the Tomato Relish Recipe cool and store it in the fridge in a glass container.
4. Serve Tomato Relish as a dip or use it as a sauce while making sandwiches and rolls.

title: Dubuk Vade Recipe - Khandeshi Gram Flour Dumpling Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Dubuk Vade Recipe - Khandeshi Gram Flour Dumpling Curry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Maharashtrian Recipes recipe for Dubuk Vade Recipe - Khandeshi Gram Flour Dumpling Curry (Main Course).
Ingredients: Onion, Clove, /4 cup Fresh coconut - grated, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), tablespoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), tablespoon Garam masala powder, Salt - To Taste, /2 cup Gram flour (besan), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Khandeshi Dubuk Vade Recipe - Gram Flour Dumpling Curry, heat a kadai on medium heat, drizzle some oil.
2. Add chopped onions and garlic and saute till it softens and the onions turn golden brown.
3. Once the onions have lightly colored, add grated coconut and saute for 5 more minutes until the coconut have also roasted well.
4. Add chopped coriander leaves and saute for 2 more minutes and turn off the heat.Allow the mixture to cool down for a while and then blitz it in a mixer with some water to a smooth and creamy mixture.
5. To make the Dumpling / Kandeshi VadeMix besan flour, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt to taste.
6. Add 1/4 cup water to it and mix to form a dropping consistency batter.
7. Heat a kuzhi paniyaram pan on medium heat, drizzle some oil and drop in a spoonful of the batter into each cavity and allow the bhadi's to cook on either side for 5 minutes.
8. Once done, take the fried Kandeshi Vade out and drain them over a paper napkin.
9. To Make the Kandeshi Vade Curry Heat a kadai on medium heat, drizzle some oil, add cumin seeds and allow it to crackle for few seconds.Add ground coriander and coconut paste and keep sauteing until the mixture reduces.
10. Sprinkle all the spice powders like red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and salt to taste.
11. Mix well.
12. Add about 1 cup of water and and keep stirring until the Kandeshi Dubuk Vade Curry comes to a boil.
13. Add in the fried Vade and allow the Kandeshi Dubuk Vade Curry to boil for 10 more minutes and turn off the heat.
14. Check the salt and adjust the taste accordingly.
15. Once done, transfer the Khandeshi Dubuk Vade Recipe to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve Khandeshi Dubuk Vade Recipe - Gram Flour Dumpling Curry along with Jowar Atta Roti Recipe and Aloo Palak Sabzi for your everyday simple Indian Lunch.

title: Radish Soup Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Radish Soup Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Radish Soup Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Mooli/ Mullangi (Radish) - purple one, Cups Water, /4 teaspoon Garam masala powder, Salt, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, Mooli/ Mullangi (Radish) - slices, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Radish Soup recipe, wash, peel and slice the radish.In a saucepan, add radish slices, garam masala powder, and water.Cook the radish until tender.
2. Remove from the stove and allow it to cool.Once cooled down, blend and pass it through the strainer.Mix the strained liquid with the required amount of water and pepper.Boil the soup for few minutes, about 5 minutes.Serve the soup hot, garnished with radish slices and coriander leaves.Prepare Radish soup effortlessly and enjoy as a mid snack or just sip it before your lunch or dinner during winters.

title: Mango Donut Cake Recipe With Chocolate Glaze
content:
Recipe Name: Mango Donut Cake Recipe With Chocolate Glaze
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Mango Donut Cake Recipe With Chocolate Glaze (Desserts).
Ingredients: /2 cups Vivatta Maida, /4 cup Mango Pulp (Puree), /2 teaspoons Baking powder, /4 teaspoon Baking soda, /4 cup Sunflower Oil, /4 cup Sugar, Salt, teaspoon Vanilla Extract, grams Dark chocolate - chopped, /4 cup Fresh cream, tablespoons Cocoa Powder, Sugar - powdered
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Mango Donut Cake Recipe With Chocolate Glaze, preheat the oven to 180 deg C.
2. Grease a donut (doughnut) pan with oil or line up with butter paper.Sift the maida baking powder, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
3. Mix everything and keep it aside.In a mixing bowl, take mango puree along with sugar.
4. Mix well until sugar dissolves completely.
5. Next add oil, vanilla essence and mix well again.Add the mango mixture into the sifted dry flour mixture, fold gently until a smooth batter texture.
6. Now pour the Mango donut cake batter equally into the donut pan slots.Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven at 180 degree C.
7. Take the Mango Donut Cake from the oven and let them cool down a bit.While the Mango Donut Cake is baking, add the chocolates and the cream into the saucepan.
8. Melt the dark chocolate until you get a smooth Chocolate Glaze.Once the Mango Donut Cake is done, remove from the pan and allow it to cool.
9. Once cooled, hold the mango donut cake upside down, dip the top surface of the cake in the glaze and pull it up.Let the extra glaze dribble and then immediately turn glaze side up and keep on a cooling rack for the glaze to harden.
10. Repeat this process for rest of the Mango Donut Cake.
11. Serve the donut cake after the glaze hardens.Serve Mango Donut Cake Recipe With Chocolate Glaze along with Grilled Stuffed Mushrooms Recipe With Onion Parmesan & Herbs, Heart Shaped Tea Sandwiches and Adrak Chai for your next tea party.

title: Matar Paneer Kachori Korma Recipe - Green Peas And Paneer Kachori Curry
content:
