Recipe Name: Matar Paneer Kachori Korma Recipe - Green Peas And Paneer Kachori Curry
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Matar Paneer Kachori Korma Recipe - Green Peas And Paneer Kachori Curry (Main Course).
Ingredients: Cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), tablespoons Sunflower Oil, /2 teaspoons Ajwain (Carom seeds), Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - as required for frying, cup Green peas (Matar), cup Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - crumbled, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, Salt, Onion, cup Homemade tomato puree, Ginger, Pecan, /2 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), Cloves (Laung), Mace (Javitri), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 teaspoon Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves), /2 Teaspoon Sugar, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Fresh cream - as required for garnishing, tablespoons Sunflower Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Matar Paneer Kachori Korma Recipe, we will firstly make the dough for kachori.Dough for the KachoriMix maida, salt, carom seeds, oil in a bowl and mix till you get crumbly texture.
2. Then add cold water to this slowly.
3. The dough has to be stiff and shouldn't be kneaded for long.Once the dough is done, let this rest for 15 to 20 minutes.
4. The next step is to make the filling for Kachori.
5. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan, add green peas, salt and all dry spices including turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, amchur powder, salt and pepper.
6. Let it cook for about 4 to 5 minutes while slightly mashing the peas in between.
7. After 4 minutes, add the crumbled paneer to this and mix well.
8. Let it simmer for 2 minutes and take it out in a bowl.
9. Keep it aside to cool down.Take a ball size dough and roll it like a roti but slightly thicker.
10. Take a 2.5" diameter lid or cookie cutter and cut the circles.
11. Now add a small teaspoon of the paneer and matar mixture in the middle and seal them using water on the edges.
12. Pat them a little to make it flat and keep them aside.To make the Kachoris, heat the required oil in a frying pan.
13. When the oil is hot, add the kachoris and fry them for 5 to 6 minutes until they turn golden brown and crispy on both the sides.Once done, take them out on a paper towel to absorb the excess oil and place aside.*Gravy / Korma for the dishWe will first make the onion paste, tomato paste and cashew paste separately in a mixer.
14. Keep aside.
15. In a wide bottomed pan, add oil, let it heat, then add the whole spices including cloves, mace, cumin seeds, cardamom, cinnamon stick and let it crackle.
16. This will take about a minute.To the pan, add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, ginger garlic paste, the freshly ground onion paste and let it cook for about 4 to 5 minutes until the raw smell of onions go away.
17. Add in the tomato puree and let it cook until the tomatoes are well combined into the gravy.
18. Next, add the cashew paste to tomato onion mixture and stir well to get a uniform mixture.
19. Switch the heat to low, add the beaten curd and let it cook for 2 minutes.
20. Next add 1/2 cup of water or more according to the gravy consistency.
21. Finally add garam masala powder, sugar, salt to taste and let it cook for 5 minutes on low heat.
22. Once done, add the mini kachoris to the gravy and garnish it with chopped coriander leaves.Serve Matar Paneer Kachori Korma with Boondi Raita and Phulka for a weekday meal.Serve Matar Paneer Kachori Korma along with Dal Makhani, Palak Raita, Phulka, Jeera Rice and Kachumber Salad for a meal, when you have guests coming home for dinner or you are organizing a house party.

title: Zucchini Roll Up Lasagne Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Zucchini Roll Up Lasagne Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Zucchini Roll Up Lasagne Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Green zucchini - thinly sliced, Salt - To Taste, Extra Virgin Olive Oil - for cooking, /2 cup Mozzarella cheese - grated, /2 Green zucchini - finely chopped, Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) - finely chopped, Onion, Clove, teaspoon Dried Thyme Leaves, teaspoon Rosemary, Teaspoon Red Chilli Flake, Salt - To Taste, Tomatoe, Onion, Clove, teaspoons Black pepper corns - crushed, Teaspoon Red Chilli Flake, Teaspoon Sugar, /4 cup Basil leaves - chopped, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Zucchini Roll Up Lasagne Recipe, we will prep the zucchini, cut them vertically long to thin stripes.Grill the zucchini over a grill pan, until you notice grill marks on either side.
2. Once you have finished grilling all the zucchini stripes, keep them aside to cool down.
3. To make the stuffing for the Zucchini Roll Up LasagneHeat a sauce pan with oil, add chopped garlic and saute till they soften.
4. Add in chopped onions and saute till the onions turn translucent.Add in chopped zucchini and bell peppers and saute for another 5 minutes, sprinkle all the seasonings like thyme, rosemary and dried red chilli flakes and salt to taste.Give it a toss and sauté for another 2 minutes and turn off the heat and allow it to cool.To make the Tomato Basil SauceBoil the tomatoes with required water in a saucepan.Once you see the tomato skin peeling, turn off the heat.When the skin peel off, then you know the tomatoes are ready.
5. Peel the skin off the tomatoes, remove the seeds of the tomato and roughly chop them.Do keep all the juices the tomatoes release, this will add body to the tomato sauce.
6. Keep the chopped tomatoes aside.In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
7. Add the chopped garlic and onions.
8. Stir for a few seconds until it begins to sizzle in the oil and the onions soften.At this stage, add in the chopped tomatoes and the roughly chopped basil leaves, some salt, sugar, black pepper corns and stir to combine well.We will now use a hand blender to coarsely puree the ingredients together to get a saucy texture.Cover the pan with the lid slightly ajar and simmer the mixture for 20 to 30 minutes until the sauce is thick.Keeping the lid slightly ajar helps to thicken the sauce by evaporating the excess water.Add salt to taste, red chilli flakes for the punch and give it a stir.
9. Turn off the heat and set aside.To Make the Zucchini Roll Up LasagnePreheat the oven to 180 degree celsius for 10 minutes.
10. Place one of the zucchini sheet and add a tablespoon of the filling on one corner and roll it tightly.
11. Do the same for the rest of the zucchini sheets.Take out a baking dish, pour the tomato basil sauce on to the tray and place Rolled Zucchini next to each other inside the tray.
12. Fill it up completely.Top each zucchini roll with cheese and bake the Zucchini Roll Up Lasagne till the cheese melts.
13. Once done, remove from the oven and serve hot.Serve the Zucchini Roll Up Lasagne Recipe along with Garlic Bread With Herb Butter , Chickpea Orange Salad Recipe with Sun Dried Tomatoes by the side to make a delicious meal.

title: Thengai Sadam Recipe (A Quick And Healthy Coconut Rice)
content:
Recipe Name: Thengai Sadam Recipe (A Quick And Healthy Coconut Rice)
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Thengai Sadam Recipe (A Quick And Healthy Coconut Rice) (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Fresh coconut - grated, /2 cups Cooked rice, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, teaspoons White Urad Dal (Split), teaspoons Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), Raw Peanuts (Moongphali) - fistful, sprig Curry leaves, or 4 Green Chillies - finely chopped, Ginger, + 1 tablespoon Coconut Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin cooking the Thengai Sadam (Coconut Rice Recipe), heat a tablespoon of coconut oil in a heavy bottomed pan or wok.
2. Add the mustard seeds to the oil, and once it begins to crackle, add in the urad dal, channa dal and the peanuts.Once the dals begins to brown, add the green chillies, curry leaves and ginger and stir them together for a few minutes.Next, add in the coconut to the kadai and mix them all together.
3. Care should be taken to avoid any moisture remaining in the mixture, therefore keep stirring it properly until all the moisture in the coconut evaporates.
4. At this stage, stir in the cooked rice and salt and combine all the ingredients well.
5. Add a tablespoon of coconut oil to it to separate the grains of the rice.
6. Finally, add a tablespoon of coconut oil to the Thengai Sadam, to separate the grains of the rice.
7. Stir fry gently to combine all the ingredient taking care and ensuring that the rice does not get mashed, in the process.
8. Once combined, turn the heat to low and simmer for a couple of minutes.
9. Turn off the heat and serve the Thengai Sadam (Coconut Rice) hot with a potato roast and papad.

title: Karwar Style Ambade Udid Methi Recipe - Hog Plum Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Karwar Style Ambade Udid Methi Recipe - Hog Plum Curry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Coastal Karnataka recipe for Karwar Style Ambade Udid Methi Recipe - Hog Plum Curry (Main Course).
Ingredients: Hog Plum (Amtekai) - (Ambade), /4 cup Fresh coconut - grated, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Black Urad Dal (Split), teaspoon Rice - (raw rice), /4 Teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Pepper, Dry Red Chilli, tablespoons Jaggery, Pinch Asafoetida (Hing), Karela (Bitter Gourd/ Pavakkai) - (Small), Salt - To Taste, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Pinch Asafoetida (Hing)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Karwar Style Ambade Udid Methi Recipe (Hog Plum Curry), firstly, scrape away the outer layer of the bitter gourd, clean it from inside and cut it into thin rings.
2. Apply a bit of salt to it (I used 1/4 teaspoon), toss well to coat and keep aside for about an hour to do away with the bitterness of bitter gourd.
3. After an hour, wash the chopped bitter gourd thoroughly and keep aside to drain.
4. Use a little oil and roast the bitter gourd rings on low heat in a kadai till crisp.
5. Peel and clean the Ambade meanwhile when the bitter gourd is roasting on low heat.
6. Heat a little oil in a kadai (a few drops each time) and lightly roast the coriander seeds, urad dal, methi seeds, rice grains, peppercorns, asafoetida piece and dry red chillies separately on low heat.As soon as each ingredient changes its colour, remove from flame and keep aside to cool.Once cooled, grind all these ingredients in a mixer grinder along with the grated coconut, using required water to form a smooth paste.
7. Add to this paste to a cup of water and mix well to form a semi-thick gravy and pour in the kadai.Now, add turmeric powder, ambade/hog plum/amtekai, jaggery, roasted bitter gourd rings, salt to taste and keep on a high heat stirring occasionally till it reaches boiling point.
8. Once it starts boiling, lower the heat and simmer for about 8-10 minutes or till the ambade are cooked and soft.
9. If you feel that the gravy has thickened too much by now, just add some water to bring back a medium consistency which is desirable.Check for seasoning and adjust salt and jaggery if required.
10. In a tadka pan, heat a bit of oil for tempering and when the oil is hot, add mustard seeds and asafoetida.
11. Pour this over the prepared udid methi.Serve Karwar Style Ambade Udid Methi Recipe (Hog Plum Curry) along with Steamed Rice and Sol Kadhi for a South Indian meal.

title: Roasted Cauliflower Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Roasted Cauliflower Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Roasted Cauliflower Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Cauliflower (gobi), Garlic - sliced, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Black pepper powder - or red chilli powder, Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, /4 cup Anardana Powder (Pomegranate Seed Powder), tablespoons Pomegranate molasses - orhoney (optional but recommended), Fresh Herbs - Handful of herbs of choice like basil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the roasted cauliflower, first pre-heat the oven to 200 degree celsius.In a mixing bowl, toss together the olive oil, garlic and cauliflower florets.
2. Sprinkle salt as required.Place these florets on a baking tray and roast till they just soften (about 10-12 minutes). Take the tray out of the oven.Add the coriander powder, cumin and black pepper powder.Mix and place it back in the oven to roast for another 10 to 12 minutes or till the cauliflower is cooked and caramelizes or slightly turns brown.
3. Take it out onto a serving dish.Garnish with pomegranate seeds, herbs and drizzle some molasses or honey over it.
4. Serve immediately.Serve Roasted Cauliflower as a starter or as a side dish along with Panchmel Dal and Phulkas for a weekday lunch or dinner

title: Pain Viennois | Vienna Bread Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Pain Viennois | Vienna Bread Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic European recipe for Pain Viennois | Vienna Bread Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: ml Lukewarm Water, grams Active dry yeast, tablespoons Sugar, grams Milk Powder, grams Vivatta Maida - or half of bread flour, Salt, Salt, Egg white - for brushing (or milk)
Instructions:
1. To begin making Pain Viennois | Vienna Bread Recipe, in a bowl, combine water, sugar, yeast and milk powder in a big mixing bowl.
2. Allow it to stand for 10 minutes until bubbly and frothy.Add the flours, salt and butter to the yeast mixture and knead them to a dough.Later transfer it over a work surface and continue kneading until smooth and pliable for about 10 minutes.
3. Do not use any extra flour while kneading or shaping.Place the dough in a greased bowl and cover the container with a plastic wrap.
4. Set aside in a warm place until almost tripled in volume.Transfer the proofed dough on to a flat working surface and knead the dough for a minute or two to release the trapped air.
5. Divide the dough into 9 equal pieces and shape them into tight round balls.
6. Place them on a baking sheet and rest them for about 15 minutes.Flatten each dough ball to remove the air bubbles and shape them into tight 8 inch logs.
7. Place 4 to 5 logs over each baking tray lined with parchment paper.Brush their tops with milk or beaten egg.
8. Carefully score each log horizontally 12 to 15 times with a sharp blade or razor.
9. Allow them proof for about an hour until doubled.Bake them in a preheated oven at 450 degree fahrenheit for about 15 minutes rotating the trays half way through to ensure equal baking.Remove the baked buns and cool them on a wire rack to room temperature.
10. Vienna bread stays good for upto 2 days at room temperature and can be freezed for upto 3 weeks.Serve Pain Viennois | Vienna Bread Recipe after grilling it with Braised Pork Belly Recipe or along with Beetroot Gazpacho Soup Recipe for a light dinner.

title: Crunchy Ginger Capsicum Rice Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Crunchy Ginger Capsicum Rice Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Crunchy Ginger Capsicum Rice Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Basmati rice - cooked, Yellow Bell Pepper (Capsicum), Red Bell pepper (Capsicum), Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum), Green Chillies - finely chopped, Inch Ginger - Grated, teaspoon Butter, teaspoon Sesame seeds (Til seeds) - mixed black and white, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making Crunchy Ginger Capsicum Rice Recipe, let's get the basmati rice ready.
2. Wash the basmati rice in running tap water until clear and soak for 30 minutes.Now, take a big pan, fill it with 3.5 cups of water and bring it to a rolling boil.
3. Add the soaked and drained rice, salt to taste, close it with a lid and cook for 20 minutes on a low flame.
4. The rice should be cooked to al dente (firm to bite). Switch off the flame, let it rest for 10 minutes.Fluff up the rice with a fork such it does not become lumpy after cooling and keep aside.Now heat a kadai with some butter and a teaspoon of oil.
5. Oil will avoid the butter getting burnt or turning brown.Add the finely chopped bell peppers and green chillies.
6. Sauté for 2 minutes.Add the grated ginger and give it a good stir.Now add 2 cups of cooked basmati rice, season with salt and gently toss it to bring everything together.Garnish with toasted black and white sesame seeds and switch off the flame.Serve the Crunchy Ginger Capsicum Rice for kids lunch box or with chicken/vegetable Manchurian to make an interesting weeknight dinner.

title: Bengali Chirer Payesh / Poha Pudding Recipe With Nolen Gur
content:
Recipe Name: Bengali Chirer Payesh / Poha Pudding Recipe With Nolen Gur
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Bengali Chirer Payesh / Poha Pudding Recipe With Nolen Gur (Desserts).
Ingredients: /2 cup Poha (Flattened rice), tablespoons Rice flour, /2 liter Milk, cup Nolen Gur - or brown sugar, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Pecan, Raisin, pinch Saffron strands - and a little more for garnish, Salt
Instructions:
1. To cook Bengali Chirer Payesh/Poha Pudding Recipe With Nolen Gur, wash poha/chirer with water and strain the poha.Soak the washed and drained poha/chirer in a cup of milk.Also mix 1/2 cup of milk with rice flour and keep aside.Soak saffron in a little milk.
2. Keep aside.Boil the rest of milk and cardamom pods together in a Saucepan and bring to boil.
3. Stir occasionally.Add rice flour mix in boiling milk and stir constantly.Boil about 12-15 minutes till the rice flour is cooked and milk is condensed.Now add milk soaked flattened rice/chirer then add the milk soaked saffron.Cook chirer payesh for 15 minutes more or when flattened rice/chirer is cooked well and milk thickens considerably, add nolen gur or brown sugar.Stir it and cook it till the date jaggery/brown sugar dissolves.
4. Then add chopped almonds/cashews and a pinch of salt, cook for a minute and remove from heat.Pour the Bengali Chirer Payesh/Poha Pudding Recipe With Nolen Gur in a serving bowl, garnish with saffron strands/almonds/cashews and raisins and serve hot or chilled with sumptuous meal of Cholar Dal Recipe/ Aar Macher Jhol Recipe and jeera rice for dinner.

title: Shanghai Style Chap Nian Gao Recipes (Stir Fried Rice Cakes Recipes)
content:
Recipe Name: Shanghai Style Chap Nian Gao Recipes (Stir Fried Rice Cakes Recipes)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Chinese recipe for Shanghai Style Chap Nian Gao Recipes (Stir Fried Rice Cakes Recipes) (One Pot Dish).
Ingredients: cup Rice flour, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - For Cooking, Bok Choy - sliced, Carrot (Gajjar) - thinly sliced, /2 cup Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose), /2 cup Button mushrooms - quartered, tablespoons Corn flour, tablespoon Dark soy sauce, tablespoon Bean Paste, teaspoon Red Chilli sauce, Teaspoon Sugar, Sunflower Oil - For Cooking, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. We begin making the Shanghai Style Chap Nian Gao Recipes (Stir Fried Rice Cakes Recipes) by preparing the rice cakes, so mix all the ingredients in a microwave bowl and add 1/2 cup water.
2. Mix thoroughly and make it into a sticky paste.Cover the bowl with cling film, leaving an inch open.
3. Place it in the microwave oven for 2 minutes on high.
4. Remove and add 1/4 water and mix it again and repeat the process.Once done remove dough and it and place it on the board and using a muddler, pound the dough in order to combine and get a smooth consistency.
5. You can apply some oil on the board before doing this process to prevent sticking.
6. Pound the dough for 5 minutes.After it is done, use your hand to bind it together and knead it for 2 minutes.
7. Divide the dough into two and roll it into the cylindrical shape by applying some more oil on your hand as well as on the board.
8. Wrap it using a cling film and store it in the fridge for 1 hour.Remove from the fridge and cut them lengthwise and keep it aside.
9. Heat a wok with oil, add ginger and garlic, saute for few seconds.Add all the vegetables and saute them till it is cooked, you can add some water and cover it and let it cook.Meanwhile,mix all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl with 1/4 water and keep it aside.
10. Once the vegetables are done , pour in the sauce mixture and keep stirring till it thickens.At this point, you can add in the rice cakes and give it a stir.
11. Serve the Shanghai Style Chap Nian Gao Recipes (Stir Fried Rice Cakes Recipes) along with General Tso cauliflower for a satisfying lunch.

title: White Pumpkin Mor Kuzhambu Recipe - Kerala Style White Pumpkin Curry
content:
Recipe Name: White Pumpkin Mor Kuzhambu Recipe - Kerala Style White Pumpkin Curry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Kerala Recipes recipe for White Pumpkin Mor Kuzhambu Recipe - Kerala Style White Pumpkin Curry (Main Course).
Ingredients: /2 cups Curd (Dahi / Yogurt) - thick, /2 cup Fresh coconut, cup Vellai Poosanikai (Ash gourd/White Pumpkin) - cubed, Green Chillie, /4 teaspoon Black pepper powder, /3 cup Water, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt, teaspoon Coconut Oil, /4 teaspoon Mustard seeds, /4 Teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), sprig Curry leaves, Dry Red Chilli
Instructions:
1. To begin making White Pumpkin Mor Kuzhambu, we need to first cook the pumpkin.
2. Pressure cook the white pumpkin with little water in a pressure cooker for 2 whistles and release the pressure immediately by running the cooker under cold water.
3. Keep aside.Meanwhile, whisk curd with water in a bowl until the its smooth.
4. Make sure that there are no lumps in the curd.Next, add grated coconut, green chilli, black pepper powder in a mixer grinder and grind it to a smooth paste with a little water.
5. Your Kuzhambu paste is ready.Transfer this kuzhambu paste to the curd and mix well.
6. Once it is mixed properly, add in turmeric powder, cooked white pumpkin, salt and mix everything well.
7. Place this mixture on low heat in a saucepan and allow the mixture to become warm.
8. You will notice a light froth around the edges of the vessel.
9. Do not let the mixture boil, the curd will split on high heat.
10. Turn off the flame the moment you see froth.
11. The next step is to temper the kuzhambu.In a tempering pan/tadka pan, add one teaspoon of coconut oil.
12. Once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds, Once the mustard seeds starts to crackle, add the curry leaves, dry red chilli and give it a mix.
13. Turn off the flame and add this tempering to the Mor Kuzhambu.
14. Your Mor Kuzhambu is ready to be served.
15. Serve Mor Kuzhambu with Steamed Rice and Menthia Keerai Paruppu Usili for a simple weekday lunch.

title: Chettinad Style Prawn Biryani Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Chettinad Style Prawn Biryani Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Chettinad recipe for Chettinad Style Prawn Biryani Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Shrimps - or prawns, /2 cups Basmati rice, shallots, Ginger, tablespoon Garlic - paste, tablespoons Fresh coconut - grated, teaspoon Green Chilli - paste, /2 cup Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt), sprig Curry leaves, cup Sunflower Oil, Tablespoons Ghee, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Garam masala powder, Pepper, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Black cardamom (Badi Elaichi), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Bay leaves (tej patta), Dry Red Chilli, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
Instructions:
1. To prepare Chettinad Style Prawn Biryani Recipe, wash and clean prawns well, collect in a bowl and add ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, few drops of lemon juice and 2-3 pinch salt.
2. Mix well and marinate for 15-20 minutes.Wash and soak rice in water for a minimum 30 minutes before cooking.Heat oil in a large and thick bottomed handi and add the whole spices and wait till they splutter.Now add shallots and saute them till they are pale in color.Add green chili paste, grated coconut and marinated prawns and mix well.Fry for 4-5 minutes and then slowly add curd and carefully mix everything to avoid breaking the prawns.Keep the flames high and let the water from curd dry up completely.Season with coriander powder, garam masala powder and salt.
3. Fry till it is cooked and deeper in color.Now add the soaked rice and again stir well such that everything incorporates well with each other.Add warm water (double the quantity of rice), check salt and add a dollop of ghee and mix well.Allow the rice to come to a boil, close the lid and let the rice cook at low heat.Keep the lid covered till the rice is done.
4. Gently mix the rice and collect in a serving bowl.Garnish with chopped coriander and chopped curry leaves.Serve the Chettinad Style Prawn Biryani hot with raita for a wholesome meal.

title: Walnut And Flax Seed Trail Mix Recipe With Figs And Honey
content:
Recipe Name: Walnut And Flax Seed Trail Mix Recipe With Figs And Honey
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Walnut And Flax Seed Trail Mix Recipe With Figs And Honey (World Breakfast).
Ingredients: cup Walnuts, cup Dried Figs, /3 cup Flax seeds, /3 cup Honey, /2 cup Roasted Peanuts (Moongphali), Cinnamon
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Walnut and Flax Seed Trail Mix Recipe With Figs & Honey, in a mixing bowl, combine the walnuts, figs, flax seeds, honey, roasted peanuts and the cinnamon powder.
2. Preheat an oven to 190 degree celsius.
3. Transfer the Walnut and Flax Seed Trail Mix onto a baking tray and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until they are crisp.Remove the tray from the oven.
4. Allow the Walnut and Flax Seed Trail Mix to cool and transfer to an airtight jar and store.Serve Walnut and Flax Seed Trail Mix Recipe With Figs & Honey along with  Watermelon Smoothie Recipe as an after school snack for your kids.

title: Murgh Malaiwala Recipe - Chicken In Rich Creamy Gravy
content:
Recipe Name: Murgh Malaiwala Recipe - Chicken In Rich Creamy Gravy
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Murgh Malaiwala Recipe - Chicken In Rich Creamy Gravy (Main Course).
Ingredients: gram Chicken - cut into pieces, Ginger, teaspoon Garlic - paste, tablespoon Fresh cream, tablespoon Badam (Almond) - paste, Lemon Juice, /4 teaspoon Black pepper powder, Salt - To Taste, Onion, /2 cup Fresh cream, cup Milk, Cardamom Powder (Elaichi), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), teaspoon Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves), Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Murgh Malaiwala recipe, firstly clean and wash the chicken pieces and dry it.
2. Soak kasuri methi leaves in 1/4th cup of water in a small bowl.Take a big bowl and add chicken, salt, pepper and mix it well.
3. Refrigerate it for about 2 hours or more.After 2 hours, add garlic, ginger, lemon juice, almond paste and 2 tablespoons cream into the chicken and keep it aside for 20 minutes.Heat a heavy bottomed pan with ghee.
4. Add cardamom powder and onions in the pan and let it cook till the onions become soft and translucent.Next, add the marinated chicken pieces and let it cook for 10 minutes.
5. After 10 minutes, add in the cream, milk with cinnamon stick and bay leaf.Boil stirring occasionally till the chicken pieces are fully cooked and semi thick gravy consistency is formed.
6. Strain the methi leaves and sprinkle on the gravy and stir it well.
7. Let it cook for about a minute or two.Switch off the gas, cover the pan and let it sit for 10 minutes before serving.
8. Serve Murgh Malaiwala along with Burani Raita, Garlic Naan and Jeera Rice for a weekend meal with your family.

title: Paal Kesari Recipe - South Indian Style Milk Kesari
content:
Recipe Name: Paal Kesari Recipe - South Indian Style Milk Kesari
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Paal Kesari Recipe - South Indian Style Milk Kesari (Desserts).
Ingredients: /2 cup Sooji (Semolina/ Rava), Tablespoon Ghee, cups Milk, /4 cup Sugar, Saffron strands - (lightly powdered using mortar and pestle), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds - crushed (optional), Tablespoon Ghee, Cashew nuts, Raisin, Mixed dry fruits - chopped
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Paal Kesari Recipe, prepare all the ingredients and soak crushed saffron strands in a tablespoon of warm milk for 15-20 minutes (Soaking is optional for better infusion).Heat a Pan with ghee and roast the rava/semolina by continuously stirring till it turns fragrant.Switch off and allow it to cool completely.Heat a Kadai with milk over a low flame and when it starts to boil, add saffron and sugar.
2. Add cardamom if you like.Once the sugar melts, keep stirring over low flame and add the roasted rava in parallel to avoid any lumps.Cook the rava over a low flame, stirring continuously till it is completely cooked.
3. Switch off.Heat a Tadka pan with ghee and lightly roast the cashew nuts, raisins and any other dry fruits and nuts if using.Garnish the milk kesari with nuts and raisins.Your delicious Milk Kesari is ready to be served immediately or you can refrigerate and serve it chilled.Serve Paal Kesari Recipe after a South Indian Meal of Tomato Onion Sambar, Jeera Rasam, Chow Chow Thoran, Steamed Rice and Elai Vadam.

title: Spicy Lemon Chicken Kebab Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Spicy Lemon Chicken Kebab Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Spicy Lemon Chicken Kebab Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Chicken breasts - cut into cubes, Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) - cut into squares, Onion, Lemon Juice, teaspoon Dried Thyme Leaves, Teaspoon Red Chilli Flake, teaspoon Black pepper powder, Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Spicy Lemon Chicken Kebab Recipe, thoroughly wash and clean the chicken, and cut them into cubes.To marinate the chicken, in a mixing bowl, combine the chicken pieces along with the bell peppers and onions and lemon juice, dried thyme, red chilli flakes, pepper powder, olive oil, salt and mix well.
2. Rest it for at least for about 1 hour.
3. Once it is well coated and marinated, start skewering by first placing the red bell pepper, a chicken cube followed by a onion chunk, repeating the sequence one more time.
4. Ensure the skewer is not over crowded and packed.
5. Heat a grill pan, drizzle some oil and place the skewers and cook for at least 25 minutes.
6. Keep brushing the extra marinade over the chicken and keep turning the skewers so that it is evenly cooked.Serve the Spicy Lemon Chicken Kebab Recipe, along with tzatziki dip, sliced onions and green chutney to make it more interesting.

title: Gond Ke Ladoo Recipe - Edible Gum Ladoo
content:
Recipe Name: Gond Ke Ladoo Recipe - Edible Gum Ladoo
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Gond Ke Ladoo Recipe - Edible Gum Ladoo (Desserts).
Ingredients: grams Goond (Edible Gum), Tablespoon Ghee, grams Whole Wheat Flour, grams Sugar - powdered, grams Dry coconut (kopra), grams Badam (Almond) - chopped, grams Cashew nuts - chopped
Instructions:
1. To begin making Gond Ke Ladoo, in a large and heavy bottomed pan, add 350 ml ghee and melt it on a low flame.
2. Once the ghee is hot and melted, add gond/edible gum in the pan little at a time and fry on low flame until the goond puffs up like popcorn and crisps up.
3. Make sure that goond is completely cooked from inside and outside.
4. Repeat process with rest of the goond.Once goond is fried, using a ladle spoon out the goond from the ghee and keep aside to cool down.
5. Into the same pan containing the melted ghee, add whole wheat flour and roast until it becomes aromatic and brown.
6. The mixture should be crumbly.
7. Turn off the flame.
8. Transfer the flour on to a plate.
9. Add the powdered sugar and all dry fruits and mix well.
10. Let the mixture cool down.
11. Meanwhile, once the goond has cooled, with a rolling pin, crush them into a coarse powder.
12. Add this crushed goond in to wheat and dry fruit flour mixture.
13. Now take little amount of mixture in your hands and give them round shape.
14. Small or big that is totally up to you.Keep them aside for few hours, it will help the ladoos to set properly.
15. You can keep them in airtight container for a month.Serve Gond Ke Ladoo as a healthy snack during winter to ward off flus and colds or to new mothers after delivery to provide them with instant energy and aid in lactation.

title: Mukhadi Halwa Recipe (Semolina & All Purpose Flour Halwa)
content:
Recipe Name: Mukhadi Halwa Recipe (Semolina & All Purpose Flour Halwa)
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Mukhadi Halwa Recipe (Semolina & All Purpose Flour Halwa) (Desserts).
Ingredients: cup Sooji (Semolina/ Rava), tablespoons All Purpose Flour (Maida), cup Milk - +1/3 cup extra, cup Sugar, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Mukhadi Halwa recipe, remove 3 table spoons of semolina from one cup of semolina. and replace it with 3 tablespoons of all purpose flour.
2. Transfer this mix into a bowl and add milk.
3. Whisk them together and set aside while you begin to prep for caramelising the sugar.Heat a heavy bottomed pan, add ghee and once it begins to get hot (not smoking), reduce the heat to medium.
4. Add sugar and level it in ghee using a spatula.
5. After five minutes stir the sugar using a spatula (using spatula helps ensure that the caramel won’t stick to it). Keep stirring once in a while till the sugar starts caramelizing as it melts. (The colour of the caramel should not deepen or darken in colour as this will lead to a bitter tasting halwa)Give a quick stir to the flour-semolina batter and slowly add it to the caramelised sugar.Now, starts the tricky part.
6. Hold the wok or pan firmly using a cloth or holder (to avoid the heat) so that you can work your way with the batter.
7. Using ladle (a large heavy spoon/ kalchhul), carefully yet swiftly start mixing the batter into the caramel.
8. The batter will seem to turn lumpy but nothing to worry.Increase the flame to medium and using the back of the spoon keep smashing the batter, especially the whitish lumps, till the whole batter gets completed assimilated and incorporated with the caramel and the halwa wears a homogeneous look.This process will take approximately 3 to 4 minutes.
9. You will also notice that the halwa releases the oil as it begins to come together as evenly toned mixture.
10. At this point, remove excess oil in a small bowl and again roast the halwa for 3 to 4 minutes.
11. Switch off the heat and push the halwa towards the edge of one side of the wok to allow any excess ghee to drain in the centre.
12. Once the ghee leaves the halwa, drain it out in the bowl.
13. Halwa is now ready to be served!Serve Mukhadi Halwa as a dessert after your weekday meal of Dal Makhani, Aloo Ki Sabzi and Phulka.

title: Carrot Corn Mayo Pancake Recipe With Sandwich Spread
content:
Recipe Name: Carrot Corn Mayo Pancake Recipe With Sandwich Spread
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Carrot Corn Mayo Pancake Recipe With Sandwich Spread (World Breakfast).
Ingredients: Carrot (Gajjar) - peeled and grated, /4 cup Sweet corn - blanched, Cup Whole Wheat Flour, Onion, tablespoons Del Monte Sandwich Spread, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /3 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt) - whisked, Whole Egg, teaspoon Baking powder, /4 teaspoon Baking soda, Green Chillies - finely chopped, Butter - as required, Salt - To Taste, Black pepper powder - to taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Carrot Corn Mayo Pancake Recipe With Sandwich Spread, first prep all the ingredients and keep them ready to make the pancakes.
2. In a large mixing bowl, add eggs, yogurt and sandwich spread.
3. Combine very well until creamy.
4. Stir in the grated carrot, onions, chilies, corn and season with Salt and pepper.
5. Mix very well.In another bowl, add flour, baking soda and baking powder, mix well.Now add the dry flour mixture to the carrot mayo mixture.
6. Mix to form a thick pancake batter.
7. The pancake batter should be of thick creamy consistency.
8. Stir in the chopped coriander leaves and mix well.
9. Check the salt and seasonings and adjust to taste accordingly.
10. Heat flat griddle or pan over medium heat and grease it with a little butter.Pour a ladle full of pancake batter and cook for a couple of minutes.
11. Gently flip to cook on the other side for another 2 to 3 minutes.
12. Once you notice the pancake is lightly browned on both sides and cooked through, remove from the pan.Repeat the same for the rest of the pancake batter.
13. Once done, serve the pancakes warm.Serve the Carrot Corn Mayo Pancake as a wholesome breakfast on a sunday along with a Bullseye On Toast and bowl of fruits with a cup of Espresso Coffee.

title: Tamil Nadu Style Spicy Egg Fry Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Tamil Nadu Style Spicy Egg Fry Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Tamil Nadu recipe for Tamil Nadu Style Spicy Egg Fry Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Whole Egg, Sunflower Oil - for frying, tablespoons Roasted Gram Dal (Pottukadalai), Dry Red Chillie, Ginger, Cloves Garlic, Pepper, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Tamil Nadu Style Spicy Egg Fry Recipe, we will first boil the egg.
2. Heat a saucepan with required water and add eggs into it.
3. After 15 minutes, you will see that the outer skin of the egg will start to break.
4. Switch off the gas and let the eggs cool down.
5. Once done, remove the outer shell and cut the egg into half.
6. Keep it aside.Meanwhile, grind all the ingredients together that are mentioned in the list including roasted gram dal, dry red chillies, ginger, garlic, whole black peppercorns and salt by adding little water to form a smooth batter.Heat a saucepan on a medium heat, drizzle a tablespoon of oil, dip half cut boiled egg carefully into the ground batter and place it over the pan.Cook on either side till it crisps up and the batter it evenly cooked.
7. Flip it and cook the other side as well.Serve the Tamil Nadu Style Spicy Egg Fry Recipe on the side along with Prawn Biryani and Raita of your choice to enjoy your simple lunch.

title: Chirer Dudh Puli Recipe - Bengali Style Beaten Rice Dumpling Kheer
content:
Recipe Name: Chirer Dudh Puli Recipe - Bengali Style Beaten Rice Dumpling Kheer
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Chirer Dudh Puli Recipe - Bengali Style Beaten Rice Dumpling Kheer (Desserts).
Ingredients: cups Fresh coconut - grated, cup Palm jaggery - use date palm jaggery, cup Poha (Flattened rice), /2 cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), /4 cup Sooji (Semolina/ Rava), tablespoons Milk - warm, liter Milk, /4 cup Palm jaggery - use date palm jaggery
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chirer Dudh Puli recipe, firstly we will make the stuffing.
2. Take a large pan, 1 cup jaggery into this pan and heat it on medium flame.
3. Once the jaggery is melted, add grated coconut, stir this mixture continuous until the mixture comes together and sticks together.
4. Switch off the gas when the mixture leaves the sides of the pan.
5. Keep this mixture in a wide plate to become cool.The next step is to make the outer shell for the Puli.
6. Soak Chire or Poha or flat beaten rice into a bowl of water for 2 to 3 minutes, then wash the chire or poha properly and drain the water through a colander.Add chire or poha, maida and sooji in a bowl, make a soft dough by adding milk gradually.
7. Now make lemon sized balls from the dough.
8. Flatten each ball with your fingers then a make a bowl by pressing down the middle section in.Do not make it very thick or thin.
9. The shell would be medium thin.
10. Add small amount of jaggery coconut mixture into it.Bring together both the edges, then press and seal with your finger.
11. Make other pulis the same way.To make the kheer, add milk for Kheer in a big heavy bottomed pan on medium flame.
12. Once it starts to boil, switch the heat to low and cook for another 5 minutes.
13. Then remove the pan from the heat, add the required jaggery and mix, then place the pan back on the heat again and let it be cook on low flame.Adding jaggery into the milk in this way will prevent the milk to be curdled.
14. Add all the prepared pulis now one by one, cook for another 10 minutes or until pulis are soft and the milk has thickened.
15. Once done, take the Chirer Dudh Puli out in a bowl and serve hot or chilled.Serve Chirer Dudh Puli as a dessert after your meal of Dhokar Dalna, Bengali Style Sheem Poshto and Luchi for your everyday meal.

title: Appalam Vatha Kuzhambu Recipe - Papad In Tamarind Gravy
content:
Recipe Name: Appalam Vatha Kuzhambu Recipe - Papad In Tamarind Gravy
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Appalam Vatha Kuzhambu Recipe - Papad In Tamarind Gravy (Main Course).
Ingredients: tablespoon Gingelly oil, /4 teaspoon Mustard seeds, /4 Teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Asafoetida (hing) - a pinch, Dry Red Chillie, Onion, sprig Curry leaves, Urad dal papad - broken in to quarters, cup Tamarind Water, teaspoon Sambar Powder, tablespoon Jaggery, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Cups Water, Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Appalam Vatha Kuzhambu recipe, prepare all the ingredients and keep them ready.Heat oil in a preheated pan over medium heat.
2. Add mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves and dried red chilies.
3. Allow it to crackle.Add the onions and saute until the onions have softened and lightly golden.
4. Once the onions have softened, add the tamarind water, turmeric powder, sambar powder, jaggery and appalam.Add 3 cups of water, salt to taste and simmer the appalam vatha kuzhambu, until the kuzhambu has thickened and the appalam has soaked and cooked through as well.
5. The Appalam Vatha Kuzhambu will have a gravy like consistency with the starch from the appalam giving it this texture.
6. Adjust the consistency of the kuzhambu by adding water and also check the salt and spices and adjust to taste accordinglyServe the Appalam Vatha Kuzhambu along with hot Steamed Rice, Bean Paruppu Usili and Elai Vadam for simple and delicious weekend lunch.

title: Kashmiri Style Modur Pulao With Pomegranate Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Kashmiri Style Modur Pulao With Pomegranate Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Kashmiri recipe for Kashmiri Style Modur Pulao With Pomegranate Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Basmati rice - soaked for 1/2 hour, Cinnamon, Cloves (Laung), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, /4 cup Milk - (adjust), /2 cup Water, pinch Saffron strands, teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera) - roasted, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste, /2 cup Anardana Powder (Pomegranate Seed Powder) - cleaned, teaspoon Cashew nuts, teaspoon Badam (Almond), Raisin, Dates - pitted and sliced, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making Kashmiri Modur Pulao Recipe first Soak saffron in 2 teaspoons of warm milk for about 10 minutes and crush it well.Wash and soak Basmati rice for half an hour.Next in a Biryani pot or a pressure cooker, heat ghee, add cinnamon, cloves and cardamom and saute for a while till aromatic.Drain excess water from soaked Basmati rice, add rice to the pan and saute for about 3 minutes on medium flame.Add saffron milk mix to rice and add 1/2 cup milk and 1/2 cup water and salt to taste.
2. Cook covered until the rice is cooked well.
3. In the pressure cooker leave it for about 2 whistle.Once rice is cooked, switch off and fluff it up with a fork and set aside.Just before serving, in a pan, fry the dry fruits and nuts including cashew nuts, badam, dates and raisins in a little ghee till they are golden brown.
4. Keep a few fried cashews aside for garnishing.On a medium flame, add fried dry fruits and nuts to the fluffed up rice in the pot and mix well and switch off heat.
5. While it is still warm, add the pomegranate and stir.
6. Finally, add the roasted jeera powder and give it a good mix.Serve the Kashmiri Modur Pulao Recipe along with Paneer Masala and Boondi Raita to relish your mid day meals.

title: North Indian Style Mushroom Matar Masala Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: North Indian Style Mushroom Matar Masala Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for North Indian Style Mushroom Matar Masala Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Button mushrooms - chopped, cup Green peas (Matar) - boiled, Sunflower Oil - As Required, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Asafoetida (hing) - a pinch, Onion, Onion, Tomato - paste, Tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste, Green Chilli - chopped, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /4 teaspoon Garam masala powder, Water - As Required, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the North Indian Style Mushroom Matar, heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan.
2. Add cumin seeds, mustard seeds and asafoetida.
3. Let it splutter.Add the chopped onions and cook it for about a minute or two.
4. Next, add the ginger garlic paste and let it cook for 3 minutes.
5. After 3 minutes, add the onion paste and green chillies and let it cook for about 2 minutes.
6. After 2 minutes, add the tomato puree and all the masalas including red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder and garam masala powder.
7. Let it cook for about 5 to 7 minutes.Meanwhile heat a little oil in a pan and stir fry the mushroom for about 2 to 3 minutes and boil the green peas till they become soft.After this add the stir fried mushrooms and boiled green peas to the gravy and add a little water.
8. Let it cook for another 10 minutes.Once it is done, add the chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.Serve North Indian Style Mushroom Matar Masala along with Dal Makhani and Pudina Lahsun Lachha Paratha for a weekday lunch or dinner.

title: Dhania Chole Masala Recipe - Chickpeas In Fresh Coriander Gravy
content:
Recipe Name: Dhania Chole Masala Recipe - Chickpeas In Fresh Coriander Gravy
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Dhania Chole Masala Recipe - Chickpeas In Fresh Coriander Gravy (Main Course).
Ingredients: Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Green Chillie, Inch Ginger, Salt - To Taste, Lemon - juice extracted, cups Kabuli Chana (White Chickpeas) - soaked overnight, Tablespoon Ghee, Onion, Ginger, Clove, Cinnamon, Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), Brown cardamom (Badi Elaichi), Salt, /4 teaspoon Garam masala powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Salt, Salt - To Taste, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making Dhania Chole Masala, wash and soak the chana or chickpeas overnight.
2. Drain the water in which the chickpeas/chole is soaked in.
3. Pressure cook the drained chana along with 3 cups of water and salt for 6 whistles.
4. After 6 whistles reduce the heat to low and continue to cook for 20 minutes.
5. Turn off the flame and allow the pressure to release naturally.
6. The chana has be cooked well once you open the pressure cooker.
7. Once done, when you press between your fingers to should mash easily.The next step is to make the Dhania Masala.Into a mixer grinder, add the coriander, ginger and green chillies, along with a little salt and lemon juice.
8. Add 1/4 cup water and blend to make a smooth mixture like a chutney.
9. Keep the Dhania Masala aside.Heat ghee in a pan over medium heat; add the onion, ginger and garlic and saute until the onion softens.
10. Add the bay leaves, cinnamon stick, badi elaichi and saute for a few more seconds until you can smell the aromas.After a few seconds, add the garam masala, coriander powder, kala namak and the dhania masala.
11. Give it a stir.Add the cooked chana, give it a stir.
12. Add water if required to adjust the consistency of the chana masala.
13. Cover the pan and simmer the Dhania Chole Masala for a good 10 minutes.After 10 minutes, you will notice that the chole is well coated with the dhania masala.
14. At this stage, check the taste and adjust the salt and chilli accordingly.Once done, turn off the heat and transfer the Dhania Chole Masala to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve the Dhania Chole Masala, along with Puri, Paneer in White Gravy, Lacha Pyaz and Chaas for a delicious weekend lunch.

title: Cheese Stuffed Aloo Bonda Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Cheese Stuffed Aloo Bonda Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Cheese Stuffed Aloo Bonda Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Potatoes (Aloo) - boiled and mashed, grams Mozzarella cheese - cut into 1/2 inch pieces, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Inch Ginger - Grated, Onion, Green Chillies - chopped, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Sunflower Oil - as needed, cup Gram flour (besan), Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Cheese Stuffed Aloo Bonda Recipe, heat oil in a frying pan, add mustard seeds and allow it to crackle.Once the seeds have crackled add the onions and sauté for a couple of minutes till onions are soft and light golden in colour.Once done add ginger, green chillies, asafoetida, turmeric and salt.
2. Saute for a minute and add the mashed potatoes.
3. Stir in the coriander leaves and combine.Turn off the heat and allow the potato mixture to cool down.Once the potato mixture has cooled down divide it into 8 portions.
4. While shaping, flatten the potatoes in the palm of your hand , place a piece of the Mozzarella cheese in the center and cover it to make a ball.
5. Shape the bonda into round balls and keep aside.Combine gram flour, turmeric powder, salt to taste in a bowl.
6. Add a little water at a time to make a thick batter which coats the back of a spoon.
7. Make sure to whisk the batter well until light and fluffy.
8. Keep aside.Preheat a kuzhi paniyaram pan.
9. Add a few drops of oil into each cavity.Dip and coat each of the potato cheese balls in the gram flour batter and gradually place it into the cavity.
10. Cover the pan and allow the bonda to steam.
11. Once you notice the batter is cooked, uncover the pan and cook all sides by flipping and turning.Once the Cheese Stuffed Aloo Bonda turns golden brown in color on all sides, transfer the Cheese Stuffed Aloo Bonda onto a plate with an oil absorbent paper and serve hot.Serve the Cheese Stuffed Aloo Bonda along with a spicy Coconut Chutney or Green Chutney  along with a cup of steaming Filter Coffee .

title: Dahi Wale Paneer Recipe - Paneer In A Curd Gravy
content:
Recipe Name: Dahi Wale Paneer Recipe - Paneer In A Curd Gravy
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Dahi Wale Paneer Recipe - Paneer In A Curd Gravy (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese), Clove, Ginger, Fresh Red chillies - chopped, teaspoon Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) - chopped, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), tablespoon Garam masala powder, gram Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), tablespoon Butter, Onion, tablespoons Homemade tomato puree, Pecan, grams Fresh cream, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Tablespoon Lemon Juice, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Tablespoon Lemon Juice, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Dahi Wale Paneer Recipe, add ginger, garlic and fresh red chillies in a mortar and pestle and grind it to paste.In a bowl, add capsicum, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and mix everything well.Divide this mixture into half and keep in an another bowl.
2. In one of them, add curd, salt, paneer and mix everything well.
3. Keep it aside to marinate for about 1 hour.To make the gravy for the Paneer Curry, heat butter in a heavy bottomed pan on low heat.
4. Add onions and saute till it turns soft.Once the onions turn soft, add the ginger garlic chilli paste and cook it for about 2 minutes.
5. After 2 minutes, add the capsicum mixture and let it cook till the capsicum turns a little soft.Once done, add the tomato puree, turmeric powder, cashew or almond paste, salt, required water and give it a mix.
6. Let it cook for about 3 to 4 minutes.After 3 to 4 minutes, turn the flame to low and add the whisked curd.
7. Cook it for another 5 minutes.Meanwhile, shallow fry or grill the paneer pieces on a non stick pan, using oil as required.
8. Cook from both the sides till it turns golden brown.Add the fresh cream and mix it again.
9. Add the paneer cubes and mix everything properly.Cook for about 2 minutes, add the lemon juice and garnish it with coriander leaves.Serve Dahi Wale Paneer Recipe along with Palak Dal, Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita, Jeera Rice, Phulka and Kachumber Salad for a weekend meal.

title: Nutty Aloo Paratha Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Nutty Aloo Paratha Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Nutty Aloo Paratha Recipe (North Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, cup Spinach Leaves (Palak) - pureed, Water - as required to make pliable dough, Potatoes (Aloo) - boiled and mashed, /2 cup Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - crumbled/grated, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder, Salt - To Taste, /2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera), teaspoon Red Chilli powder - or 2 chopped green chillies, /2 tablespoon Mixed nuts - chopped, Raisin, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making Nutty Aloo Paratha Recipe,first knead the dough and keep it aside.In a Mixing bowl, bring together wheat flour, water, and spinach puree (if using) to a soft pliable dough by kneading well.
2. Few drops of ghee or oil can be added if required.To make the fillingIn a large mixing bowl add the  mashed potatoes or aloo, and all the other ingredients, crumbled paneer, coriander, garam masala, salt, jeera powder, red chilli powder/green chillies, chopped nuts, and raisins and mix them till they are well combined.Divide the nutty aloo filling into 8 to 10 equal portions.
3. This process of dividing and keeping the portions of aloo paratha dough and filling ready, helps you gauge the number of parathas you can make and if you need more or less of the filling.The final step is to stuff the filling into the dough to make Nutty Aloo Paratha.Roll the dough into a small circle, place the filling inside and close the dough from all sides.Dust the filled aloo paratha dough in some flour and roll this stuffed nutty dough into a paratha, taking care not to let the stuffing ooze out.preheat a roti tawa and  place the filled  nutty aloo paratha.
4. Allow it to cook on medium heat for about 30 to 45 seconds and flip over.Add this stage add a teaspoon of ghee or oil and spread it around.
5. Flip again, so the oiled side can cook on the skillet.
6. Spread a little more ghee and keep pressing the parathas while on the skillet to cook the paratha evenly from inside out.Do the flipping over process a couple of times until both sides get cooked, browned and crisp evenly.
7. Make sure you cook on medium heat as it allows the nutty aloo parathas to get a crisp on the outside and yet soft texture.Once the aloo paratha is cooked transfer to a plate.
8. Continue to the same process with the remaining parathas the same way.Serve Nutty Aloo Paratha Recipe with Rawal Pindi Style Chole and some Kachumber Salad Recipe With Cucumber, Onion & Tomatoes for weekend brunch.
9. Add Quick Strawberry Yogurt Smoothie to complete the meal.

title: Chicken Tikka Taco Recipe Topped With Cheesy Garlic Mayo
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Tikka Taco Recipe Topped With Cheesy Garlic Mayo
Description: A flavorful and authentic Mexican recipe for Chicken Tikka Taco Recipe Topped With Cheesy Garlic Mayo (Main Course).
Ingredients: Hard taco shells, cup Hariyali Chicken Tikka, /2 cup Summer Salad, Refried beans, tablespoons Nutralite Cheesy Garlic Mayo, /4 cup Tomato Salsa
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chicken Tikka Taco Recipe, keep the elements ready to assemble the tacos.
2. Summer salad - Red Cabbage Salad RecipeHomemade refried beans - Homemade Refried Beans RecipeHomemade spicy Mexican salsa - Spicy Mexican Salsa Recipe - Tomato Salsa RecipeHariyali Chicken Tikka - Hariyali Chicken Tikka RecipeTo assemble the Chicken Tikka Taco, hold the tacos in your palms, making sure it's easy to add the fillings.
3. First in put one tablespoon of homemade refried beans right at the bottom and spread evenly.
4. Next add a generous layer of fresh summer salad, over this salad place the Hariyali chicken tikka, then spoon some homemade Mexican salsa and drizzle the Nutralite Cheesy Garlic Mayo.Once done, serve the Taco immediately for a wholesome and delicious dinner.Serve Chicken Tikka Taco Recipe along with Vegetable Clear Soup With Lemon Grass and Rich Dark Chocolate Mousse Recipe as dessert.

title: Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Cinnamon, cup Button mushrooms - cut into quarters, cup Soy Chunks (Nuggets) - soaked in hot water, Onion, Inch Ginger, /2 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), tablespoons Biryani Masala, Cloves Garlic, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Garam masala powder, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /4 cup Mint Leaves (Pudina) - finely chopped, Salt - To Taste, Tablespoons Ghee, Green Chillies - chopped, teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), Star Anise, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Cloves (Laung), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani recipe, wash and soak the rice in water for 20 minutes.
2. In a bowl, place the soya chunks, and pour boiling hot water over it and allow it to soak in it.
3. In a pressure cooker, heat ghee on low flame, add the whole spices - cumin seeds, bay leaf, star anise, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon stick, once these begin to sizzle, add in the ginger, garlic, green chili, saute for a coulee of minutes.
4. Next increase the heat to medium -low and add the sliced onions and cook until transparent, this will take about 2-3 minutes.
5. At this stage, add the mushrooms, and the dry masalas - biryani masala, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala, salt and give it a good mix.
6. Now add the curd, drained soya chunks, pudina leaves, drained rice and 2 cups of water and close the pressure cooker.
7. Allow the Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani recipe to pressure cook for 2 whistles and turn off the flame.
8. Allow the pressure to release naturally.
9. Once released, open the pressure cooker and gently sluff up the Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani recipe and transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve hot Pudina Mushroom And Soya Biryani along with Boondi raita and Kachumber Salad for a weeknight dinner.

title: White Vegetable Kurma Recipe With Coconut & Cashew
content:
Recipe Name: White Vegetable Kurma Recipe With Coconut & Cashew
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for White Vegetable Kurma Recipe With Coconut & Cashew (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Carrot (Gajjar) - chopped, Potatoes (Aloo) - chopped, cups Cauliflower (gobi) - cut to small florets, Onion, Tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, /2 Cup Fresh Coconut - Grated, Pepper, Green Chillie, Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf), teaspoon Poppy seeds, Cashew nuts, Cinnamon, Star Anise, Cloves (Laung), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
Instructions:
1. To begin making White Vegetable Kurma Recipe With Coconut & Cashew, wash the vegetables - carrot, potato, cauliflower,  chop into small pieces.
2. Keep aside.
3. Keep the potato immersed in water until use.In a mixer jar, combine the grated coconut, peppercorns, green chilli, fennel seeds, poppy seeds, cashews.Add little water and grind into smooth paste.
4. Keep aside.Heat a kadai with oil and add the spices - cinnamon, star anise, cloves, cardamom and cumin seeds.
5. Allow them to sizzle.
6. Add ginger-garlic paste and saute until raw smell goes.
7. Now add chopped onion and saute until translucent without turning brown.
8. Add the chopped vegetables and saute for a minute.
9. Pour the required water for cooking vegetables along with required salt.Mix and cook covered in medium flame until the veggies are cooked through.
10. Then add the ground coconut paste along with required quantity of water for the gravy.
11. Check for salt.
12. Cook on low flame for few minutes until it is combined well and starts boiling.Remove from flame.
13. The delicious white veg kurma is ready.
14. Serve White Vegetable Kurma Recipe With Coconut & Cashew along with Muttai Parotta Recipe ( Ande Ka Paratha / Egg Filled Flat Bread) and Kerala Style Egg Roast Curry Recipe

title: Muttaikose Poriyal Recipe - Cabbage Stir Fry With Coconut
content:
Recipe Name: Muttaikose Poriyal Recipe - Cabbage Stir Fry With Coconut
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Muttaikose Poriyal Recipe - Cabbage Stir Fry With Coconut (Side Dish).
Ingredients: grams Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) - roughly chopped or sliced thin, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /2 teaspoons White Urad Dal (Split), sprig Curry leaves - finely chopped, Green Chilli - slit, /4 cup Fresh coconut - grated, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Muttaikose Poriyal Recipe/ Cabbage Poriyal, get the cabbage chopped or sliced and prep the rest of the ingredients and keep them ready.Heat a teaspoon of oil a heavy-bottomed pan on medium heat.
2. Add the mustard seeds and urad dal.
3. Allow them to crackle.
4. Roast the urad dal until it gets lightly browned.Once the dal is browned, add the curry leaves, green chillies, cabbage and salt to taste.Give the mixture a stir.
5. Sprinkle some water and cover the pan.
6. Simmer for about 5 minutes until the cabbage is steamed and ready to eat.
7. The cabbage should still be a bit firm and not too soft to get a nice texture when you eat it.Once done, add the grated coconut, give the cabbage poriyal a mix and check the salt.
8. Add more coconut if required.
9. Turn off the heat and serve the Muttaikose Poriyal / Cabbage Poriyal warm.Serve the Muttaikose Poriyal Recipe/ Cabbage Poriyal along with Tomato Rasam and steamed rice topped with ghee for lunch or dinner.

title: Bengaluru Style Brinjal Gravy Recipe - For Biryani
content:
Recipe Name: Bengaluru Style Brinjal Gravy Recipe - For Biryani
Description: A flavorful and authentic Karnataka recipe for Bengaluru Style Brinjal Gravy Recipe - For Biryani (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Brinjal (Baingan / Eggplant) - cut into big pieces, Tomatoe, Onion, Tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste, grams Tamarind - soaked in hot water, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Pepper, /2 tablespoon Jaggery - powdered, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, Salt, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Brinjal Gravy For Biryani, first soak a lemon sized or 20 grams tamarind in hot water for 20 minutes.After 20 minutes extract the pulp of tamarind and keep aside.
2. You will need 1/4 cup of tamarind pulp for this recipe.
3. Add roughly chopped onions in a mixer and make an onion paste.
4. Remove and keep it aside.
5. In the same mixer, add the tomatoes and puree them.
6. Keep aside.In a heavy bottomed pan, add 1 teaspoon of cooking oil.
7. Let it warm up.Once the oil is hot, add the chopped brinjal till the skin becomes slightly brown.
8. Once they are browned, remove from the pan and keep it aside. (Browning indicates that it has cooked halfway)In the same pan, add one more teaspoon of oil and add mustard seeds and peppercorns and wait for them to splutter.
9. Keep it on a low flame as the peppercorns might sputter everywhere the moment it touches heat.
10. Next, add in the ground onion paste, ginger garlic paste and saute for a few minutes until the raw smell of onion, ginger and garlic go away.
11. Next, add the tomato puree, tamarind extract and salt according to your taste.
12. Cover the pan and cook on a low flame for about 15 minutes.
13. Open the pan occasionally and stir so that the gravy does not stick to the bottom of the pan.
14. After 15 minutes, add the powdered jaggery in to the tamarind gravy and give it a good mix.
15. Finally add the half cooked brinjals, 1/2 cup of water and cook till the brinjals are soft.
16. Turn off the flame and garnish with coriander leaves.Serve Brinjal Gravy For Biryani with Hyderabadi Vegetable Biryani Recipe or Ambur Style Chicken BIryani along with a Tadka Raita for a delicious Sunday Lunch.

title: Pf Chang'S Style Crispy Chicken Lettuce Wraps Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Pf Chang'S Style Crispy Chicken Lettuce Wraps Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Asian recipe for Pf Chang'S Style Crispy Chicken Lettuce Wraps Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Iceberg lettuce, Chicken breasts - cut into 1 cm cubes, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste, teaspoon Black pepper powder, teaspoons Garlic - finely chopped, /4 cup Button mushrooms - finely chopped, Onion, teaspoon Chilli vinegar, teaspoon Soy sauce, teaspoon Red Chilli sauce, teaspoon Sweet and Spicy Red Chilli Sauce (Tomato Chilli Sauce)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the PF Chang's Style Crispy Chicken Lettuce Wraps, separate the layers of the lettuce and form sets of cups by stacking two-three leaves together.
2. Keep aside.
3. Next to make the Crispy chicken, in a skillet heat a teaspoon of oil on medium flame, add the chopped chicken and saute until it turns into a light brown colour.
4. Add some salt and pepper and continue to cook.
5. This will take about 4-6 minutes.
6. Once the chicken is cooked, transfer to a bowl and set aside.
7. In the same pan add another teaspoon of oil on medium flame, to this add garlic and saute for 30 seconds.
8. Now add the chopped spring onion bulbs, mushrooms and continue to saute until the mushroom softens.At this stage add salt, pepper, vinegar, soy sauce and the red chilli sauces.
9. Add the cooked chicken to this and stir on high heat until the chicken is well coated with the sauces and is slightly sticky.
10. Check the salt and spices and adjust to taste.Turn off the heat.
11. The final step is the assemble and serve the PF Chang's Style Crispy Chicken Lettuce Wraps.In a serving platter, arrange the lettuce cups, place a tablespoon of the sweet and spicy crispy chicken and serve along with the Soy Dipping Sauce.
12. Serve PF Chang's Style Crispy Chicken Lettuce Wraps along with Sweet & Spicy Soy Dipping sauce followed by a meal of Thai Chicken Noodle Soup With Veggies Recipe and Layered Thai Basil & Tofu Rice Recipe.
13. Finish the meal with a dessert of Gluten Free Banana Coconut Milk Ice Cream

title: Lemon Frozen Yogurt Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Lemon Frozen Yogurt Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Lemon Frozen Yogurt Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Lemon Juice, grams Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), /4 cup Sugar - powdered, tablespoons Fresh cream, /8 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi), Vanilla Extract - few drops, teaspoon Orange Zest (Rind), Orange - two wedges
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Lemon Frozen Yogurt recipe, take a medium bowl and beat yogurt and turmeric powder for about 4 minutes.
2. Into the bowl of yogurt, add cream, powdered sugar, 2-3 drops of vanilla essence and squeeze out the lemon juice.
3. Pour the yogurt mixture in a freezing bowl and freeze it for 2 hours.
4. Take the frozen yogurt bowl out of the freezer and stir well, return to the freezer and keep overnight.Take out of freezer 30-40 minutes before serving.
5. Serve in fancy bowl with few big scoops of Lemon Frozen Yogurt with orange zest on top and a slice of orange for garnishing.Serve Lemon Frozen Yogurt on its own as a snack or serve it with your meal.

title: Paneer Capsicum Sandwich Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Paneer Capsicum Sandwich Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Paneer Capsicum Sandwich Recipe (World Breakfast).
Ingredients: Whole Wheat Brown Bread, grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - grated, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - finely chopped, Green Chilli - finely chopped, teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, tablespoons Butter, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Paneer Capsicum Sandwich Recipe, grate the paneer using a handy grater and place it in a big bowl.To this add the finely chopped capsicum, green chilli, chaat masala, pepper powder, salt and mix well.Now place a small portion of this mixture on a bread slice, spread it evenly and place another bread slice over it and press it gently to seal it.Similarly prepare the rest of the bread slices with the fillings.To make the sandwiches, heat a skillet on medium heat, apply a little butter and place two sets of the sandwich prepared over it and toast it until it turns light brown.
2. This will take around 2 minutes.Apply a little butter on the top layer of the bread, flip over and cook the other side for 2 more minutes to turn it brown and crisp.Similarly, toast the other two sets of the sandwiches.Serve the Paneer Capsicum Sandwich Recipe along with Papaya Banana Shake for a quick breakfast or along with Masala Tea for an evening snacks.

title: Sukhi Suran Masala Sabzi Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Sukhi Suran Masala Sabzi Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Sukhi Suran Masala Sabzi Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: grams Elephant yam (Suran/Senai/Ratalu) - sliced into 1 inch square pieces, Onion, Green Chillies - Slit, Ginger, teaspoon Garlic - finely chopped, sprig Curry leaves, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera), /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making Sukhi Suran Masala Sabzi Recipe first prepare the yam, remove the hard outer skin and then slice yam/ suran into one inch square pieces.
2. Soak the sliced yam pieces in water and keep aside.Next heat oil in a non stick wok/Kadai or a deep pan and add curry leaves and cumin seeds, saute for a minute.Add the sliced onions, ginger and garlic and saute till the onions are translucent and softened.Now add the drained suran and saute for a minute.
3. Sprinkle some water, salt to taste and cover the pan and cook the suran and onion masala on low heat for ten minutes.
4. Once the suran is cooked then add all the dry spices like red chilli powder, coriander powder, jeera powder, black pepper powder, garam masala and stir the masalas in the suran.Stir fry for 3 to 4 more minutes until the masala gets well coated to form a delicious tasting Sukhi Suran Masala Sabzi.
5. Check the taste and adjust the salt and spices accordingly.Once done, turn off the heat and the Sukhi Suran Masala Sabzi to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve Sukhi Suran Masala Sabzi with Dal Palak, Steamed Rice and Curd for a healthy weeknight dinner.

title: Lauki Ka Salan Recipe - Bottle Gourd Salan Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Lauki Ka Salan Recipe - Bottle Gourd Salan Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Andhra recipe for Lauki Ka Salan Recipe - Bottle Gourd Salan Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Bottle gourd (lauki) - Cut into 1/2 inch discs, Onion, Clove, Ginger, Green Chillies - Slit, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /4 Teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Tablespoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), cup Tamarind Water, Tomatoe, Sunflower Oil - to cook, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), tablespoons Roasted Peanuts (Moongphali), tablespoons Sesame seeds (Til seeds), tablespoons Fresh coconut - grated
Instructions:
1. To begin making Lauki Ka Salan Recipe prep all the ingredients and keep them ready.Into a mixer grinder blend the peanuts, sesame seeds and grated coconut along with a little water to make a smooth paste and keep aside.Make a puree of the tomato and keep aside.Next take a kadai or a deep pan and heat oil.
2. Add mustard seeds, methi seeds, curry leaves and allow it to crackle.Once the mustard seeds crackle,  add the slit green chilies, chopped onions, ginger and garlic and saute the onions till they turn translucent and soft.Stir in the tomato puree, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and give it a brisk boil.
3. Add the bottle gourd, slices, tamarind water and 1/4 cup of addition water.Cover the pan and simmer until the bottle gourd/ lauki has cooked through.
4. Once done, stir in the peanut sesame paste and simmer the Lauki Ka Salan for 3 to 4 minutes until the salan gets a good gravy like consistency.Check the salt and spices and adjust according to taste.
5. Turn off the heat and transfer the Lauki Ka Salan into a serving bowl and serve hot.
6. Serve Lauki Ka Salan Along with Hyderabadi Vegetable Biryani and Dangar Pachadi With Grated Carrots for a weekend lunch.
7. You can also serve it with Tawa Paratha Recipe - Plain Paratha or Whole Wheat Lachha Paratha.

title: Togari Bele Tovve Recipe  - Toor Dal Rasam
content:
Recipe Name: Togari Bele Tovve Recipe  - Toor Dal Rasam
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Togari Bele Tovve Recipe - Toor Dal Rasam (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Arhar dal (Split Toor Dal), Cups Water, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Ginger, Green Chillies - slit (adjust), grams Tamarind, Lemon Juice, Tablespoon Ghee, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Curry leaves - Handful, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Togari Bele Tovve recipe, soak dal in water for about 30 minutes.Wash the dals thoroughly with water.
2. In a pressure cooker, add soaked dal, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder, 2 cups of water and pressure cook for 3 whistles.
3. Turn off the flame and allow the pressure to release naturally.
4. Soak Tamarind in a bowl of hot water and extract tamarind Juice.
5. We need 1-1/2 cup of tamarind juice for tovve.Once the dal is cooked, gently mash the dal with the back of the ladle.In a wok/kadai, add ghee and gently heat over medium flame.Once the ghee melts, add mustard seeds followed by curry leaves, ginger, and green chilies.Cook until the aroma of ginger fades out and chilies are lightly fried.Add tamarind water to the pan and bring it to boil.
6. Add the remaining turmeric powderLet it boil.
7. Once the raw smell of tamarind goes off, add cooked dal and required amount of salt.Cook until froth forms on top of the tovve.
8. Ensure not to boil it again.Season with hing and give a stir.
9. Switch off the flame.
10. Add lemon juice and combine it well.Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with steam rice or idlisTovve can be prepared with Moong dal by following the same procedure.
11. One can adjust the amount of Tamarind or completely avoid the same according to their desires.
12. In such cases, add the juice of a lemon.Serve this humble Togari Bele Tovve with hot steaming rice and Beetroot Thoran or with Spongy Idlis and Mysore Chutney to please your tummy as well as your taste buds.

title: Chicken Shawarma Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Shawarma Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Middle Eastern recipe for Chicken Shawarma Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Chicken breasts - cut into thin strips, Tablespoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), tablespoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), teaspoon Black pepper powder, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste, Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt - To Taste, Cup Whole Wheat Flour, tablespoon Active dry yeast, /2 cup Milk, tablespoon Sugar, Salt - To Taste, Cucumber - cut into julienne, Carrot (Gajjar) - cut into julienne, Tomato - pulp removed and julienned, /4 cup Chilli vinegar, Salt, Teaspoon Sugar, cup Homemade Hummus, cup Tzatziki, Onion
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chicken Shawarma Recipe we will first make the Pita bread.To make the Pita BreadFor the pita bread dough, in a bowl mix together yeast & sugar.Heat the milk until lukewarm and mix it with yeast and sugar.
2. Allow this to sit for a while till you notice bubbles rising.
3. This is when the yeast starts to activate.
4. Now add flour, salt and water slowly and combine to form a soft dough.
5. Keep kneading for at least 10 minutes on to a working surface and place it inside a big bowl.
6. Cover it with a damp cloth and rest the dough in a warm place, allowing it to rise and doubles its size.Marinade for the chickenIn a mixing bowl, add cumin powder, coriander powder, red chilli powder, black pepper powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and olive oil.
7. Combine everything well.Add in the chicken pieces and mix them well till it is nicely coated.
8. Marinate the chicken pieces for at least 30 minutes.Meanwhile pickle the cucumber, tomatoes and carrots.
9. In a separate bowl, add chilli vinegar, salt and sugar and the vegetables.
10. Keep it aside.Make the Tzatziki Recipe - A Greek Yogurt Dip and Classic Homemade Hummus Recipe With Lemon And Coriander and keep aside.
11. Check on the bread dough, knock out the all the air by kneading it once again.
12. Make small sized dough balls.Dust some flour on to your surface and with the help of the rolling pin start rolling one of the ball to a circle shaped flat bread.
13. The bread should not be rolled too thin and it has to big enough to stuff the chicken and roll it up to form a roll.Heat a flat skillet, on medium flame and cook the rolled out bread on both sides until you see small brown spots.
14. Do the same for the rest of the dough and keep the bread aside as you move ahead to cook the chicken.Heat a pan with oil, add chicken pieces and keep turning them over as they are getting cooked and charred on all the side.
15. This will take about 20 minutes to cook.Assembling the Chicken ShawarmaTake one square of parchment paper and place one cooked pita bread, and spoon in 2 tablespoons of hummus evenly, and a tablespoon of the tzatziki dip as well.
16. Place one cucumber, carrot and tomatoes julienne in the middle.
17. Then place some cooked chicken pieces, add chopped onion and roll it tightly along with the parchment paper and pack both ends of the paper into the roll if you want it as a take away.Serve the Chicken Shawarma Recipe along with Summer Lettuce Salad Recipe to make it a complete meal for your Sunday lunch.

title: Mushroom Paratha Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Mushroom Paratha Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Mushroom Paratha Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste, Tablespoon Ghee, grams Button mushrooms - chopped, Onion, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), teaspoon Garam masala powder, Green Chillies - finely chopped, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Mushroom Paratha Recipe, take all the ingredients meant for dough into a large mixing bowl.
2. Add a little water at a time to make a soft and smooth dough.
3. Cover the dough 30 minutes until we get the filling ready.
4. Next we will proceed to make the mushroom stuffing for the paratha recipe.Heat oil in a wok or a kadai on medium heat.
5. Add the cumin seeds and allow it to crackle.
6. Once the cumin seeds crackle, add onion and saute until the onions turns pinkish in colour.Add the chopped green chilies, chopped chopped mushrooms and salt to taste.
