7. Stir fry on high heat until most of the moisture from the mushrooms is evaporated.
8. Once the mushrooms have shrunk in size and the moisture has evaporated, add the garam masala and turmeric powder and give it a stir for a few minutes and turn off the heat.Allow the mushroom paratha stuffing mixture to cool completely.Divide the dough into 5 equal portions.
9. We will now proceed to make the stuffed mushroom paratha.
10. To begin making the paratha, keep a plate of dry flour for dusting.We dust the dough in flour, flatten it with your finger and place it on a flat surface.
11. Roll them out thin to approximately 3 inches in diameter circle.Take a portion of the mushroom filling and place it in the center.
12. Next Gather the sides of the dough and bring them together.
13. Remove the little excess dough which popped out when you brought them together.
14. Press the filled dough down.Dust the filled dough in some flour and roll it gently applying just a pressure.
15. Roll it to desired thickness and proceed the similar way with the remaining portions of dough and filling.Preheat a Skillet/Tava on medium heat and place the filled Mushroom Paratha.
16. Allow it to cook on medium heat for about 30 to 45 seconds and flip over.Add this stage add a teaspoon of ghee or oil and spread it around.
17. Flip again, so the oiled side can cook on the skillet.
18. Spread a little more ghee and keep pressing the parathas while on the skillet to cook the paratha evenly from inside out.Do the flipping over process a couple of times until both sides get cooked, browned and crisp evenly.
19. Make sure you cook on medium heat as it allows the parathas to get a crisp on the outside and yet soft texture.Once the paratha is cooked transfer to a plate.
20. Continue to the same process with the remaining Mushroom Parathas the same way.Serve the Mushroom Parathas along with a spicy mango pickle for breakfast or a sunday brunch.

title: Palak Chana Dal Recipe - Healthy Spinach Gram Dal Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Palak Chana Dal Recipe - Healthy Spinach Gram Dal Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Palak Chana Dal Recipe - Healthy Spinach Gram Dal Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) - soaked in water for about 20 minutes, grams Spinach Leaves (Palak) - washed and chopped, Cups Water, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, Tablespoons Ghee, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Dry Red Chillie, Tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste, Onion, Green Chillies - chopped, Tomato - chopped, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera), Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Palak Chana Dal recipe, pressure cook the soaked chana dal with 3 cups of water, salt and turmeric powder for 5 to 6 whistles and turn off the heat.
2. Allow the pressure to release naturally.Add the palak (spinach leaves) along with 2 tablespoons of water, salt into a pressure cooker and cook for 1 whistle.
3. Turn off the heat and release the pressure immediately to retain the green color of the spinach.Heat ghee in a heavy bottomed pan and add cumin seeds.
4. Once cumin seeds start to crackle, add asafoetida.After 30 seconds, add dry red chillies and saute for few seconds.Next add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few seconds.Now, add chopped onions and green chillies, saute it until onion turns to golden brown in colour.Add chopped tomato and cook them until they become soft.Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder and salt to taste but remember we have already added salt while boiling dal and spinach.Mix all dry spices with tomato onion mixture and cook it on medium heat for 1-2 minutes until mixture starts releasing ghee.This will take about 3 to 4 minutes.After 3 to 4 minutes, add the cooked chana dal and palak (spinach leaves), mix everything well.Cook the Palak Chana Dal for next 4 to 5 minutes on low heat and turn off the heat.
5. Check the salt and spices and adjust according to taste.
6. Transfer the Palak Chana Dal to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve Palak Chana Dal along with Bharli Bhendi, Boondi Raita and Phulka for an everyday meal.
7. You can also pack this dal for your Lunch Box.

title: Pasi Paruppu Kosumalli Recipe (Spiced Lentil Salad Recipe)
content:
Recipe Name: Pasi Paruppu Kosumalli Recipe (Spiced Lentil Salad Recipe)
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Pasi Paruppu Kosumalli Recipe (Spiced Lentil Salad Recipe) (Main Course).
Ingredients: /2 cup Yellow Moong Dal (Split), Cucumber - finely chopped, Carrot (Gajjar) - grated, /4 cup Fresh coconut - grated, Tablespoon Lemon Juice, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Green Chillies - Slit, /2 teaspoon Asafoetida (hing), sprig Curry leaves - roughly torn, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. We begin making Pasi Parupu Kosumalli Recipe (Spiced Lentil Salad Recipe) by washing and soaking the dal for half an hour.
2. Drain the water.Keep all the vegetables prepped and set it aside.Heat the skillet with oil and temper it with mustard seeds, asafoetida, green chillies, and curry leaves.
3. Add it to the mixed vegetables.Drain the dal and add it to the mixture with salt to taste and mix it thoroughly till the dal is evenly coated.Serve your fresh Pasi Paruppu Kosumalli Recipe (Spiced Lentil Salad Recipe) during lunch or relish it as a quick snack.

title: Ragi Masala Roti Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Ragi Masala Roti Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Ragi Masala Roti Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Ragi Flour (Finger Millet/ Nagli), Onion, Green Chillies - finely chopped, Carrot (Gajjar) - grated, /2 cup Dill leaves - finely chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Salt - To Taste, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making Ragi Masala Roti Recipe prep all the ingredients required.In a large mixing bowl add all the ingredients, ragi flour, onions, chopped green chillies, dill leaves, coriander leaves, grated carrots and salt,and then mix everything together.Add water little at a time to form a soft Ragi Masala Roti dough.Keep kneading for five minutes till the texture of the dough changes and becomes softer.
2. Bring it all together and cover the Ragi Masala Roti dough and keep aside for 15 minutes.Divide the dough into equal portions.Take a Ragi Masala Roti dough ball and place it on the center of a wet muslin cloth.Using wet flatten the ball with your palms.
3. Continue pressing the dough until the Ragi Masala Roti has attained a round shape.
4. Place the Ragi Masala Roti by inverting the cloth on a heated iron skillet and cook on one side and turn over gently with a flat spatula to the other side.Drizzle ghee and cook the Ragi Masala Roti on both sides until it is lightly browned with golden spots and crisp.Serve Ragi Masala Roti Recipe with Hurali Saaru, Keerai Masiyal and Methi Raita Flavoured With Garlic for a diabetic friendly meal.

title: Dry Sweet Potato Thoran Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Dry Sweet Potato Thoran Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Kerala Recipes recipe for Dry Sweet Potato Thoran Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Sweet Potatoes - medium size, Onion, /2 teaspoon Rasam Powder, Turmeric powder (Haldi) - a pinch, Asafoetida (hing) - a pinch, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, teaspoon White Urad Dal (Split), sprig Curry leaves
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Dry Sweet Potato Thoran Recipe, wash and trim the edges of sweet potatoes.
2. Pressure cook in enough water for 1 whistle over medium flame.
3. After the pressure is released, peel the skin and cut into roundels and keep it aside.Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan, add mustard seeds and urad dal.
4. When the mustard seeds splutter, add curry leaves.
5. Later add chopped onion and saute till soft and translucent.Add the sliced sweet potato to the pan and toss them gently.
6. Add turmeric powder, salt and rasam powder.
7. Mix everything so that sweet potato slices are well coated.Keep the flame on low, close with a lid and let it cook over low flame.
8. Mix in between.
9. The mixture should cook from the steam released by it.When the sweet potato is cooked, sprinkle gram flour and toss gently such that it gets coated well.
10. Add 1-2 teaspoon of oil and let the raw banana pieces get nicely fried on low flame .Let it cook for 5-7 minutes for all the flavors to absorb.
11. Take off stove and serve hot.Serve Dry Sweet Potato Thoran along with Mixed Vegetable Sambar and Steamed Rice for a weekday meal.

title: Oreo Milkshake Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Oreo Milkshake Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Oreo Milkshake Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Oreo biscuits - broken into pieces, /2 cup Vanilla Ice cream - 2 scoops, /4 cup Milk, tablespoon Chocolate sauce, Chocolate sauce - as required for garnishing, Heavy whipping cream - as required for garnishing
Instructions:
1. To begin making Oreo Milkshake Recipe prep up to make Oreo milkshake with all the ingredients mentioned.
2. Take a powerful hand blender to blend everything.Blend Oreo biscuits, milk, ice cream and chocolate syrup until everything very well combined and smooth textured.Pour into glasses, top it up with some whipped cream and chocolate syrup for garnishing and serve immediately.Serve Oreo Milkshake along With Grilled Mushroom Sandwich to kids for their after school snacks.

title: Mexican Grilled Corn Flavoured With Cheesy Garlic Mayo Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Mexican Grilled Corn Flavoured With Cheesy Garlic Mayo Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Mexican recipe for Mexican Grilled Corn Flavoured With Cheesy Garlic Mayo Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Sweet corn, tablespoons Butter, tablespoon Paprika powder, tablespoon Del Monte Cheesy Garlic Mayo, /2 Lemon - wedged, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), tablespoon Parmesan cheese - grated
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Mexican Grilled Corn With Del Monte cheesy garlic mayonnaise recipe, Pull the husk on the corn and tie them back.Rub butter generously on all the cobs.
2. Next spread DelMonte cheesy garlic mayonnaise on all sides of the corn.Sprinkle paprika powder evenly over the cob.
3. Now grill the corn in oven or a charcoal grill turning occasionally until corn is fully cooked and lightly charged.Remove corn from the grill; rub fresh lime over the corn.
4. Sprinkle some fresh coriander leaves.
5. Sprinkle parmesan cheese and serve the Mexican Grilled Corn With Del Monte cheesy garlic mayonnaise immediately.Serve Mexican Grilled Corn With Del Monte Cheesy Garlic Mayonnaise on its own with a cup of hot Masala Chai on a rainy day or as a tea time snack.

title: Paneer Matar Butter Masala (Indian Cottage Cheese And Peas Masala With Butter) Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Paneer Matar Butter Masala (Indian Cottage Cheese And Peas Masala With Butter) Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Paneer Matar Butter Masala (Indian Cottage Cheese And Peas Masala With Butter) Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: /2 cups Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - cubed, Sunflower Oil - As Required, /2 cup Green peas (Matar), Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Sugar, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /4 cup Milk, teaspoon Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves), Onion, Tomatoe, Ginger, Clove, Tablespoon Ghee, Dry Red Chillie, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Cinnamon, Pepper, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /4 cup Cashew nuts - broken into small pieces
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Paneer Matar Butter Masala recipe, first shallow fry the paneer cubes in 1 to 2 tablespoons of oil in a wide pan until it is slightly golden/ creamy golden and keep it aside.The next step is to prepare the masala/gravy.
2. Heat butter/clarified butter in a large heavy bottomed pan, add onions and peas/matar.Sauté until onions & peas/matar till the onions turn transparent.
3. Add ginger and garlic and stir for 1 to 2 minutes.Add whole dry red chilies, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, whole black peppercorns and coriander seeds (that is all the whole spices) and stir a few times.Add tomatoes and cook until tomatoes turn soft and mushy.
4. Remove from heat and keep aside to cool a little.Puree this entire mixture along with 1/4 cup of cashews until smooth, adding a little water if required.Transfer this gravy back to the wide pan and place on heat.
5. Add shallow fried paneer pieces to the gravy, add salt to taste, sugar, kasuri methi, chili powder (if using), water if required to achieve desired consistency and simmer on low heat for the flavors to mingle.Finally add milk, mix well, allow the curry to simmer for another minute or so on low heat, then remove.Serve Paneer Matar Butter Masala with Phulkas or even steamed rice for a delicious weekday meal.

title: Rajasthani Style Sukhe Gatte Capsicum Ki Sabzi Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Rajasthani Style Sukhe Gatte Capsicum Ki Sabzi Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Rajasthani recipe for Rajasthani Style Sukhe Gatte Capsicum Ki Sabzi Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: cup Gram flour (besan), /2 teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, tablespoons Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - cut into cubes, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, teaspoon Garam masala powder, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Sunflower Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Sukhe Gatte Capsicum Ki Sabzi Recipe we will first make the gatte.In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients for the gatta.
2. Add a few teaspoons of water at a time and knead to make a firm dough.Knead well for about 5 minutes to make a very soft melt in the mouth gatta.
3. If you add more water and it does not shape into a dough, then you will have to add more gram flour and knead it well.Roll the dough into a long cylinder and cut them into 1 inch discs.
4. The next step is to cook the gattas in boiling water.In a large saucepan boil water.
5. Once the water comes to a brisk boil, add the gattas into the water and boil until they comes floating to the top.
6. Once they come floating to the top, boil for another 3 to 4 minutes.
7. Drain the gattas and keep it aside.To make the Sabzi, in a sauce pan add oil, add cumin seeds and asafoetida, allow the cumin seeds to crackle for few seconds.Once that is done, you can add chopped bell peppers (Capsicum) and saute until the capsicum become slightly soft.Turn the heat to low, add red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, coriander powder, amchoor and salt.Add the cooked gattas at this stage, mix well to combine and sprinkle some water and cook until the raw smell of spice goes away.Saute for another 10 minutes and switch off the heat and garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.Serve the Sukhe Gatte Capsicum Ki Sabzi Recipe along with Kadhi Pakoras , Mooli Paratha and Kadai Paneer Recipe to make it a rich meal for your Sunday lunch.

title: Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Fusion recipe for Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: grams Chicken - cut into medium sized pieces, Sunflower Oil - As Required, tablespoons Garlic - minced, Ginger, Green Chillies - Slit, Onion, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - sliced, tablespoon Soy sauce, /2 teaspoon Vinegar, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, Salt - To Taste, Tablespoon Red Chilli Sauce, /2 teaspoon Green Chilli Sauce, tablespoon Roasted tomato pasta sauce, teaspoon Corn flour, Water - As Required, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, /2 teaspoon Soy sauce, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli sauce, /2 tablespoon Corn flour, /2 tablespoons All Purpose Flour (Maida), Water - As Required, Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli recipe, firstly let us marinate the chicken.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine, black pepper powder, soy sauce, red chilli sauce, corn flour, and maidaAdd a little water to make it a smooth batter.
3. Make sure that the batter is neither too thick nor too runny.The next step is to coat the chicken pieces in the batter for the Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli recipe.Once they are coated well, deep fry them on medium-high  in a deep fry pan.
4. Drain them on a tissue paper to absorb the extra oil.
5. Keep them aside.Heat oil in a wide skillet on medium flame, add ginger, garlic and green chillies.
6. Saute it for about a minute.After a minute, add onion, green bell pepper and salt.
7. Toss them on high flame.
8. Do not over cook, as we want the crunchiness in the vegetables.Now bring the flame back to medium and add soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper powder, green chilli sauce, tomato sauce and red chilli sauce.
9. Again bring the flame to high and toss them properly.After 2 to 3 minutes, mix cornflour with 1 tablespoon water and add it to the veggies.
10. When its cooked, add the fried chicken pieces.Adjust the salt according to your taste and mix it properly so that the chicken pieces are well coated with the prepared sauce.Once it is done, switch off the stove and Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli ready to be served.Serve Indo Chinese Crispy Chicken Chilli with Hakka Noodles or Szechuan Vegetarian Fried Rice for a weekend dinner with your friends and family.

title: Aar Macher Jhol Recipe - Bengali Fish Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Aar Macher Jhol Recipe - Bengali Fish Curry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Aar Macher Jhol Recipe - Bengali Fish Curry (Main Course).
Ingredients: Aar Maach (fish) - (rohu or katla), Tomatoe, Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), Ginger, Green Chillie, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Mustard oil - as required, Salt - To Taste, Water - As Required, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Aar Macher Jhol Recipe, wash and clean fish pieces twice with water.
2. Ensure they are properly cleaned.Add salt and turmeric powder to the cleaned fish pieces.
3. Marinate it and set aside.Leave the fish marination for about 2 hours.In a heavy bottomed pan, add the required oil and heat over medium heat.
4. Fry the fish pieces and fry until they turn lightly brown.
5. The fish pieces should be half cooked.In the medium sized wok/kadhai, add the remaining oil and heat over medium heat.Once the oil is hot, add cumin seeds and bay leaf.
6. Let it crackle.Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they become mushy.
7. To the mushy tomatoes, add red chilli powder, coriander powder and ginger garlic paste.Cook until the raw smell goes off and the spice powders are absorbed by the tomatoes.
8. Add water as per your required consistency and bring it to boil.Once the water starts boiling, add the fried fish pieces and cook them over low flame.Slit the green chillies and add them to the curry.
9. Once the fishes are cooked completely and the curry reaches required consistency, season it with salt and switch off the flameEnsure the curry is cooked over medium flame once the fish pieces are added.
10. If fish is overcooked, it might dissolve in the curry.Garnish with coriander leaves and serve warmly.
11. Prepare Aar Macher Jhol and serve it along with Steamed Rice and Begun Bhaja for your everyday meals.

title: Thandu Keerai Puli Kuzhambu Recipe - Amaranth Greens In Tangy Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Thandu Keerai Puli Kuzhambu Recipe - Amaranth Greens In Tangy Curry
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Thandu Keerai Puli Kuzhambu Recipe - Amaranth Greens In Tangy Curry (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Green Amaranth Leaves - roughly chopped, grams Tamarind - soaked in hot water and pulp extracted, Onion, Tomato - roughly chopped, Cloves Garlic, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), sprig Curry leaves, teaspoons Sambar Powder, teaspoon Methi Powder (Fenugreek Powder), tablespoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil, Salt - To Taste, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making Thandu Keerai Puli Kuzhambu Recipe, soak tamarind in hot water, squeeze the pulp out and keep aside.
2. You will approximately 1-1/2 cups of tamarind water.Heat sesame oil in a heavy bottomed pan, add the mustard seeds, and let it crackle.Add the asafoetida, curry leaves and let it splutter.Add the whole garlic cloves, chopped onions and saute until the garlic turns slightly golden and onions become soft.Once the onions become soft, add chopped tomato and cook until it turns soft and mushy.Next add the chopped thandu keerai or amaranth leaves and saute until the greens become soft.After the Thandu Keerai/ Amaranth leaves turn soft, add the tamarind pulp, sambar powder, fenugreek powder and season with salt, mix well and let it simmer for 10 minutes on low heat.
3. Add additional water if required to adjust the consistency of the kuzhambu.
4. Simmer and cook until the Thandu Keerai Puli Kuzhambu gets a little thicker.
5. Once the Kuzhambu thickens, turn off the heat and serve hot.Serve Thandu Keerai Puli Kuzhambu along with Steamed Rice, Kathirikai Kootu, Carrot and Beans Poriyal Recipe and Curd for a weeknight dinner.

title: Crispy Masala Peanuts Recipe - Gujarati Sing Bhujia
content:
Recipe Name: Crispy Masala Peanuts Recipe - Gujarati Sing Bhujia
Description: A flavorful and authentic Gujarati Recipes﻿ recipe for Crispy Masala Peanuts Recipe - Gujarati Sing Bhujia (Appetizers).
Ingredients: cup Raw Peanuts (Moongphali), tablespoons Gram flour (besan), tablespoon Rice flour, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), pinch Chaat Masala Powder, /4 cup Water, pinch Black pepper powder, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - to fry
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Crispy Masala Peanuts recipe, First we need to take a big bowl, mix together peanuts, gram flour, rice flour, red chilly powder, coriander powder, chat masala, water, black pepper powder, oil and salt to tasteMix all nicely using little water.Remember add less water and making sure the spices and flour stick to the peanuts uniformly.Heat the oil in a kadai/wok on medium heat.
2. Fry the peanuts until they turn golden brown.When they are done, take them out from the oil and place them on a absorbent paper.At this time these are not much crispy but after cooling to room temperature, the peanuts should be crispy.Now Crispy Masala Peanuts are ready, sprinkle some chat masala with dry mint and serve.Serve Crispy Masala Peanuts along with Masala Chai during your tea time break.
3. You can also serve it as a snack with your drinks for house parties.

title: Palak Mushroom Makhani Recipe - Creamy Spinach & Mushroom
content:
Recipe Name: Palak Mushroom Makhani Recipe - Creamy Spinach & Mushroom
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Palak Mushroom Makhani Recipe - Creamy Spinach & Mushroom (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Button mushrooms - quatered, grams Spinach Leaves (Palak) - washed and chopped, Tomato - chopped or pureed, Clove, Ginger, Green Chillies - Slit, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Garam masala powder, tablespoons Fresh cream, Tablespoon Ghee, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Palak Mushroom Makhani Recipe, we will first steam the washed and chopped spinach.Add the chopped spinach, tomatoes, green chillies, ginger and garlic into the pressure cooker, add 2 tablespoons water and pressure cook for one whistle.
2. After the first whistle, release the pressure immediately by running it under cold water.
3. This helps to retain the fresh green color of the spinach/ palak.Once cooked allow the palak to cool completely and then pulse it in your blender, with almost no water.
4. You can also choose to mash the spinach with a masher to give it a different texture as well.Melt the ghee in a frying pan on medium heat; add cumin seeds and the cinnamon stick.
5. Saute the ingredients for a few seconds.
6. Stir in the turmeric powder and sauté for a few seconds and add the mushrooms.Roast the mushroom, along with a little salt until just about cooked.
7. Stir in the garam masala as well and saute for a few seconds.Once the mushrooms are cooked, add the cooked palak puree, the fresh cream, any more salt if required.
8. Give the Palak Mushroom Makhani a brisk boil for about 2 to 3 minutes and turn off the heat.
9. Transfer the Palak Mushroom Makhani to as serving bowl and serve hot.Serve the Palak Mushroom Makhani Recipe along with hot Phulkas smeared with ghee, Jeera pulao and a raita for lunch or dinner.
10. You can also pack the Palak Mushroom Makhani Recipe along with Phulkas into a kids lunch box.

title: Dahi Bhalla Papdi Chaat Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Dahi Bhalla Papdi Chaat Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Dahi Bhalla Papdi Chaat Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Curd Vada, cup Papdi puris, cup Sweet Chutney (Date & Tamarind), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Chaat Masala Powder - to taste, Cumin powder (Jeera) - to taste, Onion, Carrot (Gajjar) - grated, Anardana Powder (Pomegranate Seed Powder), /4 cup Raw Peanuts (Moongphali) - roasted and halved, cup Boondi - or sev, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Dahi Bhalla Papdi Chaat, you can either use the puri's or papdi.
2. We will be making a plate at a time.In a flat plate or a bowl; arrange the papdis or puri's.
3. Add the dahi bhalla over the papdi or into the puri.
4. If your bhalla's are large, then break them into small pieces and add them.
5. Pour some of the dahi as well.
6. Next drizzle the date chutney and the green chutneys around each of the papdi/ puri's.
7. Sprinkle chaat masala powder and the cumin powder.
8. Next sprinkle the grated carrots, pomegranates and the crisp boondi/sev.Finally sprinkle the onions and the chopped coriander leaves.
9. The chaat is now ready to be served.
10. Proceed the same way with the remaining Bhalla's and Papdi.Serve the Dahi Bhalla Papdi (Puri) Chaat Recipe as an Appetizer or as as Tea Time Snack to fill your hunger craving.

title: Wheat Grass Shikanji - Wheat Grass Lemonade Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Wheat Grass Shikanji - Wheat Grass Lemonade Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Wheat Grass Shikanji - Wheat Grass Lemonade Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: grams Wheat Grass Powder, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, Salt, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Lemon - juiced
Instructions:
1. To make the Wheat Grass Shikanji, soak the cut wheat grass in water for a few minutes to remove the dirt.Wash it well again, drain the water and then cut it into small pieces.Add boiled water to it and grind in a blender along with ginger to make a fresh green juice and strain.
2. Drink the Wheat Grass Shikanji early morning in an empty stomach to get the best results.Serve Wheat Grass Shikanji in evening with some snacks like Kala Chana Chaat or Baked Mathri.
3. You can also drink this empty stomach every morning.

title: Khara Obbattu Recipe (Bread Stuffed With Spicy Potato Mixture Recipe)
content:
Recipe Name: Khara Obbattu Recipe (Bread Stuffed With Spicy Potato Mixture Recipe)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Karnataka recipe for Khara Obbattu Recipe (Bread Stuffed With Spicy Potato Mixture Recipe) (Main Course).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, /4 cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), /4 cup Sooji (Semolina/ Rava), tablespoon Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt, Sunflower Oil - for kneading, Potatoes (Aloo) - boiled and mashed, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Onion, Clove, Ginger, Green Chillies - finely chopped, Curry leaves - finely chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - as needed
Instructions:
1. We begin by baking Kara Obbattu Recipe(Bread Stuffed with Spicy Potato Mixture Recipe) the dough by combining all the ingredients with curd and soak it for 10 minutes then knead with enough water till it is soft and stretchy.
2. Add oil for a good binding.For the filling heat the pan with oil and temper with cumin and curry leaves.
3. Then add the rest of the ingredients except boiled potato and the spice powders.Once the onions are translucent add the spice powders.
4. Then add the mashed potato and combine it together, finally add some coriander leaves.
5. Bind them and make small balls and keep it aside.Make small balls and divide the dough equally.Keeping a little flour for dusting handy on a plate; roll out the dough into 3 inch diameter circles.
6. Place a portion of the filling (potato) mixture into the center of the circle.
7. Bring edges of the circle towards the center and fold over to cover the entire filling; making sure the edges are all sealed well by pinching them together if there is any opening.Flatten the stuffed dough; dust the dough over a little flour and roll gently into a 5 to 6 inch diameter circle taking care not to put too much pressure as the filling can come out of the dough.Preheat an iron skillet on medium-high; place the rolled obbattu onto the skillet to cook until golden brown on both sides.
8. You can cook the obbattu with ghee to give it a richer taste and flavor.Repeat the above process for all the remaining dough and filling portions.Serve the Karnataka style Kara Obbattu hot with ghee smeared on the top, or with allam pachadi recipe

title: Kashmiri Style Paneer Masala Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Kashmiri Style Paneer Masala Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Kashmiri recipe for Kashmiri Style Paneer Masala Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - diced in cubes, Pinch Asafoetida (Hing), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Bay leaves (tej patta), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, /2 teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), teaspoon Homemade tomato puree, /2 teaspoon Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, Ginger, /4 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), teaspoon Fennel seeds (Saunf) - powdered, pinch Saffron strands, pinch Garam masala powder, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Kashmiri Style Paneer Masala, firstly, have a bowl ready with 500 ml warm water.In a Frying pan, heat a little oil and shallow fry the paneer cubes in batches, till they are golden brown.
2. Use only medium flame such that paneer won’t break/splutterDrain the fried paneer on a kitchen towel and add the fried paneer to the bowl of warm water.
3. Let it soak, while we make the curry.
4. The paneer will retain moisture and stay soft this way.to make the curry add a little oil to a heavy bottomed pan, and add hing.
5. Let it sizzle for a few seconds.Add cinnamon stick, bay leaf and green cardamom.Fry the spices for a minute, as they begin to splutter and release their aroma in the oil.
6. Care not to over fry them.
7. Add shahi jeera and fry till it splutters.On a low heat, add tomato puree and stir to ensure that it does not stick to the bottom.
8. Add red chilli powder, ginger powder and fennel powder.Stir and fry for a couple of minutes so that it blends well.Add required water (you can add the warm water in which the paneer are soaked) and continue to cook on a medium heat.Bring it to boil and simmer for 5-7 minutes without lid, till a thick consistency is achieved.Crush the saffron into the gravy and whisk in the yogurt.
9. Simmer for few more minutes.
10. When the gravy is done and cooked, add paneer cubes.
11. Stir, making sure that the paneer does not break.Garnish Kashmiri Style Paneer Masala with coriander and a pinch of garam masala and switch off the flame.
12. Serve Kashmiri Style Paneer Masala Recipe along with Kashmiri Modur Pulao with pomegranate to enjoy your Sunday Meal.

title: Aromatic Vegetable Pulao Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Aromatic Vegetable Pulao Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Aromatic Vegetable Pulao Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Rice, tablespoons Sunflower Oil, Onion, Tomato - chopped, Tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste, /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /4 cup Carrots (Gajjar) - chopped, /4 cup Green peas (Matar) - steamed, /4 cup Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - chopped, /4 cup Potato (Aloo) - cut into small cubes, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Cloves (Laung), teaspoon Garam masala powder, Star Anise, Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Mint Leaves (Pudina) - a few sprigs finely chopped, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Aromatic Vegetable Pulao recipe, wash and soak rice for at least 30 minutes.
2. Drain the water and keep it aside.Heat oil in a sauce pan and add onions, whole spices and cook until the onion turns golden brown.Meanwhile add 4 cups of water in a different saucepan and bring it to rolling boil.Add ginger garlic paste and tomatoes with the onions and whole spices.
3. Let it cook until the tomatoes are soft and mushy.Once the tomatoes are soft, add all the remaining spices and veggies and cook for a minute.
4. After a minute, add the hot water to the veggies.Add the soaked rice into the pan and cover it with a lid.
5. Let it cook till the rice is 3/4 cooked and the turn the flame to low heat.Cook it for few more minutes till the rice is almost done and it is ready to be served.Serve Aromatic Vegetable Pulao along with Burani Raita, Raw Mango Raita or any other raita of your choice.

title: One Pot Spicy Vegetable Pulao Recipe With Coconut Milk
content:
Recipe Name: One Pot Spicy Vegetable Pulao Recipe With Coconut Milk
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for One Pot Spicy Vegetable Pulao Recipe With Coconut Milk (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Basmati rice - (or any other rice), ml Coconut milk, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Green beans (French Beans) - diced small, /2 cups Cauliflower (gobi) - florets, Carrots (Gajjar) - diced small, Clove, Ginger, Green Chillies - Slit, Cloves (Laung), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), Salt - To Taste, Tablespoons Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Spicy Vegetable Pulav with Coconut Milk, we will first wash the rice under water and keep it aside.Keep the coconut milk, vegetable chopped and the spices ready by the side.
2. We will be making the pulav in one pot and cooking it in a Pressure Cooker.
3. If you dont have a pressure cooker, then you can proceed with the same intructions and cook in a Sauce Pan.Pound the ginger and garlic in a pestle and mortar and keep aside.Into the pressure cooker or the sauce pan, add in the a teaspoon of oil and add in the ginger garlic paste.
4. Saute for a few seconds and add in the cloves, cardamom, cinnamon and bay leaf.Next add in the vegetables, green chillies, rice, turmeric powder, salt and coconut milk.
5. Add an additional cup of water and stir all the ingredients and cover the pressure cooker (saucepan).*Method Sauce Pan:Turn the heat to high and allow the pulao mixture to come to a boil.
6. Once it comes to a boil, turn the heat to low, cover the pan and simmer the rice until the pulao absorbs all the water.Once all the water is absorbed turn off the heat and allow the pulao to rest for at least 10 minutes, this will help the rice to become a little stiff and remain as grains.*Method Pressure Cooker:Turn the heat to high, place the weight on cook on high until you hear a couple of whistles.
7. After a couple of whistles, turn the heat to low and simmer for about 3 minutes and then turn off the heat.
8. Allow the pressure to release naturally as the the rice will continue to cook in the pressure cooker.
9. Once the pressure is released you can open the cooker and proceed to the next steps.Finally stir in the ghee and serve the Spicy Vetegetable Pulav hot along with a Raita or Kadhi.Serve One Pot Spicy Vegetable Pulao Recipe with Coconut Milk along with Boondi Raita and a roasted Papad for your weekend meal.

title: Hyderabad Soy Biryani Recipe With Vegetables & Palak
content:
Recipe Name: Hyderabad Soy Biryani Recipe With Vegetables & Palak
Description: A flavorful and authentic Hyderabadi recipe for Hyderabad Soy Biryani Recipe With Vegetables & Palak (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Basmati rice - soaked for 30 minutes, Cups Water, Salt - To Taste, /4 cup Soy Chunks (Nuggets) - soaked in hot water for 15 minutes, /4 cup Carrots (Gajjar) - chopped, /4 cup Green beans (French Beans) - chopped, /4 cup Green peas (Matar), /4 cup Cauliflower (gobi) - chopped, /4 cup Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - chopped, Potatoes (Aloo) - cubed, Tomatoe, Onion, Ginger, Sunflower Oil - to cook, Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Cloves (Laung), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 cups Spinach Leaves (Palak) - or 1 bunch, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 cup Mint Leaves (Pudina), Green Chillie, Badam (Almond), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Black cardamom (Badi Elaichi), Cloves (Laung), Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), /2 teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), /4 Mace (Javitri), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Garam masala powder, Salt - To Taste, Onion, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /4 cup Mint Leaves (Pudina) - roughly torn, /2 cup Milk, Saffron strands, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making Hyderabad Soy Biryani Recipe With Vegetables & Palak, wash rice well and soak for half an hour.In a handi, boil water, almost  triple the quantity of rice or more, with salt and the whole spices mentioned above.
2. When the water comes to a boil, add the soaked rice and cook till almost done.
3. When almost a bite remains in the grains, drain the rice in a sieve.
4. Keep aside.
5. Warm a bowl of milk in a saucepan, and soak the saffron in it and keep aside till required.
6. In the meantime, heat a kadai with a bit of oil and on high heat, caramelise the onions with sprinkling some salt on it and sauteing them.
7. Keep aside.Now in the same kadai, with a bit of oil heated, add the potatoes and cook till they are shallow fried and crisp-cooked, season with salt and keep aside till required for layering.In another vessel, bring enough water to boil to cook the remaining vegetables except the capsicum.
8. Add the cauliflower first to the boiling water.
9. After about 6 minutes or when the cauliflower is softened half-way through, add the rest of the vegetables.
10. When almost done, drain from the clear stock and keep aside.
11. Reserve and use this water for making soups if you wish.
12. Take off soy chunks off the hot water, wash thoroughly and squeeze tightly to discard any extra water.
13. For the biryani, in another vessel heat oil and add to it all the whole spices mentioned and saute till aromatic.
14. Now add the remaining half of the chopped onions and saute on high flame.
15. Add a bit of salt to it.
16. Add the chopped capsicum too.
17. When onions turn translucent, add ginger garlic paste and saute well for a minute till the raw smell vanishes.
18. Now add turmeric and the chopped tomatoes.
19. Mix well and cover and cook for a while.
20. Add all the other dry spice powders and mix well.Meanwhile in a mixer grinder, puree the palak with other mentioned ingredients for palak puree.
21. Add the palak puree and mix well.
22. Keep stirring on high flame for a while.
23. Now add the beaten curds to the gravy and stir continuously on high flame.
24. Add the soya chunks and mix well.
25. Cover and cook.
26. After a few minutes, add the boiled and drained vegetables, and adjust salt to taste.
27. Mix well.
28. Adjust seasoning or masalas now.
29. Add most of the fried onions reserving little for layering and garnishing.
30. When all the water has evaporated and the gravy has thickened, switch of heat.
31. Keep a thick griddle to heat on the stove top.
32. Place a handi on the griddle, just to ensure the even heat distribution such that the bottom of the biryani doesn't get burnt.
33. Now in the handi, start layering the biryani.
34. Start with spreading half the gravy at the bottom.
35. Cover with some cooked rice.
36. Spread some ghee, fried onions, potato cubes, coriander leaves and mint leaves over it.
37. Repeat layering so that you finish with caramelised onions on top most layer.. Make four vertical holes in the biryani with the handle of a spoon and pour saffron milk into it.
38. Cover the vessel with aluminium foil and shut the lid tightly over it.
39. Keep vessel on medium heat for dum.
40. Keep on high heat for first 3 minutes and then on a low heat for about 6-7 minutes.
41. Keep covered for few more minutes.
42. Open the lid and mix a bit or serve in layers.
43. Serve Hyderabad Soy Biryani Recipe With Vegetables & Palak along with Burani Raita Recipe (Garlic Based Yogurt), Pickled Onions Recipe, and Saunf Aloo & Dal Kebab Recipe (Potato & Lentil Kebabs).

title: North Indian Pheni Recipe - Seviyan Kheer
content:
Recipe Name: North Indian Pheni Recipe - Seviyan Kheer
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for North Indian Pheni Recipe - Seviyan Kheer (Desserts).
Ingredients: grams Pheni - or one roll, ml Milk, /4 cup Sugar, Tablespoon Ghee, tablespoons Cashew nuts, Raisin, tablespoons Almond Meal (Badam Powder)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the North Indian Pheni Recipe, we will first get all the ingredients ready and keep them by the side.
2. In a heavy bottom pan, bring the milk to a brisk boil.
3. Lower the heat and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes till it thickens a little.
4. Once the milk has thickened a little, add the sugar and almond powder and simmer for another couple of minutes.The almond powder will help thicken the milk.
5. Add the pheni at this stage and mix well and turn off the heat.
6. Allow the milk and pheni mixture to rest in the pan for about 10 minutes.
7. This will help soften the pheni in the warm milk.Transfer the Pheni to a serving bowl.
8. In a small pan, heat the ghee on medium to low heat and roast cashew and raisins until golden brown and crisp.
9. Turn off the heat and pour it over the Pheni (Kheer).Serve North Indian Pheni as a dessert after your delicious festive meal of Jodhpuri Aloo, Ajwain Puri, Satvik Carrot Sprout Salad and Mirchi Ka Chunda.

title: Moong Dal Khichdi Recipe For Babies And Toddlers Over 10 Months
content:
Recipe Name: Moong Dal Khichdi Recipe For Babies And Toddlers Over 10 Months
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Moong Dal Khichdi Recipe For Babies And Toddlers Over 10 Months (Main Course).
Ingredients: /4 cup Rice, /4 cup Yellow Moong Dal (Split), Carrot (Gajjar) - finely chopped, Green beans (French Beans) - finely chopped, Tablespoon Ghee, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Moong Dal Khichdi For Babies And Toddlers, add yellow moong dal and rice along with 1 cup water in a pressure cooker.Pressure cook the dal and rice for 3 whistles, reduce the flame to low and leave it for 2 minutes.
2. After 2 minutes, turn off the flame and let the pressure release naturally.
3. Meanwhile, in another pressure cooker, add the chopped carrots, beans, add 2 tablespoons water and pressure cook for 2 whistles.
4. Turn off the heat and run the pressure cooker under cold water to release the pressure.
5. This will ensure that the vegetables are cooked without losing its colour and nutrition.
6. Next, place a kadai on low heat and add ghee.
7. Once the ghee melts, add jeera and allow it to crackle.
8. Once the jeera has crackled, add asafoetida and mix well into the ghee.
9. Add cooked carrots, beans, cooked dal and rice khichdi along with a pinch of salt.Stir to combine the Moong Dal Khichdi For Babies And Toddlers until it becomes almost smooth.
10. Turn off heat.
11. Moong Dal Khichdi for your baby is ready.
12. Serve this Moong Dal Khichdi to your babies/toddlers who are over 10 months for a wholesome lunch meal.

title: Dahi Wale Aloo Recipe (Indian Yogurt-Based Potato Curry)
content:
Recipe Name: Dahi Wale Aloo Recipe (Indian Yogurt-Based Potato Curry)
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Dahi Wale Aloo Recipe (Indian Yogurt-Based Potato Curry) (Main Course).
Ingredients: Potatoes (Aloo) - chopped, /2 cups Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), tablespoons Gram flour (besan), /3 teaspoon Asafoetida (hing), Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), sprig Curry leaves, Onion, Ginger, /2 teaspoon Garlic - finely chopped, Green Chillies - chopped, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 Turmeric powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, tablespoons Sunflower Oil, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making Dahi Wale Aloo Recipe, first wash the potatoes thoroughly.
2. Then pressure cook them till they are cooked soft, but not completely mushy.
3. You can follow this method to learn how to pressure cook them.Once the pressure has released from the cooker, open the line, drain the water and allow the potatoes to cool.
4. Then, peel them and roughly break into chunks.In a large bowl, add curd and besan with a little water and whisk them together to make a smooth batter.
5. There should not be any lumps in the curds.
6. Whisk till it is smooth and then set aside.In a wok or kadhai, warm some oil.
7. Add cumin seeds and hing.
8. As soon as cumin begins to crackle, add finely chopped onion and saute till the onions soften.Next add the finely chopped ginger, garlic and green chilies along with the curry leaves and toss them all together for a couple of minutes.Add the red chilli powder, coriander powder and turmeric and saute the masala well until it is cooked through and begins to release oil from the sides.
9. If you find the masala sticking at this stage, add a little water (2 tablespoons) in it and toss well.Add the potatoes to the masala and mix again till the potatoes are well-coated.Turn the heat to low and start pouring the beaten curd over the potatoes.
10. Mix well.
11. Adjust salt as per your taste and close the lid to allow the curry to simmer for 5 minutes.Once done, turn the heat off, garnish with coriander leaves and serve with Steamed Rice or Phulkas.

title: Vegetable Fried Brown Rice Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Vegetable Fried Brown Rice Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Chinese recipe for Vegetable Fried Brown Rice Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Brown Rice - cooked, tablespoons Garlic - chopped, Green Chilli - chopped, /2 cup Carrots (Gajjar) - chopped, /2 cup Green beans (French Beans) - chopped, /2 cup Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - chopped, Onion, /2 cup Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) - chopped, tablespoon Roasted tomato pasta sauce - or store bought, Tablespoon Red Chilli Sauce, teaspoon Soy sauce, Ginger, Onion, Salt, teaspoon Vinegar, Extra Virgin Olive Oil - as required
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Vegetable Fried Brown Rice recipe, collect all the ingredients on the kitchen platform before you start cooking.You can use fresh cooked brown rice or even the left over brown rice.Heat oil in heavy bottomed pan and add garlic and saute till golden in colour.Now add onion and green chilies and again saute for 2 to 3 minutes till the raw smell goes off.Add in the rest of the chopped vegetables and fry them all.Season with salt and black pepper and then add vinegar and the three sauces together.Cook for 2 to 3 minutes on low flame and then add the pre cooked brown rice and mix well such that the flavours incorporate well.Turn off the gas stove and garnish the brown fried rice with some fresh spring onion greens and coriander.Brown rice when teamed up with plenty of fine vegetables and tossed in olive oil and sauces to give a Chinese flavour.
2. Vegetable Fried Brown Rice dish makes an amazing rice meal that can be anytime enjoyed with any Chinese curry like Indo-Chinese Paneer Manchurian.

title: Eggless Devil'S Food Cake Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Eggless Devil'S Food Cake Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Eggless Devil'S Food Cake Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: cups All Purpose Flour (Maida), /3 cup Cocoa Powder, /2 teaspoons Baking powder, Salt, /4 cup Butter - softened, /2 cups Caster Sugar, /2 teaspoon Vanilla Extract, Egg, /4 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), /2 teaspoon Red Food Color - (only optional), Chocolate ganache - as needed, tablespoons Flax seed powder (flax meal), tablespoons Chilled water
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Rich Dark Devil's Food Cake Recipe, we will first preheat the oven to 180 C.
2. Grease and flour 2 - 8 inch cake round cake pans.
3. Keep aside.To make the Flax Meal Egg Replacer If your recipe asks for 3 eggs, measure 3 tablespoons of flax meal along with 9 tablespoons of water.
4. Stir well and let the mixture rest for about 15 minutes.
5. This process of resting helps the flax meal mixture develop a gelatinous consistency similar to eggs.To make the Batter Sift the flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa powder and keep aside.In a large bowl or the bowl of the stand mixer, beat in the softened butter, vanilla and sugar until light and fluffy.
6. Add an egg at a time, whisking it into the butter mixture until light and fluffy(if making eggless, add the flaxmeal egg replacer)Gradually add in the butter milk and food coloring.
7. And finally, gradually fold in the flour mixture and continue to fold until the mixture is well blended and smooth.Divide the chocolate cake batter into 2 greased baking pans and place in the preheated oven to bake for about 35 to 45 minutes, until a tester when inserted in the center comes out clean.Once the cakes are baked, remove them from the oven and cool them completely.
8. While the cake is cooling, prepare the Chocolate Ganache recipe.
9. Place one cake on the serving tray in which you plan to set the cake.
10. Spread a generous portion of the chocolate ganache on the top of the cake.
11. Place the other cake over the bottom one and lightly press down.
12. Finally cover the whole cake with the Chocolate Ganache including the sides and the top.
13. Refrigerate the cake for at least 4 to 5 hours.Serve the Rich Dark Chocolate Devils Food Cake along with a cup of coffee or as a dessert for parties.

title: Bengali Langcha Recipe With Mawa
content:
Recipe Name: Bengali Langcha Recipe With Mawa
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Bengali Langcha Recipe With Mawa (Desserts).
Ingredients: /2 cup Milk, tablespoon Sooji (Semolina/ Rava), cup Milk Powder, /2 cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), /8 teaspoon Baking soda, tablespoon Caster Sugar, cups Sugar, /2 cups Water, teaspoon Cardamom Powder (Elaichi), teaspoon Pistachios - chopped, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. Making dough for langcha:To begin making Bengali Langcha Recipe With Mawa, first start by making dough for langcha.
2. Take a bowl add milk powder, all purpose flour, semolina, baking powder, whole milk( pouring small milk at a time) and make a soft dough.Cover it with damp cloth and keep aside for 10 minutes.
3. After 10 minutes add 1 pinch of food color(optional)and powder sugar mix it well.
4. Rest it for another 5 to 10 minutes.Wet your hands.
5. Take small amount of dough and pressing by hands give it a  oblong shape like langcha.Keep the size of sweets small from your desire size, it will puff up after frying.Making sugar syrup:When the dough is resting let's make the sugar syrup . In a big pan add sugar and water (1:1.25 ratio), boil until sugar dissolves completely.
6. Add a pinch of cardamom powder and mix well.
7. Keep aside.Frying Langcha:In a deep frying pan, heat vegetable oil or ghee.
8. Then slowly add lanchas not crowded much and fry it until brown in low flame.
9. If flame is high then langcha will take color easily but not cook from inside.Take out fried langcha and place it on a paper towel.Warm up the sugar syrup.
10. Add fried langcha slowly in hot sugar syrup.
11. Let them soak for 3-4 hours, then serve.
12. Serve it hot or refrigerate for 1 hour then serve, as per your wish.Serve Bengali Langcha Recipe With Mawa as a dessert along with a meal of Steamed rice, Kanchakalar Khosha Bata, Bengali Posto Porota Recipe (Spiced Poppy Seed Parathas), Bengali Style Cholar Dal Recipe and Posto Pabda (Bengali Fish Curry In Poppy Seeds Paste)

title: Kovakkai Podi Curry Recipe - Tamil Nadu Style Ivy Gourd Stir Fry
content:
Recipe Name: Kovakkai Podi Curry Recipe - Tamil Nadu Style Ivy Gourd Stir Fry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Tamil Nadu recipe for Kovakkai Podi Curry Recipe - Tamil Nadu Style Ivy Gourd Stir Fry (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Tindora (Dondakaya/ Kovakkai) - thinly sliced vertically, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /2 teaspoon White Urad Dal (Split), Pinch Asafoetida (Hing), sprig Curry leaves, Dry Red Chilli, Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), tablespoon White Urad Dal (Split), tablespoon Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), Dry Red Chillie, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing)
Instructions:
1. To begin making Kovakkai Podi Curry Recipe, dry roast the ingredients mentioned in the spicy lentil mix table and grind it to a coarse mix using a hand blender or Mixer and keep aside.Heat oil in a Kadai on medium flame, add the mustard seeds, urad dal and let it splutter.Add the asafoetida, dry red chilli and curry leaves and let it splutter.Now add the sliced ivy gourds and give it a good stir.Sprinkle with a little water, mix and let it cook with the lid closed.
2. This will take around 10 minutes.Once the ivy gourds are cooked yet firm, add the lentil spice mix and stir well.Let the ivy gourds roast on low flame for another 10 minutes, and occasionally keep stirring the mix in between.Switch off the flame once it is done.Serve the spicy Kovakkai Podi Curry Recipe along with Steamed Rice, Tomato Onion sambar, Pepper Rasam and Curd for a full course Tamil Nadu Style lunch.

title: Chicken Sausages, Baked Beans And Stir Fried Broccoli Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Chicken Sausages, Baked Beans And Stir Fried Broccoli Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Chicken Sausages, Baked Beans And Stir Fried Broccoli Recipe (World Breakfast).
Ingredients: Chicken sausage, teaspoon Butter, grams Dry beans - (such as cannellini or soya beans), teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Onion, Clove, Tomatoe, tablespoon Honey - or more to taste, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), teaspoon Dried oregano, /4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder - or cayenne pepper, Salt, cup Broccoli - cut into small florets, Clove, teaspoon Dried Thyme Leaves, teaspoon Dried oregano, Salt - To Taste, Black pepper powder - for seasoning
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chicken Sausages, Baked Beans and Stir Fried Broccoli Recipe, we will first make the baked beans.
2. Soak the beans overnight for about 8 hours in water.We also have to make the cooked tomato puree.
3. Once the beans are soaked well, our next step is to cook them.
4. Place the beans in the pressure, place the weight on, cover the pan and cook it along with 2-1/2 cups of water.
5. After 4 to 5 whistles, turn the heat to low and cook for another 15 minutes.Turn off the heat and allow the pressure cooker to release its pressure naturally.
6. This would take another 10 minutes.
7. The beans continue to cook under the pressure even when it is turned off.Once the pressure is released, open the cooker and drain out the excess liquids.
8. You store this liquid and use it in the vegetable stock or risotto.Once the beans are cooked, our next step is to spice it up to make the baked beans.Heat oil in a sauce pan on medium heat; add in the onions and garlic and give it a light sauté until the onions are tender.
9. Add the tomatoes, honey and the spices and give it a stir.Add in the cooked drained beans into the tomato gravy.
10. Stir fry the beans until the beans get well coated with the tomatoes.
11. Cover the pan, turn the heat to low and simmer the beans for about 30 minutes until you noticed the beans are well coated with the spices and tomatoes.
12. Check the salt and seasoning levels and adjust to suit your taste.To Stir fry the BroccoliHeat a sauce pan with oil, add garlic and sauté them till they soften.
13. Add broccoli and season it well with all the seasonings.Sprinkle little water and cook the broccoli for about 5 more minutes till they become quiet tender.
14. Check for salt and switch off the heat.To Cook the sausagesBefore you fry the sausages over a pan, make sure the sausages are not frozen and they are thawed well.Prick the sausages with the fork, place a wide pan with 1 inch water and butter.
15. Bring it to a boil.Once it begins to boil, place the sausages inside.
16. Keep turning them until all the water is evaporated and till you can deglaze the pan.
17. Brown the sausages well on all the sides.The sausages will take about 10 minutes to cook and you can serve it over a plate.To plate, place the sausages over the side, add baked beans, place the stir fried broccoli and keep a garlic bread next to it and serve.
18. Serve the Chicken Sausages, Baked Beans and Stir Fried Broccoli Recipe along with a glass of Cantaloupe Pomegranate and Mint Juice Recipe for your Sunday brunch.

title: Crispy Chicken Pakoda Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Crispy Chicken Pakoda Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Crispy Chicken Pakoda Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Chicken, Ginger, /2 teaspoons Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, Green Chillies - Slit, sprig Curry leaves, Whole Egg, tablespoon Gram flour (besan), tablespoon Corn flour, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - to deep fry
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Crispy Chicken Pakoda Recipe, clean and wash chicken pieces well.Add chicken pieces, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, pepper powder, salt to taste into a large bowl and mix well to combine.
2. Next add gram flour, corn flour, and mix again to coat all chicken pieces well.finally add the egg and mix again.
3. Cover and let it sit in the fridge to marinate for about 15 minutes.Heat oil in a Pan for deep frying, on a medium flame.Add a handful of chicken pieces into the oil separately.
4. Do not over crowd the kadai.
5. Remove from oil when cooked well and crisp and drain excess oil on kitchen towel.Repeat deep frying all the chicken pieces in batches.
6. At last slit green chilies and curry leaves into the oil and mix with the deep fried Chicken Pakoda and serve hot.Serve Crispy Chicken Pakoda immediately with tomato sauce or any delicious dip like Mirchicha Chatka or Peanut Chilli Dipping Sauce during tea time.

title: Turkish Chicken Gozleme Recipe-Stuffed Spinach Chicken Bread
content:
Recipe Name: Turkish Chicken Gozleme Recipe-Stuffed Spinach Chicken Bread
Description: A flavorful and authentic Middle Eastern recipe for Turkish Chicken Gozleme Recipe-Stuffed Spinach Chicken Bread (Main Course).
Ingredients: /2 cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), /2 cup Whole Wheat Flour, /4 cup Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt), Salt - To Taste, grams Chicken - minced, cup Spinach Leaves (Palak) - finely chopped, Onion, Clove, Tomatoe, tablespoon Cumin powder (Jeera), Tablespoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 teaspoon Paprika powder, teaspoon Black pepper powder, sprig Mint Leaves (Pudina) - chopped, Onion, Salt - To Taste, grams Feta Cheese - crumbled
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Turkish Chicken Gozleme Recipe, we will first knead the dough for the bread and keep it ready.In a mixing bowl add all the flour, curd, salt to taste and knead well with little water to form a firm dough.
2. Once done cover with a damp cloth and rest the dough.For the Gozleme StuffingHeat a skillet on medium heat with oil, add chopped garlic and saute till it softens.
3. Add chopped onions and saute till they turn golden brown.Add in tomatoes and sprinkle little salt and cook until the tomatoes turn mushy.
4. At this stage add the minced chicken and add all the spice powders, paprika, cumin, coriander and pepper.
5. Saute till the chicken is cooked.
6. This will take about 3 to 4 minutes.Once done add chopped spinach leaves and mint leaves to the chicken Gozleme mixture and saute till the leaves wilt and all the moisture is evaporated.Check for seasonings and adjust if required.
7. Once done turn off the heat and allow it to cool down.To make the Chicken GozlemeDivide the dough the into 3 equal portions.
8. Take one portion and flatten it on the rolling surface, dust it with some flour and roll it flat to thin  circle.Add the chicken stuffing in the centre, sprinkle the chopped spring onions and crumbled feta cheese on top.Fold the dough from either side and seal it tightly so that it doesn’t open up.
9. You will get a rectangular shaped flat stuffed bread - Chicken Gozleme.Heat a flat skillet, place the Chicken Gozleme and toast it on either side for couple of minutes until you see the dough is getting partially cooked.Drizzle oil on the Chicken Gozleme and cook till your notice brown spots on both sides.
10. Once done, remove the Chicken Gozleme from the pan and serve hot.Serve the Turkish Chicken Gozleme Recipe along with Pickled onions, lemon wedges and Couscous Raw Mango Salad by the side to make weekend meals special.

title: Moon Biscuits Recipe (Moon Shaped Baked Cookies)
content:
Recipe Name: Moon Biscuits Recipe (Moon Shaped Baked Cookies)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Moon Biscuits Recipe (Moon Shaped Baked Cookies) (Appetizers).
Ingredients: grams Vivatta Maida, grams Sugar, Salt, grams Milk Powder, pinch Baking powder, /2 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
Instructions:
1. To begin making Moon Biscuits Recipe (Moon Shaped Baked Cookies), first take maida, milk powder, and baking powder and combine them well.Now add the softened butter, confectionery sugar (powdered sugar) and vanilla extract into a bowl.Combine the butter mixture well and add in the dry ingredients and make a dough.Now preheat the oven at 350°F,take a rolling pin and flatten the dough by using a round cookie cutter cut the dough in to moon shape cookies.Arrange them on baking tray now set the cooking time to15 mins and place the tray into the oven.
2. Cool them before serving.Serve Moon Biscuits Recipe (Moon Shaped Baked Cookies) during tea time with Masala Chai Recipe - Indian Spiced Tea and Karachi Biscuits Recipe.

title: Andaman Style Steamed Garlic Prawns Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Andaman Style Steamed Garlic Prawns Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Side Dish recipe for Andaman Style Steamed Garlic Prawns Recipe (Non Vegeterian).
Ingredients: Prawns, tablespoon Soy sauce, teaspoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil, Clove, Green Chillies - finely chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Pepper, Lemon Juice, Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Andaman Style Steamed Garlic Prawns recipe, in a heat proof boil collect chopped garlic and green chilies and keep aside.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a pan till smoking hot, and pour the hot oil immediately over the chopped garlic and chilies.
3. Wait till they crackle and leaves and aroma.
4. Set aside to cool.While the garlic oil is cooling, set up a steamer and place the prawns in a pan/plate that will go inside the steamer.
5. Pour the garlic infused oil all over the prawns and gently rub them, season with some salt and set to marinade till the steamer gets ready.
6. Now steam the prawns for around 8 to 10 minutes.
7. Meanwhile mix soy sauce and sesame oil in a small bowl.Take out the cooked prawns and spoon the sauce mix all over.
8. Sprinkle some freshly crushed black pepper and some chopped coriander.
9. Drizzle some lemon juice over the prawns if you like or else skip it.
10. Serve hot.
11. Serve Andaman Style Steamed Garlic Prawns as a side dish along with steamed rice and Jeera Rasam for a weekday meal.

title: Rock Toast Recipe - Semolina Bread Toast
content:
Recipe Name: Rock Toast Recipe - Semolina Bread Toast
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Rock Toast Recipe - Semolina Bread Toast (Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: /2 cup Sooji (Semolina/ Rava), /4 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), Onion, /2 cup Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - finely chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Green Chilli - finely chopped, teaspoon Black pepper powder, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - for cooking the toast
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Rock Toast, in a mixing bowl, combine semolina, yogurt, onion, capsicum, coriander leaves, green chilli, salt and pepper powder.Adjust the topping mixture with a little water, making sure you get a spreadable consistency.
2. Let it sit aside for about 5-7 minutes.
3. In the meanwhile, heat a griddle on medium flame, spread some oil.Take a slice of bread, spread the semolina topping on it with a spoon and place the bread in a way that the topping is  facing  down on the griddle.Cook this on medium-high heat for about three minutes and flip.Remove from the tawa and serve hot.Serve this Rock Toast along with tomato ketchup or Dhaniya Pudina Chutney and Homemade Pomegranate Juice with Ginger Recipe

title: Potato Vindaloo Recipe (Spicy Goan Potato Curry)
content:
Recipe Name: Potato Vindaloo Recipe (Spicy Goan Potato Curry)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Goan Recipes recipe for Potato Vindaloo Recipe (Spicy Goan Potato Curry) (Main Course).
Ingredients: Kashmiri dry red chillies - deseeded and soaked in hot water for 1/2 hour, /4 teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds) - roasted, Clove, Shallots - peeled, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Vinegar, /3 cup Water - as required to grind to puree, Potatoes (Aloo) - cleaned, Salt, Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Curry leaves, Water - Enough for boiling potatoes, /2 Teaspoon Sugar
Instructions:
1. To begin making Potato Vindaloo Recipe first place a large sauce pan or heavy bottomed pot on the heat.Add the chopped potatoes into it, cover them with water, add a little salt and place it on the heat.
2. Bring it to a boil and simmer it until the potatoes are par-cooked.
3. They should be soft when a knife is inserted into them, but they shouldnt be mushy and give way.Strain the potatoes, reserving some boiled water separately, and keep both aside for later use.In a mixer jar add all the ingredients under "For the Vindaloo paste" list and grind them into a fine, smooth paste.Next, place a kadai on the heat, add some oil and mustard seeds to it.
4. Allow it to sputter, and then add curry leaves.When the curry leaves are crisp, add the vindaloo paste and saute until the raw smell goes away and oil begins to separate at the edges.Add 1/2 cup of reserved water in which the potatoes were cooked water, the boiled potatoes, check for salt and adjust as required.Cook the curry together, stirring in between until the curry thickens.
5. This may take 10-12 minutes.Sprinkle some sugar and stir once before switching off.
6. Add additional curry leaves in the end and serve hot with Vegetable Biryani and Raita or Bread.

title: Aloo Potol Posto Recipe (Aloo Parwal In Poppy Seed Masala Recipe)
content:
Recipe Name: Aloo Potol Posto Recipe (Aloo Parwal In Poppy Seed Masala Recipe)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Aloo Potol Posto Recipe (Aloo Parwal In Poppy Seed Masala Recipe) (Main Course).
Ingredients: Pointed gourd (Parval) - cut into wedges, to 4 Potatoes (Aloo) - skin peeled, /2 teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf), Cloves (Laung), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Dry Red Chilli, Ginger, /2 Cup Fresh Coconut - Grated, tablespoon Poppy seeds, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Green Chillies - finely chopped, Teaspoon Sugar, Salt - To Taste, Mustard oil - as required for cooking
Instructions:
1. We begin making Aloo Potol Posto Recipe (Aloo Parwal in Poppy Seed Masala Recipe) heat the pan with oil and roast by adding methi,cumin, fennel,cloves,cardamom, dry red chilli along with ginger, grated coconut and poppy seeds.
2. Fry till the aroma comes out.Cool and transfer it into a blender.
3. Blend it to a fine paste and keep it aside.Heat oil in a kadai and saute the parawal with turmeric powder till it turns brown and softens.Remove and keep it aside.
4. Keep the potatoes boiled and ready as well.
5. With the leftover oil temper green chilies and add the (coconut-poppy seed) masala paste.
6. Sprinkle the spice powders and fry till the oil comes out from the masala.Finally add the vegetables.
7. Add water and cook it for some more time for about 10 minutes .Serve your delicious and spicy Aloo Potol Posto (Aloo Parwal in Poppy Seed Masala) with layered Lachaa Paratha.

title: Aloo Bhey Ki Sabzi Recipe (Potato Lotus Stem Curry)
content:
Recipe Name: Aloo Bhey Ki Sabzi Recipe (Potato Lotus Stem Curry)
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Aloo Bhey Ki Sabzi Recipe (Potato Lotus Stem Curry) (Main Course).
Ingredients: Potatoes (Aloo) - peeled and diced, cup Lotus Stem - sliced round, /2 cup Homemade tomato puree, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoons Turmeric powder (Haldi), /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, teaspoon Garam masala powder, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - For Cooking, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Onion, Garlic, Inch Ginger, Green Chillie
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Aloo Bhey Ki Sabzi Recipe, we will first prep all the various components.First of all, place the ingredients listed under “Ingredients to be made into a paste” into a blender and grind them down into a smooth paste.
2. Pour it into a bowl and set it aside for later.Then add 3 small tomatoes into the blender and blend them to a puree.
3. Pour the puree into a bowl and set that aside too.Now to make the sabzi, heat some oil in a pressure cooker.
4. When it is warm enough, add asafetida and cumin seeds and let them crackle.Next add the prepared onion garlic paste and saute well for 3-4 minutes until the paste turns golden-brown and the raw smell goes away.Next add the red chilli powder, turmeric and coriander powder.
5. Top with salt and continue to cook for 2 minutes more.At this stage, when the masalas are all cooked through, pour in the prepared tomato puree and cook for another 3-4 minutes, stirring continuously, until you see oil leaving the sides of the pan.
6. This is an indication that the masalas are cooked through.Now add cubed potato and lotus stem rounds, stir well and cook for 2-3 minutes.Top it up with 2 cups of water and cover the pressure.
7. Allow the sabzi to cook covered for 2 whistles.Turn the heat off and allow the pressure to release natural.
8. When the weight can be lifted and the lid comes off with ease, open the cooked and simmer the sabzi for 5 minutes.
9. This will allow some excess water to evaporate.
10. At this stage you can taste for salt and spice and adjust both accordingly.When done, take the pressure cooked off the heat, pour the sabzi into a serving bowl and serve hot with Phulkas and Pumpkin Dal Tadka

title: Classic Grilled Tomato Cucumber Chutney Sandwich Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Classic Grilled Tomato Cucumber Chutney Sandwich Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Classic Grilled Tomato Cucumber Chutney Sandwich Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Whole Wheat Brown Bread, Tomatoe, Cucumber - peeled and sliced into thin rounds, Salt, Black pepper powder - to sprinkle, Chaat Masala Powder - to sprinkle, tablespoons Butter, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), tablespoons Tomato Ketchup
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Classic Tomato Cucumber Chutney Sandwich with Chutney Recipe, arrange two slices of bread next to each other.Spread tomato ketchup on one slice and the Dhaniya Pudina Chutney on the other slice.
2. Arrange the sliced tomato & cucumber slices on one of slice.
3. Sprinkle some chaat masala powder, pepper powder and salt.
4. Close the sandwich with the other slice.Heat a grill sandwich maker, lightly spread butter on the outside and cook until  it turns golden brown, around 3-4 minutes or when the light turns off on the sandwich maker.If you don't have a sandwich maker, you can grill the sandwich on the tawa no medium heat until each one of the sides turn golden brown and crisp.
5. Once the Tomato Cucumber Chutney Sandwich is grilled well, place it on a platter and cut into triangles and serve.Serve the Classic Grilled Tomato Cucumber Chutney Sandwich for a quick weeknight dinner and serve it along with Indian Style Beetroot Soup Recipe and Bean Sprout & Corn Salad Recipe for a weeknight dinner, simple serve the sandwich along with a glass of Chikoo Banana Date Smoothie as an after school snack for kids.

title: Homemade Granola Mix Recipe With Oats & Wheat Flakes
content:
Recipe Name: Homemade Granola Mix Recipe With Oats & Wheat Flakes
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Homemade Granola Mix Recipe With Oats & Wheat Flakes (World Breakfast).
Ingredients: /2 cup Instant Oats (Oatmeal), /2 cup Wheat Flakes (Cereal), tablespoon Pine nuts, tablespoons Pumpkin seeds, tablespoon Dates - (dried ones) finely chopped, tablespoon Dried raspberries, Raisin, tablespoon Badam (Almond), tablespoon Walnuts, Cinnamon, Nutmeg, /2 tablespoon Vanilla Extract, /2 teaspoon Sunflower Oil, tablespoon Honey
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Homemade Granola Mix Recipe with Oats & Wheat Flakes, heat a wok or a heavy bottomed pan over medium heat and gently roast the oats until they turn crisp and lightly golden.Once roasted, remove from the pan and keep aside.
2. Heat the vegetable oil in the same pan over medium heat.
3. Add all the nuts and seeds and roast them for about 5 minutes.Once the nuts and seeds are roasted, add the dried dates, raspberries and sultanas along with the honey and vanilla essence.
4. Roast for another couple of minutes.
5. Finally add in the tossed oats, wheat flakes, cinnamon and nutmeg powderUsing a spatula mix everything thoroughlyOnce they are cooled down the Homemade Granola Mix with Oats & Wheat Flakes is ready.
6. Store them in an airtight container for a few weeks.Serve the Homemade Granola Mix with Oats & Wheat Flakes crunchy for breakfast along with fresh milk & fruits or as an evening snack for kids or can be even used as a topping for smoothies.

title: Baingan Sarson Ka Saag Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Baingan Sarson Ka Saag Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Baingan Sarson Ka Saag Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Small Brinjal (Baingan / Eggplant) - quartered, grams Mustard greens, Onion, Clove, Ginger, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Garam masala powder, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Salt - To Taste, tablespoons Mustard oil - for cooking
Instructions:
1. To begin making Baingan Sarson Ka Saag Recipe first prep all the ingredients and keep aside.
2. Quarter the brinjal and keep them in salted water till you use them.
3. Keeping them in salted water prevents discolouration of the brinjal.Wash and chop the mustard greens ( sarson ka saag) roughly and keep them aside.
4. Next heat oil in a deep pan or wok and once the oil has reached a smoking point reduce the heat to medium.
5. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle.
6. Then add onions, ginger and garlic and saute till the onions are cooked.Now add the drained and cut brinjal slices to the pan and saute.
7. Sprinkle some water, cover and cook the brinjal till its cooked through and is well roasted.This will take about 4 to 5 minutes.Once the brinjal is well roasted, softened and cooked through, add all the dry spices to the pan, chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, amchur powder, salt and saute for a minute till all the brinjal is well coated with the masalas.
8. Finally add the chopped mustard leaves to the brinjals and cover and cook till the mustard greens are cooked through.
9. This will take about 3 to 4 minutes as well.Check the salt and seasonings of the Baingan Sarson Ka Saag and adjust according to taste.Once done, turn off the heat and transfer the Baingan Sarson Ka Saag to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve Baingan Sarson Ka Saag with Phulka , Panchmel Dal and Lauki Raita for a lovely weekday lunch.

title: Kalyana Veetu Senai Curry Recipe - South Indian Spicy Roasted Yam
content:
Recipe Name: Kalyana Veetu Senai Curry Recipe - South Indian Spicy Roasted Yam
Description: A flavorful and authentic Tamil Nadu recipe for Kalyana Veetu Senai Curry Recipe - South Indian Spicy Roasted Yam (Side Dish).
Ingredients: grams Elephant yam (Suran/Senai/Ratalu) - cut into 1 inch thin pieces, /2 Cup Fresh Coconut - Grated, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Curry leaves - few, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Mustard Seed, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Sambar Powder, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - as required for frying
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Kalyana Veetu Senai Curry Recipe, add the cut yam pieces into a pressure cooker with 1/4 cup of water, 1/2 turmeric powder and salt and pressure cook the yam for one whistle and keep aside.Preheat oil in a pan over medium heat; add the mustard seeds and allow it to splutter.Once the mustard seeds crackle, stir in the hing and curry leaves and saute for few seconds.After a few seconds, add the grated coconut and roast for about minute until it turns golden in colour and releases an aroma.
2. At this stage, add the red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, sambar powder and saute for a few seconds and add the cooked yam.
3. Stir well until all the masalas coat the yam - about a minute.The yam, tends to get a little dry, as it combines with the masala; you could add a little more oil to help give the yam a little more crispy texture and also help the masalas to get absorbed well into the Senai Curry.Once you notice the masalas are well coated and the Kalyana Veetu Senai Curry has a slightly roasted texture, check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste.Once done, turn off the heat and transfer the Kalyana Veetu Senai Curry to a serving bowl and serve hot.Serve Kalyana Veetu Senai Curry along with Keerai Sambar and Steamed Rice for a weekday lunch.
4. You can also pack it in your Lunch Box along with Palak Raita and Tawa Paratha.

title: Chettinad Takkali Sadam Recipe (Chettinad Style Tomato Rice)
content:
Recipe Name: Chettinad Takkali Sadam Recipe (Chettinad Style Tomato Rice)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Chettinad recipe for Chettinad Takkali Sadam Recipe (Chettinad Style Tomato Rice) (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Rice - cooked, Tomatoe, Onion, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Green Chilli - slit, Mint Leaves (Pudina) - fistful, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Cinnamon, Cloves (Laung), sprig Curry leaves, Tablespoon Ghee, Salt - To Taste, Ginger, Clove, Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf)
Instructions:
1.
