To begin making Chettinad Takkali Sadam Recipe, cook the rice to a fluffy texture and keep aside.Also, coarsely pound the ginger, garlic and fennel seeds using a mortar and pestle and keep aside.Heat ghee in a pan on medium flame, add the cinnamon stick and cloves and let it splutter.Add the ginger, garlic and fennel seeds mix and saute until the raw smell goes away.Add the curry leaves and sliced onions and saute until the onions turn translucent.Add the tomatoes and saute until its half cooked.Now, add the slit green chilli, red chilli powder, mint and coriander leaves and mix well.Season with salt and cook the mix until the tomatoes are well cooked and the whole mixture comes together.
2. This will take around 10 minutes.Now, add the cooked rice and mix it evenly using a fork.Let it simmer for 5 minutes and switch off the flame.Serve the Chettinad Takkali Sadam Recipe along with Cauliflower & Cucumber Raita Recipe (Cauliflower Yogurt Salad) for lunch or for kids lunchbox.

title: Thai Yellow Coconut Curry Rice Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Thai Yellow Coconut Curry Rice Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Thai recipe for Thai Yellow Coconut Curry Rice Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Cinnamon, Ginger, tablespoon Turmeric powder (Haldi), teaspoons Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoons Fennel seeds (Saunf), Pepper, Cloves Garlic, teaspoon Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds, teaspoon Mace (Javitri), cups Jasmine Rice, cup Coconut milk, Salt, tablespoons Coconut Oil, Onion, Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) - sliced thin, Gawar Phali (Kothavarangai / Cluster beans) - chopped into half, Ginger, Stalks Lemongrass - fresh minced, Clove, Tablespoon Lemon Juice, tablespoon Jaggery, Salt - To Taste, Thai basil leaves - for garnish
Instructions:
1. We begin making the Thai Yellow Coconut Curry Rice Recipe by boiling  milk and 1 cup of water in a sauce pan.In the meantime roast the cumin seeds, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, peppercorns and cinnamon sticks slightly.
2. Once that is done grind it along with the rest of the ingredients in a mixer to a smooth paste.Add this paste along with rice and bring it to a boil.
3. Cook till the rice till it becomes soft and cooked.
4. In the middle when the rice start to absorb all the moisture add the lime leaves and lemon grass.In another pan, heat oil and saute the onions,ginger, garlic, bell peppers and cluster beans . Cook till it is soft and crunchy.Add these vegetable to the rice along with jaggery.
5. Give it stir and make sure the rice does not stick to the bottom of the pan.
6. Once the rice cooked taste for salt and season it well.At the end drizzle some lime juice and serve Serve the Thai Yellow Coconut Curry Rice Recipe as a one pot meal for a Sunday Lunch

title: Bael Ka Sharbat Recipe - Wood Apple Squash Drink
content:
Recipe Name: Bael Ka Sharbat Recipe - Wood Apple Squash Drink
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Bael Ka Sharbat Recipe - Wood Apple Squash Drink (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Wood apple (bael fruit), tablespoons Jaggery - or sugar, Salt, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Lemon Juice, Mint Leaves (Pudina) - as required, Water - chilled, Ice cubes
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Bael Ka Sharbat recipe, muddle the mint leaves and keep aside.Break open the fruit by hitting on the floor.
2. Scoop out the pulp in a large bowl using a spoon or a scooper.Pour in some water and mash the pulp with your hands so as to separate the seeds.Now strain the liquid using a sieve separating the seeds and the fiber.
3. Repeat the process once again, adding some more water.Add sugar/ jaggery, lemon juice and the remaining spices which includes black salt and cumin powder.
4. Add in the muddled mint leaves.Add water, ice cubes and mix Bael Ka Sharbat properly.
5. Adjust the quantity of the spices according to your preference and serve.Serve Bael Ka Sharbat on its own as a summer drink to your family.
6. You can also serve this to your guests as a welcome drink along with Baked Chevdo Recipe (Chivda Mixture -Tea Time Snack) and Baked Mathri Recipe (Non Fried Tea Time Snack).

title: Karnataka Style Gorai Kai Kara Recipe - Cluster Beans Chutney
content:
Recipe Name: Karnataka Style Gorai Kai Kara Recipe - Cluster Beans Chutney
Description: A flavorful and authentic Karnataka recipe for Karnataka Style Gorai Kai Kara Recipe - Cluster Beans Chutney (South Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: Gawar Phali (Kothavarangai / Cluster beans) - chopped, Ginger, Clove, Green Chillies - chopped, tablespoons Roasted Peanuts (Moongphali) - dry roasted, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), grams Tamarind, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, teaspoon White Urad Dal (Split), Pinch Asafoetida (Hing)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Karnataka Style Gorai Kai Kara Recipe (Cluster Beans Chutney Recipe), firstly begin by washing the cluster beans and removing the two pointed ends.
2. Chop them half and keep it aside.Heat a kadai with oil and splutter cumin seeds, coriander seeds and curry leaves.
3. Add the chopped onions and sauté them till it turns translucent.Once the onions are translucent, add the chopped garlic, ginger, green chilies and the cluster beans.
4. Add salt and fry them till it is cooked.
5. You can cover it with the lid and let it cook over medium heat.Once that is done let it cool down and add it in a mixer along with tamarind and roasted peanuts.
6. Grind this into a smooth paste.
7. The next step is to make the tempering for the chutney.
8. Heat required oil in a tadka pan.
9. When the oil is hot, add in the mustard seeds, urad dal, asafoetida, curry leaves and let the mustard seeds splutter.
10. Once done, switch off the gas and pour the tempering over the chutney and give it a mix.
11. Your chutney is ready to be served.Serve the Karnataka Style Gorai Kai Kara Recipe along with Ghee Roast Dosa and Filter Coffee for your morning breakfast.

title: Kunafa With Mango Cottage Cheese Cream Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Kunafa With Mango Cottage Cheese Cream Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Arab recipe for Kunafa With Mango Cottage Cheese Cream Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: grams Kataifi dough - ready made, grams Butter, tablespoons Sugar, tablespoon Rose water, /2 cups Sugar, /2 cups Water, Lemon Juice, teaspoon Rose water, Saffron strands - few, cup Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese), /2 cup Mango Pulp (Puree), /2 cup Icing Sugar, teaspoons Thandai Masala, grams Heavy whipping cream, /2 cup Fresh cream, tablespoons Pistachios - crushed, tablespoons Dried rose petals
Instructions:
1. To begin making Kunafa With Mango Cottage Cheese Cream Recipe, start by making the  Syrup and the mango Cream.Make sugar syrup by boiling water and sugar.
2. When the sugar has dissolved, boil for 3 to 4 minutes and switch off the flame and add lemon juice.
3. Add in Saffron strands and rose water to the sugar syrup.
4. Set aside to cool completely.With the help of hand blender, blend together all the ingredients listed under *for the Mango Cream till very well combined and keep this Icing in the Fridge.Preheat the oven at 180 degree Celsius for 15 minutes.In the meanwhile, prepare the dough by loosening kataifi dough in a large bowl.Melt the butter and add this to the kataifi dough slowly, while breaking and separating its strands.Add in the sugar and rose water to the kataifi to mix thoroughly, to get kunafa dough.Grease the dish in which you want to bake the kunafa for Kunafa With Mango Cottage Cheese Cream Recipe.
5. Spread a layer of the prepared kunafa dough.
6. Press it a little bit and spread some more dough.I wanted a Crescent Moon shape so I took dough and arranged it in a spring form pan in crescent moon and star shape.
7. I also used 2 more spring form pans for utilizing the rest of the dough.Put the prepared pans in the preheated oven and let the kunafa bake at 180 degree Celsius for about 20-25 minutes or until lightly golden in color.
8. The bottom side will be more golden brown when you flip it.Immediately pour cold sugar syrup evenly over the hot kunafa.
9. Let it cool completely at room temperature.
10. Invert onto a serving plate.When it is completely cooled put sufficient Mango Cream on the Kunafa.
11. Garnish with Crushed Pistachios and Rose petals.Serve Kunafa With Mango Cottage Cheese Cream as a desert along with a meal of Foxtail Millet Pilaf , Delicious Spinach Falafels and Okra Bamia .

title: Royal Bread Gulab Jamun Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Royal Bread Gulab Jamun Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Royal Bread Gulab Jamun Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: Whole Wheat Brown Bread, cup Milk, grams Khoya (Mawa), cup Sugar, /4 cup Badam (Almond) - finely chopped, Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Royal Bread Gulab Jamun Recipe, first combine the khoya and chopped dry fruits in a bowl and keep aside.Cut out the sides of the milk bread.Now dip each bread slice in milk and squeeze out the milk.Knead the bread slices to make a soft dough.
2. Knead the dough well and make small balls with the bread dough.Flatten the dough in the palm of your hands and place a small portion of the khoya and nuts mixture in the center.
3. Seal and cover the jamun and make small round balls.Proceed the same way with the remaining dough portions.In a saucepan, heat the sugar with 2 cups water and make a syrup of one string consistency.
4. Keep this aside.Heat oil or ghee for deep frying over medium heat.
5. Once the oil is heated, deep fry the bread jamun balls in the ghee until it turns golden brown.
6. Drain the excess oil and dip the Bread Jamuns in the sugar syrup.Allow the jamuns to soak well into the syrup and fluff up.
7. Once its absorbed the syrup and fluffed up the Bread Jamuns are ready to be served.Serve the Bread Gulab Jamun for a party at home or even for special occasions and festivals like Diwali, Holi and Raksha Bandhan.

title: Safed Achari Baingan Recipe - White Aubergine In Pickled Spices
content:
Recipe Name: Safed Achari Baingan Recipe - White Aubergine In Pickled Spices
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Safed Achari Baingan Recipe - White Aubergine In Pickled Spices (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Brinjal (Baingan / Eggplant), Onion, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Inch Ginger - Grated, Clove, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Tablespoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Tomato - chopped, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf), Onion, teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), /4 Teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Dry Red Chillie, Sunflower Oil - For Cooking
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Achari Baingan Recipe, we will first make the achari masala.To prepare marinade for Achari masala, in a pan add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, nigella seed, carom seeds, fenugreek seeds and dry red chilies.
2. Dry roast the spices and chilies over medium heat till fragrant and slightly browned.
3. Turn off the heat.
4. Transfer spices to the jar of mixer and grind into a coarse powder.
5. Keep the achari powder aside.Wash and clean baingan and keep aside.Heat oil in a wok and add mustard and cumin seeds in it and wait till they crackle.Add chopped onions and saute till raw smell goes off.
6. Now add ginger garlic paste and fry well till golden.Now add turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder and the achari masala along with chopped tomatoesSaute until the tomatoes soften.
7. Meanwhile slit the baingan from the middle into two but keep the joint intact.
8. This is done so that the masala gets inside the aubergine nicely while cooking.Add the baingan in the fried masala and mix well such that everything incorporates well.Add little amchur if required and stir well.
9. Add little water just to make sure the masala doesn't stick to the bottom of the heavy bottomed pan.Add salt as per your taste and slow cook the baingan in low flame with lid closed.Once the baingan softens, turn off the heat and garnish with freshly chopped coriander and stir.Serve the Safed Achari Baingan Recipe along with hot Phulkas smeared with ghee or along with hot steamed rice as a one dish dinner or a quick weeknight dinner.

title: Potlakaya Perugu Pachadi Recipe (Curd And Snake Gourd Chutney)
content:
Recipe Name: Potlakaya Perugu Pachadi Recipe (Curd And Snake Gourd Chutney)
Description: A flavorful and authentic South Indian Recipes recipe for Potlakaya Perugu Pachadi Recipe (Curd And Snake Gourd Chutney) (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Snake gourd (pudulangai) - finely chopped (approximately 1 cup), cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), /2 Cup Fresh Coconut - Grated, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, Dry Red Chilli - broken into pieces, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing)
Instructions:
1. To begin the preparation of Potlakaya Perugu Pachadi Recipe, first heat a small pan and add oil.
2. Add the finely chopped snake gourd pieces.
3. Fry for a few seconds.
4. Add salt and cover the pan.Let it cook for 2-3 minutes.
5. Ensure the pieces do not get burnt, by checking in between.Once the pieces are cooked, add grated coconut and mix well.
6. Turn off the flame, and let it cool down.For the seasoning, heat a small pan, add jeera and mustard.Let the mustard seeds splutter.
7. Add red chilli pieces, hing and saute.
8. If you prefer, add turmeric and put off the flame.Transfer the cooked snake gourd pieces and coconut to a bowl.Add curd.
9. Add the seasoning and mix well.Serve this gentle Potlakaya Perugu Pachadi with hot rice for a weekday lunch.

title: Karela Dahi Puri Recipe - A Chatpata Chaat Made From Bitter Gourd
content:
Recipe Name: Karela Dahi Puri Recipe - A Chatpata Chaat Made From Bitter Gourd
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Karela Dahi Puri Recipe - A Chatpata Chaat Made From Bitter Gourd (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Karela (Bitter Gourd/ Pavakkai) - sliced into rounds, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder - (adjust), Pinch Asafoetida (Hing), /4 cup Gram flour (besan), Salt, Sunflower Oil - as needed, /4 cup Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt), teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder, tablespoon Sweet Chutney (Date & Tamarind), /2 cup Sev, /4 cup Aloo Bhujia - (optional), Dates - few, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making Karela Dahi Puri Recipe, heat about 2 cups of water in a saucepan and add all the sliced bitter gourd in it and boil for about 2 minutes or until semi cooked.Strain the karela slices out of water and keep aside.In a mixing bowl, add the gram flour, red chili powder, black salt, coriander powder and asafoetida.Toss the bitter gourd slices into this mixture.
2. Sprinkle some water if needed and mix till it is coated well.Heat oil in a pan for shallow frying and fry the spiced bitter gourd in batches until done and crisp.
3. Whisk the yogurt along with chaat masala powder and keep aside.Arrange the pan fried karela slices in a plate.
4. Drizzle the spiced chatpata yogurt, tamarind chutney on each slice.
5. Spread bhujia & sev, dates and garnish with chopped coriander and serve.
6. Serve Karela Dahi Puri along with a hot cup of Masala Tea or Filter Coffee for evening snacks.

title: Kasuri Methi Aur Aloo Rasedar Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Kasuri Methi Aur Aloo Rasedar Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Kasuri Methi Aur Aloo Rasedar Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: cups Potatoes (Aloo) - boiled and roughly mashed, Tomatoe, Ginger, Green Chillies - Slit, tablespoons Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves) - (adjust), /2 teaspoon Fennel seeds (Saunf), Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Tablespoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Garam masala powder, teaspoons Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Tablespoon Ghee, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making Kasuri Methi Aur Aloo Rasedar Recipe, first boil the potatoes using a pressure cooker.
2. Once done, peel and roughly mash the potatoes keep a few pieces intact.Heat ghee in a wok on medium heat, add cumin seeds, fennel and methi seeds and let it splutter.Add the dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), and let its aroma release into the oil.Add the ginger paste, slit green chillies and saute until the raw smell goes away.Add the chopped tomatoes and saute until its half cooked.Add the coriander, turmeric, cumin and red chilli powder and saute for 2 minutes.Now, add the roughly mashed potatoes and two cups of water and mix well.Season with salt, aamchoor powder and simmer the mixture for 5 to 6 minutes.Once the gravy comes together and reaches your desired consistency, switch off the flame.Garnish with a teaspoon of kasuri methi and serve the Kasuri Methi Aur Aloo Rasedar Recipe along with Parathas

title: Sprouted Matki Cheela Recipe With Palak -Moth Beans Cheela
content:
Recipe Name: Sprouted Matki Cheela Recipe With Palak -Moth Beans Cheela
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Sprouted Matki Cheela Recipe With Palak -Moth Beans Cheela (North Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: cup Moth Sprouts (Matki), /2 cup White Urad Dal (Split) - soaked for 4 hours, Green Chillie, Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf), Inch Ginger, cup Spinach Leaves (Palak) - coarsely ground, Salt - To Taste, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Sunflower Oil - For Cooking
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Sprouted Moth Cheela Recipe With Palak, we need to keep the sprouts ready.In a Mixer jar combine moth sprouts, soaked and drained urad dal, green chilies, fennel seeds and ginger, grind to a smooth paste.Transfer into a mixing bowl, mix in the finely chopped methi coarsely ground palak leaves, salt and turmeric.
2. Check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste.The cheela batter will be similar to the consistency of a dosa batter or pancake batter.
3. The batter should be able coat the back of the spoon.Preheat a skillet on medium heat, pour a ladleful of cheela batter on the pan and spread it in a circular motion to form a thin crepe/ dosa.Drizzle some oil around the Sprouted Moth Cheela Recipe With Palak and cook it until the top does not look raw and you notice the edges are getting brown.
4. Flip and cook the matki cheela on the other side for a few seconds.Once done, transfer the Sprouted Moth Cheela Recipe to a plate and proceed to make the cheela with the remaining batter.Serve this Sprouted Moth Cheela Recipe With Palak with Sweet and Spicy Tomato Chutney Recipe for a light and simple weeknight dinner or even a diabetic friendly breakfast.

title: Assamese Sweet Kordoi Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Assamese Sweet Kordoi Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Assamese recipe for Assamese Sweet Kordoi Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, Salt, Tablespoon Ghee, /2 cup Lukewarm Water - (adjust), /4 cup Caster Sugar - (powdered sugar), cup Water, Sunflower Oil - to deep fry
Instructions:
1. To prepare Assamese Sweet Kordoi Recipe, mix together the flour and salt.Add the ghee and mix.Adding water gradually, knead until you have a smooth pliable dough.
2. Cover and keep aside for 15 minutes.Make bigger balls of dough, about 2 inches in size.On a lightly dusted surface, roll each dough ball into a small circle (about 5-6 inches) .Using a sharp knife , cut 6-7 vertical and parallel lines into the dough circle , each line about 1/2 inch from the next.
3. Dont cut all the way through.
4. The lines should not reach the edge of the circle (about 1/4 inch from the edge). Think of a slotted spoon !Starting from one end, roll the dough circle . Pinch both the ends and push the ends gently towards the centre.
5. This will fluff up the centre and give the kordoi its characteristic shape like a start fruit.
6. Repeat with all the dough.
7. This measurement makes about 12 such kordoi.Heat oil in a deep frying pan and fry the shaped kordoi in batches until golden brown and crisp.
8. Cool the kordoi, placing them on kitchen towels or tissue to drain excess oil.Meanwhile, make the sugar syrup by bringing the sugar and water to a boil in a saucepan.Simmer for few minutes until syrup is thick and sticky.One by one, drop the kordoi into this syrup, turn over to the other side, and remove.
9. Serve Assamese Sweet Kordoi Recipe warm or cool, paired with Adrak Chai.

title: Jodhpuri Aloo Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Jodhpuri Aloo Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Rajasthani recipe for Jodhpuri Aloo Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Baby Potatoes - boiled, Dry Red Chillie, teaspoons Sesame seeds (Til seeds), Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf), /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, tablespoons Red Chilli flakes, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Jodhpuri Aloo Recipe, wash and pressure cook the baby potatoes for four whistles,  until they are well cooked.
2. Peel the skin, cut them into halves and keep aside.Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan, add the dry red chilli, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, white sesame seeds and let it splutter.Add the red chilli flakes and flavour the oil.Now, add in the boiled baby potatoes along with kashmiri red chili powder and  turmeric powder.
3. Season with salt and mix well.Let the jodhpuri aloo roast on the slow heat, toss the baby potatoes occasionally from time to time.We have to slow roast the potatoes until they are slightly crisp on the outside.
4. This will take around 12-15 minutes.Now, add in the amchur powder, combine well and switch off the heat.
5. Garnish Jodhpuri Aloo with coriander leaves, sesame seeds and serve hot.
6. Serve this Jodhpuri Aloo Recipe along with Rajasthani Kadhi and Phulkas for a delicious weekday lunch.
7. You can also serve it with Ajwain Puri and Boondi Raita for breakfast.

title: Vendakkai Thoran Recipe - Kerala Style Bhindi Stir Fry
content:
Recipe Name: Vendakkai Thoran Recipe - Kerala Style Bhindi Stir Fry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Kerala Recipes recipe for Vendakkai Thoran Recipe - Kerala Style Bhindi Stir Fry (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Bhindi (Lady Finger/Okra) - slit into half and cut into 1 inch pieces, Onion, /4 cup Fresh coconut - grated, Green Chillies - finely chopped, sprig Curry leaves, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - For Cooking
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Vendakkai Thoran Recipe, firstly prepare all the ingredients and keep them ready.Heat a teaspoon of oil in a heavy bottomed wok/kadai; add the mustard seeds, curry leaves and allow it to crackle.
2. Add the chopped onions and saute until the onions become tender.
3. Once the onions are soft and tender, add the green chilies, cut Vendakkai (bhindi) and sprinkle salt.Cover the pan, with the lid slightly ajar and cook the Vendakkai until it is soft.
4. Keep stirring intermittently until it is cooked through.Once the Vendakkai is cooked through, add the turmeric powder, grated coconut and saute for a few more minutes.
5. Check the salt and spices and adjust to suit your taste.Once done, transfer the Vendakkai Thoran to a serving bowl and serve warm.Make the delicious Vendakkai Thoran Recipe and serve it along with Kuruku Kaalan (Raw Bananas in Coconut Curry) and Steamed Rice for a delicious lunch.

title: Tomato Chicken Roast Recipe Flavoured With Kasuri Methi
content:
Recipe Name: Tomato Chicken Roast Recipe Flavoured With Kasuri Methi
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Tomato Chicken Roast Recipe Flavoured With Kasuri Methi (Side Dish).
Ingredients: grams Chicken thighs - skinless and boneless, Onion, Clove, Inch Ginger - Grated, Tomatoe, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Green Chillies - Slit, teaspoon Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves), /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, teaspoon Garam masala powder, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoons Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making Tomato Chicken Roast Recipe Flavoured With Kasuri Methi, get prep with all the ingredients first.In a kadai, heat a little oil on medium flame and once the oil is hot, addp garlic.
2. Fry them for a few seconds on low heat.
3. Do not let the garlic brown.Once the garlic looks cooked, add onions on medium heat and fry them till they are almost translucent.Once done, add the finely chopped tomatoes and saute well until mushy.
4. Add the ginger, green chillies, coriander, chilli, garam masala and turmeric powder, coriander leaves and salt.
5. Cook for a few minutes till the flavours are blended well.Add the chicken pieces and stir.
6. Cover and cook on a low heat till the chicken is tender.When the chicken is cooked and the gravy is thick, add kasuri methi.
7. Blend well and remove chicken roast from heat.
8. By this time, chicken would have the flavours of the added spices.Serve Tomato Chicken Roast Recipe Flavoured With Kasuri Methi along with Biyyapu Rotte Recipe (Rice Flour Roti) and Kadai Egg Masala Recipe by the side.

title: Stuffed Arbi Paratha Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Stuffed Arbi Paratha Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Stuffed Arbi Paratha Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Colocasia root (Arbi) - boiled and peeled, Green Chilli - chopped, /2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera), Tablespoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), tablespoon Garam masala powder, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Cup Whole Wheat Flour, Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making Stuffed Arbi Paratha Recipe, we will make the paratha dough.
2. In a large bowl add in 2 cups of whole wheat flour and some salt.Use your fingers and stir in the salt into the flour.
3. Add little water at a time and knead to make soft, pliable paratha dough.
4. Knead paratha dough for a couple of minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic.
5. Use the fold press and knead motion to make the dough smooth.Next add a teaspoon of oil to coat the paratha dough and knead little more.
6. You want a paratha dough that will be soft smooth and not sticky.
7. Divide the dough into 8 to 10 equal portions.
8. Cover the dough and allow the dough to rest until you get the filling ready.Pressure cook arbi with 1 cup water and salt for around 4 whistle and switch off the heat.Once it is pressure cooked, allow the pressure to release naturally and peel the skin.Mash the arbi into a coarse lumpy texture with your fingers or a fork.
9. Once mashed, add in the finely chopped green chillies, lots of freshly chopped coriander leaves,  salt to taste, half teaspoon of cumin powder, half a teaspoon of coriander powder, a teaspoon of dry mango powder, 1 teaspoon of garam masala, 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric powder and finally if you want it extra spicy, the red chilli powder.
10. Using your fingers again, mix all the ingredients into the arbi until well combined.Divide the arbi filling into 8 to 10 equal portions.
11. This process of dividing and keeping the portions of arbi paratha dough and filling ready, helps you gauge the number of parathas you can make and if you need more or less of the filling.The final step is to stuff the filling into the arbi paratha dough.We dust the paratha dough in flour, flatten it with your finger and place it on a flat surface.
12. Roll them out thin to approximately 3 inches in diameter circle.Take a portion of filling and place it in the center.
13. Next Gather the sides of the paratha dough and bring them together.
14. Remove the little excess dough which popped out when you brought them together.
15. Press the filled arbi paratha dough down.Dust the filled arbi paratha dough in some flour and roll it gently applying just a pressure.
16. Roll it to desired thickness and proceed the similar way with the remaining portions of paratha dough and filling.Preheat a skillet on medium heat and place the filled arbi paratha.
17. Allow it to cook on medium heat for about 30 to 45 seconds and flip over.Add this stage add a teaspoon of ghee or oil and spread it around.
18. Flip again, so the oiled side can cook on the skillet.
19. Spread a little more ghee and keep pressing the parathas while on the skillet to cook the paratha evenly from inside out.Do the flipping over process a couple of times until both sides get cooked, browned and crisp evenly.
20. Make sure you cook on medium heat as it allows the arbi parathas to get a crisp on the outside and yet soft texture.Once the arbi paratha is cooked transfer to a plate.
21. Continue to the same process with the remaining parathas the same way.Serve the Stuffed Arbi Paratha Recipe along with Palak Raita Recipe and Amla Mirchi Ka Achari Subzi Recipe by the side to make it a healthy breakfast.

title: Rajasthani Gunde Ki Sabzi Recipe (Bird Lime Stir Fry)
content:
Recipe Name: Rajasthani Gunde Ki Sabzi Recipe (Bird Lime Stir Fry)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Rajasthani recipe for Rajasthani Gunde Ki Sabzi Recipe (Bird Lime Stir Fry) (Side Dish).
Ingredients: grams Gunde (bird lime), teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), Sunflower Oil - As Required, Water - As Required, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /2 teaspoon Asafoetida (hing), Teaspoon Fennel Seeds (Saunf), /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Rajasthani Gunde Ki Sabzi, firstly boil the gunde in a saucepan with water, drain the water, remove the seeds and keep it aside to cool down for about an hour.Once it is done, heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan.
2. Add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, fennel seeds, fenugreek seeds and hing.Let it cook for about a minute and then add the boiled gundas and mix it properly.Next, add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, amchur powder and the required salt.
3. Give it a stir and let it cook for about 3 to 4 minutes.After 3 to 4 minutes, switch off the stove and garnish it with chopped coriander leaves.Serve Rajasthani Gunde Ki Sabzi with Panchmel Dal and hot Phulkas for a perfect meal.

title: Raw Jackfruit Burrito Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Raw Jackfruit Burrito Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Mexican recipe for Raw Jackfruit Burrito Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Jackfruit Raw (Kathal) - peeled and cut into small junks, Onion, Clove, Ginger, tablespoon Cumin powder (Jeera), teaspoon Black pepper powder, Cinnamon, teaspoon Paprika powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, /2 cup Rajma (Large Kidney Beans) - soaked and boiled, Onion, Tomato - chopped, Clove, tablespoon Cumin powder (Jeera), tablespoon Red Chilli powder, teaspoon Black pepper powder, Teaspoon Sugar, Salt - To Taste, /4 cup Cooked rice, tablespoon Dried Thyme Leaves, tablespoon Paprika powder, Salt - To Taste, /2 Red Bell pepper (Capsicum), /2 Yellow Bell Pepper (Capsicum), /2 Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum), Onion, teaspoon Paprika powder, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Salt, cup Sour cream, cup Tomato Salsa, Tortillas
Instructions:
1. To make the refried beansTo begin making the Raw Jackfruit Burrito Recipe, we will first pressure cook the rajma beans in a pressure cooker in about 2 cups of water and salt for at least 30 minutes.Once done, allow the pressure to release naturally and keep it aside.
2. Heat a skillet with oil, add garlic and saute till it softens.Add in onions and saute till they turn translucent and crispy, add in cooked rajma beans and tomatoes together so that the tomatoes remain fresh and juicy as it gets blended with the rajma.Sprinkle salt to taste and spice powders like cumin powder, red chilli powder and pepper powder and give it a mix.
3. Check for seasoning, if required, add some more and keep sautéing until the mixture comes together.To make the Jamaican Raw JackfruitPressure cook the raw jackfruit with 1 cup of water, salt to taste and pressure cook for just one whistle and set aside later to release the pressure naturally.Heat a sauce pan with a tablespoon oil, add ginger and garlic and saute till they turn soft.
4. Later add in the onions and saute till they turn translucent.Once the onions are lightly sautéed, add cooked jackfruit and give it a mix.
5. Sprinkle the spice powders like paprika, pepper, turmeric, cumin, cinnamon and salt to taste.Give it a toss and at the end add a teaspoon of sugar and saute well for at least 5 more minutes.
6. Check for seasonings and set aside to cool.For the riceHeat a sautéing pan with oil, add rice and sprinkle with thyme, paprika powder and salt and give it a toss.For the FajitasHeat a grill pan with oil, add  onions, bell peppers allow it to cook for few minutes.
7. Sprinkle with spice powders like cumin powder, paprika powder and salt.
8. Toss it well and cook till the bell peppers are soft and crunchy.
9. Once done set aside.
10. To make the Mexican salsa and sour cream, click on the link below and follow the steps:How to Mexican salsaHow to make Sour creamTo Assemble the Jerk Raw Jackfruit BurritoWarm up the tortillas for 2 minutes on either side.
11. Place the Tortillia on a flat surface and layer it with rice first.Then add in some Mexican tomato salsa, followed by Jamaican style raw jackfruit, fried beans, fajitas, sour cream and roll the Raw Jackfruit Burrito tightly and them half and serve.Serve the Jamaican Style Jerk Raw Jackfruit Burrito Recipe along with some more Mexican salsa, tortilla chips, sour cream and guacamole to make it a Mexican meal for your Sunday.

title: Bengali Cholar Dal Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Bengali Cholar Dal Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Bengali Recipes recipe for Bengali Cholar Dal Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), /2 cup Fresh coconut - cut into small bits, Tablespoon Ghee, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, tablespoon Mustard oil, Dry Red Chillie, Cloves (Laung), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Green Chillies - slit into halves lengthwise, Ginger
Instructions:
1. To begin making Bengali Cholar Dal, first wash and soak chana dal in water for an hour or so.Cook soaked dal with 2-1/2 Cups of water , turmeric powder, salt to taste and cook dal for 8 whistles / 30 minutes until the dal is cooked completely.
2. See how to cook lentils (dals/pulses). Let the pressure release naturally and keep aside.In a pan heat mustard oil over medium heat, add the coconut pieces and fry until they turn golden brown.
3. Turn off the heat.
4. Transfer the fried coconut pieces in a bowl.
5. Keep aside until required.In the same pan heat a tablespoon of mustard seeds and add cumin seeds, once seeds crackle add dry red chilies, cloves, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, green chilies and grated ginger.Saute for a few second and add the cooked dal and roasted copra into the pan.
6. Briskly boil Bengali Style Cholar Dal for three to four minutes and turn off the heat.Transfer the Bengali Style Cholar Dal into a serving bowl; finally garnish with a few more of the roasted coconut pieces and serve hot.Serve the Bengali Cholar Dal with Begun Bhaja  and steamed rice for a wholesome weekend lunch or dinner.

title: Chocolate Chip & Raisin Rolls Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Chocolate Chip & Raisin Rolls Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Chocolate Chip & Raisin Rolls Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: cups Whole Wheat Flour, cups All Purpose Flour (Maida), cup Milk - luke warm, teaspoons Active dry yeast, tablespoons Honey - or jaggery or sugar, tablespoon Butter - softened, Salt, /2 cups Water - or as required, Raisin, /4 cup Chocolate chips - dark and white, tablespoons Butter - ricotta cheese or cream cheese or soft paneer, Orange Zest (Rind) - of 1 orange, Sugar - to sprinkle on top
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chocolate Chip & Raisin Rolls first mix the flours and salt in a mixing bowl or the bowl of a food processor or stand mixer.
2. Blend them together briefly.Next, in a large measuring cup, measure 1 cup lukewarm milk.
3. To this add honey, butter and whisk together.
4. Sprinkle the yeast over the milk and allow it to get frothy for about 3-4 minutes.If using a food processor/stand mixer; with the food processor/stand mixer running on low speed, gradually pour the milk mixture into the processor over the flour.Slowly add in the water (as much required) and allow the flour to form a soft dough within the bowl of the processor/mixer.If using a mixing bowl; add the frothy yeast and milk mixture to the flour and begin to knead with your hands.Add water gradually, only as much as needed and keep kneading it till the flour forms a soft and pliable dough.Take care not to add too much water or you will have a sticky unmanageable dough.Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead again for 8-10 minutes, working the dough very well, until it is smooth and elastic. (If using the stand mixer, knead on medium speed using the dough hook)Transfer the formed dough to a lightly greased bowl, turning once to coat all over.
5. Cover with a wet kitchen towel or plastic wrap and set it aside in a warm place for about 1 - 1 1/2 hours until it has risen and doubled in size.Meanwhile, mix together the butter, chocolate chips, raisins and orange zest.
6. Grease and line a baking sheet or a tray with parchment paper and set it aside for later use.Once the dough has doubled, dust a working surface again with flour and gently roll the dough into a rough 9x12 inch rectangle on it.Spread the butter chocolate chip raisin mixture evenly on top of the rolled out dough.Then, starting with the longer end, roll the dough up into a scroll, making sure to keep it tight so the filling remains inside.Use a sharp knife to cut the log into 1 inch rounds.
7. Place the individual rounds on the prepared sheet, cut side down.Cover the sheet with a wet kitchen towel and allow the rolls to rise a second time, for about 30 minutes.Meanwhile, set your oven to preheat at 200 degrees C.When the rolls have risen for 30 minutes, reduce the heat to 180 degrees C, sprinkle the rolls with granulated sugar and place them to bake until they are are golden brown.Remove the Chocolate Chip and Raisin Rolls from the oven, allow them to rest for 5-10 minutes.Serve Chocolate Chip & Raisin Rolls along with your evening masala chai or as an after school snack.

title: Baby Corn Cigar Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Baby Corn Cigar Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Baby Corn Cigar Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Baby corn - to be blanched, tablespoons Whole Wheat Bread crumbs - roasted, tablespoons Corn flour, /2 tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, tablespoon Vinegar, Potato (Aloo) - boiled and mashed, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), teaspoon Pizza seasoning, /2 teaspoon Garlic - paste, tablespoon Red Chilli powder - adjust accordingly, tablespoon Green Chilli Paste, Ginger, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - for frying
Instructions:
1. To prepare baby corn cigar recipe, start by blanching the baby corn.
2. Make sure you do not overdo it. 2-3 minutes in hot water and immediate transfer to ice water will do just fine.Slit baby corn longitudinally into two.Boil the potatoes and mash them well with a masher.Take a mixing bowl, add red chili and pizza seasoning, garlic paste, salt and then the vinegar.
3. Mix.Drizzle olive oil and give a nice mix.
4. Add slit baby corn, coat them well with the prepared mixture.
5. Keep aside for 10 minutes.Add coated baby corn onto a heavy bottomed pan and let it cook on medium heat for 2 minutes.
6. Flip and cook for further 2 minutes such that garlic paste and other spices are well cooked.Remove from heat and let it cool.In another pan, add mashed potato, 1-1/2 tablespoon ginger chili paste, cornflour, coriander leaves and salt and mix them well to combine.Apply some oil to your palms such that the mixture doesn’t get too much sticky.
7. Take some mashed potato mixture about the size of a small lemon between your palms, roll it out cylindrically and flatten it.
8. Keep the blanched and split baby corn in the center and cover it completely with potato mixture.
9. This appears cigar-shaped at this stage.Repeat rolling out baby corn cigars similarly until you use up all baby corn and potato mixture.Keep a Kadai on medium heat and add oil for deep frying.While the oil is heated, roll cigars one by one in breadcrumbs and ensure it get coated from everywhere. (You can also oil the cigars a bit to make the breadcrumbs stick nicely)Deep fry the baby corn cigars in batches till golden brown and place on kitchen towel to drain excess oil.These baby corn cigars goes well with dips like Cottage Cheese Dip Recipe with Pepper and Olives or Tzatziki.

title: Gehu Bajra Thepla Recipe - Bajra Masala Paratha
content:
Recipe Name: Gehu Bajra Thepla Recipe - Bajra Masala Paratha
Description: A flavorful and authentic Gujarati Recipes﻿ recipe for Gehu Bajra Thepla Recipe - Bajra Masala Paratha (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Bajra Flour ( Pearl Millet), /2 cup Whole Wheat Flour, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, Inch Ginger - Grated, Green Chilli - finely chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Sunflower Oil - As Required
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Gehu Bajra Thepla Recipe, combine the bajra flour, whole wheat flour, turmeric powder, black pepper powder, ginger, green chilli, and coriander leaves, in a large mixing bowl.
2. Add little water at a time and knead to make a smooth and firm dough.
3. Drizzle some oil on the top and knead for a few more minutes until smooth.
4. Cover the thepla dough and allow it to rest for half an hour.Preheat the iron skillet on medium heat.
5. Divide the dough into 6 to 8 portions.Roll the thepla portions into balls; flatten them with the palm of your hand.
6. Toss the thepla dough on flour and roll them out into thin circles to approximately 6 inches in diameter.As you roll them out, you can keep tossing the dough in dry flour to prevent sticking when rolling them out.Continue the same process of rolling the thepla dough out with the remaining balls.
7. It is ideal when you can roll out the all portions of dough before you can start cooking them.
8. Method of Cooking the Gehu Bajra TheplaWith skillet on high heat, place the rolled out Gehu Bajra thepla on the skillet.
9. After a few seconds you will notice small air pockets popping out.At this point flip the Gehu Bajra thepla and smear about half a teaspoon of oil and using a flat spatula and do a light pressing and turning motion to cook to the thepla.Flip to the other side and press and turn in a similar way.
10. You will notice brown spots around the cooked Gehu Bajra thepla.
11. Remove from heat and place the thepla on a flat plate.
12. Continue the similar process with the remaining rolled out portions and stack the cooked Gehu Bajra thepla one above the other.
13. Stacking them maintains softness and prevents the thepla’s from drying out, preserving moisture.Serve the Gehu Bajra Thepla with Bangain Bharta and Jaggery for dinner.

title: Kaju Badam Ladoo Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Kaju Badam Ladoo Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Kaju Badam Ladoo Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: cup Cashew nuts, cup Badam (Almond), //4 cups Sugar, /2 cup Water, teaspoon Cardamom Powder (Elaichi), Tablespoon Ghee
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Kaju Badam Ladoo we will first soak the almonds in hot water for 15 minutes.
2. Once soaked, peel the skin from the almonds and keep aside.
3. Drain the water and wipe the almonds dry.Soak cashews for 15 to 20 minutes as well.
4. After soaking, drain and wipe dry.
5. Grind soaked almonds (badam) and cashews (kaju) together into smooth paste.
6. Keep this kaju badam paste aside.The next step is to make a sugar syrup for the ladoos.
7. Bring sugar and water to boil and wait until the sugar syrup reaches 1 string consistency.
8. It is very important to get the sugar syrup to 1 string consistency if you miss this step, the burfi/balls will be not set and harden.Once you have a one string consistency of the sugar syrup, add the cashew almond paste and the cardamon powder.
9. Mix the paste until well combined.
10. Keep flame to medium low and keep stirring the kaju badam mixture continuously.Big bubbles will begin to form and you need to keep mixing constantly, else they will start burning.
11. Keep stirring till the mixture becomes thick.
12. It will take you approximately 30 to 40 minutes until the mixture has thickened and comes away from the sides of the pan and starts looking like a very soft dough.To test, pinch a tiny piece of dough and roll into ball and place it on a plate, if the ball holds it's shape then it is cooked properly, the mixture is ready.
13. If you prefer to cut them into diamonds or square shapes, grease a pan with ghee all over and transfer the dough into the pan and level it even.
14. Since I wanted to shape them into balls I waited until the dough cooled a bit and then while it was still warm I rolled them into bite size balls.Kaju Badam Ladoo to cool completely and store them in airtight container for about 5 days or refrigerate it for longer storage.Serve Kaju Badam Ladoo after your everyday meal of Jodhpuri Aloo, Ajwain Puri and Boondi Raita.

title: Spaghetti Aglio Olio With Parmesan & Greens Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Spaghetti Aglio Olio With Parmesan & Greens Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Italian Recipes recipe for Spaghetti Aglio Olio With Parmesan & Greens Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Spaghetti Pasta, grams Spinach - or amaranth leaves, Clove, Lemon zest - a pinch, Salt - To Taste, tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil - adjustable, /4 cup Parmesan cheese - grated or powdered
Instructions:
1. To begin Spaghetti Aglio Olio With Parmesan & Greens, cook the spaghetti in boiling water along with salt until it is al dente (firm yet cooked).Once the spaghetti is cooked, wash the spaghetti in running water to stop the cooking process.
2. Drain the excess water and toss the spaghetti in a little olive oil, so it does not stick together.Heat a tablespoon of oil in a wok over medium heat; add the garlic and saute for a few seconds until it begins to sizzle.
3. At this stage add the roughly chopped greens, sprinkle salt and cook the greens until softened.Add the lemon zest, the cooked spaghetti, remaining olive oil and chili flakes.
4. Toss all the ingredients together in a wok until combined.
5. Check the salt and adjust to suit your taste.Once done, turn off the heat and transfer to a serving bowl.
6. Spread the parmesan cheese on the top and serve.Serve Spaghetti Aglio Olio With Parmesan & Greens along with a glass of wine and garlic bread for a perfect summer weeknight dinner.

title: Mushroom Dumpling Recipe With Potatoes (Momos)
content:
Recipe Name: Mushroom Dumpling Recipe With Potatoes (Momos)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Asian recipe for Mushroom Dumpling Recipe With Potatoes (Momos) (Appetizers).
Ingredients: grams Button mushrooms - finely chopped, Potato (Aloo) - boiled and mashed, Onion, Green Chilli - finely chopped, Inch Ginger - Grated, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Cup All Purpose Flour (Maida)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Mushroom Dumpling Recipe, we will first make the dough.
2. To make the dumpling (momo) dough;  add the flour into a large mixing bowl, add a little water at a time to the flour and knead well to make a smooth and yet firm dough.
3. We don't add the salt or oil to make the dumpling dough.
4. Cover the dough and allow it to rest for about 20 minutes, till we get the filling ready.Next step is the make the filling for the dumplings.
5. Heat the oil in a saucepan on medium heat.
6. Add the mushrooms, sprinkle some salt and stir fry on high heat until the mushroom become tender.
7. Mushrooms release a lot of water, so stir-fry until all the moisture evaporates.Once the mushrooms are cooked and dry, allow it to cool.
8. Once the mushrooms cool down, add it to a large bowl and combine it with the remaining filling ingredients including the oil.
9. Our final step is to make the Mushroom DumplingsDivide the dough into small lemon sized portions of an inch in diameter.
10. Dust the dough portions in flour and roll out into a circle.
11. Don’t roll too thick, as the filling will push itself out and tear when steamed.Place a small spoon of filling in the center of the rolled circle.
12. Bring together the edges of the dough with a pinching and folding motion on one side and bring the other side to hold to the pinched side.
13. By doing this, the half moon shaped momos (dumplings) will have a frilled look.
14. Proceed the similar way with the remaining dough.As you keep shaping the dumplings (momos) you need to keep them on a greased platter and cover with a damp cloth to prevent them from drying out.While you are shaping the dumplings (momos), keep a steamer with water boiling.
15. Grease the steamer pan with some oil to prevent the momos from sticking.Place the shaped dumplings (momos) on the greased steamer pan.
16. So when you have one set of shaped dumplings, place them in the steamer and steam on high for 5 to 7 minutes until you see a glaze on the skin.
17. Serve the Mushroom Dumplings along with a hot and spicy Homemade Red Chilli Garlic Sauce Recipe as a tea time snack or as an appetizer for parties with Chinese Vegetable Dry Manchurian Balls Recipe.

title: Baked Oats And Whole Wheat Kachori Stuffed With Peas Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Baked Oats And Whole Wheat Kachori Stuffed With Peas Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Baked Oats And Whole Wheat Kachori Stuffed With Peas Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, /2 cup Instant Oats (Oatmeal), /4 cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt, teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds), Water - to knead, cup Green peas (Matar), Green Chilli, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. We begin making the Oats and whole wheat Kachori stuffed with Peas Recipe make dough for the outer layer first, add whole wheat flour, oats and ajwain, salt, and oil in a mixing bowl and mix well with fingers and palm.Add water to make a smooth and firm dough.
2. Rest the dough for 15 minutes.
3. Once it is done resting, divide the dough into small equal rounds.
4. While the dough is resting make the stuffing, grind all the ingredients mentioned in the list to a coarse mixture and keep it aside.Now to stuff the dough with filling, take one ball and press the sides of dough with fingers so that the center of the kachori is a little thick.Fill the center with a tablespoon of stuffing and seal it from all sides to form the kachori.
5. Repeat the same for the rest of the kachoris.Meanwhile, preheat Oven to 180 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes.
6. Place an aluminum foil on a baking tray and brush it with oil.Place kachoris at a half inch distance from each other and brush upper portion of kachoris with oil.
7. Bake in oven for 20 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius.
8. You can brush it with honey to give a nice golden colour.
9. Serve the Oats and whole wheat Kachori stuffed with Peas Recipe along with cup of Masala Chai Recipe - Indian Spiced Tea or you use it to make a Raj Kachori Recipe for your evening snack.

title: Masala Carrot And Peas Sandwich Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Masala Carrot And Peas Sandwich Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Masala Carrot And Peas Sandwich Recipe (World Breakfast).
Ingredients: Whole Wheat Brown Bread, cup Carrot (Gajjar) - grated, cup Green peas (Matar) - boiled, Clove, Green Chillies - finely chopped, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder, /4 cup Cheese - grated, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making Carrot and Peas Sandwich Recipe, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan.
2. Once the oil is heated, add finely chopped garlic and green chillies in the pan.Saute for a few seconds and add the grated carrots and boiled green peas and let it cook for 10 minutes or till the vegetables are cooked through.Once done add black pepper powder and chaat masala and stir.
3. Add salt according to your taste and mix everything properly.
4. Turn off the heat and keep aside.
5. Now to prepare the sandwich, take a slice of bread and spread some filling evenly on the slice.Garnish the carrot and peas mixture layer with grated cheese.
6. Close it with another slice of bread.
7. Grill the sandwich in a grilling pan from both the sides till golden brown.
8. Cut the sandwhich diagonally and serve hot.Serve Carrot and Peas Sandwich along with a hot cup of Masala Chai or Cantaloupe Pomegranate and Mint Juice .

title: Aam Panna Pani Puri Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Aam Panna Pani Puri Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Aam Panna Pani Puri Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Pani Puris, Potato (Aloo) - boiled, /4 cup Green Moong Sprouts - 1/4 cup green moong sprouts, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Mango (Raw), Mint Leaves (Pudina), Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Salt, /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, tablespoons Sugar
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Aam Panna Pani Puri Recipe, we will first make the Aam Panna Pani.
2. In a pressure cooker, peel the raw mango and add the whole raw mango along with 1/2 cup of water and pressure cook for 4 whistles.
3. It has to be cooked until they become soft and tender.
4. Turn off the flame.
5. Allow the pressure to release naturally.
6. Open the lid, drain the water, transfer the mangoes into a bowl and allow the mangoes to cool . Extract the pulp from the cooked raw mango and discard the seed.
7. You will be left with the cooked raw mango pulp.
8. In the bowl with the cooked raw mango pulp, add in the mint leaves, cumin powder, black salt , black pepper powder and sugar.
9. Transfer this mixture into a mixer jar and grind into a smooth puree.Transfer the aam panna into a serving bowl, add 1 cup of water and mix well.
10. Check the taste and spices and adjust accordingly.
11. Chill the Aam Panna Pani in the refrigerator.For the Pani Puri filling, in a mixing bowl, mash the potatoes, add the green moong sprouts and the dry masalas- chaat masala, cumin powder and red chilli powder.
12. Mix well.
13. Check the taste of the aloo masala and adjust salt or seasoning if required.Serve Aam Panna Pani Puri Recipe, by slightly cracking the puris on the top to make an opening, stuff the potato-sprouts filling, fill it with the Aam Panna Pani.
14. Serve Aam Panna Pani Puri Recipe as an appetizer along with a fun party meal of Rawal Pindi Style Chole Recipe, Bhatura , Mumbai Style Tawa Pulao Recipe with Moong Sprouts and finish of with a dessert of Double Ka Meetha Recipe With Mixed Nuts Rabri.

title: Quinoa Vegetable Upma Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Quinoa Vegetable Upma Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Fusion recipe for Quinoa Vegetable Upma Recipe (Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: cup Quinoa, Cups Water, tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), teaspoon White Urad Dal (Split), teaspoon Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), Curry leaves, Green Chillies - finely chopped, Shallot - finely chopped, Tomato - finely chopped, /4 cup Carrot (Gajjar) - finely chopped, /4 Del Monte Whole Corn Kernels, /4 Green peas (Matar), Green beans (French Beans) - finely chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder, Salt, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making Quinoa Vegetable Khichdi, first heat a heavy bottomed pan on medium flame, add the olive oil and mustard seeds and allow them to splutter.
2. Next add the cumin seeds, urad dal, channa dal, curry leaves and green chili.
3. Saute it all for a few seconds.Add the chopped shallots and sprinkle a little salt.
4. Saute gently until they turn translucent.
5. Next, add the vegetables - beans, carrots, corn, peas and cook on a medium flame until they are half cooked.Next, add the chopped tomatoes, mix well and saute sauté for a couple of minutes.
6. Follow this by adding coriander powder, garam masala, quinoa and sauté once again for a couple of minutes, until the masalas cook through.Add 2 cups of water and adjust salt according to your taste.Increase the heat to medium and bring the water to a boil.
7. Then, reduce the heat and cover the pan, allowing the quinoa to cooked completely.
8. It will absorb all the water completely.Take the pan off the heat, garnish the Quinoa Vegetable Upma with fresh chopped coriander leaves and serve.Quinoa Vegetable Upma can be served with Lehsuni Pudina Chutney Recipe and Apple, Kiwi, Pineapple Juice Recipe.

title: Whole Wheat Espresso Chocolate Streusel Cake Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Whole Wheat Espresso Chocolate Streusel Cake Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Whole Wheat Espresso Chocolate Streusel Cake Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: cup Apricots - finely chopped, /4 cup Whole Wheat Flour, /4 cup Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar), Salt, Cinnamon, tablespoon Sugar, /4 cup Pecans - chopped coarsely, /4 cup Whole Wheat Flour, Salt, /4 cup Cocoa Powder, grams Dark chocolate - coarsely chopped, cup Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar), /4 cup Coffee Decoction, Whole Egg, teaspoon Vanilla Extract, /4 cup Sour cream, /2 teaspoon Baking powder, /4 teaspoon Baking soda
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Whole Wheat Espresso Chocolate Streusel Cake Recipe, first get all the ingredients ready for all the steps.To make the Streusel topping, combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
2. Using your fingers make a coarse crumble of the mixture.
3. Refrigerate the crumble until we are ready to use it.To make the center layer of the Streusel, combine the sugar and nuts in a bowl and keep it aside.The next step is the make the cake.
4. Preheat the oven at 180 C.
5. Grease and line 9-inch round cake pan.In a double boiler, melt the chocolate.
6. Once the chocolate melts, add the espresso to the melted chocolate and stir well to combine until it looks creamy and smooth.
7. Keep the melted chocolate sauce aside.Sift in a bowl, flour, baking powder, baking soda and cocoa powder and keep aside.Beat together sugar, butter and sour cream using a hand mixer until just creamy.
8. Do not over beat it.
9. Add one egg and continue to beat until the eggs are fluffy.
10. Gradually beat in the vanilla essence and espresso chocolate mixture.
11. Finally gradually fold in the flour mixture and beat until the cake mixture is just about combined.
12. Don't overbeat at this stage.Pour 1/2 of the cake batter in into the cake pan.
13. Spread the nuts and sugar over this layer and finally top it with the remaining cake batter.
14. Finally sprinkle the refrigerated streusel topping evenly on the top and press it slightly.Place the cake in the preheated oven and bake for about 55 to 60 minutes, until a tester inserted in the center comes out clean.
15. Note: After 30 minutes, if you find the top over browning, just cover with aluminium foil to avoid burning.Once done, remove from the oven and allow the cake to cool.
16. Once cooled, the Whole Wheat Espresso Chocolate Cake is ready to be served.

title: Basella Fritters Recipe - Malabar Spinach Fritters
content:
Recipe Name: Basella Fritters Recipe - Malabar Spinach Fritters
Description: A flavorful and authentic Malabar recipe for Basella Fritters Recipe - Malabar Spinach Fritters (Appetizers).
Ingredients: grams Basella (Malabar Spinach), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Salt - To Taste, /2 cup Gram flour (besan), /2 cup Corn flour, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Salt, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder - for the batter, Sunflower Oil - for frying, /4 cup Water, Sunflower Oil - for frying, Tomato Ketchup
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Basella Fritters Recipe (Malabar Spinach Fritters), firstly pick only thin steam spinach leaves.
2. Wash the leaves thoroughly and pat dry with a kitchen towel.
3. Place the leaves in a bowl and sprinkle some red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt.
4. Take a mixing glass and add all the ingredients needed to make the fritters - Gram flour, Corn flour, Cumin seeds, Enos Salt or Baking Powder, Red Chilli powder and then add a little water to make semi thick consistency with no lumps in the batter.
5. In a frying pan, add some oil and place the heat on medium to low flame.
6. Dip each leaf in batter and drop it in the oil and fry until golden brown.
7. Drain the oil from the fritters and place it on a kitchen paper towel.
8. Serve Basella Fritters Recipe (Malabar Spinach Fritters) with Peanut Chilli Dipping Sauce and a hot cup of Adrak Chai on a cold winter evening.

title: Fig Honey & Paprika Preserve Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Fig Honey & Paprika Preserve Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Malabar recipe for Fig Honey & Paprika Preserve Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: grams Fresh Figs, Lemon Juice, teaspoon Lemon zest, Teaspoon Red Chilli Flake, /2 cup Honey, /4 cup Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Fig Honey & Paprika Preserve Recipe, wash and chop the figs and let them dryAdd honey and figs in a heavy bottomed saucepan and cook on high heat for about 5 minutes till the figs begin to caramelise a bit.To this stage, add the sugar and the remaining ingredients, turn the heat to low and allow it to cook until the figs turn soft.To check whether its done dip a chilled spoon into the boiling jam mixture and hold it above the pan, if the jam falls down together like a sheet rather than falling in drops then you know that the fig preserve is ready.
2. If it is not, then simmer for some more time until you get that consistency.Once done, allow the Fig Honey & Paprika Preserve to cool completely.
3. Store the Fig Honey & Paprika Preserve at room temperature in a clean container and use within a month.You can serve the Fig Honey & Paprika Preserve as a spread over cookies, over toasted bread or even over a custard bowl.

title: Sepu Vadi Recipe (Himachali Split Urad Dal Dumplings In Spinach Gravy)
content:
Recipe Name: Sepu Vadi Recipe (Himachali Split Urad Dal Dumplings In Spinach Gravy)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Himachal recipe for Sepu Vadi Recipe (Himachali Split Urad Dal Dumplings In Spinach Gravy) (Side Dish).
Ingredients: /2 cup Black Urad Dal (Split) - soaked overnight, Green Chillies - chopped, Inch Ginger, Salt - To Taste, Salt, Lemon Juice, /4 teaspoon Sunflower Oil - ¼ and more for frying vadis, grams Spinach, cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), tablespoon Mustard oil, Dry Red Chilli - deseeded, Cloves (Laung), Cinnamon, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds - pounded, Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Green Chilli - finely chopped, Pinch Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /4 teaspoon Fennel Powder, /4 teaspoon Black pepper powder - freshly crushed, teaspoon Dill leaves, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. For the Dumplings (Vadi)To make Sepu Vadi Recipe (Himachali Split Urad Dal Dumplings In Spinach Gravy), make the dumplings by washing and soaking urad dal (split black gram) in about 1.5-2 cups water overnight.Drain and wash the dal.Heat water in a steamer and let it boil.In a blender/grinder jar, combine washed and drained urad dal, ginger, green chilli and grind to make a smooth paste adding about ¼ cup water gradually, so that the mixture is very thick and forms a paste.Take the paste in a bowl and add salt.
2. Whisk it well till it becomes light and fluffy.Add eno and lemon juice and immediately transfer the mixture to a greased plate and steam for about 15-20 minutes.Remove from steamer and insert a toothpick to check whether it is done.
3. If toothpick comes out clean, our vadi is ready.
4. If it doesn’t come out clean, steam for another few minutes more.Meanwhile heat enough oil in a deep frying pan to fry the vadis.Cut the steamed vadis into square pieces.Deep fry the vadi pieces in hot oil till they are crisp and golden in colour.For the Palak PureeSoak Palak leaves in a bowl of water and pinch of salt for about 5 minutes.Remove the stems from the leaves.
5. Roughly chop the leaves.Add water in a wide pan and bring to a boil.
6. Then add spinach leaves and cook for 2 minutes.Immediately remove and soak the leaves in a bowl of ice cold water for a minute.
7. Drain all the excess water.In a mixer/blender jar, add blanched palak leaves, dill leaves and about 1-2 tablespoons water and blend till you get a smooth puree.Keep the spinach puree aside.For the GravyHeat oil in a kadai.
8. Add dry red chilli, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, bay leaf and cumin seeds.Once they splutter, add green chilli and hing.
9. Saute for a couple of seconds.Now turn off the flame and add jeera powder, dhaniya powder, red chili powder, fennel powder and black pepper powder.
10. Mix well.
11. Turn on the flame and saute for 1-2 minutes on a low flame so that spice powders does not burn.Add spinach puree and cook for about 2-3 minutes.Now add salt, whisked curd and the fried sepu vadis and let it simmer for 5-6 minutes.
12. At this stage, you may add required quantity of water as per the consistency of the gravy you prefer.
13. Switch off heat once the gravy is well combined.Serve Sepu Vadi Recipe (Split Urad Dal Dumplings In Spinach Gravy) with Papad Parathas Recipe, Pudina Tawa Paratha (Mint Leaf Skillet Flat Bread) or steamed rice.

title: Himachali Dry Raw Mango Chutney Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Himachali Dry Raw Mango Chutney Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Himachal recipe for Himachali Dry Raw Mango Chutney Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: cup Aam Papad (Sun Dried Mango) - pieces, cup Mint Leaves (Pudina) - washed and chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Green Chillies - chopped, /2 tablespoon Sugar, Salt - To Taste, Hot water - as required (preferably 2 cups)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Himachali Dry Mango Chutney recipe, soak dry raw mango pieces in hot water for 10 to 15 minutes so that they become soft and tender.
2. Strain the mango pieces and keep the water aside.
3. In a mixer- jar, combine the raw mango pieces, mint leaves, coriander leaves, green chillies, sugar, salt and some water which we kept aside and blend them to a fine paste.
4. Add some water if required.
5. Adjust the salt and sugar according to your taste and dry mango chutney is ready to serve.Serve Himachali Dry Mango Chutney recipe with Himachali Chana Madra and Steamed rice for a weekday meal.

title: Vegan Navratan Korma Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Vegan Navratan Korma Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Vegan Navratan Korma Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Carrots (Gajjar) - diced small, to 12 Green beans (French Beans) - cut into 1 inch pieces, /2 cup Cauliflower (gobi) - cut into florets, Potatoes (Aloo) - boiled and diced, /2 cup Tofu - diced, Onion, Green Chillie, Tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds - powdered, Black cardamom (Badi Elaichi), Cloves (Laung), Inch Ginger, cup Coconut Yogurt - optional, /2 cup Coconut milk - thick, Mint Leaves (Pudina) - as needed, Saffron strands, Edible Silver Foil/Leaf (Chandi Ka Vark) - optional, Pineapple - few pieces, Raisin, Cashew nuts - toasted, tablespoon Badam (Almond) - sliced, tablespoon Pistachios - sliced, /2 Garam masala powder - optional, Coconut Oil - cold pressed, /2 tablespoons Poppy seeds, Cashew nuts - whole, Badam (Almond)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Vegan Navratan Korma, soak cashews and almonds reserved for the paste in water for 40 minutes.
2. Grind this to a smooth paste along with poppy seeds and set aside.Chop all the vegetables and gather all the ingredients required for the korma.Steam the vegetables with a pinch of salt until tender, make sure they hold the shape.Grind the poppy seeds, cashew and almonds into a smooth paste, adding little water.
3. Keep the nut-seed mixture aside.In a large pan heat some oil, add cloves, cinnamon, green cardamom and black cardamom, now add sliced onions, ginger and garlic paste and saute this the raw smell disappears, add green chillies and cook briefly.
4. Let this mixture cool down to room temperature.Now add these ingredients into a mixie jar and grind to smooth.Return this gravy into the pan add turmeric powder, red chilli powder and some salt and cook for 3-4 minutes.Now to this mixture add the coconut yogurt, coconut milk and the nut-seed paste and mix to well and cook for 4-5 minutes or until the korma thickens.Add the cooked vegetables, tofu and a cup of water and cook until the korma comes together.
5. This should take around 4-5 minutes.
6. Add little water to loosen the korma if required.
7. Add salt and adjust the seasoning.
8. Finally sprinkle the garam masala if using and give it a stir.In a small pan heat some coconut oil and gently fry cashews and sultanas, turn off the heat add sliced almonds and pistachios and roast for a few seconds.
9. Spoon the Vegan Navratan Korma into a serving bowl, place the chandi ka varq if using, top it with cashews, sultanas, almonds and pistachios.
10. Now arrange slices of pineapple, saffron and mint leaves on top.Serve the Vegan Navratan Korma along with a Paneer Pulao with Green Peas and Tadka Raita Recipe (Spiced Curd With Onions) to make a delicious weeknight dinner or even serve as a main course for parties.

title: Lentils And Mixed Grains Kichada Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Lentils And Mixed Grains Kichada Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Rajasthani recipe for Lentils And Mixed Grains Kichada Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: /4 cups Broken Wheat (Dalia/ Godumai Rava) - soaked for 3 hours, /4 cup Bajra (seeds) - soaked for 3 hours, /4 cup Jowar Seeds - soaked for 3 hours, /4 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), /4 cup Masoor Dal (Whole), /2 cup Rice, Clove, Ginger, Green Chilli, sprigs Curry leaves, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), teaspoons Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoons Garam masala powder, /2 teaspoon Asafoetida (hing), Sunflower Oil - For Cooking, Onion, Tablespoon Lemon Juice, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To prepare the Lentils and Mixed Grains Kichada Recipe, first get all the ingredients handy.Drain water from the soaked wheat and bajra and grind them in a mixer grinder to make a coarse paste.Pour water (5 cups) in a deep kadai just enough to cook the coarse grain mixture.Add 1 cup of rice and chana dal to the boiling mixture.After 10 minutes when the rice is half done, add in masur dal, turmeric powder, salt and mix well.
2. Allow it to cook further for about 10 minutes on a medium flame.Take another deep frying pan to heat oil.
3. Once the oil is hot, fry in onions till golden brown.Add in green chillies, ginger garlic paste and jeera powder and mix it well.Simmer the flame to toss in red chilli powder, garam masala powder, curry leaves and hing powder.
4. Saute for half a minute.Slowly add cooked cereals to it and mix until the masala blends in it evenly.Garnish the Lentils and Mixed Grains Kichada Recipe with a generous pinch of finely chopped coriander, a few rings of onion and lemon for the dish to look as yummy as it tastes.

title: Dhania Wale Aloo Recipe - Coriander Potato Dry
content:
Recipe Name: Dhania Wale Aloo Recipe - Coriander Potato Dry
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Dhania Wale Aloo Recipe - Coriander Potato Dry (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Baby Potatoes, /2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera), /2 teaspoon Black pepper powder, /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder - optional, Lemon Juice, teaspoons Sesame seeds (Til seeds) - dry roasted, Tablespoon Ghee, Salt, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Inch Ginger, Green Chilli
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Dhania Wale Aloo Recipe, wash and boil the baby potatoes in a pressure cooker to two whistles (until they are cooked yet firm), peel and keep aside.Also, dry roast sesame seeds in a pan in low heat to golden brown colour and keep aside.Next, add all the ingredients mentioned in the 'Dhania Chutney' including coriander leaves, green chillies, ginger and grind it to a smooth paste with little water using a hand blender or mixer and keep aside.Heat ghee in a heavy bottomed pan on low flame, add the cumin seeds powder, pepper, garam masala and sendha namak or rock salt.Add the boiled baby potatoes and sauté until they are mildly roasted in low heat.
2. This will take around 10 minutes.Now, add the dhania chutney that we prepared earlier to the potatoes and give it a good toss.Let the potatoes simmer for 10 minutes, occasionally stir in-between, until the potatoes are well coated by the masala paste.Switch off the flame, add the lemon juice and give it a good toss.Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and serve hot.
3. Serve Dhania Wale Aloo along with Phulkas and Palak Raita for a weekday lunch or dinner.

title: Baked Potato-Spaghetti Rolls Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Baked Potato-Spaghetti Rolls Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Fusion recipe for Baked Potato-Spaghetti Rolls Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Potato (Aloo), Green Chilli - (adjust), gram Spaghetti Pasta, Inch Ginger, Lemon Juice, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /4 cup Fried Bread Cubes (Croutons) - seasoned with chopped garlic & dried rosemary, teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt
Instructions:
1. To prepare Baked Potato-Spaghetti Rolls Recipe, cook spaghetti in a pan of water as per the instructions mentioned on the spaghetti packet, drain and cool it when done.Peel and cut potato into small pieces and boil in a pressure cooker for about 3 whistles and mash it.Powder the croutons in a mixer. and keep it aside.
2. Coarsely bend in coriander leaves, ginger, green chili in the mixer and keep it aside.Chop the cooled spaghetti into small pieces and keep it aside.
3. Add potato, spaghetti, croutons, coriander leaves mix, salt into a single pot.Add few drops of lemon.Mix and mash everything together.
4. Take a small portion and make them into oval shaped balls.Do the same for the rest of the mixture.
5. Place them on a tray, covered with a cling film.
6. Keep them in a refrigerator for a minimum of 20 minutes.Preheat Oven for 5 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius.Take an Oven tray and brush oil.
7. Covering with aluminum foil is optional.Take the potato-spaghetti rolls and place them in the tray.
8. Brush oil.
9. One side is enough.Place the tray inside the oven and bake for 30, and keep checking at every 15 minutes.Brush oil if necessary but this is optional.Flip the pieces once the bottom side is cooked.
10. Generally, the bottom side gets cooked faster and it again depends on your oven.Potato Spaghetti Rolls Recipe is ready to be served hot with Dhaniya Pudina chutney recipe or Roasted Tomato Sauce Recipe.

title: Andhra Style Vendakaya Charu Recipe - Ladies Finger Rasam
content:
Recipe Name: Andhra Style Vendakaya Charu Recipe - Ladies Finger Rasam
Description: A flavorful and authentic Andhra recipe for Andhra Style Vendakaya Charu Recipe - Ladies Finger Rasam (Main Course).
Ingredients: Bhindi (Lady Finger/Okra), Tomato - roughly chopped, Onion, Garlic, cup Tamarind Water, teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /4 Teaspoon Asafoetida (Hing), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Teaspoon Sugar, Salt - To Taste, Tablespoon Ghee, /2 Teaspoon Mustard Seed, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), /4 Teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds), sprig Curry leaves, Dry Red Chilli - broken into half
Instructions:
1. We begin making the Andhra Style Vendakaya Charu Recipe (Ladies Finger Rasam Recipe) by placing  a pressure cooker on medium flame with ghee and the mustard seeds and allow them to splutter, next add  cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, dry red chillies, curry leaves and allow them to crackle.
2. Next add in the chopped onions, and garlic pods.
3. Saute till it is translucent.
4. Then add in the tamarind water,  sugar, salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, asafoetida, coriander powderand chopped tomatoes and okra.
5. Stir well.Pressure cook the rasam for about 3 whistles, turn off the flame and allow the pressure to release naturally.
6. Serve the Andhra Style Vendakaya Charu Recipe (Ladies Finger Rasam Recipe) with  Chettinad Beans & Cauliflower Poriyal Recipe, hot steamed rice with a teaspoon of ghee to enrich the taste.

title: Mexican Vegetarian Burrito Bowl Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Mexican Vegetarian Burrito Bowl Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Mexican recipe for Mexican Vegetarian Burrito Bowl Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cups Cooked rice - fluffy, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Pepper, Salt - To Taste, Lemon Juice, cups Rajma (Large Kidney Beans) - cooked but not drained, cup Homemade tomato puree, Onion, Clove, /2 Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Chipotle Chillies / Peppers - chopped (or 1 flat teaspoon red chilli flakes), Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Salt - To Taste, Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) - sliced (or use any other vegetables that can be stir fried), Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - sliced, Yellow Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - sliced, Onion, Clove, teaspoon Dried oregano, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli flakes, Salt, teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, cups Del Monte Whole Corn Kernels - fire roasted, Onion, Tomato - chopped, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Lemon Juice, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli flakes - (optional), Salt - To Taste, /4 cup Cheddar cheese - or Mexican cheese, /2 cup Lettuce leaves - shredded (optional), /4 cup Black olives - sliced, Guacamole - 1 recipes
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Mexican Vegetarian Burrito Bowl, you need to prepare the various components first.For the coriander-lime rice, to the cooked rice, add the chopped coriander, lime juice, black pepper and salt.
2. Toss the mix together till all the flavors are well combined.For the spicy beans, place a pan on heat, add some oil to it and allow it to get warm.Add the onion, garlic and sauté it for 1-2 minutes until the onions are softened.
3. Then add tomato puree and cook for 5-10 minutes on a medium heat.When the mix begins to bubble, add the cooked kidney beans/rajma along with the water that was used for cooking it.
4. Stir well.Add Chipotle chilli along with Adobo sauce, crushed cumin and salt.
5. If using red chilli flakes instead, add it now.Mix it all up well and cook to make a thick sauce.
6. This may take 5-7 minutes.
