7. Turn off the heat and keep it aside.For the sautéed peppers/vegetables, place a pan on heat, add some oil to it and allow it to get warm.Once done add all the chopped peppers (or any other vegetables that you may like) along with the garlic.Sprinkle salt and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
8. Then, add chilli flakes and oregano, toss together and turn off the heat.
9. Keep aside till ready to use.For the roasted corn salsa, char the corn on the stove top or in a preheated oven.
10. Take the kernels off the cob and put it in a bowl.Add in the rest of the ingredients and mix thoroughly.
11. Keep aside until later use.For the guacamole, prepare the Avocado guacamole but remember that guacamole needs to be eaten fresh, so this is one component that has to be made last, or just before assembling and serving the burrito bowl.To assemble the burrito bowl, if you are preparing one big bowl for your guests, use a fairly deep 8-9” flat bottom bowl or serving dish.A burrito bowl is essentially layered, so begin with the coriander-lime rice.
12. Spread it generously at the base of the bowl.Over it, spoon the spicy beans and spread it around the rice.Next, layer the sauteed peppers over the beans.On top of that goes a layer of guacamole.Spread some corn salsa over it, and top it with the lettuce (if using), cheese and black olives and serve.If you are making individual burrito bowls for a smaller crowd, follow the same sequence of layers, but use smaller sized ramekins for serving.To make a Burrito Bar, simply place all the prepared components on convenient location.
13. Give your guests individual bowls and allow them to choose their favorite toppings to assemble the bowls of their choice.To serve it as a warm winter casserole, once assembled, bake the bowl in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes and serve hot with baked Tortilla chips.Serve the Mexican Vegetarian Burrito Bowl for a wholesome dinner followed by a dessert of Apple Enchiladas.

title: Dahi Bhindi Recipe - Okra In Yogurt Curry With Caramelized Onions
content:
Recipe Name: Dahi Bhindi Recipe - Okra In Yogurt Curry With Caramelized Onions
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Dahi Bhindi Recipe - Okra In Yogurt Curry With Caramelized Onions (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Bhindi (Lady Finger/Okra) - cut into 1 inch pieces, Onion, Inch Ginger - Grated, cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), tablespoons Gram flour (besan), teaspoon Garam masala powder, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Salt - To Taste, Onion, Sunflower Oil - For Cooking, Tablespoons Ghee, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Dry Red Chillie, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Dahi Bhindi Recipe, we will first roast the Bhindi .Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a Wok or a Kadai; add the chopped onions and the bhindi (okra). Sprinkle some salt and sauté the bhindi and the onions on low heat.
2. Keep the pan covered for the few minutes so the bhindi gets cooked.When covered the bhindi releases moisture, but this moisture helps it to cook and soften as well.Once you notice that it has released a little moisture and the bhindi is slightly softened, open the pan and stir fry the bhindi until it is well roasted.
3. Make sure you roast it on medium heat.
4. Roast the Bhindi until you notice it has begun to shrink and has browned.
5. It should not become sticky, slimy and gooey.
6. If it has turned this way, add a little more oil and sprinkle some gram flour/besan and stir it gently.
7. This will absorb the sliminess.The bhindi is a tricky vegetable to cook, so it takes some practice to not making it gooey.Once the bhindi is cooked and well roasted, keep it aside till we prepare the yogurt gravy.To make the Yogurt Curry, add the yogurt into a saucepan; add the gram flour, grated ginger, garam masala powder,  turmeric powder and chili powder.
8. Whisk until smooth.
9. Add in 1/4 cup of water and whisk again until well combined.Place the saucepan on a medium heat and allow the yogurt mixture to come to a brisk boil.
10. Allow it to boil for a couple of minutes and then turn the heat to low.
11. Simmer the mixture until the yogurt becomes thick and creamy.
12. Once thick and creamy, add in the roasted bhindi and stir.
13. Simmer for a few more minutes.
14. Check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste.Turn off the heat and transfer the Dahi Bhindi a serving bowl.
15. The final step is to make the seasoning.
16. Heat a tablespoon of ghee in a Tadka Pan.
17. Add the cumin seeds, dry red chilies and roast them until lightly browned.Pour this seasoning and the caramelized onions into the Dahi Bhindi.
18. Stir to mix gently and finally stir in the chopped coriander leaves.Serve the Dahi Bhindi along with Phulka Recipe  or Steamed Rice and  Green Moong Sprout Salad for a simple weeknight dinner or even a weekend lunch.

title: Sweet & Spicy Vegetable Hong Kong Style Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Sweet & Spicy Vegetable Hong Kong Style Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Cantonese recipe for Sweet & Spicy Vegetable Hong Kong Style Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Carrot (Gajjar) - cut into chunks, /4 cup Green beans (French Beans) - cut into inch pieces, grams Tofu - cut into cubes, /2 Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) - cut into chunks, /2 Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - cut into chunks, Inch Ginger - Grated, Clove, Dry Red Chillies - halved, tablespoons Soy sauce, teaspoon Chilli vinegar, teaspoons Red Chilli sauce, /2 Teaspoon Sugar, /2 cups Vegetable stock, tablespoons Corn flour - mixed with 1/4 cup water, Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Salt
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Sweet and Spicy Vegetable Hong Kong Style Recipe heat the oil in a wok on high heat add the garlic, ginger, green bell peppers and the carrots and green beans.
2. Stir fry on high heat for a few minutes until you have tender-crisp vegetables.Once done add the chillies, tofu and stir-fry for 2 more minutes on high heat.
3. After two minutes add the soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper and mix well.Add the cornflour paste and the vegetable stock; simmer until the sauce thickens.
4. Turn off heat and serve Sweet and Spicy Vegetable Hong Kong Style hot.Serve the Sweet & Spicy Vegetable Hong Kong Style Recipe along with Sichuan fried Rice for a delicious asian dinner.

title: Badam Halwa Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Badam Halwa Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Awadhi recipe for Badam Halwa Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: cup Badam (Almond), Tablespoon Ghee, /4 cup Milk, tablespoon Whole Wheat Flour, /4 cup Sugar, Saffron strands, tablespoons Slivered Almonds (Badam)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Badam Halwa Recipe, combine the almonds and enough water in a deep bowl and soak for 8 hours.
2. Drain and de-skin the almonds.Blend the almonds in a mixer to get a coarse mixture without using any water or milk.
3. Keep this badam mixture aside.The next step is to make the badam halwa.
4. In a saucepan, add the milk, 1/2 cup water, sugar and saffron.
5. Dissolve the sugar in the milk mixture and keep the heat on low so the milk mixture stays warm.Heat ghee in a Heavy Bottomed Pan, add the ground badam mixture and roast in the ghee over medium heat for about 7 to 8 minutes, stirring continuously.
6. The badam mixture will change in color slightly and get a roasted aroma.Once the badam is well roasted and has a good aroma, slowly stir in the warm milk mixture into the halwa.
7. At this stage the halwa will begin to sizzle and liquid will start spluttering everywhere.Keep stirring the badam halwa until all the milk is evaporated and the badam halwa comes away from the sides of the pan.
8. Once you notice the badam halwa comes away from the sides of the pan, turn off the heat.Stir in the slivered almonds and serve.Serve the Badam Halwa as a sweet for the festivals like diwali or a special occasion like a wedding in the family.Serve Badam Halwa after a delicious festive meal of Aloo Tamatar Ki Sabzi, Ajwain Puri and Boondi Raita.

title: Tender Coconut Ice Cream Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Tender Coconut Ice Cream Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Tender Coconut Ice Cream Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: /2 cup Tender coconut water, cup Fresh cream, /4 cup Sugar - granulated, cup Tender coconut meat - + Little extra, /2 cup Condensed Milk, Honey - for glazing (Optional), Ice cream cone - (Optional)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Tender Coconut Ice Cream recipe, in a grinder or blender, grind tender coconut meat along with tender coconut water to make a puree.
2. Now add the full fat cream, sugar and the condensed milk into the same jar and beat everything together until well combined.
3. Chop the extra tender coconut into small chunks and ix it into the the tender coconut ice cream.Your ice cream is all ready now.
4. Pour this tender coconut ice cream mixture in a freezer safe bowl with a tight lid and freeze it for minimum 5-6 hours.Once the ice cream is frozen remove the bowl out, scoop the tender coconut ice cream into the serving bowl.
5. Drizzle some honey over it and a few broken ice cream cone pieces and enjoy.Serve Tender Coconut Ice Cream as a dessert after you simple meal of Mixed Vegetable Sambar, South Indian Coconut Chutney and Ghee Masala Dosa.

title: Milk Powder Chena Burfi Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Milk Powder Chena Burfi Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Milk Powder Chena Burfi Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: /2 liter Milk, tablespoons White vinegar - or lime juice, /2 cup Sugar, /2 cup Milk Powder, cup Condensed Milk, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds - crushed, Tablespoons Ghee, tablespoon Pistachios - chopped, /8 teaspoon Saffron strands - optional, or 2 Yellow food colour - optional
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Milk Powder Chena Burfi recipe, we need to prepare chena first.
2. Boil the milk on high heat in a thick bottomed pan.As soon as milk starts boiling turn the heat medium and then add white vinegar or lime juice in it.
3. Keep on stirring the milk very slowly with a spoon.In about 2-3 minutes complete whey will be separated from chena, pour the curdled milk into pan or bowl lined with a thin cotton napkin.Once you are done adding all the curdle milk then bring together the edges of the cotton napkin and gently squeeze out the remaining whey from it.Rinse the collected bundle of chena in water, by this you will get rid of the after taste and smell of both lime juice or vinegar, keep a weight on the chenna bundle for 6 to 7 minutes.Chena is ready now.Now mash the chena coarsely and add sugar, condensed milk, cardamom powder and ghee.
4. Mix well.Now heat the mixture in a thick bottom pan.When sugar completely dissolve add milk powder and cook on medium heat with constant stirring until the mixture become thick and starts leaving the sides of the pan.Switch off the flame and spread onto a greased plate.
5. And garnish with pistachios and saffron.Cool and cut into squares or your desire shapes.
6. Now your delicious Milk powder chena burfi is ready to serve.Serve Milk Powder Chena Burfi during festivals or you can serve it as a dessert after your meals or during your house parties.
7. You can also serve it as a dessert after your everyday meal of Jodhpuri Aloo, Ajwain Puri and Boondi Raita.

title: Carrot Orange Walnut Raita (Fruity Nutty Yogurt) Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Carrot Orange Walnut Raita (Fruity Nutty Yogurt) Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Carrot Orange Walnut Raita (Fruity Nutty Yogurt) Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: grams Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), Carrot (Gajjar) - grated, Orange - peeled and sliced, Walnuts - chopped, to 6 Cashew nuts - chopped, Salt, /4 Cumin powder (Jeera) - (optional), pinch Raita masala - (optional)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Carrot Orange Walnut Raita, wisk the curd to a smooth texture in a mixing bowl.To this add the peeled and grated carrot.
2. Once it is done, add the oranges segments and chopped walnuts and cashew nuts.Mix well and add the seasonings.
3. If you prefer salted add 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon cumin powder, pinch of raita masala.If you prefer sweet, then add 1 teaspoon sugar and mix well.
4. It is ready to be served.Carrot Orange Walnut Raita can be served with lunch or dinner.
5. It also makes a great party food, if served along with your delicious meal.

title: Coffee Chocolate Truffles Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Coffee Chocolate Truffles Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Coffee Chocolate Truffles Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: grams Heavy whipping cream, tablespoon Instant Coffee Powder, grams Dark chocolate, Salt, tablespoons Cocoa Powder
Instructions:
1. To begin making Coffee Chocolate Truffles Recipe, take a saucepan and add the heavy cream and bring it to a boil on low heat.
2. Once the heavy cream has come to a boil, add the Instant Coffee Powder and mix it well.
3. Once coffee powder and heavy cream have combined well, turn off the flame.
4. Break dark chocolate in small pieces in a heatproof bowl.
5. Add the softened butter to this bowl.Pour the hot cream and coffee mixture to the chocolate and butter.
6. Let it rest for one or two minutes.
7. We will see that chocolate has started melting.
8. Stir the mixture until it forms a smooth consistency Pour the mixture in a shallow dish,cover it with a cling wrap and keep it in fridge for an hour.
9. After an hour take truffle mixture out of the fridge.
10. Scoop out some mixture using a spoon and roll them with your palm, do it quickly as if you keep rolling them, they might start melting.Toss the truffle in cocoa powder and keep aside.
11. Repeat the same process for the rest of the mixture.
12. Once done keep the Truffle in the fridge until they feel firm.Serve these Coffee Chocolate Truffles as a dessert with your continental meal of Spinach Corn Pasta In Whole Wheat White Sauce, Garlic Bread With Herb Butter and Roasted Garlic Potato Soup

title: Karnataka Style Ragi Ujju Rotti Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Karnataka Style Ragi Ujju Rotti Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Karnataka recipe for Karnataka Style Ragi Ujju Rotti Recipe (South Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: cup Ragi Flour (Finger Millet/ Nagli), cup Water, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Tablespoon Ghee, Rice flour - for dusting
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Ragi Ujju Rotti Recipe, in a medium sized vessel, bring the water to a boil in a pan with salt and oil.Lower the flame and pour ragi flour into the boiling water from a cup, pour it in the center of the boiling water.Let it get cooked on a low to medium flame untouched for 8-10 minutes without lid.Turn off the flame, take a wooden stick or a wooden spatula, run it under a tap to wet it and then mix the flour and water mixture vigorously until combined.
2. This step must be done quickly to avoid lumps.
3. This takes about 2 minutes.Cover for a couple of minutes and let it cool until you can handle the mixture.Drop it on an oiled surface and knead well after wetting the hands with water.
4. Moist and freshly washed hands are required since the dough is sticky.Knead for about 5-7 minutes to get rid of lumps if any and to smoothen the pre-cooked flour.Roll the mixture into a cylinder and divide them equally.
5. This should give you about 4 equal sized balls.Keep them covered at all times.
6. Knead each ball for 15-20 seconds and roll it out just like regular ujju rotis using rice flour to dust.
7. Just make sure you do it slow and steady since the edges might crack.Roll out all the balls and stack the roti one on top of another on a plate first and then start roasting them.
8. Use a little rice flour in-between each, to avoid getting stuck to one another.Heat a Tawa and cook the Ujju Roti just like a chapati by smearing oil /ghee on both sides.
9. Cooking will take 1-1.5 minutes on each side.Serve Karnataka Style Ragi Ujju Roti with Steamed Vegetable in Coconut and Lentil Curry or your favorite chutney like Heerekai Sippe Chutney or Kadale Chutney Recipe.

title: Pui Shaager Chorchori Recipe - Mixed Vegetable Curry With Malabar Spinach
content:
Recipe Name: Pui Shaager Chorchori Recipe - Mixed Vegetable Curry With Malabar Spinach
Description: A flavorful and authentic North East India Recipes recipe for Pui Shaager Chorchori Recipe - Mixed Vegetable Curry With Malabar Spinach (Side Dish).
Ingredients: cups Malabar Spinach Leaves - as well as stalks chopped into big pieces, cup Kaddu (Parangikai/ Pumpkin) - cut into big pieces, /2 cup Mooli/ Mullangi (Radish) - cut into small pieces, /2 cup Potato (Aloo) - cut into small pieces, cup Brinjal (Baingan / Eggplant) - cut into big pieces, /2 teaspoon Panch Phoran Masala, Dry Red Chillie, tablespoons Mustard oil - or vegetable oil, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Salt - To Taste, teaspoon Sugar - optional, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Pui Shaager Chorchori Recipe, firstly we will wash the vegetables and the leaves well in water.
2. Keep them aside.
3. Heat mustard oil in a heavy bottomed pan on low heat.
4. Once hot, add 1/2 teaspoon of panch phoran masala, followed by red chillies.After 30 seconds, add the pieces of pumpkin, radish, potato, eggplant and saute them well.
5. Now add the spinach leaves to the vegetables and sprinkle some water for the vegetables to cook.You can also cook the pumpkin and potatoes in pressure cooker first for one whistle.Simultaneously, cook the rest of the vegetables in a kadai with water, add the spinach and cooked pumpkin and potato to this once done.
6. To this add salt, turmeric powder and cumin powder.
7. Cover and cook for 15 to 20 minutes till the vegetables are tender.
8. The vegetables should be well cooked and tender.
9. Stir the vegetables well and add a teaspoon of sugar (optional) and mix well.Break 2-3 whole green chillies and add to the Pui Shaager to spice up the dish a little.If the vegetable feels dry, add some water and cook.
10. Once done, switch off the gas and serve hot.Serve Pui Shaager Chorchori along with Bengali Style Cholar Dal and Steamed Rice for your everyday meals.
11. You can also serve Begun Bhaja along with this meal.

title: Potato Pancakes Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Potato Pancakes Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Potato Pancakes Recipe (World Breakfast).
Ingredients: Potato (Aloo), Lemon Juice, Onion, Clove, Whole Egg - lightly beaten (or 1/4 cup yogurt), /4 cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), /2 cup Whole Wheat Bread crumbs, Parsley leaves - half a bunch, sprig Chives - finely chopped (or any other herb), Salt, Peanut oil - for pan frying
Instructions:
1. To begin making Potato Pancakes, peel the potatoes.
2. Soak in water after peeling to prevent browning of the potatoes.Using a grater attachment of the food processor, shred the potatoes into a medium bowl.Add lemon juice and onions to the shredded potatoes.
3. Toss to coat evenly.Let this onion potato mixture sit for about 10 minutes.
4. Drain the potatoes and squeeze out the excess liquid.
5. Place the squeezed potatoes in a muslin cloth or on a metal sieve.In a large mixing bowl, combine the potato mixture, minced garlic, egg (or yogurt), flour, bread crumbs, parsley and chives.Season with salt and pepper.
6. Combine the ingredients to form a thick paste like mixture.
7. Fill the frying pan an inch deep with oil.Heat the oil over medium heat.
8. Take a small portion from the potato mixture and shape it into flat patties of medium thickness.Shallow fry the pancakes from both the sides until crisp and golden.
9. This might take about 5 to 7 minutes each side.
10. Drain on paper towels and similarly prepare remaining pancakes.
11. Serve Potato Pancakes hot along with Spicy Mexican Salsa for a delicious weekend breakfast or as a tea time snack along with masala chai.

title: Bamboo Shoot Stir Fry Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Bamboo Shoot Stir Fry Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Asian recipe for Bamboo Shoot Stir Fry Recipe (Side Dish).
Ingredients: cups Bamboo shoots - julienned, Button mushrooms - or cremini mushrooms, Onion, cup Red Yellow and Green Bell Peppers (Capsicum) - julienned, Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, /2 teaspoon Red Chilli flakes, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To start making Bamboo Shoot Fry, Heat up a cast iron skillet on medium heat.
2. Add olive oil when its hot, add chopped spring onions and saute for 2 minutes.Add bamboo shoots and cook for 2 minutes.
3. Add chopped sweet peppers and mushrooms with required salt, cook until all the vegetables are cooked but crispy.Sprinkle chilli flakes and stir for a minute.Check salt and serve Bamboo Shoot Stir Fry Recipe with with phulka or as a side dish with rice and sambar.

title: Udupi Style Red Parboiled Rice Sevai Recipe (Red Rice Vermicelli)
content:
Recipe Name: Udupi Style Red Parboiled Rice Sevai Recipe (Red Rice Vermicelli)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Udupi recipe for Udupi Style Red Parboiled Rice Sevai Recipe (Red Rice Vermicelli) (South Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: cups Red matta rice - parboiled, cup Fresh coconut - grated, /4 cups Water, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Udupi Style Red Parboiled Rice Sevai Recipe, wash and soak the red parboiled rice in enough water overnight.In the morning, drain the water and grind it along with the grated coconut, salt using a mixer grinder adding water little at a time, remove it in a bowl.The dough should be tight to hold a shape.
2. Now, knead the dough till it soft and divide it into four equal portions.Heat water in a steamer, bring it to a rolling boil, before you proceed further to make the sevai.Grease the steamer plate with a little oil.
3. Place a portion of the dough in the chakli / murruku maker, to which the sevai mould is attached.Make small roundels on the steamer plate and place it inside the steamer.Let the sevai steam for 10 minutes, remove and proceed to make sevai with the remaining dough.Garnish a little grated fresh coconut on top before serving.
4. Serve the Udupi Style Red Parboiled Rice Sevai Recipe along with Spicy Coconut Chutney and Filter Coffee for the breakfast.

title: Till Wale Aloo Recipe - Sesame Potato Sabzi
content:
Recipe Name: Till Wale Aloo Recipe - Sesame Potato Sabzi
Description: A flavorful and authentic Indian recipe for Till Wale Aloo Recipe - Sesame Potato Sabzi (Main Course).
Ingredients: Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, Potato (Aloo) - boiled, Ginger, Green Chilli - chopped, /12 tablespoons Sesame seeds (Til seeds), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), Salt - To Taste, /2 teaspoon Garam masala powder, tablespoons Sweet Chutney (Date & Tamarind), Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Till Wale Aloo Recipe, heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan.
2. Once the oil is hot, add ginger and green chillies.
3. Make sure you don't burn them.
4. After a minute, add sesame seeds and saute for a while.
5. Add potatoes and toss it for about 2 minutes.After 2 minutes, add red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt to taste.
6. Saute for 3-4 minutes on low flame.After 3 to 4 minutes, add tamarind chutney, mix it well and cook for one more minute.
7. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.Serve Till Wale Aloo along with Gujarati Dal, Roti and Kachumber Salad for a weekday meal.

title: Beetroot Loni Sponge Dosa Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Beetroot Loni Sponge Dosa Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Beetroot Loni Sponge Dosa Recipe (North Indian Breakfast).
Ingredients: cups Idli Dosa Batter, cups Rice - parboiled, /4 cup Poha (Flattened rice) - (thick variety), cups Buttermilk - sour, teaspoon Cooking soda, /4 cup Butter - loni (white butter), Beetroot - peeled, to 7 Curry leaves, /2 tablespoon Green Chilli Paste, Salt, Sesame (Gingelly) Oil - as required
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Beetroot Loni Sponge Dosa recipe, wash rice 2 to 3 times and then along with Poha soak it for overnight in sour buttermilk.Next Morning, grind the soaked Rice and Poha into a smooth consistency batter in a mixer grinder.
2. Add salt giving it stir and keep it aside.In a mixer grinder, add the peeled beetroot, curry leaves and blend it without water into a paste.
3. Take a sieve and squeeze beet juice and add it to Sponge Dosa Batter.Add green chillies to the batter and mix the batter gently.Heat up a non-stick tawa and sprinkle water to check its temperature.
4. If there is a sizzle then its temperature is correct.Add cooking soda in the Dosa Batter and give it a quick whips in same direction.Pour in two ladles of batter on the tawa turning the flame to low.
5. Add oil across the edges and cover it with a lid.Take a Loni/Butter in your hand and drop it on sponge Dosa generously.
6. Let the butter smear on the Dosa.
7. Flip it on other side to get it more crusty.Serve Beetroot Loni Sponge Dosa with Mixed Vegetable Sambar and South Indian Coconut Chutney for a delicious and healthy breakfast.

title: Sweet & Spicy Stuffed Paneer In Kofta Curry Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Sweet & Spicy Stuffed Paneer In Kofta Curry Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Sweet & Spicy Stuffed Paneer In Kofta Curry Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) - cut into 1-inch cubes, Green Chilli - finely chopped, Ginger, Raisin, Cashew nuts - finely chopped, Badam (Almond) - finely chopped, Pistachios - finely chopped, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoons Gram flour (besan), Salt - To Taste, /4 teaspoon Cardamom Powder (Elaichi), Teaspoon Sunflower Oil, Bay Leaf (Tej Patta), Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed, Cinnamon, Cloves (Laung), Mace (Javitri), Star Anise, cup Homemade tomato puree, Inch Ginger, Cloves Garlic, Onion, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder, /4 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Cashew nuts - soaked and grind to a smooth paste, tablespoons Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), Salt - To Taste, tablespoon Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves), tablespoon Honey, /2 cup Fresh cream
Instructions:
1. To begin making Stuffed Paneer In Kofta Curry Recipe, we will begin with the stuffing for the panner.
2. Scoop out or cut out little paneer from the center of each cube.
3. You can use a melon scooper or with a small spoon.
4. Transfer the scooped out paneer to a bowl, crumble / grate and set aside.Heat oil in a heavy bottomed pan.
5. Add finely chopped green chillies and ginger, sauté until the ginger is fragrant.Add raisins and chopped nuts, sauté another 30 seconds.
6. Add this mixture to crumbled paneer along with, turmeric powder, besan, salt and cardamom powder.
7. Mix well to come.
8. Adjust the salt according to taste.Stuff this paneer and nut mixture in scooped out paneer cubes and press firmly.
9. Heat a teaspoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
10. Add the stuffed paneer pieces and pan fry the paneer cubes until lightly golden on both sides.
11. Once done remove from the pan and keep aside.
12. To begin making the kofta curry, grind the onion, ginger and garlic to a smooth paste.
13. Keep aside.Grind the cashewnuts along with a little water and make a smooth paste.
14. Keep aside.
15. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat;  add the whole spices and saute it for a few seconds until you can smell the aromas coming through.
16. Add the ginger garlic and onion paste and saute for about a minute until the raw smell goes away.At this stage, add the turmeric powder, coriander powder, and red chilli powder.
17. Adding the condiments to the onion ginger garlic paste helps further reduce the raw smell.
18. Saute for a few seconds and then add the tomato puree, cashewnut puree, salt to taste and the fresh cream.
19. Add a little water to adjust the consistency of the kofta gravy.
20. Simmer this kofta curry for 3 to 4 minutes until the flavors combine well.
21. Once done, turn off the heat, stir in the kasuri methi and check the salt and spices.
22. Adjust to suit your taste.Transfer the kofta curry to a serving bowl and when you are ready to serve, place the stuffed paneer in the curry and serve warm.
23. Serve your Stuffed Paneer Baskets with Punjabi Dal Tadka, Mixed Vegetable Pulao (Pilaf), Butter Garlic Naan, Kela Anar Raita for a perfect weekend dinner with family and friends.

title: Sichuan Style Zhong Shui Jiao Recipe (Caramelized Onion, Cabbage And Peas Dumplings In Red Oil Recipe)
content:
Recipe Name: Sichuan Style Zhong Shui Jiao Recipe (Caramelized Onion, Cabbage And Peas Dumplings In Red Oil Recipe)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Sichuan recipe for Sichuan Style Zhong Shui Jiao Recipe (Caramelized Onion, Cabbage And Peas Dumplings In Red Oil Recipe) (Side Dish).
Ingredients: Cup All Purpose Flour (Maida), Tablespoon Sunflower Oil, cup Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) - shredded, /2 cup Green peas (Matar), Onion, tablespoon Soy sauce, Tablespoon Red Chilli Sauce, teaspoon Honey, Salt - To Taste, tablespoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil, Tablespoon Red Chilli Sauce, teaspoon Sesame seeds (Til seeds), tablespoon Soy sauce, /3 cup Water, tablespoons Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar), Inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini), Star Anise, Inch Ginger
Instructions:
1. We begin making the Sichuan Style Zhong Shui Jiao Recipe (Caramelized Onion, Cabbage And Peas Dumplings in Red Oil Recipe) by mixing the ingredients to make a dough for the wonton wrappers in a large mixing bowl.
2. Add enough water to get a soft but not a sticky dough consistency.
3. Once done cover it with a damp cloth so that it does not become dry.The next step is to make the stuffing for the dumplings, heat a heavy bottomed shallow pan, and add oil and sauté the garlic, ginger onions, cabbage, peas and spring onions for about 10 minutes.
4. Cook until the cabbage is soft and crunchy.Once done add soya sauce, Sichuan chili paste, honey, salt and pepper according to your taste.
5. Give it a toss so that the sauces are well coated with all the vegetables.
6. Set it aside to cool down.Next to make the chili oil, heat a small flat bottomed pan, heat the oil and add the Sichuan chili paste and sesame seeds.
7. Let it cook in the oil for few minutes till the aroma comes out and keep it aside.To make the soya sauce concentration, heat a sauce pan with all the ingredients combined.
8. Keep the heat low and slowly let it boil and keep stirring occasionally to combine the ingredients well.
9. After 10 minutes switch off the heat.Now it is time to roll the wonton wrappers, divide the dough into small ball shaped balls, roll each ball on a board, the dough has to be rolled very thin making sure it does not tear.
10. Roll the dough into a circle shape.Once done, in a small bowl keep some water ready to bind the wonton mixture, Take a teaspoon of the filling and place it in the center of the rolled dough, dab some water on the edges of the dough.Form a taco shape and pinch at one end and seal till the middle, then join the opposite side to the middle to form a triangle shape.
11. Make sure all the edges are sealed properly.Heat a vegetable gas steamer by adding one cup of water below, apply some oil on the plate where the dumpling are kept, once the water starts to boil, place all the dumplings and cover them.
12. Let it cook for 5 minutes.Remove the dumplings after it is cooked, place it on a plate, add a teaspoon of chili oil and drizzle the concentrated soya on top and serve.Serve the Sichuan Style Zhong Shui Jiao Recipe (Caramelized Onion, Cabbage And Peas Dumplings in Red Oil Recipe) along withDinner meal.

title: Spicy Baby Potatoes Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Spicy Baby Potatoes Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic North Indian Recipes recipe for Spicy Baby Potatoes Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: Baby Potatoes, Sunflower Oil - As Required, Dry Red Chilli, Teaspoon Cumin Seeds (Jeera), sprig Curry leaves - optional, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), Teaspoon Cumin Powder (Jeera), teaspoon Red Chilli powder, teaspoon Garam masala powder, Teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder), Salt - To Taste, Lemon Juice, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Spicy Baby Potatoes recipe, pressure cook the baby potatoes and keep aside to cool.
2. Peel off the skin and collect the boiled potatoes in a bowl.Heat oil in a wok/kadhai and add dry red chilies, curry leaves, cumin and let them crackle.Now add all the spices (coriander powder, red chili powder, amchur, cumin powder, garam masala powder and turmeric). Saute it for few seconds, don't burn it.Add the baby potatoes and mix well with the spice mix.
3. Fry for 6-7 minutes in medium flames till everything incorporates well and the flavors gets along with the potatoes.Adjust salt as per your taste and add some lemon juice and mix again.Turn off the heat, add lot of chopped coriander and give a quick stir.
4. Serve Spicy Baby Potatoes along with Phulkas and Panchmel Dal for a weekday lunch or dinner.

title: Barley Whole Wheat Coffee Marble Cake Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Barley Whole Wheat Coffee Marble Cake Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Barley Whole Wheat Coffee Marble Cake Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: Cup Whole Wheat Flour, /4 cup Barley flour, Salt, cup Caster Sugar - (adjust), Whole Egg, /2 teaspoons Baking powder, Salt, teaspoons Instant Coffee Powder - (adjust based on its strength), tablespoons Lukewarm Water - (adjust)
Instructions:
1. To prepare Barley Wholewheat Coffee Marble Cake Recipe, preheat oven to 180 degree Celsius.In a large mixing bowl, beat together the sieved sugar and butter until the mixture turns pale, creamy and fluffy. [I used an electric beater for the whole process]Add the eggs one by one and continue to beat on low speed.
2. Once all the eggs have been added, beat for a few seconds on medium speed till all the ingredients have been mixed well.Sift together the flours, baking powder and salt.Now add the sifted flour mixture little by little and gently fold it in using a rubber spatula to form a creamy batter. [please note: do not use your electric beater for this process]Grease and line a cake tin.Now divide the prepared cake batter into 2 equal parts and add into 2 bowls.Mix the instant coffee powder in 2.5 tablespoons water to form a thick creamy coffee paste.Add the coffee paste into one portion of cake batter and gently fold it in till well incorporated. [do a taste test once fully mixed and add more coffee-warm water paste if you like a stronger flavor]Add the rest of the warm water to the plain cake batter and mix well.Now you have both your cake mixes ready.Into the prepared cake tin, first add a dollop of plain cake batter.
3. Follow it up by a dollop of coffee flavored cake batter.
4. Continue this process till you have used up your entire cake batter.Tap the bottom of your cake tin on your work surface, to ensure there are no air bubbles.Take a skewer/ toothpick and swirl it around the mixture in the tin a few times to create a marbled effect.Bake the cake at 180 degree Celsius for 40 to 45 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. [oven times may vary, so be careful not to burn your cake]Turn out onto a cooling rack and leave to cool.Slice and serve Barley Whole wheat Coffee Marble Cake Recipe with a glass of milk or just as it is.
5. Enjoy!

title: Chettinad Dry Pepper Chicken Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Chettinad Dry Pepper Chicken Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Chettinad recipe for Chettinad Dry Pepper Chicken Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: grams Chicken - (chicken with bones gives better taste), Onion, Tomatoe, sprig Curry leaves, Tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste, /2 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera) - roasted, teaspoon Fennel Powder - roasted, Tablespoon Coriander Powder (Dhania), /2 tablespoon Black pepper powder, Salt - To Taste, Sunflower Oil - As Required, Water - As Required, Teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Chettinad Dry Pepper Chicken Recipe, clean the chicken thoroughly and wash it well.Place it in a bowl,  then add about 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric powder and water until chicken in fully immersed and let it sit for 10 minutes.
2. After 10 minutes, drain the turmeric water and marinate with little salt.
3. This step of washing chicken in turmeric water will reduce the smell in the chicken.Heat oil in a kadai/wok on medium flame, add finely chopped onions and sauté till onions turn soft.Once the onions are soft, add ginger garlic paste and cook till the raw smell of the paste is gone.
4. Add curry leaves and mix well.At this stage add finely chopped tomatoes and cook till tomatoes turn soft and mushy.
5. This will take about 3-4 minutes.
6. Now add the marinated chettinad chicken and let it cook for 3-5 minutes.
7. Add all the spice powders- cumin powder, fennel seeds powder, coriander powder, crushed pepper or pepper powder and salt.Mix the Chettinad Dry Pepper Chicken and cook for another 5 minutes.
8. Now add about 1/4 cup water.
9. Cover and cook till the Chettinad Dry Pepper Chicken is fully cooked and all water is evaporated.
10. Once done, check the salt and spices and adjust accordingly.Hot, spicy, flavourful Chettinad Dry Pepper Chicken is ready to be served.Serve Chettinad Dry Pepper Chicken Recipe with Pickled onions as an appetizer.
11. Or you could also serve it as a side dish to a meal along wit steamed rice and Milagu Rasam Recipe (Village Style Pepper Rasam).

title: Andhra Style Palakura Pappu Recipe (Spinach Dal Recipe)
content:
Recipe Name: Andhra Style Palakura Pappu Recipe (Spinach Dal Recipe)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Andhra recipe for Andhra Style Palakura Pappu Recipe (Spinach Dal Recipe) (Main Course).
Ingredients: /2 cup Arhar dal (Split Toor Dal), /2 cup Yellow Moong Dal (Split), cup Spinach Leaves (Palak) - Washed and chopped, Onion, Green Chillies - Slit, Teaspoon Turmeric Powder (Haldi), /2 cup Tamarind Water, Salt - To Taste, Teaspoon Mustard Seed, Clove, sprig Curry leaves, Dry Red Chillie, Teaspoon Sunflower Oil
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Andhra Style Palakura Pappu, add Arhar dal/toor dal into a pressure cooker with 2 cups water and pressure cook for about 3 whistles.Switch off the heat and allow it release the pressure by itself.Once the pressure is released, open the lid and give it a stir.Place the pressure cooker on low heat and add the tamarind water.
2. In the meanwhile, heat a small kadai with 1 teaspoon oil.
3. Once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds and allow it splutter.
4. Add curry leaves and leave it to crackle.
5. Next add dry red chilies and garlic, saute for few seconds and turn off the flame.
6. Pour this tempering over the Palakura Pappu and stir well.
7. Serve Andhra Style Palakura Pappu with Phulka or hot steamed rice with a dollop of ghee over it, and Aloo Bhindi Ki Sabzi Recipe to enjoy your lunch.

title: Rich Dark Chocolate Mousse Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Rich Dark Chocolate Mousse Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Rich Dark Chocolate Mousse Recipe (Desserts).
Ingredients: grams Dark chocolate - chopped, teaspoon Sprig Extract of Natural Bourbon Vanilla, Egg yolks, Egg whites, /2 cup Caster Sugar - + 3 Tablespoons, /4 cup Fresh cream - chilled and strained from water
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Rich Dark Chocolate Mousse Recipe, we will first melt the chocolate.
2. For this, heat about 1 inch of water in a large pan till it boils.
3. Reduce the heat to low and maintain the temperature.
4. We will use this skillet water for double boiling and melting the chocolate.In a sauce pan add the chocolate and vanilla essence . Set the bowl in the water bath and stir until the chocolate is melted and smooth.
5. Remove from the water bath and set aside to cool.In a heat proof bowl whisk together the egg yolks, coffee and 3 tablespoons of sugar.
6. Set the bowl in the same water bath, whisking constantly until thick and fluffy almost like a marshmallow.
7. Remove from the water bath and whisk this mixture into the chocolate mixture thoroughly.
8. Allow it to cool completely.While the above mixture is cooling.
9. In a large bowl, whisk together the egg whites and cream of tartar and gradually beat in the powdered sugar, until stiff peaks are formed.Using a wooden or rubber spatula, stir half of the egg whites into the chocolate egg mixture to lighten it.
10. Then gently fold in the remaining whites.
11. Gradually add in the heavy cream and whisk gently until soft peaks form.Transfer the Rich Dark Chocolate Mousse into eight 6 oz ramekins or mini cups or a large bowl.
12. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours or up to one day.Serve the Rich Dark Chocolate Mousse cold as it is or with whipped cream and berries.
13. You can also sprinkle the mousse with grated chocolate.For the Eggless MousseHeat about 1 inch of water in a large skillet/pan until bubbles form.
14. Reduce the heat to low and maintain the temperature.
15. We will use this skillet water for double boiling.In a sauce pan add the chocolate and vanilla essence . Set the bowl in the water bath and stir until the coffee and chocolate is melted and smooth.
16. Remove from the water bath and set aside to cool.
17. Once cooled, stir in the dissolved agar agar/china grass.Once cooled completely add in the heavy cream and whisk gently to combine all the ingredients well.Transfer the Rich Dark Chocolate Mousse into ramekins or mini cups or a large bowl.
18. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours or up to one day.Serve this Dark Chocolate Mousse after a meal of Lemon Coriander Soup Recipe, Mozzarella Basil Sandwiches Recipe.

title: Qahwa | Arabic Coffee Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Qahwa | Arabic Coffee Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Arab recipe for Qahwa | Arabic Coffee Recipe (Appetizers).
Ingredients: tablespoon Green Coffee beans - lightly roasted and coarsely ground, tablespoon Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds - crushed, Cups Water, /8 teaspoon Saffron strands - optional, teaspoon Rose water - optional
Instructions:
1. To make this traditional Qahwa/ Qahwah – Arabic Coffee Recipe, bring water to boil in a saucepan.
2. When it boils, add ground coffee.After 10 minutes of boiling, add cloves, crushed cardamom and stir once and boil for another 4 to 5 minutes.Now switch off the flame, cover and let coffee grounds settle at the bottom for a minute.
3. Do not stir at this time since the liquid needs to settle.Now add the rose water and saffron if you are using them.Strain and pour the steaming coffee into the flask or teapot.Now Qahwa | Arabic Coffee Recipe is ready to be served hot in dallah/kulhar.
4. Serve with dates during evenings and Enjoy!!You can also serve the Qahwa | Arabic Coffee Recipe Eggless Ragi & Whole Wheat Crisp Biscuits Recipe or Whole Wheat Apple Muffins Recipe (Eggless & Vegan options) to enjoy your evening tea.

title: Broccoli Corn & Barley Soup Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Broccoli Corn & Barley Soup Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Continental recipe for Broccoli Corn & Barley Soup Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Barley (seeds) - soaked for 2-6 hours, cup Broccoli - florets, /4 cup Green peas (Matar) - fresh or frozen, /4 cup Sweet corn, /4 cup Green beans (French Beans) - chopped, /2 cup Carrots (Gajjar) - thinly sliced in strips, cup Rocket leaves - or spinach leaves, Tomatoe, Onion, Clove, Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, teaspoon Basil leaves, teaspoon Fresh Thyme leaves, Teaspoon Red Chilli Flake, Salt - To Taste, Black pepper powder - to taste, teaspoons Corn flour, Water - As Required, Sour cream - to serve
Instructions:
1. To prepare Broccoli Corn & Barley Soup Recipe, wash and soak pearl barley in 2 cups of water for 2 to 6 hours.Drain and place them in a saucepan with 2 cups of water and a dash of salt.
2. Bring it to boil and then simmer and let it cook for 15 minutes.Once cooked drain the excess water and set it aside.In another saucepan, heat olive oil.
3. Add minced garlic and onion and saute for 2-3 minutes until slightly brown in colour.Now add all the chopped vegetables except rocket leaves, tomatoes, salt, pepper, basil, thyme and chilli flakes.
4. Stir and cook for a minute.Add in 4 cups of water and let it boil.
5. Once boiled keep the heat on low to medium and cook for 15 minutes.Now add the drained pearl barley and rocket leaves.
6. Stir and add cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons of water.Stir and let the soup thickened a little.Remove from heat.
7. Season with more salt and pepper if desired.Serve Broccoli Corn & Barley Soup Recipe warm with a dollop of sour cream, pair it up with Cauliflower Chutney Grilled Sandwich or any sandwich of your choice.

title: Spirulina And Mint Basil Pesto Pasta Recipe
content:
Recipe Name: Spirulina And Mint Basil Pesto Pasta Recipe
Description: A flavorful and authentic Italian Recipes recipe for Spirulina And Mint Basil Pesto Pasta Recipe (Main Course).
Ingredients: cup Basil leaves, /2 cup Mint Leaves (Pudina), tablespoon Spirulina, /2 cup Badam (Almond) - blanched, Cloves Garlic, /2 cup Tofu, teaspoon Black pepper powder, Salt, /4 cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil, cup Pasta, Clove, cup Green zucchini - diced, Yellow Bell Pepper (Capsicum) - diced, Tomato - diced, Teaspoon Red Chilli Flake, teaspoon Dried oregano, Salt - To Taste
Instructions:
1. We begin making the Spirulina and Mint Basil Pesto Pasta Recipe by first making the pesto.
2. For that wash the herbs and put all the ingredients in a blender and blend it into a coarse mixture.
3. Once done keep it aside.Next is to boil the pasta, for that heat a sauce pan with enough water and add a little salt and let it boil, once it starts boiling add in the pasta and then boil till it is al dante stage (Just done).Strain the water and run the pasta under cold water and drizzle with olive oil and coat it well.Heat a sauce pan with oil, add chopped garlic and the rest of the vegetables except tomato and saute them well till it is cooked but still firm.Once done switch off the flame add the seasoning and the tomato.
4. Also add in the cooked pasta and the pesto.
5. Mix well till it combines.
6. Serve the Spirulina and Mint Basil Pesto Pasta Recipe along with Fresh Vegetable Salad Bowl to enjoy your Lunch meal.

title: Goan Style Sando Recipe (Steamed Rice Cakes Filled With Sweet Coconut)
content:
Recipe Name: Goan Style Sando Recipe (Steamed Rice Cakes Filled With Sweet Coconut)
Description: A flavorful and authentic Goan Recipes recipe for Goan Style Sando Recipe (Steamed Rice Cakes Filled With Sweet Coconut) (Desserts).
Ingredients: /2 cup Red matta rice - parboiled, /4 cup Basmati rice, /4 cup White Urad Dal (Split), cup Coconut milk - or toddy, tablespoon Sugar, teaspoon Active dry yeast, Salt - To Taste, /2 Cup Fresh Coconut - Grated, /2 cup Jaggery, Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seed
Instructions:
1. To begin making the Goan Style Sando Recipe (Steamed Rice Cakes Filled With Sweet Coconut)soak parboiled matta rice, basmati rice and urad dal in water for atleast 4 hours.After 4 hours, grind the rice and urad dal to a smooth paste.
2. The batter must be smooth and not grainy.You will now mix toddy, yeast, sugar and leave it to ferment for atleast 4 hours which will make the batter to rise well.
3. Make sure you keep this in a warmer place.Meanwhile heat powdered jaggery with 1/4 cup water and cardamom in a saucepan, until all the jaggery melts, add grated coconut and keep cooking until the jaggery thickens.
4. Once done switch off the heat and allow it to rest.Once the batter is risen well.
5. You can keep your idli steamer on with enough water below to steam.Grease the idli trays with oil, Mix the risen batter with salt and keep stirring until the salt is evenly distributed.
6. Pour the batter carefully into each cavity.After that is done, sprinkle little of the sweet coconut mixture on top of the batter and keep it inside the steamer and steam for atleast 10 minutes.
7. After 10 minutes, If it is not found sticky then it is done.Switch off the heat, take out the trays and keep it aside to cool down.
8. By using a knife go around the edges and flip the sandons on to a serving plate and do the same for rest.Serve the Goan Style Sando Recipe after a meal of Spinach Rice Recipe (Palak Pulao) and Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita Recipe by the side.

4. Serve hot alongside fresh mint chutney and onion rings.

title: Tandoori Chicken Soup
content:
Recipe Name: Tandoori Chicken Soup
Description: Hearty dinner dish: Tandoori Chicken Soup.
Ingredients: Chilli Powder, Corn Starch, Ginger, Chicken, Oil, Onion, Broth
Instructions:
1. Gather and prepare all raw ingredients.
2. Marinate or sauté with Tandoori spices and let rest.
3. Boil broth with vegetables/protein, thicken with corn starch, season.
4. Serve hot alongside fresh mint chutney and onion rings.

title: Ragi Sangati
content:
Recipe Name: Ragi Sangati
Description: Traditional wholesome Andhra style Ragi Mudda prepared from finger millet and rice.
Ingredients: Ragi Flour, Rice, Water, Salt, Ghee
Instructions:
1. Boil water in a heavy bottomed vessel and add soaked rice.
2. Once rice is cooked soft, add ragi flour in the center without stirring.
3. Let it cook on low heat for 5-7 minutes, then blend thoroughly using a wooden stick.
4. Shape into balls using wet hands and top with fresh ghee.

title: Sarvapindi
content:
Recipe Name: Sarvapindi
Description: Telangana traditional savory rice flour pancake with peanuts and chana dal.
Ingredients: Rice Flour, Peanuts, Chana Dal, Green Chilli, Sesame Seeds, Onion, Curry Leaves
Instructions:
1. Mix rice flour, soaked chana dal, peanuts, sesame seeds, chopped onions, chillies, and salt.
2. Knead into a soft dough adding water gradually.
3. Grease a wide copper or iron pan (sarva), press the dough evenly into a thin layer.
4. Make small holes, fill with oil, cover and cook on medium flame till golden and crispy.

title: Akki Roti
content:
Recipe Name: Akki Roti
Description: Karnataka style rice flour flatbread with onions, dill leaves, and green chillies.
Ingredients: Rice Flour, Dill Leaves, Onion, Green Chilli, Grated Coconut, Cumin Seeds
Instructions:
1. Mix rice flour with finely chopped dill leaves, onions, green chillies, grated coconut, and cumin seeds.
2. Add water and knead to a soft dough.
3. Pat the dough directly onto a cold greased griddle.
4. Cook covered on medium flame, drizzle oil, flip and cook till crispy.

title: Bisi Bele Bath
content:
Recipe Name: Bisi Bele Bath
Description: Rich traditional hot lentil rice dish from Karnataka cuisine.
Ingredients: Rice, Toor Dal, Mixed Vegetables, Bisi Bele Bath Powder, Tamarind Juice, Ghee, Cashews
Instructions:
1. Pressure cook rice and toor dal till mushy.
2. Boil mixed vegetables with tamarind juice and bisi bele bath masala powder.
3. Combine cooked rice, dal, and veggies, simmer together with ghee and water to reach flowing consistency.
4. Temper with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and roasted cashews.

title: Andhra Chicken Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Andhra Chicken Curry
Description: Spicy and aromatic traditional Andhra style chicken gravy cooked with special spice mix.
Ingredients: Chicken, Garam Masala, Chilli Powder, Onion, Ginger-Garlic Paste, Coconut Powder, Curry Leaves
Instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with turmeric, chilli powder, salt, and ginger-garlic paste for 30 minutes.
2. Sauté onions, green chillies, and curry leaves in oil.
3. Add marinated chicken and cook till water evaporates.
4. Stir in coconut powder and ground spice paste, add water and simmer till gravy thickens.

title: Gongura Chicken Curry
content:
Recipe Name: Gongura Chicken Curry
Description: Spicy chicken curry prepared with tangy sorrel leaves (Gongura) in Andhra style.
Ingredients: Chicken, Gongura Leaves (Sorrel), Onion, Green Chilli, Ginger-Garlic Paste, Spices
Instructions:
1. Boil gongura leaves with green chillies, mash into a fine paste and set aside.
2. Sauté onions and spices, add chicken and cook till tender.
3. Add the mashed gongura paste to the chicken curry.
4. Simmer for 10 minutes to allow the chicken to absorb the tangy gongura flavor.

title: Natu Kodi Pulusu
content:
Recipe Name: Natu Kodi Pulusu
Description: Country chicken (Natu Kodi) curry cooked in a fiery, thin gravy, popular in Rayalaseema.
Ingredients: Country Chicken, Andhra Chili Powder, Poppy Seeds Paste, Onion, Ginger-Garlic Paste, Garam Masala
Instructions:
1. Clean country chicken and pressure cook with turmeric and salt until tender.
2. Sauté onions, curry leaves, and tomatoes in a deep pot.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste and poppy seeds paste, fry until oil separates.
4. Add chicken, cooked broth, chili powder, and garam masala, simmer on high heat to form pulusu gravy.
